termTranslations.vi: Cài đặt mã máy phát đáp
termTranslations.th: ตั้งค่ารหัสทรานสพอนเดอร์

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: Cessna 123AB, transponder kodunu 4721 olarak ayarla ve 119.2 frekansında kalkışla iletişime geç.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour: Cessna 123AB, réglez le code transpondeur sur 4721 et contactez le départ sur 119.2.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: Cessna 123AB, stellen Sie den Transpondercode auf 4721 ein und kontaktieren Sie den Abflug auf 119.2.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: Cessna 123AB, ajuste el código del transpondedor a 4721 y contacte salida en 119.2.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：Cessna 123AB，设置应答机代码为4721，并在119.2联系离场。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: سيسنا 123AB، اضبط رمز جهاز الاستجابة على 4721 واتصل بالمغادرة على 119.2.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: Cessna 123AB, ajuste o código do transponder para 4721 e contate a partida em 119.2.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: Cessna 123AB, установите код транспондера 4721 и свяжитесь с вылетом на 119.2.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：セスナ123AB、トランスポンダコードを4721に設定し、119.2で出発と連絡してください。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: Cessna 123AB, imposta il codice del transponder su 4721 e contatta la partenza su 119.2.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: Cessna 123AB, cài đặt mã máy phát đáp 4721 và liên lạc với khởi hành trên 119.2.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: सेसना 123AB, ट्रांसपोंडर कोड 4721 सेट करें और 119.2 पर प्रस्थान से संपर्क करें।
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุม: Cessna 123AB, ตั้งค่ารหัสทรานสพอนเดอร์เป็น 4721 และติดต่อการออกเดินทางที่ 119.2
usageTranslations.id: Menara: Cessna 123AB, atur kode transponder ke 4721 dan hubungi keberangkatan di 119.2.

terms.definition: An instruction for a pilot to set the aircraft's transponder to standby mode, ceasing transmission of the transponder signal.
terms.usage: Approach: N123AB, squawk standby until further advised.

termTranslations.fr: Réglez le transpondeur en mode veille
termTranslations.es: Ponga el transpondedor en modo de espera
termTranslations.zh: 将应答机设置为待机模式
termTranslations.ar: اضبط جهاز الاستجابة على وضع الاستعداد
termTranslations.pt: Coloque o transponder em modo de espera
termTranslations.ja: トランスポンダをスタンバイモードに設定
termTranslations.it: Imposta il transponder in modalità standby
termTranslations.vi: Đặt máy phát đáp ở chế độ chờ
termTranslations.hi: ट्रांसपोंडर को स्टैंडबाय मोड में सेट करें
termTranslations.th: ตั้งค่าทรานสพอนเดอร์เป็นโหมดสแตนด์บาย

usageTranslations.tr: Yaklaşma: N123AB, başka bir talimata kadar transponderı bekleme moduna al.
usageTranslations.fr: Approche : N123AB, réglez le transpondeur en mode veille jusqu'à nouvel ordre.
usageTranslations.de: Anflug: N123AB, setzen Sie den Transponder auf Standby, bis weitere Anweisungen erfolgen.
usageTranslations.es: Aproximación: N123AB, ponga el transpondedor en modo de espera hasta nuevo aviso.
usageTranslations.zh: 进近：N123AB，将应答机设置为待机，等待进一步指示。
usageTranslations.ar: الاقتراب: N123AB، اضبط جهاز الاستجابة على وضع الاستعداد حتى إشعار آخر.
usageTranslations.pt: Aproximação: N123AB, coloque o transponder em modo de espera até nova orientação.
usageTranslations.ru: Заход: N123AB, установите транспондер в режим ожидания до дальнейших указаний.
usageTranslations.ja: アプローチ：N123AB、さらなる指示があるまでトランスポンダをスタンバイモードに設定してください。
usageTranslations.it: Avvicinamento: N123AB, imposta il transponder in modalità standby fino a nuovo avviso.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp cận: N123AB, đặt máy phát đáp ở chế độ chờ cho đến khi có thông báo tiếp theo.
usageTranslations.hi: एप्रोच: N123AB, आगे की सूचना तक ट्रांसपोंडर को स्टैंडबाय मोड में रखें।
usageTranslations.th: การเข้าใกล้: N123AB, ตั้งค่าทรานสพอนเดอร์เป็นโหมดสแตนด์บายจนกว่าจะมีคำแนะนำเพิ่มเติม
usageTranslations.id: Pendekatan: N123AB, atur transponder ke mode siaga hingga pemberitahuan lebih lanjut.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction to activate the IDENT feature on the aircraft's transponder, which causes the radar return to flash, allowing identification of the aircraft.
terms.usage: Radar: Speedbird 121, squawk ident for identification.

termTranslations.ja: スクォーク・アイデント
termTranslations.th: ส่งสัญญาณระบุตัวตน

usageTranslations.tr: Radar: Speedbird 121, tanımlama için ident kodla.
usageTranslations.fr: Radar : Speedbird 121, répondez ident pour identification.
usageTranslations.de: Radar: Speedbird 121, senden Sie Ident zur Identifikation.
usageTranslations.es: Radar: Speedbird 121, marque ident para identificación.
usageTranslations.zh: 雷达：Speedbird 121，请按识别按钮以便识别。
usageTranslations.ar: الرادار: Speedbird 121، أرسل إشارة التحديد للتعريف.
usageTranslations.pt: Radar: Speedbird 121, acione ident para identificação.
usageTranslations.ru: Радар: Speedbird 121, включите идентификацию для опознавания.
usageTranslations.ja: レーダー：Speedbird 121、識別のためにIDENTを送信してください。
usageTranslations.it: Radar: Speedbird 121, traspondi ident per identificazione.
usageTranslations.vi: Radar: Speedbird 121, phát mã ident để nhận diện.
usageTranslations.hi: रडार: स्पीडबर्ड 121, पहचान के लिए स्क्वॉक आइडेंट करें।
usageTranslations.th: เรดาร์: Speedbird 121, ส่งสัญญาณ ident เพื่อยืนยันตัวตน
usageTranslations.id: Radar: Speedbird 121, aktifkan ident untuk identifikasi.

terms.definition: A function on the aircraft transponder that, when activated, causes the radar return to flash on the controller’s screen for identification.
terms.usage: Radar: N123AB, radar contact not established, try ident now.

termTranslations.th: ident

usageTranslations.tr: Radar: N123AB, radar teması kurulamadı, şimdi ident deneyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Radar : N123AB, contact radar non établi, essayez ident maintenant.
usageTranslations.de: Radar: N123AB, kein Radarkontakt, senden Sie jetzt Ident.
usageTranslations.es: Radar: N123AB, contacto radar no establecido, intente ident ahora.
usageTranslations.zh: 雷达：N123AB，未建立雷达联系，请现在尝试发送识别信号。
usageTranslations.ar: الرادار: N123AB، لم يتم الاتصال بالرادار، جرّب الآن التحديد.
usageTranslations.pt: Radar: N123AB, contato de radar não estabelecido, tente ident agora.
usageTranslations.ru: Радар: N123AB, радиолокационный контакт не установлен, включите идентификацию.
usageTranslations.ja: レーダー：N123AB、レーダー接触なし、今IDENTを試してください。
usageTranslations.it: Radar: N123AB, contatto radar non stabilito, prova ident ora.
usageTranslations.vi: Radar: N123AB, chưa có liên lạc radar, hãy thử ident bây giờ.
usageTranslations.hi: रडार: N123AB, रडार संपर्क स्थापित नहीं हुआ, अभी आइडेंट ट्राय करें।
usageTranslations.th: เรดาร์: N123AB, ยังไม่พบการติดต่อด้วยเรดาร์ ลองใช้ ident ตอนนี้
usageTranslations.id: Radar: N123AB, kontak radar belum terjalin, coba ident sekarang.

terms.definition: Phrase used by pilots to confirm that they have visually acquired the reported traffic.
terms.usage: Tower, N521AB, traffic in sight, we’ll maintain visual separation.

termTranslations.th: เห็นการจราจรทางอากาศ

usageTranslations.tr: Kule, N521AB, trafik görüşte, görsel ayrımı sürdüreceğiz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, N521AB, trafic en vue, nous maintiendrons la séparation visuelle.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, N521AB, Verkehr in Sicht, wir halten Sichttrennung.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, N521AB, tráfico a la vista, mantendremos separación visual.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，N521AB，目视到交通，将保持目视间隔。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، N521AB، رأينا الحركة الجوية، سنحافظ على الفصل البصري.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, N521AB, tráfego à vista, manteremos separação visual.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня, N521AB, трафик вижу, сохраняем визуальное разделение.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、N521AB、トラフィック視認、目視分離を維持します。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, N521AB, traffico in vista, manterremo separazione visiva.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp kiểm soát, N521AB, đã thấy máy bay khác, duy trì cách ly bằng mắt.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर, N521AB, ट्रैफिक देखा गया है, हम विज़ुअल सेपरेशन बनाए रखेंगे।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์, N521AB, เห็นการจราจรแล้ว จะรักษาระยะห่างด้วยสายตา
usageTranslations.id: Tower, N521AB, lalu lintas terlihat, kami akan jaga pemisahan visual.

terms.definition: Phrase used by pilots to indicate that they do not have visual contact with the reported traffic.
terms.usage: Approach, N521AB, negative contact, looking out for traffic.

termTranslations.th: ไม่พบการจราจร

usageTranslations.tr: Yaklaşma, N521AB, temas yok, trafik için gözlüyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Approche, N521AB, contact négatif, nous cherchons le trafic.
usageTranslations.de: Anflug, N521AB, kein Sichtkontakt, wir halten Ausschau.
usageTranslations.es: Aproximación, N521AB, sin contacto visual, buscando el tráfico.
usageTranslations.zh: 进近，N521AB，未目视到交通，正在观察。
usageTranslations.ar: اقتراب، N521AB، لا يوجد اتصال، نبحث عن الحركة الجوية.
usageTranslations.pt: Aproximação, N521AB, sem contato, observando o tráfego.
usageTranslations.ru: Подход, N521AB, нет контакта, наблюдаем за трафиком.
usageTranslations.ja: アプローチ、N521AB、トラフィック未視認、確認中。
usageTranslations.it: Avvicinamento, N521AB, nessun contatto, cerchiamo il traffico.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp cận, N521AB, chưa thấy máy bay khác, đang quan sát.
usageTranslations.hi: एप्रोच, N521AB, संपर्क नहीं है, ट्रैफिक देख रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: แอพโพรช, N521AB, ไม่พบการจราจร กำลังตรวจสอบ
usageTranslations.id: Approach, N521AB, tidak ada kontak visual, kami sedang mengamati lalu lintas.

terms.definition: An instruction to continue holding a specified altitude, heading, speed, or other parameter until further advised.
terms.usage: Climb and maintain flight level three five zero.

termTranslations.th: คงไว้

usageTranslations.tr: Tırman ve uçuş seviyesi üç beş sıfırı koru.
usageTranslations.fr: Montez et maintenez le niveau de vol trois cinq zéro.
usageTranslations.de: Steigen Sie und halten Sie Flugfläche drei fünf null.
usageTranslations.es: Ascienda y mantenga nivel de vuelo tres cinco cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 爬升并保持飞行高度三五零。
usageTranslations.ar: اصعد وحافظ على مستوى الطيران ثلاثة خمسة صفر.
usageTranslations.pt: Suba e mantenha o nível de voo três cinco zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Наберите и сохраняйте эшелон три пять ноль.
usageTranslations.ja: 上昇してフライトレベル350を維持してください。
usageTranslations.it: Salire e mantenere livello di volo tre cinque zero.
usageTranslations.vi: Tăng lên và duy trì mức bay ba năm không.
usageTranslations.hi: चढ़ाई करें और फ़्लाइट लेवल तीन पांच शून्य बनाए रखें।
usageTranslations.th: ไต่และคงระดับการบินสามห้าศูนย์
usageTranslations.id: Naik dan pertahankan ketinggian tiga lima nol.

terms.definition: An instruction to continue on the magnetic heading of the runway after takeoff without turning, usually for departure sequencing or obstacle avoidance.
terms.usage: After departure, maintain runway heading until passing 3000 feet.

termTranslations.ja: 滑走路方位を維持して
termTranslations.th: คงทิศทางตามรันเวย์

usageTranslations.tr: Kalkış sonrası, 3000 feet geçilene kadar pist istikametini koru.
usageTranslations.fr: Après le décollage, maintenez le cap piste jusqu'à 3000 pieds.
usageTranslations.de: Nach dem Start Kurs der Piste halten bis 3000 Fuß.
usageTranslations.es: Después del despegue, mantenga rumbo pista hasta pasar 3000 pies.
usageTranslations.zh: 起飞后保持跑道航向，直到通过3000英尺。
usageTranslations.ar: بعد الإقلاع، حافظ على اتجاه المدرج حتى تجاوز 3000 قدم.
usageTranslations.pt: Após a decolagem, mantenha a proa da pista até passar 3000 pés.
usageTranslations.ru: После взлета сохраняйте курс ВПП до 3000 футов.
usageTranslations.ja: 離陸後、3000フィートを通過するまで滑走路方位を維持してください。
usageTranslations.it: Dopo il decollo, mantieni prua pista fino a 3000 piedi.
usageTranslations.vi: Sau khi cất cánh, duy trì hướng đường băng đến 3000 feet.
usageTranslations.hi: टेकऑफ़ के बाद, 3000 फीट तक रनवे हेडिंग बनाए रखें।
usageTranslations.th: หลังจากขึ้นบิน ให้คงทิศทางรันเวย์จนกว่าจะผ่าน 3000 ฟุต
usageTranslations.id: Setelah lepas landas, pertahankan heading landasan hingga melewati 3000 kaki.

terms.definition: Instruction to the pilot to continue flying at the present assigned altitude.
terms.usage: Delta 245, maintain current altitude until advised otherwise.

termTranslations.vi: Duy trì độ cao hiện tại
termTranslations.th: รักษาระดับความสูงปัจจุบัน

usageTranslations.tr: Delta 245, başka bir talimat verilene kadar mevcut irtifayı koruyun.
usageTranslations.fr: Delta 245, maintenez l'altitude actuelle jusqu'à nouvel ordre.
usageTranslations.de: Delta 245, halten Sie die aktuelle Flughöhe bis auf Weiteres.
usageTranslations.es: Delta 245, mantenga la altitud actual hasta nuevo aviso.
usageTranslations.zh: Delta 245，在另行通知前保持当前高度。
usageTranslations.ar: دلتا 245، حافظ على الارتفاع الحالي حتى إشعار آخر.
usageTranslations.pt: Delta 245, mantenha a altitude atual até nova instrução.
usageTranslations.ru: Delta 245, сохраняйте текущий эшелон до дальнейших указаний.
usageTranslations.ja: デルタ245、次の指示があるまで現在の高度を維持してください。
usageTranslations.it: Delta 245, mantieni l'altitudine attuale fino a nuovo ordine.
usageTranslations.vi: Delta 245, duy trì độ cao hiện tại cho đến khi có chỉ thị khác.
usageTranslations.hi: डेल्टा 245, अगले निर्देश तक वर्तमान ऊंचाई बनाए रखें।
usageTranslations.th: Delta 245, รักษาระดับความสูงปัจจุบันจนกว่าจะมีคำสั่งใหม่
usageTranslations.id: Delta 245, pertahankan ketinggian saat ini sampai ada instruksi lebih lanjut.

terms.definition: Instruction for the aircraft to begin climbing to the stated altitude and maintain that altitude when reached.
terms.usage: United 357, climb and maintain flight level three two zero.

termTranslations.vi: Tăng độ cao và duy trì
termTranslations.th: ไต่ระดับและคงไว้

usageTranslations.tr: United 357, uçuş seviyesi üç iki sıfıra tırman ve koru.
usageTranslations.fr: United 357, montez et maintenez niveau de vol trois deux zéro.
usageTranslations.de: United 357, steigen Sie und halten Sie Flugfläche drei zwei null.
usageTranslations.es: United 357, ascienda y mantenga nivel de vuelo tres dos cero.
usageTranslations.zh: United 357，爬升并保持飞行高度三二零。
usageTranslations.ar: يونايتد 357، اصعد وابق على مستوى الطيران ثلاثة اثنان صفر.
usageTranslations.pt: United 357, suba e mantenha nível de voo três dois zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Юнайтед 357, набирайте и удерживайте эшелон три два ноль.
usageTranslations.ja: ユナイテッド357、フライトレベル320まで上昇して維持してください。
usageTranslations.it: United 357, sali e mantieni livello di volo tre due zero.
usageTranslations.vi: United 357, tăng lên và duy trì mức bay ba hai mươi.
usageTranslations.hi: यूनाइटेड 357, फ्लाइट लेवल तीन दो शून्य तक चढ़ें और बनाए रखें।
usageTranslations.th: United 357, ไต่ระดับและคงที่ที่ระดับการบินสามสองศูนย์
usageTranslations.id: United 357, naik dan pertahankan level penerbangan tiga dua nol.

terms.definition: An instruction to begin descent and level off at the specified altitude, maintaining it until further clearance is issued.
terms.usage: Descend and maintain one one thousand feet, American 317.

termTranslations.vi: Giảm độ cao và duy trì
termTranslations.th: ลดระดับและคงไว้

usageTranslations.tr: Alçal ve on bir bin feet'i koru, American 317.
usageTranslations.fr: Descendez et maintenez onze mille pieds, American 317.
usageTranslations.de: Sinkflug auf elftausend Fuß und halten, American 317.
usageTranslations.es: Descienda y mantenga once mil pies, American 317.
usageTranslations.zh: 下降并保持一万一千英尺，American 317。
usageTranslations.ar: انخفض واحتفظ بارتفاع 11000 قدم، American 317.
usageTranslations.pt: Desça e mantenha onze mil pés, American 317.
usageTranslations.ru: Снижайтесь и удерживайте 11000 футов, American 317.
usageTranslations.ja: アメリカン317、11000フィートまで降下して維持せよ。
usageTranslations.it: Scendi e mantieni undicimila piedi, American 317.
usageTranslations.vi: Giảm xuống và duy trì 11000 feet, American 317.
usageTranslations.hi: 11000 फीट तक नीचे आएं और बनाए रखें, American 317.
usageTranslations.th: ลดระดับและคงไว้ที่ 11000 ฟุต, American 317
usageTranslations.id: Turun dan pertahankan 11000 kaki, American 317.

terms.definition: An instruction to initiate a climb to a specific altitude and level off upon reaching it, unless otherwise directed.
terms.usage: Climb to flight level two seven zero, Delta 406.

termTranslations.th: ไต่ไปที่

usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi iki yedi sıfıra tırman, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.fr: Montez au niveau de vol deux sept zéro, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.de: Steigen Sie auf Flugfläche zwei sieben null, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.es: Ascienda a nivel de vuelo dos siete cero, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.zh: 爬升至飞行高度二七零，Delta 406。
usageTranslations.ar: اصعد إلى مستوى الطيران 270، Delta 406.
usageTranslations.pt: Suba para o nível de voo dois sete zero, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.ru: Наберите эшелон два семь ноль, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.ja: フライトレベル270まで上昇してください、Delta 406。
usageTranslations.it: Salire a livello di volo due sette zero, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.vi: Tăng lên mức bay hai bảy không, Delta 406.
usageTranslations.hi: फ़्लाइट लेवल 270 तक चढ़ें, Delta 406।
usageTranslations.th: ไต่ไปที่ระดับการบินสองเจ็ดศูนย์, Delta 406
usageTranslations.id: Naik ke flight level dua tujuh nol, Delta 406.

terms.definition: An instruction from air traffic control directing an aircraft to decrease altitude to a specified level.
terms.usage: Tower: Speedbird 123, descend to altitude 3000 feet.

termTranslations.th: ลดระดับลงไปที่

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: Speedbird 123, 3000 feet irtifaya inişe geçin.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour: Speedbird 123, descendez à l'altitude de 3000 pieds.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: Speedbird 123, sinkflug auf 3000 Fuß.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: Speedbird 123, descienda a una altitud de 3000 pies.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：Speedbird 123，下降到3000英尺高度。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: سبيدبيرد 123، انحدر إلى ارتفاع 3000 قدم.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: Speedbird 123, desça para a altitude de 3000 pés.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: Speedbird 123, снижайтесь до высоты 3000 футов.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：スピードバード123、3000フィートまで降下してください。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: Speedbird 123, scendere a quota 3000 piedi.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: Speedbird 123, giảm độ cao xuống 3000 feet.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर: स्पीडबर्ड 123, 3000 फीट की ऊंचाई तक नीचे उतरें।
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุม: Speedbird 123, ลดระดับลงไปที่ความสูง 3000 ฟุต
usageTranslations.id: Menara: Speedbird 123, turun ke ketinggian 3000 kaki.

terms.definition: A standardised altitude expressed in hundreds of feet, based on a pressure setting of 1013.2 hPa.
terms.usage: ATC: Emirates 789, climb to flight level 350.

termTranslations.th: ระดับการบิน

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: Emirates 789, uçuş seviyesi 350'ye tırmanın.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC: Emirates 789, montez au niveau de vol 350.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: Emirates 789, steigen Sie auf Flugfläche 350.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: Emirates 789, ascienda al nivel de vuelo 350.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：Emirates 789，爬升到飞行高度层350。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: طيران الإمارات 789، اصعد إلى مستوى الطيران 350.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: Emirates 789, suba para o nível de voo 350.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: Emirates 789, набирайте эшелон 350.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC：エミレーツ789、フライトレベル350まで上昇してください。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: Emirates 789, salire al livello di volo 350.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: Emirates 789, leo lên mức bay 350.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: एमिरेट्स 789, उड़ान स्तर 350 तक चढ़ें।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: Emirates 789, ไต่ระดับขึ้นไปที่ระดับการบิน 350
usageTranslations.id: ATC: Emirates 789, naik ke level penerbangan 350.

terms.definition: A term used by pilots to report the altitude they are currently climbing or descending through.
terms.usage: Climbing to one four thousand, passing one one thousand, Delta 423.

termTranslations.th: กำลังผ่าน

usageTranslations.tr: On dört bin feet'e tırmanıyorum, on bir bini geçiyorum, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.fr: Montée à quatorze mille pieds, passant onze mille, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.de: Steige auf vierzehntausend Fuß, passiere elftausend, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.es: Ascendiendo a catorce mil, pasando once mil, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.zh: 正在爬升至一万四千英尺，正通过一万一千英尺，Delta 423。
usageTranslations.ar: أصعد إلى 14000 قدم، أعبر 11000 قدم، Delta 423.
usageTranslations.pt: Subindo para quatorze mil, passando onze mil, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.ru: Набираю до 14000, прохожу 11000, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.ja: 14000フィートへ上昇中、11000フィートを通過、Delta 423。
usageTranslations.it: Salgo a quattordicimila piedi, passando undicimila, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.vi: Tăng lên 14000 feet, đang qua 11000 feet, Delta 423.
usageTranslations.hi: चढ़ाई 14000 फीट तक, 11000 फीट पार कर रहा हूँ, Delta 423।
usageTranslations.th: ไต่ไปที่ 14000 ฟุต กำลังผ่าน 11000 ฟุต, Delta 423
usageTranslations.id: Naik ke 14000 kaki, melewati 11000 kaki, Delta 423.

terms.definition: Used by pilots to report they are vacating a specific altitude, either climbing or descending from it.
terms.usage: Leaving flight level three six zero, descending to flight level two nine zero, Lufthansa 621.

termTranslations.th: ออกจาก

usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi üç altmışı terk ediyorum, iki doksana alçalıyorum, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.fr: Quitte niveau de vol trois six zéro, descente vers deux neuf zéro, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.de: Verlasse Flugfläche drei sechs null, sinke auf zwei neun null, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.es: Saliendo del nivel tres seis cero, descendiendo a dos nueve cero, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.zh: 离开三六零飞行高度，下降至二九零，Lufthansa 621。
usageTranslations.ar: أغادر مستوى الطيران 360، أهبط إلى 290، Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.pt: Saindo do nível três seis zero, descendo para dois nove zero, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.ru: Покидаю эшелон 360, снижаюсь до 290, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.ja: フライトレベル360を離脱、290へ降下中、Lufthansa 621。
usageTranslations.it: Lasciando livello di volo tre sei zero, in discesa verso due nove zero, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.vi: Rời FL360, hạ xuống FL290, Lufthansa 621.
usageTranslations.hi: FL360 छोड़ रहा हूँ, FL290 तक उतर रहा हूँ, Lufthansa 621।
usageTranslations.th: ออกจาก FL360 ลดลงสู่ FL290, Lufthansa 621
usageTranslations.id: Meninggalkan FL360, turun ke FL290, Lufthansa 621.

terms.definition: A generic term used to denote a pilot's cleared vertical position, whether expressed as an altitude, flight level, or height.
terms.usage: ATC: Lufthansa 234, report reaching and maintaining assigned level.

termTranslations.th: ระดับ

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: Lufthansa 234, tahsis edilen seviyeye ulaştığınızı ve sürdürdüğünüzü raporlayın.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : Lufthansa 234, signalez atteinte et maintien du niveau assigné.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: Lufthansa 234, melden Sie Erreichen und Halten der zugewiesenen Höhe.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: Lufthansa 234, informe al alcanzar y mantener el nivel asignado.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：汉莎234，报告已达到并保持指派高度层。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: لوفتهانزا 234، أبلغ عند الوصول إلى والحفاظ على المستوى المحدد.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: Lufthansa 234, reporte ao atingir e manter o nível atribuído.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: Lufthansa 234, доложите достижение и выдерживание заданного эшелона.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC：ルフトハンザ234、指定されたレベルに到達し維持していることを報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: Lufthansa 234, riferire il raggiungimento e mantenimento del livello assegnato.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: Lufthansa 234, báo cáo khi đạt và duy trì mức độ cao được chỉ định.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: लुफ्थांसा 234, निर्दिष्ट स्तर तक पहुँचने और बनाए रखने की सूचना दें।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: Lufthansa 234, รายงานเมื่อถึงและรักษาระดับที่กำหนดไว้
usageTranslations.id: ATC: Lufthansa 234, laporkan saat mencapai dan mempertahankan level yang ditentukan.

terms.definition: An instruction for the pilot to provide specific information, such as position, altitude, or status, either once or at specified intervals.
terms.usage: Tower: Ryanair 82T, report established on final runway 27.

termTranslations.th: รายงาน

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: Ryanair 82T, 27 pistine son yaklaşmaya geçtiğinizi bildiriniz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour : Ryanair 82T, signalez établi en finale piste 27.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: Ryanair 82T, melden Sie Endanflug auf Bahn 27.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: Ryanair 82T, informe establecido en final pista 27.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：Ryanair 82T，报告已进近27号跑道末段。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: رايان إير 82T، أبلغ عند الاستقرار في النهائي المدرج 27.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: Ryanair 82T, reporte estabelecido na final da pista 27.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: Ryanair 82T, доложите вход в глиссаду ВПП 27.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：Ryanair 82T、滑走路27の最終進入に入ったことを報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: Ryanair 82T, riferire quando stabilito sulla finale pista 27.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: Ryanair 82T, báo cáo đã vào đường cuối đường băng 27.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: रायनएयर 82T, रनवे 27 पर फाइनल में आने की सूचना दें।
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุม: Ryanair 82T, รายงานเมื่อเข้ารอบสุดท้ายที่รันเวย์ 27
usageTranslations.id: Menara: Ryanair 82T, laporkan saat telah masuk pendekatan akhir landasan 27.

terms.definition: An instruction to notify ATC when a specified altitude or level has been attained.
terms.usage: Climb and maintain one eight thousand, report reaching one eight thousand.

termTranslations.th: รายงานเมื่อถึง

usageTranslations.tr: On sekiz bine tırmanın ve ulaştığınızda rapor edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Montez et maintenez dix-huit mille, signalez atteinte.
usageTranslations.de: Steigen Sie auf eins-acht-tausend, melden Sie beim Erreichen.
usageTranslations.es: Ascienda y mantenga uno ocho mil, informe al alcanzar.
usageTranslations.zh: 爬升并保持一万八千英尺，到达后报告。
usageTranslations.ar: اصعد وابق على 18000، أبلغ عند الوصول.
usageTranslations.pt: Suba e mantenha dezoito mil, reporte ao atingir.
usageTranslations.ru: Наберите и удерживайте 18000, доложите при достижении.
usageTranslations.ja: 一八千フィートへ上昇して維持、到達時に報告。
usageTranslations.it: Salga e mantenga diciottomila piedi, riporti al raggiungimento.
usageTranslations.vi: Tăng lên và duy trì 18000 feet, báo cáo khi đạt đến.
usageTranslations.hi: 18,000 फीट पर चढ़ें और पहुँचने पर रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: ไต่และรักษาระดับที่ 18000 รายงานเมื่อถึง
usageTranslations.id: Naik dan pertahankan 18000 kaki, laporkan saat mencapai.

terms.definition: An instruction for the pilot to notify ATC when passing through a specific altitude or level.
terms.usage: Descend to flight level two four zero, report passing flight level three one zero.

termTranslations.th: รายงานเมื่อผ่าน

usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi iki dört sıfıra alçalın, üç bir sıfırı geçerken rapor edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Descendez au niveau de vol deux quatre zéro, signalez en passant trois un zéro.
usageTranslations.de: Sinkflug auf Flugfläche zwei vier null, melden Sie beim Passieren von drei eins null.
usageTranslations.es: Descienda al nivel de vuelo dos cuatro cero, informe al pasar nivel tres uno cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 下降至飞行高度240，通过310时报告。
usageTranslations.ar: انخفض إلى FL240، أبلغ عند عبور FL310.
usageTranslations.pt: Desça para o nível de voo dois quatro zero, reporte ao passar três um zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Снижайтесь до эшелона 240, доложите при прохождении эшелона 310.
usageTranslations.ja: FL240へ降下、FL310通過時に報告。
usageTranslations.it: Scenda al livello di volo due quattro zero, riporti al passaggio di tre uno zero.
usageTranslations.vi: Giảm xuống FL240, báo cáo khi qua FL310.
usageTranslations.hi: FL240 तक नीचे जाएँ, FL310 पार करते समय रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: ลดระดับสู่ FL240 รายงานเมื่อผ่าน FL310
usageTranslations.id: Turun ke FL240, laporkan saat melewati FL310.

terms.definition: An instruction for the pilot to inform ATC when the aircraft is established on a specified segment of the approach, typically the localizer or final approach course.
terms.usage: Big Jet 345, turn right heading 240, descend to 3000 feet, report established localizer runway 27 Right.

termTranslations.th: รายงานเมื่อเข้าที่

usageTranslations.tr: Big Jet 345, sağa 240 derece dönün, 3000 feet'e alçalın, pist 27 sağ lokalizere kurulumunuzu bildirin.
usageTranslations.fr: Big Jet 345, tournez à droite cap 240, descendez à 3000 pieds, signalez établi sur le localizer piste 27 droite.
usageTranslations.de: Big Jet 345, drehen Sie rechts auf Kurs 240, sinken Sie auf 3000 Fuß, melden Sie etabliert auf dem Localizer Piste 27 rechts.
usageTranslations.es: Big Jet 345, gire a la derecha rumbo 240, descienda a 3000 pies, informe establecido en el localizador pista 27 derecha.
usageTranslations.zh: Big Jet 345，右转航向240，下降到3000英尺，报告已建立在27右跑道的本场进近道上。
usageTranslations.ar: Big Jet 345، انعطف يمينًا إلى الاتجاه 240، انخفض إلى 3000 قدم، أبلغ عند التمركز على محدد الاتجاه المدرج 27 يمين.
usageTranslations.pt: Big Jet 345, vire à direita rumo 240, desça para 3000 pés, reporte estabelecido no localizador pista 27 direita.
usageTranslations.ru: Big Jet 345, поворот направо курс 240, снижение до 3000 футов, доложите установку на локализаторе ВПП 27 правая.
usageTranslations.ja: Big Jet 345、右に240度に旋回し、3000フィートに降下、滑走路27右のローカライザーに確立を報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: Big Jet 345, virare a destra prua 240, scendere a 3000 piedi, riportare stabilito sul localizzatore pista 27 destra.
usageTranslations.vi: Big Jet 345, rẽ phải hướng 240, hạ xuống 3000 feet, báo cáo đã thiết lập trên localizer đường băng 27 phải.
usageTranslations.hi: Big Jet 345, दायें मुड़ें 240 हेडिंग पर, 3000 फीट तक नीचे जाएं, रनवे 27 दायें लोकलाइज़र पर स्थापित होने की रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: Big Jet 345, เลี้ยวขวาหัว 240, ลดระดับสู่ 3000 ฟุต, รายงานเมื่อเข้าที่ localizer รันเวย์ 27 ขวา
usageTranslations.id: Big Jet 345, belok kanan heading 240, turun ke 3000 kaki, laporkan sudah terbang lurus pada localizer runway 27 kanan.

terms.definition: An instruction for the pilot to inform ATC when the aircraft is on the final approach segment, aligned with the runway centerline and descending for landing.
terms.usage: Metro Tower, Big Jet 345, final runway 27 Right.

termTranslations.th: รายงานเมื่อเข้าช่วงสุดท้าย

usageTranslations.tr: Metro Kulesi, Big Jet 345, pist 27 sağ son yaklaşma.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour de Metro, Big Jet 345, finale piste 27 droite.
usageTranslations.de: Metro Tower, Big Jet 345, Endanflug Piste 27 rechts.
usageTranslations.es: Torre Metro, Big Jet 345, final pista 27 derecha.
usageTranslations.zh: 地铁塔台，Big Jet 345，27右跑道最后进近。
usageTranslations.ar: برج مترو، Big Jet 345، نهج نهائي المدرج 27 يمين.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre Metro, Big Jet 345, final pista 27 direita.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня Метро, Big Jet 345, на конечном ВПП 27 правая.
usageTranslations.ja: メトロタワー、Big Jet 345、滑走路27右の最終進入。
usageTranslations.it: Torre Metro, Big Jet 345, finale pista 27 destra.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp điều khiển Metro, Big Jet 345, tiếp cận cuối đường băng 27 phải.
usageTranslations.hi: मेट्रो टॉवर, Big Jet 345, रनवे 27 दायें अंतिम चरण।
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุมเมโทร, Big Jet 345, ช่วงสุดท้ายรันเวย์ 27 ขวา
usageTranslations.id: Menara Metro, Big Jet 345, final runway 27 kanan.

terms.definition: An instruction to inform ATC when the aircraft has completely left the runway.
terms.usage: Taxi via Alpha and hold short of runway 27, report vacated.

termTranslations.vi: Báo cáo khi rời khỏi đường băng
termTranslations.hi: रनवे खाली करने की रिपोर्ट दें
termTranslations.th: รายงานเมื่อออกจากรันเวย์

usageTranslations.tr: Alpha üzerinden taksi yapın ve pist 27 önünde bekleyin, pisti terk ettiğinizi rapor edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Roulage via Alpha, attendez avant la piste 27, signalez piste libérée.
usageTranslations.de: Rollweg Alpha folgen und vor Piste 27 halten, Piste verlassen melden.
usageTranslations.es: Rodé por Alpha y espere antes de la pista 27, informe pista desocupada.
usageTranslations.zh: 经Alpha滑行并在27号跑道前等待，脱离跑道后报告。
usageTranslations.ar: اتجه عبر Alpha وتوقف قبل المدرج 27، أبلغ عند مغادرة المدرج.
usageTranslations.pt: Taxi via Alpha e aguarde antes da pista 27, reporte pista desocupada.
usageTranslations.ru: Рулите по Alpha, ждите перед ВПП 27, доложите освобождение полосы.
usageTranslations.ja: アルファ経由でタキシーし、滑走路27の手前で待機、離脱を報告。
usageTranslations.it: Rullaggio via Alpha, attendi prima della pista 27, riporti pista liberata.
usageTranslations.vi: Taxi theo Alpha, giữ ngắn đường băng 27, báo cáo khi rời khỏi đường băng.
usageTranslations.hi: अल्फा मार्ग से टैक्सी करें और रनवे 27 से पहले रुकें, रनवे खाली करने की रिपोर्ट दें।
usageTranslations.th: แท็กซี่ทาง Alpha และหยุดก่อนรันเวย์ 27 รายงานเมื่อออกจากรันเวย์
usageTranslations.id: Taxi lewat Alpha dan tunggu sebelum runway 27, laporkan saat keluar dari landasan.

terms.definition: An instruction to change aircraft heading by initiating a left turn.
terms.usage: Turn left heading zero nine zero and maintain four thousand feet.

termTranslations.th: เลี้ยวซ้าย

usageTranslations.tr: Sola dönün, baş yönü sıfır dokuz sıfır ve dört bin fitte kalın.
usageTranslations.fr: Tournez à gauche cap zéro neuf zéro et maintenez quatre mille pieds.
usageTranslations.de: Links drehen auf Kurs null neun null und halten Sie vier Tausend Fuß.
usageTranslations.es: Gire a la izquierda rumbo cero nueve cero y mantenga cuatro mil pies.
usageTranslations.zh: 向左转航向090并保持4000英尺高度。
usageTranslations.ar: انعطف يسارًا إلى الاتجاه 090 واحتفظ على ارتفاع 4000 قدم.
usageTranslations.pt: Vire à esquerda para rumo zero nove zero e mantenha quatro mil pés.
usageTranslations.ru: Поверните влево на курс 090 и удерживайте высоту 4000 футов.
usageTranslations.ja: 左に旋回して方位090、4000フィートを維持。
usageTranslations.it: Virare a sinistra prua zero nove zero e mantenere quattromila piedi.
usageTranslations.vi: Rẽ trái hướng 090 và giữ độ cao 4000 feet.
usageTranslations.hi: बाएँ मुड़ें, दिशा 090 और चार हजार फीट बनाए रखें।
usageTranslations.th: เลี้ยวซ้ายไปยังทิศ 090 และรักษาระดับที่ 4000 ฟุต
usageTranslations.id: Belok kiri menuju heading 090 dan pertahankan 4000 kaki.

terms.definition: An instruction from ATC to initiate a right turn onto a specific heading, route, or to avoid traffic or terrain.
terms.usage: Turn right heading 220, vectors for traffic separation.

termTranslations.th: เลี้ยวขวา

usageTranslations.tr: Baş 220 sağa dönün, trafik ayrımı için yönlendiriliyorsunuz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tournez à droite cap 220, guidage pour séparation du trafic.
usageTranslations.de: Rechts drehen, Kurs 220, Vektoren zur Verkehrsseparierung.
usageTranslations.es: Gire a la derecha rumbo 220, vectores para separación de tráfico.
usageTranslations.zh: 右转航向220，用于交通隔离。
usageTranslations.ar: انعطف يمينًا على العنوان 220، لتفادي حركة المرور.
usageTranslations.pt: Vire à direita rumo 220, vetores para separação de tráfego.
usageTranslations.ru: Поверните направо на курс 220, разведение по трафику.
usageTranslations.ja: 右に旋回、ヘディング220、トラフィック分離のため。
usageTranslations.it: Virare a destra con prua 220, vettori per separazione del traffico.
usageTranslations.vi: Rẽ phải hướng 220, điều hướng để tách biệt lưu lượng.
usageTranslations.hi: दाएँ मुड़ें, हेडिंग 220, ट्रैफिक अलगाव हेतु।
usageTranslations.th: เลี้ยวขวาหัวเครื่อง 220 สำหรับแยกการจราจร
usageTranslations.id: Belok kanan heading 220, untuk pemisahan lalu lintas.

terms.definition: The direction in which the aircraft’s nose is pointed, expressed in degrees from magnetic north.
terms.usage: Fly heading 270 and expect vectors for the ILS approach.

termTranslations.th: หัวเครื่อง

usageTranslations.tr: 270 başıyla uçun, ILS yaklaşması için yönlendirileceksiniz.
usageTranslations.fr: Volez au cap 270 et attendez des vecteurs pour l'approche ILS.
usageTranslations.de: Fliegen Sie Kurs 270, Vektoren zur ILS-Anflug erwarten.
usageTranslations.es: Vuele rumbo 270 y espere vectores para la aproximación ILS.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行航向270，预计将引导进ILS进近。
usageTranslations.ar: اتجه إلى 270 وتوقع توجيهات للاقتراب ILS.
usageTranslations.pt: Voe proa 270 e espere vetores para aproximação ILS.
usageTranslations.ru: Следуйте курсом 270, ожидайте векторы для захода ILS.
usageTranslations.ja: ヘディング270で飛行、ILS進入に向けて誘導を受けます。
usageTranslations.it: Voli con intestazione 270, attendi vettori per l'avvicinamento ILS.
usageTranslations.vi: Bay hướng 270, sẽ nhận điều hướng tiếp cận ILS.
usageTranslations.hi: हेडिंग 270 पर उड़ें, ILS अप्रोच के लिए निर्देश अपेक्षित हैं।
usageTranslations.th: บินหัวเครื่อง 270 และรอการนำทางสำหรับ ILS
usageTranslations.id: Terbang arah 270, tunggu vektor untuk pendekatan ILS.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction to proceed with the current action or phase of flight without change.
terms.usage: Continue taxi via Bravo and hold short of Runway 33.

termTranslations.th: ดำเนินการต่อ

usageTranslations.tr: Bravo üzerinden taksiye devam edin ve pist 33 önünde bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Continuez le roulage via Bravo et maintenez avant la piste 33.
usageTranslations.de: Fahren Sie weiter über Bravo und halten Sie vor Piste 33.
usageTranslations.es: Continúe rodando por Bravo y mantenga antes de la pista 33.
usageTranslations.zh: 沿Bravo滑行并在33号跑道前等待。
usageTranslations.ar: تابع التاكسي عبر Bravo وتوقف قبل المدرج 33.
usageTranslations.pt: Continue taxiando via Bravo e aguarde antes da pista 33.
usageTranslations.ru: Продолжайте руление по Браво, остановитесь перед ВПП 33.
usageTranslations.ja: ブラボー経由でタキシーを続け、滑走路33の手前で待機。
usageTranslations.it: Continua il rullaggio via Bravo e attendi prima della pista 33.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp tục lăn qua Bravo và giữ ngắn đường băng 33.
usageTranslations.hi: ब्रावो के माध्यम से टैक्सी जारी रखें और रनवे 33 से पहले रुकें।
usageTranslations.th: แท็กซี่ต่อไปทาง Bravo และหยุดก่อนรันเวย์ 33
usageTranslations.id: Lanjutkan taxi melalui Bravo dan tunggu sebelum runway 33.

terms.definition: An instruction to proceed with the instrument or visual approach but not yet cleared to land.
terms.usage: Continue approach, expect late landing clearance due to traffic.

termTranslations.de: Fahren Sie mit dem Anflug fort
termTranslations.ja: 進入アプローチを継続
termTranslations.th: ดำเนินการเข้าใกล้ต่อไป

usageTranslations.tr: Yaklaşmaya devam edin, trafik nedeniyle iniş izni geç verilebilir.
usageTranslations.fr: Continuez l'approche, autorisation d'atterrissage tardive prévue en raison du trafic.
usageTranslations.de: Fahren Sie mit dem Anflug fort, späte Landefreigabe wegen Verkehr erwartet.
usageTranslations.es: Continúe la aproximación, espere autorización de aterrizaje tardía debido al tráfico.
usageTranslations.zh: 继续进近，由于交通原因预计晚些时候给予落地许可。
usageTranslations.ar: تابع الاقتراب، من المتوقع تصريح هبوط متأخر بسبب الحركة الجوية.
usageTranslations.pt: Continue a aproximação, autorização de pouso tardia prevista devido ao tráfego.
usageTranslations.ru: Продолжайте заход, ожидайте позднего разрешения на посадку из-за трафика.
usageTranslations.ja: 進入アプローチを継続、交通状況により着陸許可は遅れる見込み。
usageTranslations.it: Continua l'avvicinamento, l'autorizzazione all'atterraggio potrebbe essere ritardata per traffico.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp tục tiếp cận, có thể trễ phép hạ cánh do lưu lượng.
usageTranslations.hi: एप्रोच जारी रखें, ट्रैफिक के कारण लैंडिंग अनुमति में देरी हो सकती है।
usageTranslations.th: ดำเนินการเข้าใกล้ต่อไป อาจได้รับอนุญาตให้ลงจอดช้าเนื่องจากจราจร
usageTranslations.id: Lanjutkan pendekatan, izin mendarat mungkin terlambat karena lalu lintas.

terms.definition: An instruction to proceed with ground movement along a designated taxi route or surface without stopping or awaiting further clearance.
terms.usage: Continue taxi via Alpha and hold short of Runway 18L.

termTranslations.th: แท็กซี่ต่อไป

usageTranslations.tr: Alpha üzerinden taksiye devam edin ve pist 18L önünde bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Continuez le roulage via Alpha et maintenez avant la piste 18L.
usageTranslations.de: Fahren Sie weiter über Alpha und halten Sie vor Piste 18L.
usageTranslations.es: Continúe rodando por Alpha y mantenga antes de la pista 18L.
usageTranslations.zh: 沿Alpha滑行并在18L跑道前等待。
usageTranslations.ar: تابع التاكسي عبر Alpha وتوقف قبل المدرج 18L.
usageTranslations.pt: Continue taxiando via Alpha e aguarde antes da pista 18L.
usageTranslations.ru: Продолжайте руление по Альфа, остановитесь перед ВПП 18L.
usageTranslations.ja: アルファ経由でタキシーを継続し、滑走路18L手前で待機。
usageTranslations.it: Continua il rullaggio via Alpha e attendi prima della pista 18L.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp tục lăn qua Alpha và giữ ngắn đường băng 18L.
usageTranslations.hi: Alpha के माध्यम से टैक्सी जारी रखें और रनवे 18L से पहले रुकें।
usageTranslations.th: แท็กซี่ต่อไปทาง Alpha และหยุดก่อนรันเวย์ 18L
usageTranslations.id: Lanjutkan taxi melalui Alpha dan tunggu sebelum runway 18L.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction to maintain or resume climbing to a previously assigned altitude or to a new altitude.
terms.usage: Continue climb to flight level 280, report reaching.

termTranslations.th: ปีนต่อไป

usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi 280'e tırmanmaya devam edin, ulaştığınızda bildirin.
usageTranslations.fr: Continuez la montée au niveau de vol 280, signalez lorsque atteint.
usageTranslations.de: Steigen Sie weiter auf Flugfläche 280, melden Sie Erreichen.
usageTranslations.es: Continúe ascendiendo al nivel de vuelo 280, notifique al alcanzar.
usageTranslations.zh: 继续爬升至飞行高度280，到达后报告。
usageTranslations.ar: تابع الصعود إلى مستوى الطيران 280، أبلغ عند الوصول.
usageTranslations.pt: Continue subindo para nível de voo 280, reporte ao atingir.
usageTranslations.ru: Продолжайте набор до эшелона 280, сообщите по достижении.
usageTranslations.ja: フライトレベル280まで上昇を継続し、到達時に報告せよ。
usageTranslations.it: Continua la salita al livello di volo 280, riferisci al raggiungimento.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp tục leo lên mức bay 280, báo cáo khi đến.
usageTranslations.hi: फ्लाइट लेवल 280 तक चढ़ाई जारी रखें, पहुँचने पर रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: ปีนต่อไปถึงระดับเที่ยวบิน 280 แจ้งเมื่อถึง
usageTranslations.id: Lanjutkan pendakian ke level penerbangan 280, laporkan saat mencapai.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction directing the pilot to maintain the ongoing descent to a specified level or altitude without interruption.
terms.usage: Tower: Speedbird 123, continue descent to flight level 120.

termTranslations.ja: 降下を継続してください
termTranslations.th: ดำเนินการลดระดับต่อ

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: Speedbird 123, uçuş seviyesi 120'ye alçalmaya devam edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour: Speedbird 123, poursuivez la descente au niveau de vol 120.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: Speedbird 123, setzen Sie den Sinkflug auf Flugfläche 120 fort.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: Speedbird 123, continúe el descenso al nivel de vuelo 120.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：Speedbird 123，继续下降至飞行高度120。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: سبيدبيرد 123، تابع الهبوط إلى مستوى الطيران 120.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: Speedbird 123, continue a descida para o nível de voo 120.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: Speedbird 123, продолжайте снижение до эшелона 120.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：スピードバード123、フライトレベル120まで降下を継続してください。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: Speedbird 123, continua la discesa al livello di volo 120.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: Speedbird 123, tiếp tục hạ xuống mức bay 120.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: स्पीडबर्ड 123, उड़ान स्तर 120 तक अवरोहण जारी रखें।
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุม: Speedbird 123, ดำเนินการลดระดับต่อไปที่ระดับการบิน 120.
usageTranslations.id: Menara: Speedbird 123, lanjutkan penurunan ke tingkat penerbangan 120.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction directing the pilot to follow a specified Standard Instrument Departure (SID) or route after takeoff.
terms.usage: Ground: Delta 789, cleared for takeoff runway 27, depart via the LAM3A departure.

termTranslations.ja: 経由で出発してください
termTranslations.th: ออกเดินทางผ่าน

usageTranslations.tr: Yer: Delta 789, pist 27'den kalkış için izinli, LAM3A kalkış prosedürünü takip edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Sol: Delta 789, autorisé au décollage piste 27, décollez via la procédure LAM3A.
usageTranslations.de: Boden: Delta 789, Startfreigabe für Piste 27, starten Sie über die LAM3A Abflugroute.
usageTranslations.es: Tierra: Delta 789, autorizado para despegar pista 27, despegue vía LAM3A.
usageTranslations.zh: 地面：Delta 789，获准从27号跑道起飞，经由LAM3A离场程序。
usageTranslations.ar: الأرض: دلتا 789، مُصرح بالإقلاع من المدرج 27، غادر عبر إجراء LAM3A.
usageTranslations.pt: Solo: Delta 789, autorizado para decolagem pista 27, decole via LAM3A.
usageTranslations.ru: Земля: Delta 789, разрешен взлет с полосы 27, вылетайте через маршрут LAM3A.
usageTranslations.ja: グラウンド：デルタ789、滑走路27からの離陸を許可、LAM3A出発経路を経由してください。
usageTranslations.it: Terra: Delta 789, autorizzato al decollo pista 27, parti via LAM3A.
usageTranslations.vi: Mặt đất: Delta 789, được phép cất cánh đường băng 27, khởi hành qua LAM3A.
usageTranslations.hi: ग्राउंड: डेल्टा 789, रनवे 27 से टेकऑफ़ के लिए अनुमति प्राप्त, LAM3A प्रस्थान मार्ग के माध्यम से प्रस्थान करें।
usageTranslations.th: ภาคพื้น: Delta 789, ได้รับอนุญาตให้ทะยานจากรันเวย์ 27, ออกเดินทางผ่าน LAM3A.
usageTranslations.id: Ground: Delta 789, diizinkan lepas landas dari landasan 27, berangkat melalui LAM3A.

terms.usage: ATC: N123AB, proceed direct to ALPHA waypoint.

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: N123AB, ALPHA yol noktasına doğrudan devam edin.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : N123AB, procédez directement vers le point ALPHA.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: N123AB, fliegen Sie direkt zum Wegpunkt ALPHA.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: N123AB, proceda directo al punto ALPHA.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：N123AB，直接前往ALPHA航路点。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: N123AB، توجه مباشرةً إلى نقطة ALPHA.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: N123AB, prossiga direto para o ponto ALPHA.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: N123AB, следуйте прямо к точке ALPHA.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC: N123AB、ALPHAウェイポイントへダイレクトで進入してください。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: N123AB, procedi diretto al punto ALPHA.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: N123AB, tiếp tục trực tiếp đến điểm ALPHA.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: N123AB, ALPHA वेपॉइंट पर सीधे आगे बढ़ें।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: N123AB, ดำเนินการโดยตรงไปยังจุด ALPHA
usageTranslations.id: ATC: N123AB, lanjutkan langsung ke titik ALPHA.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction directing an aircraft to follow a specified route, airway, or series of waypoints.
terms.usage: ATC: N789EF, proceed via VICTOR 12 airway to CHARLIE waypoint.

termTranslations.th: ดำเนินการผ่าน

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: N789EF, VICTOR 12 hava yolu üzerinden CHARLIE noktasına devam edin.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : N789EF, procédez via l'itinéraire VICTOR 12 jusqu'au point CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: N789EF, fliegen Sie über die Luftstraße VICTOR 12 zum Wegpunkt CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: N789EF, proceda vía la aerovía VICTOR 12 hasta el punto CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：N789EF，经由VICTOR 12航路前往CHARLIE航路点。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: N789EF، توجه عبر المسار الجوي VICTOR 12 إلى نقطة CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: N789EF, prossiga via a aerovia VICTOR 12 até o ponto CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: N789EF, следуйте по воздушной трассе VICTOR 12 к точке CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC: N789EF、VICTOR 12エアウェイを経由してCHARLIEウェイポイントへ進入してください。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: N789EF, procedi via l'aerovia VICTOR 12 fino al punto CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: N789EF, tiếp tục qua đường hàng không VICTOR 12 đến điểm CHARLIE.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: N789EF, VICTOR 12 एयरवे के माध्यम से CHARLIE वेपॉइंट पर आगे बढ़ें।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: N789EF, ดำเนินการผ่านทางอากาศ VICTOR 12 ไปยังจุด CHARLIE
usageTranslations.id: ATC: N789EF, lanjutkan melalui jalur udara VICTOR 12 ke titik CHARLIE.

terms.definition: Used by ATC to advise pilots of anticipated instructions or clearances, such as altitude changes or approach clearances, to assist with planning.
terms.usage: ATC: N456AB, expect further clearance at 1345Z.

termTranslations.th: คาดว่า

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: N456AB, 1345Z'de ek talimat bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : N456AB, prévoyez d'autres instructions à 1345Z.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: N456AB, erwarten Sie weitere Freigabe um 1345Z.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: N456AB, espere más autorizaciones a las 1345Z.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：N456AB，预计在1345Z获得进一步许可。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: N456AB، توقع تصريحًا إضافيًا في 1345Z.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: N456AB, espere nova autorização às 1345Z.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: N456AB, ожидайте дальнейшее разрешение в 1345Z.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC: N456AB、1345Zに次のクリアランスを予想してください。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: N456AB, prevedi ulteriori istruzioni alle 1345Z.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: N456AB, dự kiến nhận thêm huấn lệnh lúc 1345Z.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: N456AB, 1345Z पर अगली अनुमति की अपेक्षा करें।

usageTranslations.id: ATC: N456AB, harapkan izin lebih lanjut pada 1345Z.

terms.definition: An advisory indicating that the pilot should anticipate receiving radar vector instructions from ATC at a specified time, altitude, or fix, typically used to sequence traffic or guide aircraft to a specific point.
terms.usage: N123AB, expect vectors for the ILS approach runway 27 at waypoint ALPHA.

termTranslations.ja: ベクター指示を予期せよ
termTranslations.th: คาดว่าจะได้รับเวกเตอร์

usageTranslations.tr: N123AB, ALPHA noktası üzerinde ILS yaklaşması için radar yönlendirmesi bekleyin, pist 27.
usageTranslations.fr: N123AB, attendez des vecteurs pour l'approche ILS piste 27 au point ALPHA.
usageTranslations.de: N123AB, erwarten Sie Radarführungen für den ILS-Anflug auf Piste 27 bei Wegpunkt ALPHA.
usageTranslations.es: N123AB, espere vectores para la aproximación ILS pista 27 en el punto ALPHA.
usageTranslations.zh: N123AB，预计在ALPHA航路点接收27号跑道ILS进近的雷达引导。
usageTranslations.ar: N123AB، توقع التوجيهات للاقتراب ILS للمدرج 27 عند نقطة ALPHA.
usageTranslations.pt: N123AB, aguarde vetores para a aproximação ILS pista 27 no ponto ALPHA.
usageTranslations.ru: N123AB, ожидайте векторы для захода на ILS-подход к ВПП 27 в точке ALPHA.
usageTranslations.ja: N123AB、ALPHAウェイポイントで滑走路27のILSアプローチのベクター指示を予期してください。
usageTranslations.it: N123AB, prevedere vettori per l'avvicinamento ILS pista 27 al punto ALPHA.
usageTranslations.vi: N123AB, dự kiến nhận hướng dẫn cho tiếp cận ILS đường băng 27 tại điểm ALPHA.
usageTranslations.hi: N123AB, ALPHA बिंदु पर रनवे 27 के ILS अप्रोच के लिए वेक्टर की अपेक्षा करें।
usageTranslations.th: N123AB, คาดว่าจะได้รับเวกเตอร์สำหรับการเข้าถึง ILS รันเวย์ 27 ที่จุด ALPHA
usageTranslations.id: N123AB, harapkan vektor untuk pendekatan ILS landasan 27 di titik ALPHA.

terms.definition: Heading instructions issued to provide navigational guidance by radar
terms.usage: United 345, turn left heading 270 degrees, vectors for traffic spacing to final approach course.

termTranslations.th: การนำทางเรดาร์

usageTranslations.tr: United 345, sola dönüş, baş 270 derece, trafik aralığı için vektör, son yaklaşma hattına.
usageTranslations.fr: United 345, virez à gauche cap 270, guidage radar pour espacement en approche finale.
usageTranslations.de: United 345, links Kurs 270 Grad, Radarführung für Staffelung zum Endanflug.
usageTranslations.es: United 345, gire a la izquierda rumbo 270 grados, vectores para espaciamiento al curso de aproximación final.
usageTranslations.zh: 联合航空345，向左转向270度，雷达引导保持间隔进最后进近航线。
usageTranslations.ar: يونايتد 345، انعطف يسارا اتجاه 270 درجة، توجيه راداري للمباعدة لمسار الاقتراب النهائي.
usageTranslations.pt: United 345, curva à esquerda proa 270 graus, vetores para espaçamento na aproximação final.
usageTranslations.ru: Юнайтед 345, влево курс 270 градусов, векторение для интервала на финальный заход.
usageTranslations.ja: ユナイテッド345、左旋回、機首方位270度、最終進入コースへの間隔維持のためのレーダー誘導。
usageTranslations.it: United 345, virata a sinistra prua 270 gradi, vettori per spaziatura al sentiero di avvicinamento finale.
usageTranslations.vi: United 345, rẽ trái hướng 270 độ, dẫn đường radar để giãn cách vào đường tiếp cận cuối.
usageTranslations.hi: यूनाइटेड 345, बाएं मुड़ें हेडिंग 270 डिग्री, अंतिम दृष्टिकोण पाठ्यक्रम के लिए यातायात अंतर के लिए वेक्टर।
usageTranslations.th: ยูไนเต็ด 345 เลี้ยวซ้ายหัวเครื่อง 270 องศา นำทางเรดาร์สำหรับการเว้นระยะในแนวร่อนสุดท้าย
usageTranslations.id: United 345, belok kiri haluan 270 derajat, vektor untuk jarak lalu lintas ke jalur pendekatan akhir.

terms.definition: Indication that a particular aircraft is identified on the radar display and radar flight following will be provided
terms.usage: Delta 892 Heavy, radar contact established, climb and maintain flight level three three zero.

termTranslations.th: การติดต่อเรดาร์

usageTranslations.tr: Delta 892 Heavy, radar teması sağlandı, tırmanın ve uçuş seviyesi üç üç sıfırda muhafaza edin.

usageTranslations.de: Delta 892 Heavy, Radarkontakt hergestellt, steigen und halten Sie Flugfläche drei drei null.
usageTranslations.es: Delta 892 Heavy, contacto radar establecido, ascienda y mantenga nivel de vuelo tres tres cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 达美892重型，雷达识别建立，爬升并保持飞行高度三三零。
usageTranslations.ar: دلتا 892 هيفي، تم تأسيس الاتصال الراداري، اصعد وحافظ على مستوى الطيران ثلاثة ثلاثة صفر.
usageTranslations.pt: Delta 892 Heavy, contato radar estabelecido, suba e mantenha nível de voo três três zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Дельта 892 Хэви, радиолокационный контакт установлен, набирайте и выдерживайте эшелон три три ноль.

usageTranslations.it: Delta 892 Heavy, contatto radar stabilito, salga e mantenga livello di volo tre tre zero.
usageTranslations.vi: Delta 892 Heavy, đã thiết lập liên lạc radar, lên và duy trì mực bay ba ba không.
usageTranslations.hi: डेल्टा 892 हेवी, रडार संपर्क स्थापित, चढ़ें और उड़ान स्तर तीन तीन शून्य बनाए रखें।
usageTranslations.th: เดลต้า 892 เฮฟวี่ การติดต่อเรดาร์เสร็จสมบูรณ์ ขึ้นและรักษาระดับบิน สาม สาม ศูนย์
usageTranslations.id: Delta 892 Heavy, kontak radar terjalin, naik dan pertahankan level penerbangan tiga tiga nol.

terms.definition: ATC instruction indicating that radar monitoring and associated services are no longer being provided; the pilot must now operate under visual or procedural rules.
terms.usage: ATC: N23JL, radar service terminated, squawk VFR, frequency change approved.

termTranslations.ja: レーダーサービス終了
termTranslations.th: ยุติการให้บริการเรดาร์

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: N23JL, radar hizmeti sonlandırıldı, VFR kodu ayarlayın, frekans değişikliği onaylandı.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : N23JL, service radar terminé, codez VFR, changement de fréquence approuvé.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: N23JL, Radarüberwachung beendet, squawk VFR, Frequenzwechsel genehmigt.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: N23JL, servicio de radar finalizado, código VFR, cambio de frecuencia aprobado.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：N23JL，雷达服务终止，调整VFR编码，频率更改获批。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: N23JL، تم إنهاء خدمة الرادار، غيّر الكود إلى VFR، تم الموافقة على تغيير التردد.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: N23JL, serviço de radar encerrado, squawk VFR, mudança de frequência aprovada.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: N23JL, радиолокационное обслуживание завершено, squawk VFR, смена частоты разрешена.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC: N23JL、レーダーサービス終了、VFRスコーク設定、周波数変更承認。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: N23JL, servizio radar terminato, imposta squawk VFR, cambio frequenza approvato.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: N23JL, kết thúc dịch vụ radar, đặt mã VFR, cho phép đổi tần số.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: N23JL, रडार सेवा समाप्त, VFR स्क्वॉक करें, आवृत्ति परिवर्तन स्वीकृत है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: N23JL, ยุติการให้บริการเรดาร์, ตั้ง squawk VFR, อนุมัติการเปลี่ยนความถี่
usageTranslations.id: ATC: N23JL, layanan radar dihentikan, squawk VFR, perubahan frekuensi disetujui.

terms.definition: Instruction from ATC to switch radio communication from the current frequency to the aerodrome control tower frequency for landing or taxi clearance.
terms.usage: ATC: American 782, contact tower on 118.7 for landing clearance.

termTranslations.vi: Liên lạc với đài kiểm soát
termTranslations.th: ติดต่อหอบังคับการบิน

usageTranslations.tr: ATC: American 782, iniş izni için 118.7 kule frekansını arayın.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : American 782, contactez la tour sur 118.7 pour l'autorisation d'atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: American 782, kontaktieren Sie den Tower auf 118.7 zur Landeerlaubnis.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: American 782, contacte con torre en 118.7 para autorización de aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC：American 782，联系塔台118.7获取落地许可。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC: American 782، اتصل بالبرج على 118.7 للحصول على إذن الهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: American 782, contate a torre em 118.7 para autorização de pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC: American 782, свяжитесь с вышкой на 118.7 для разрешения на посадку.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC: American 782、着陸許可のために118.7でタワーに連絡してください。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: American 782, contatta la torre su 118.7 per autorizzazione all'atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: American 782, liên lạc với đài kiểm soát trên 118.7 để được phép hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: American 782, लैंडिंग की अनुमति के लिए 118.7 पर टॉवर से संपर्क करें।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: American 782, ติดต่อหอบังคับการที่ 118.7 เพื่อขออนุญาตลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: ATC: American 782, hubungi menara di 118.7 untuk izin pendaratan.

terms.definition: Instruction from ATC to switch communication to the ground control frequency, typically issued after landing or before taxi for departure.
terms.usage: Tower: Delta 455, taxi to parking via Alpha, contact ground on 121.9.

termTranslations.th: ติดต่อภาคพื้นดิน

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: Delta 455, Alpha taksi yolundan park yerine gidin, 121.9 üzerinden yer kontrol ile irtibata geçin.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour : Delta 455, roulez vers le parking via Alpha, contactez le sol sur 121.9.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: Delta 455, rollen Sie über Alpha zum Parkplatz, kontaktieren Sie Boden auf 121.9.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: Delta 455, ruede a plataforma por Alpha, contacte con rodadura en 121.9.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：Delta 455，经Alpha滑行至停机位，联系121.9地面台。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: Delta 455، تحرّك إلى موقف الطائرات عبر Alpha، اتصل بأرضية المطار على 121.9.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: Delta 455, taxi via Alpha até o pátio, contate o solo em 121.9.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: Delta 455, рулите по Alpha на стоянку, свяжитесь с рулением на 121.9.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：Delta 455、Alpha経由で駐機場へ、121.9でグランドに連絡してください。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: Delta 455, rulla verso il parcheggio via Alpha, contatta il suolo su 121.9.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: Delta 455, lăn qua Alpha đến bãi đỗ, liên lạc với mặt đất trên 121.9.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: डेल्टा 455, अल्फा के माध्यम से पार्किंग तक टैक्सी करें, 121.9 पर ग्राउंड से संपर्क करें।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์: Delta 455, แท็กซี่ไปยังที่จอดผ่าน Alpha, ติดต่อภาคพื้นดินที่ 121.9
usageTranslations.id: Tower: Delta 455, taxi via Alpha ke parkir, hubungi ground di 121.9.

termTranslations.ja: ディパーチャーに連絡
termTranslations.vi: Liên lạc với điều khiển khởi hành
termTranslations.th: ติดต่อฝ่ายออกเดินทาง

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: United 238, 124.35 üzerinden kalkış kontrol ile irtibata geçin, iyi günler.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour : United 238, contactez le départ sur 124.35, bonne journée.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: United 238, kontaktieren Sie Departure auf 124.35, schönen Tag.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: United 238, contacte con salida en 124.35, buen día.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：United 238，联系124.35离场台，再见。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: United 238، اتصل بالمغادرة على 124.35، يوماً سعيداً.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: United 238, contate a partida em 124.35, bom dia.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: United 238, свяжитесь с вылетом на 124.35, хорошего дня.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：United 238、124.35でディパーチャーに連絡してください。良い一日を。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: United 238, contatta la partenza su 124.35, buona giornata.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: United 238, liên lạc với điều khiển khởi hành trên 124.35, chúc một ngày tốt lành.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: यूनाइटेड 238, 124.35 पर डिपार्चर से संपर्क करें, शुभ दिन।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์: United 238, ติดต่อฝ่ายออกเดินทางที่ 124.35, สวัสดีครับ
usageTranslations.id: Tower: United 238, hubungi departure di 124.35, selamat jalan.

terms.definition: Instruction to change the aircraft's communication radio frequency to another specified ATC unit or frequency.

usageTranslations.fr: Approche : N123AB, passez sur la tour en 118.7 pour l'autorisation d'atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Anflug: N123AB, wechseln Sie für die Landefreigabe auf Turmfrequenz 118.7.
usageTranslations.es: Aproximación: N123AB, cambie a torre en 118.7 para autorización de aterrizaje.

usageTranslations.vi: Phi công: Tháp, N8123A đang vào cuối đường băng để chạm và cất cánh, đường băng 17.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट: टावर, N8123A रनवे 17 के लिए टच एंड गो पर है।
usageTranslations.th: นักบิน: ทาวเวอร์, N8123A อยู่ในขั้นสุดท้ายเพื่อแตะแล้วบินต่อที่รันเวย์ 17
usageTranslations.id: Pilot: Tower, N8123A dalam final untuk sentuh dan lanjut di runway 17.

terms.definition: An ATC clearance that permits the pilot to perform a touch and go, stop and go, low approach, or full stop landing at the pilot’s discretion.
terms.usage: Pilot: Tower, Cessna 45X requesting the option runway 12 for training.

termTranslations.th: ทางเลือกการลงจอด

usageTranslations.tr: Pilot: Kule, Cessna 45X eğitim için pist 12'de opsiyon inişi talep ediyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Pilote : Tour, Cessna 45X demande l'option piste 12 pour entraînement.
usageTranslations.de: Pilot: Tower, Cessna 45X beantragt Option auf Piste 12 für Training.
usageTranslations.es: Piloto: Torre, Cessna 45X solicita la opción en pista 12 para entrenamiento.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员：塔台，Cessna 45X 请求 12 号跑道的选择进场，用于训练。
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار: البرج، Cessna 45X يطلب خيار المدرج 12 للتدريب.
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto: Torre, Cessna 45X solicita opção na pista 12 para treinamento.
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот: Башня, Cessna 45X запрашивает опцию на ВПП 12 для тренировки.
usageTranslations.ja: パイロット：タワー、Cessna 45Xは訓練のため滑走路12でオプションを要求します。
usageTranslations.it: Pilota: Torre, Cessna 45X richiede l'opzione sulla pista 12 per addestramento.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công: Tháp, Cessna 45X yêu cầu tùy chọn trên đường băng 12 để huấn luyện.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट: टावर, Cessna 45X प्रशिक्षण के लिए रनवे 12 पर विकल्प अनुरोधित कर रहा है।
usageTranslations.th: นักบิน: ทาวเวอร์, Cessna 45X ขอใช้ทางเลือกที่รันเวย์ 12 สำหรับการฝึก
usageTranslations.id: Pilot: Tower, Cessna 45X meminta opsi di runway 12 untuk pelatihan.

terms.definition: An instruction to align the aircraft with the final approach path for landing.
terms.usage: Tower instructs: 'Cleared to join final runway 27, report established.'

termTranslations.th: เข้าร่วมขั้นสุดท้าย

usageTranslations.tr: Kule talimat verir: 'Pist 27'ye son yaklaşmaya katıl, kurulduğunu bildir.'
usageTranslations.fr: La tour instruit : 'Autorisé à rejoindre finale piste 27, signalez établi.'
usageTranslations.de: Turm weist an: 'Freigegeben zum Endanflug auf Bahn 27, melden Sie sich etabliert.'
usageTranslations.es: La torre instruye: 'Autorizado a unirse a final pista 27, informe establecido.'
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台指示：'允许加入27号跑道的最后进场，报告已建立。'
usageTranslations.ar: البرج يوجه: 'مسموح بالانضمام إلى النهائي المدرج 27، أبلغ عن التأسيس.'
usageTranslations.pt: Torre instrui: 'Autorizado a juntar-se à final pista 27, reporte estabelecido.'
usageTranslations.ru: Башня инструктирует: 'Разрешено присоединиться к финальному заходу на полосу 27, доложите о готовности.'
usageTranslations.ja: タワーは指示します：'滑走路27の最終進入に参加することを許可されました。確立を報告してください。'
usageTranslations.it: La torre istruisce: 'Autorizzato a unirsi al finale pista 27, segnalare stabilito.'
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp hướng dẫn: 'Được phép tham gia cuối đường băng 27, báo cáo đã thiết lập.'
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर निर्देश देता है: 'रनवे 27 के अंतिम में शामिल होने की अनुमति है, स्थापित होने की रिपोर्ट करें।'
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุมสั่ง: 'ได้รับอนุญาตให้เข้าร่วมขั้นสุดท้ายรันเวย์ 27 รายงานการจัดตั้ง.'
usageTranslations.id: Menara menginstruksikan: 'Diizinkan untuk bergabung dengan final landasan 27, laporkan sudah didirikan.'

terms.definition: The last leg of the approach path before landing.
terms.usage: Pilot reports: 'On final runway 18, gear down and locked.'

termTranslations.th: สุดท้าย

usageTranslations.tr: Pilot rapor verir: 'Pist 18'de son yaklaşmada, iniş takımları açık ve kilitli.'
usageTranslations.fr: Le pilote rapporte : 'En finale piste 18, train sorti et verrouillé.'
usageTranslations.de: Pilot meldet: 'Im Endanflug auf Bahn 18, Fahrwerk ausgefahren und verriegelt.'
usageTranslations.es: El piloto informa: 'En final pista 18, tren abajo y bloqueado.'
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员报告：'在18号跑道的最后进场，起落架放下并锁定。'
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار يبلغ: 'في النهائي المدرج 18، العجلات نازلة ومقفلة.'
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto relata: 'Na final pista 18, trem baixado e travado.'
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот сообщает: 'На финальном заходе на полосу 18, шасси выпущены и заблокированы.'
usageTranslations.ja: パイロットは報告します：'滑走路18の最終進入中、ギアダウンしてロックされています。'
usageTranslations.it: Il pilota riporta: 'In finale pista 18, carrello giù e bloccato.'
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công báo cáo: 'Trên đường băng 18 cuối cùng, bánh xe hạ xuống và khóa.'
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट रिपोर्ट करता है: 'रनवे 18 पर अंतिम, गियर नीचे और लॉक।'
usageTranslations.th: นักบินรายงาน: 'บนรันเวย์ 18 สุดท้าย เกียร์ลงและล็อค.'
usageTranslations.id: Pilot melaporkan: 'Di final landasan 18, roda gigi turun dan terkunci.'

terms.definition: The segment of the final approach path closest to the runway.
terms.usage: Tower advises: 'Traffic on short final, runway 22, cleared to land.'

termTranslations.th: สุดท้ายสั้น

usageTranslations.tr: Kule uyarır: 'Pist 22'de kısa son yaklaşmada trafik, iniş için izinli.'
usageTranslations.fr: La tour conseille : 'Trafic en courte finale, piste 22, autorisé à atterrir.'
usageTranslations.de: Turm rät: 'Verkehr im kurzen Endanflug, Bahn 22, zur Landung freigegeben.'
usageTranslations.es: La torre aconseja: 'Tráfico en corta final, pista 22, autorizado a aterrizar.'
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台建议：'22号跑道短进场有交通，允许着陆。'
usageTranslations.ar: البرج ينصح: 'حركة المرور في النهائي القصير، المدرج 22، مسموح بالهبوط.'
usageTranslations.pt: Torre aconselha: 'Tráfego em final curta, pista 22, autorizado a pousar.'
usageTranslations.ru: Башня советует: 'Трафик на коротком финале, полоса 22, разрешено на посадку.'
usageTranslations.ja: タワーはアドバイスします：'滑走路22のショートファイナルに交通があります。着陸許可。'
usageTranslations.it: La torre consiglia: 'Traffico in corto finale, pista 22, autorizzato ad atterrare.'
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp khuyên: 'Giao thông trên đường băng 22 ngắn, được phép hạ cánh.'
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर सलाह देता है: 'रनवे 22 पर छोटा अंतिम, लैंडिंग के लिए अनुमति है।'
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุมแนะนำ: 'การจราจรบนรันเวย์ 22 สุดท้ายสั้น ได้รับอนุญาตให้ลงจอด.'
usageTranslations.id: Menara menyarankan: 'Lalu lintas di final pendek, landasan 22, diizinkan untuk mendarat.'

terms.definition: An approach over the runway where the aircraft descends to runway level but does not land, typically followed by a climb-out.
terms.usage: Tower: N215GH, cleared low approach runway 05, traffic holding short.

termTranslations.th: การเข้าใกล้ในระดับต่ำ

usageTranslations.tr: Kule: N215GH, pist 05 için alçak yaklaşma serbest, trafik beklemede.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour : N215GH, autorisé approche basse piste 05, trafic en attente.
usageTranslations.de: Tower: N215GH, tiefer Anflug auf Piste 05 freigegeben, Verkehr wartet.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: N215GH, autorizado aproximación baja pista 05, tráfico en espera.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：N215GH，获准在05跑道低空进场，有交通等待。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: N215GH، اقتراب منخفض مسموح على المدرج 05، حركة المرور في الانتظار.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: N215GH, aproximação baixa liberada na pista 05, tráfego aguardando.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня: N215GH, низкий заход на ВПП 05 разрешён, трафик на удержании.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー：N215GH、ランウェイ05でローアプローチ許可、トラフィックは待機中です。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: N215GH, autorizzato avvicinamento basso pista 05, traffico in attesa.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: N215GH, được phép tiếp cận thấp đường băng 05, có giao thông đang chờ.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: N215GH, रनवे 05 पर लो अप्रोच की अनुमति है, ट्रैफिक प्रतीक्षा में है।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์: N215GH, อนุญาตให้เข้าใกล้ในระดับต่ำรันเวย์ 05, มีจราจรรออยู่
usageTranslations.id: Tower: N215GH, pendekatan rendah disetujui di runway 05, lalu lintas menunggu.

terms.definition: A visual maneuver used to enter the traffic pattern from above the airfield, typically involving an initial pass over the runway followed by a break into the pattern.
terms.usage: Pilot: Tower, Mustang 31 is overhead the field for a left break runway 22.

termTranslations.th: ผ่านเหนือสนามบิน

usageTranslations.tr: Pilot: Kule, Mustang 31 meydan üzerinde, pist 22 için sola dönüşe geçiyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Pilote : Tour, Mustang 31 au-dessus du terrain pour virage à gauche piste 22.
usageTranslations.de: Pilot: Tower, Mustang 31 über dem Platz für eine Linkskurve zur Piste 22.
usageTranslations.es: Piloto: Torre, Mustang 31 sobre el campo para ruptura a la izquierda pista 22.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员：塔台，Mustang 31 在机场上空，准备左转进入22号跑道。
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار: البرج، Mustang 31 فوق المطار من أجل انعطاف يسار للمدرج 22.
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto: Torre, Mustang 31 sobre o campo para quebra à esquerda pista 22.
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот: Башня, Mustang 31 над аэродромом, заход с левым разворотом на ВПП 22.
usageTranslations.ja: パイロット：タワー、Mustang 31は滑走路22の左ブレイクのためにフィールド上空にいます。
usageTranslations.it: Pilota: Torre, Mustang 31 è sopra il campo per virata a sinistra pista 22.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công: Tháp, Mustang 31 đang bay qua sân bay để rẽ trái vào đường băng 22.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट: टॉवर, Mustang 31 एयरफील्ड के ऊपर है, रनवे 22 के लिए लेफ्ट ब्रेक करेगा।
usageTranslations.th: นักบิน: ทาวเวอร์, Mustang 31 อยู่เหนือสนามบินสำหรับเลี้ยวซ้ายไปยังรันเวย์ 22
usageTranslations.id: Pilot: Tower, Mustang 31 berada di atas lapangan untuk belok kiri ke runway 22.

terms.definition: The flight path at right angles to the landing runway off its approach end.
terms.usage: Pilot reports: 'Turning base leg, runway 15, gear down.'

termTranslations.th: ขาฐาน

usageTranslations.tr: Pilot rapor verir: 'Pist 15'e taban bacağına dönüyorum, iniş takımları açık.'
usageTranslations.fr: Le pilote rapporte : 'Virage en jambe de base, piste 15, train sorti.'
usageTranslations.de: Pilot meldet: 'Im Queranflug auf Bahn 15, Fahrwerk ausgefahren.'
usageTranslations.es: El piloto informa: 'Girando pierna base, pista 15, tren abajo.'
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员报告：'转向15号跑道的基腿，起落架放下。'
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار يبلغ: 'التحول إلى الساق الأساسية، المدرج 15، العجلات نازلة.'
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto relata: 'Virando perna base, pista 15, trem baixado.'
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот сообщает: 'Поворот на базовую ногу, полоса 15, шасси выпущены.'
usageTranslations.ja: パイロットは報告します：'滑走路15のベースレッグに旋回中、ギアダウン。'
usageTranslations.it: Il pilota riporta: 'Virata in gamba base, pista 15, carrello giù.'
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công báo cáo: 'Quay chân cơ sở, đường băng 15, bánh xe hạ xuống.'
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट रिपोर्ट करता है: 'रनवे 15 पर आधार पैर में मुड़ रहा है, गियर नीचे।'
usageTranslations.th: นักบินรายงาน: 'หมุนขาฐาน รันเวย์ 15 เกียร์ลง.'
usageTranslations.id: Pilot melaporkan: 'Berbelok ke kaki dasar, landasan 15, roda gigi turun.'

terms.definition: The flight path parallel to the landing runway in the opposite direction of landing.
terms.usage: Tower instructs: 'Enter downwind runway 09, report abeam the tower.'

termTranslations.th: ลมตาม

usageTranslations.tr: Kule talimat verir: 'Pist 09'a rüzgar altına gir, kuleyi geçerken bildir.'
usageTranslations.fr: La tour instruit : 'Entrez en vent arrière piste 09, signalez en abeam de la tour.'
usageTranslations.de: Turm weist an: 'In den Gegenanflug auf Bahn 09 einfliegen, melden Sie sich querab des Turms.'
usageTranslations.es: La torre instruye: 'Entre en viento en cola pista 09, informe al pasar por la torre.'
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台指示：'进入09号跑道的顺风，报告经过塔台。'
usageTranslations.ar: البرج يوجه: 'ادخل مع الريح المدرج 09، أبلغ عند المرور بالبرج.'
usageTranslations.pt: Torre instrui: 'Entre no vento de cauda pista 09, reporte ao passar pela torre.'
usageTranslations.ru: Башня инструктирует: 'Входите в попутный ветер на полосу 09, доложите при прохождении башни.'
usageTranslations.ja: タワーは指示します：'滑走路09のダウンウィンドに入り、タワーを通過したら報告してください。'
usageTranslations.it: La torre istruisce: 'Entra in sottovento pista 09, segnala al passaggio della torre.'
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp hướng dẫn: 'Vào gió xuôi đường băng 09, báo cáo khi đi ngang qua tháp.'
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर निर्देश देता है: 'रनवे 09 पर डाउनविंड में प्रवेश करें, टॉवर के पास से गुजरते समय रिपोर्ट करें।'
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุมสั่ง: 'เข้าสู่ลมตามรันเวย์ 09 รายงานเมื่อผ่านหอควบคุม.'
usageTranslations.id: Menara menginstruksikan: 'Masuk ke angin bawah landasan 09, laporkan saat melewati menara.'

terms.definition: The flight path at right angles to the landing runway at the upwind end.
terms.usage: Pilot reports: 'Turning crosswind, runway 27, climbing to 1500 feet.'

termTranslations.th: ลมขวาง

usageTranslations.tr: Pilot rapor verir: 'Pist 27'ye yan rüzgara dönüyorum, 1500 feet'e tırmanıyorum.'
usageTranslations.fr: Le pilote rapporte : 'Virage en vent traversier, piste 27, montée à 1500 pieds.'
usageTranslations.de: Pilot meldet: 'Im Querwind auf Bahn 27, Steigflug auf 1500 Fuß.'
usageTranslations.es: El piloto informa: 'Girando viento cruzado, pista 27, subiendo a 1500 pies.'
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员报告：'转向27号跑道的侧风，爬升至1500英尺。'
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار يبلغ: 'التحول إلى الرياح الجانبية، المدرج 27، الصعود إلى 1500 قدم.'
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto relata: 'Virando vento cruzado, pista 27, subindo para 1500 pés.'
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот сообщает: 'Поворот на боковой ветер, полоса 27, набор высоты до 1500 футов.'
usageTranslations.ja: パイロットは報告します：'滑走路27のクロスウィンドに旋回中、高度1500フィートに上昇中。'
usageTranslations.it: Il pilota riporta: 'Virata in vento trasversale, pista 27, salita a 1500 piedi.'
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công báo cáo: 'Quay gió ngang, đường băng 27, leo lên 1500 feet.'
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट रिपोर्ट करता है: 'रनवे 27 पर क्रॉसविंड में मुड़ रहा है, 1500 फीट तक चढ़ाई कर रहा है।'
usageTranslations.th: นักบินรายงาน: 'หมุนลมขวาง รันเวย์ 27 ไต่ขึ้นไปที่ 1500 ฟุต.'
usageTranslations.id: Pilot melaporkan: 'Berbelok ke angin silang, landasan 27, mendaki ke 1500 kaki.'

terms.definition: A 360-degree turn in the air to delay or maintain position.
terms.usage: Tower instructs: 'Orbit left over the field, maintain 3000 feet.'

termTranslations.th: วงโคจร

usageTranslations.tr: Kule talimat verir: 'Saha üzerinde sola dönüş yap, 3000 feet koru.'
usageTranslations.fr: La tour instruit : 'Orbite à gauche au-dessus du terrain, maintenez 3000 pieds.'
usageTranslations.de: Turm weist an: 'Links über dem Feld kreisen, 3000 Fuß halten.'
usageTranslations.es: La torre instruye: 'Órbita a la izquierda sobre el campo, mantenga 3000 pies.'
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台指示：'在场地上空左转盘旋，保持3000英尺。'
usageTranslations.ar: البرج يوجه: 'مدار يسار فوق الميدان، حافظ على 3000 قدم.'
usageTranslations.pt: Torre instrui: 'Órbita à esquerda sobre o campo, mantenha 3000 pés.'
usageTranslations.ru: Башня инструктирует: 'Орбита влево над полем, поддерживайте 3000 футов.'
usageTranslations.ja: タワーは指示します：'フィールド上空で左旋回し、3000フィートを維持してください。'
usageTranslations.it: La torre istruisce: 'Orbita a sinistra sopra il campo, mantieni 3000 piedi.'
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp hướng dẫn: 'Quỹ đạo trái trên cánh đồng, duy trì 3000 feet.'
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर निर्देश देता है: 'मैदान के ऊपर बाईं ओर कक्षा बनाएं, 3000 फीट बनाए रखें।'
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุมสั่ง: 'วงโคจรซ้ายเหนือสนาม รักษาระดับ 3000 ฟุต.'
usageTranslations.id: Menara menginstruksikan: 'Orbit kiri di atas lapangan, pertahankan 3000 kaki.'

terms.definition: To maintain a specific position or altitude, often in a holding pattern.
terms.usage: ATC instructs: 'Hold at waypoint ALPHA, maintain 5000 feet.'

termTranslations.th: ถือ

usageTranslations.tr: ATC talimat verir: 'ALPHA noktasında bekle, 5000 feet koru.'
usageTranslations.fr: ATC instruit : 'Attendez au point ALPHA, maintenez 5000 pieds.'
usageTranslations.de: ATC weist an: 'Am Wegpunkt ALPHA halten, 5000 Fuß halten.'
usageTranslations.es: ATC instruye: 'Mantenga en el punto ALPHA, mantenga 5000 pies.'
usageTranslations.zh: ATC指示：'在ALPHA航点保持，保持5000英尺。'
usageTranslations.ar: ATC يوجه: 'انتظر عند النقطة ALPHA، حافظ على 5000 قدم.'
usageTranslations.pt: ATC instrui: 'Mantenha no ponto ALPHA, mantenha 5000 pés.'
usageTranslations.ru: ATC инструктирует: 'Удерживайте на точке ALPHA, поддерживайте 5000 футов.'
usageTranslations.ja: ATCは指示します：'ウェイポイントALPHAでホールドし、5000フィートを維持してください。'
usageTranslations.it: ATC istruisce: 'Mantieni al punto ALPHA, mantieni 5000 piedi.'
usageTranslations.vi: ATC hướng dẫn: 'Giữ tại điểm ALPHA, duy trì 5000 feet.'
usageTranslations.hi: एटीसी निर्देश देता है: 'ALPHA वेपॉइंट पर रोकें, 5000 फीट बनाए रखें।'
usageTranslations.th: ATC สั่ง: 'ถือที่จุด ALPHA รักษาระดับ 5000 ฟุต.'
usageTranslations.id: ATC menginstruksikan: 'Tahan di titik ALPHA, pertahankan 5000 kaki.'

terms.definition: A racetrack-shaped flight path flown to delay an aircraft's approach.
terms.usage: ATC advises: 'Enter holding pattern at waypoint BRAVO, maintain 7000 feet.'

termTranslations.ja: ホールディングパターン
termTranslations.th: รูปแบบการถือ

usageTranslations.tr: ATC uyarır: 'BRAVO noktasında bekleme paternine gir, 7000 feet koru.'
usageTranslations.fr: ATC conseille : 'Entrez dans le circuit d'attente au point BRAVO, maintenez 7000 pieds.'
usageTranslations.de: ATC rät: 'In die Warteschleife am Wegpunkt BRAVO einfliegen, 7000 Fuß halten.'
usageTranslations.es: ATC aconseja: 'Ingrese al patrón de espera en el punto BRAVO, mantenga 7000 pies.'
usageTranslations.zh: ATC建议：'在BRAVO航点进入等待航线，保持7000英尺。'
usageTranslations.ar: ATC ينصح: 'ادخل نمط الانتظار عند النقطة BRAVO، حافظ على 7000 قدم.'
usageTranslations.pt: ATC aconselha: 'Entre no padrão de espera no ponto BRAVO, mantenha 7000 pés.'
usageTranslations.ru: ATC советует: 'Входите в зону ожидания на точке BRAVO, поддерживайте 7000 футов.'
usageTranslations.ja: ATCはアドバイスします：'ウェイポイントBRAVOでホールディングパターンに入り、7000フィートを維持してください。'
usageTranslations.it: ATC consiglia: 'Entra nello schema di attesa al punto BRAVO, mantieni 7000 piedi.'
usageTranslations.vi: ATC khuyên: 'Vào mẫu giữ tại điểm BRAVO, duy trì 7000 feet.'
usageTranslations.hi: एटीसी सलाह देता है: 'BRAVO वेपॉइंट पर होल्डिंग पैटर्न में प्रवेश करें, 7000 फीट बनाए रखें।'
usageTranslations.th: ATC แนะนำ: 'เข้าสู่รูปแบบการถือที่จุด BRAVO รักษาระดับ 7000 ฟุต.'
usageTranslations.id: ATC menyarankan: 'Masuk ke pola penahanan di titik BRAVO, pertahankan 7000 kaki.'

terms.definition: An aborted landing approach, requiring the aircraft to climb and reattempt landing.
terms.usage: Tower commands: 'Go around, runway occupied, climb to 3000 feet.'

termTranslations.th: ไปอ้อม

usageTranslations.tr: Kule komut verir: 'Pist dolu, tekrar yaklaş, 3000 feet tırman.'
usageTranslations.fr: La tour commande : 'Remise de gaz, piste occupée, montez à 3000 pieds.'
usageTranslations.de: Turm befiehlt: 'Durchstarten, Bahn besetzt, steigen Sie auf 3000 Fuß.'
usageTranslations.es: La torre ordena: 'Ida al aire, pista ocupada, suba a 3000 pies.'
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台命令：'复飞，跑道被占用，爬升至3000英尺。'
usageTranslations.ar: البرج يأمر: 'الالتفاف، المدرج مشغول، اصعد إلى 3000 قدم.'
usageTranslations.pt: Torre comanda: 'Arremeter, pista ocupada, suba para 3000 pés.'
usageTranslations.ru: Башня командует: 'Уход на второй круг, полоса занята, наберите 3000 футов.'
usageTranslations.ja: タワーは命令します：'ゴーアラウンド、滑走路が占有されています。3000フィートに上昇してください。'
usageTranslations.it: La torre comanda: 'Riattaccare, pista occupata, salire a 3000 piedi.'
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp ra lệnh: 'Đi vòng quanh, đường băng bị chiếm, leo lên 3000 feet.'
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर आदेश देता है: 'रनवे पर कब्जा है, गो अराउंड करें, 3000 फीट तक चढ़ें।'
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุมสั่ง: 'ไปอ้อม รันเวย์ถูกครอบครอง ไต่ขึ้นไปที่ 3000 ฟุต.'
usageTranslations.id: Menara memerintahkan: 'Pergi berkeliling, landasan pacu ditempati, naik ke 3000 kaki.'

terms.definition: A procedure followed when a landing cannot be completed.
