usageTranslations.vi: Tháp, cầu trượt số 2 bên phải không tách tự động; đã dùng dụng cụ nhả thủ công, bè đã tách sẵn sàng đón đội cứu.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर, दाएँ स्लाइड-2 ऑटोमेटिक नहीं छूटी; मैनुअल रिलीज़ टूल से छुड़ाया, राफ्ट अब मुक्त है।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์ สไลด์ขวาหมายเลข 2 ไม่หลุดอัตโนมัติ ใช้เครื่องมือปลดมือ ตอนนี้แพพร้อมรับเรือกู้ภัย
usageTranslations.id: Tower, slide 2 kanan gagal lepas otomatis; kami pakai alat pelepas manual, rakit kini bebas siap terima kapal penyelamat.

terms.definition: High-temperature-resistant bag used on board to isolate and contain lithium battery or PED fires until landing.
terms.usage: Cabin to flight deck: passenger phone overheated and ignited; device placed inside fire containment bag, cooling with water spray, no visible smoke now.

termTranslations.th: ถุงกักไฟ

usageTranslations.en: Cabin to flight deck: passenger phone overheated and ignited; device placed inside fire containment bag, cooling with water spray, no visible smoke now.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin kokpite: yolcu telefonu aşırı ısındı ve tutuştu; cihaz yangın muhafaza çantasına kondu, su spreyiyle soğutuluyor, artık görünür duman yok.
usageTranslations.fr: Cabine vers cockpit : téléphone passager en surchauffe et feu ; appareil placé dans le sac de confinement incendie, refroidi à l’eau, plus de fumée visible.
usageTranslations.de: Kabine an Cockpit: Passagierhandy überhitzte und brannte; Gerät in Feuer-Eindämmungstasche, Wassernebel kühlt, kein sichtbarer Rauch mehr.
usageTranslations.es: Cabina a cabina de mando: móvil del pasajero se sobrecalentó y se incendió; dispositivo dentro de bolsa de contención de fuego, enfriado con agua, sin humo visible.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱呼叫驾驶舱：旅客手机过热起火；已放入防火隔离袋并喷水降温，现无可见烟雾。
usageTranslations.ar: المقصورة للقمرة: هاتف راكب احترق من السخونة؛ وُضع الجهاز في حقيبة احتواء الحريق ويجري تبريده برذاذ ماء، لا دخان ظاهر.
usageTranslations.pt: Cabine para cockpit: telefone de passageiro superaqueceu e pegou fogo; aparelho colocado na bolsa de contenção, resfriado com spray d’água, sem fumaça visível.
usageTranslations.ru: Кабина–экипажу: телефон пассажира перегрелся и загорелся; устройство помещено в чехол для локализации пожара, охлаждаем водой, дыма нет.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室から操縦室へ：乗客の携帯が過熱発火。火災封じ込めバッグに入れ水スプレーで冷却中、煙は確認されず。
usageTranslations.it: Cabina a cockpit: cellulare passeggero surriscaldato e incendiato; inserito nella sacca di contenimento incendio, raffreddato con acqua, nessun fumo visibile.
usageTranslations.vi: Khoang hành khách gọi buồng lái: điện thoại hành khách quá nhiệt bốc cháy; đã đặt vào túi cách ly cháy, phun nước làm mát, không còn khói.
usageTranslations.hi: कॉकपिट, यात्री फोन गरम होकर जलने लगा; डिवाइस फायर कंटेनमेंट बैग में रखा, पानी स्प्रे से ठंडा कर रहे हैं, अब धुआँ नहीं दिख रहा।
usageTranslations.th: ห้องโดยสารถึงค็อกพิท โทรศัพท์ผู้โดยสารร้อนจนไฟไหม้ วางในถุงกักไฟ ฉีดน้ำลดความร้อน ไม่มีควันแล้ว
usageTranslations.id: Kabins ke kokpit: ponsel penumpang panas dan terbakar; dimasukkan ke tas penahan api, didinginkan semprot air, kini tanpa asap terlihat.

terms.definition: Insulated suit or bag carried in life-rafts to reduce hypothermia risk for survivors awaiting rescue in cold seas.
terms.usage: Rescue one, survivors have donned thermal protective aids inside raft; body temperature stable while awaiting winch pick-up in ten-degree water.

termTranslations.th: อุปกรณ์ป้องกันความหนาว

usageTranslations.en: Rescue one, survivors have donned thermal protective aids inside raft; body temperature stable while awaiting winch pick-up in ten-degree water.
usageTranslations.tr: Kurtarma bir, kazazedeler sal içinde ısı koruyucu giysi giydi; vücut ısısı on derece suda vinç alınmasını beklerken stabil.
usageTranslations.fr: Sauvetage un, les survivants ont enfilé l’aide de protection thermique dans le radeau ; température corporelle stable en attendant le treuillage dans une eau à dix degrés.
usageTranslations.de: Rettung eins, Überlebende tragen thermische Schutzbeutel im Floß; Körpertemperatur stabil, warten auf Windenbergung im zehn-Grad-Wasser.
usageTranslations.es: Rescate uno, los supervivientes llevan ayudas térmicas en la balsa; temperatura corporal estable a la espera del izado en agua de diez grados.
usageTranslations.zh: 救援一号，生还者已在筏内穿上保温防护用具；在十度海水中等待吊运，体温稳定。
usageTranslations.ar: إنقاذ 1، الناجون ارتدوا وسائل الحماية الحرارية داخل الطوف؛ حرارة أجسامهم مستقرة بانتظار الرفع في ماء عشر درجات.
usageTranslations.pt: Resgate um, sobreviventes vestiram auxílio de proteção térmica no bote; temperatura corporal estável aguardando içamento em água de dez graus.
usageTranslations.ru: Спасателям-1: выжившие надели термозащитные средства в плоту; температура тела стабильна, ждут подъёма лебёдкой в воде 10 °C.
usageTranslations.ja: レスキュー1、筏内で生存者は耐寒保護具着用。水温10度でウインチ救助待ち中も体温安定。
usageTranslations.it: Soccorso uno, i sopravvissuti hanno indossato gli ausili termoprotettivi nel gommone; temperatura corporea stabile in attesa del verricello in acqua a dieci gradi.
usageTranslations.vi: Cứu hộ 1, người sống sót đã mặc thiết bị bảo hộ nhiệt trong bè; thân nhiệt ổn định khi chờ cẩu trong nước 10 độ.
usageTranslations.hi: रेस्क्यू-1, बचे लोग राफ्ट में थर्मल प्रोटेक्टिव एड पहन चुके; दस डिग्री पानी में विंच उठाने तक तापमान स्थिर।
usageTranslations.th: เรสคิว 1 ผู้รอดชีวิตสวมอุปกรณ์ป้องกันความหนาวในแพแล้ว อุณหภูมิร่างกายคงที่ขณะรอการยกในน้ำสิบองศา
usageTranslations.id: Rescue satu, korban memakai alat pelindung termal di rakit; suhu tubuh stabil menunggu winch di air sepuluh derajat.

terms.definition: Pre-sealed emergency food package stowed in life-rafts providing high-energy biscuits and vitamin tablets for post-ditching survival.
terms.usage: Rescue centre, we have opened two survival rations packs; current stock sufficient for forty-eight hours for twelve occupants awaiting pickup.

termTranslations.ja: サバイバルレーションパック
termTranslations.th: ชุดเสบียงยังชีพ

usageTranslations.en: Rescue centre, we have opened two survival rations packs; current stock sufficient for forty-eight hours for twelve occupants awaiting pickup.
usageTranslations.tr: Kurtarma merkezi, iki hayatta kalma erzak paketi açtık; mevcut stok, alınmayı bekleyen on iki kişi için kırk sekiz saate yeterli.
usageTranslations.fr: Centre de secours, nous avons ouvert deux paquets de rations de survie ; stock actuel suffisant quarante-huit heures pour douze personnes en attente d’extraction.
usageTranslations.de: Rettungsleitstelle, wir haben zwei Überlebensrationen-Packungen geöffnet; Vorrat reicht 48 Stunden für zwölf Personen bis Bergung.
usageTranslations.es: Centro de rescate, abrimos dos paquetes de raciones de supervivencia; existencias actuales cubren 48 horas para doce ocupantes a la espera de recogida.
usageTranslations.zh: 救援中心，我们已开启两包生存口粮；现有存量可供12人等待48小时。
usageTranslations.ar: مركز الإنقاذ، فتحنا حزمتين من مؤن النجاة؛ المخزون الحالي يكفي 12 شخصًا لمدة 48 ساعة حتى الوصول.
usageTranslations.pt: Centro de resgate, abrimos dois pacotes de rações de sobrevivência; estoque cobre 48 horas para 12 ocupantes aguardando resgate.
usageTranslations.ru: Центр спасения, раскрыли два пакета аварийных пайков; запаса хватит на 48 ч для 12 человек до подъёма.
usageTranslations.ja: レスキューセンター、サバイバルレーションパック2つ開封。現在の在庫で12名48時間分確保。
usageTranslations.it: Centro soccorsi, abbiamo aperto due pacchi di razioni di sopravvivenza; scorte attuali sufficienti 48 ore per dodici persone in attesa.
usageTranslations.vi: Trung tâm cứu hộ, đã mở 2 gói lương khô sinh tồn; lượng còn lại đủ cho 12 người 48 giờ chờ cứu.
usageTranslations.hi: रेस्क्यू सेंटर, दो सर्वाइवल राशन पैक खोले; मौजूदा भंडार 12 लोगों के लिए 48 घंटे पर्याप्त।
usageTranslations.th: ศูนย์กู้ภัย เปิดชุดเสบียงยังชีพสองชุดแล้ว สำรองพอสำหรับ 12 คน 48 ชั่วโมงรอรับตัว
usageTranslations.id: Pusat penyelamat, kami buka dua paket ransum survival; stok cukup 48 jam untuk 12 penumpang menunggu evakuasi.

terms.definition: Sealed potable water container included in life-raft survival kit to supply drinking water for occupants in distress.
terms.usage: Mayday relay, raft echo reporting two emergency water packs ruptured during boarding; requesting priority drop of potable water by SAR aircraft.

termTranslations.th: แพ็คเกจน้ำฉุกเฉิน

usageTranslations.en: Mayday relay, raft echo reporting two emergency water packs ruptured during boarding; requesting priority drop of potable water by SAR aircraft.
usageTranslations.tr: Mayday aktarma, Echo salı biniş sırasında iki acil su paketi yırtıldı; SAR uçağından içme suyu öncelikli bırakma talep ediliyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Mayday relais, radeau écho signale deux paquets d’eau d’urgence rompus à l’embarquement ; demande largage prioritaire d’eau potable par avion SAR.
usageTranslations.de: Mayday-Relais, Floß Echo meldet zwei beschädigte Notwasserpackungen beim Einsteigen; bittet SAR-Flugzeug um vorrangigen Abwurf Trinkwasser.
usageTranslations.es: Mayday en relevo, la balsa echo informa dos paquetes de agua de emergencia rotos al embarcar; solicita lanzamiento prioritario de agua potable por aeronave SAR.
usageTranslations.zh: 求救中继，回声筏报告登筏时两包应急饮水破裂；请求搜救机优先投放饮用水。
usageTranslations.ar: نداء استغاثة، قارب إيكو يبلغ عن تمزق حزمتين مياه طارئة أثناء الصعود؛ طلب إسقاط عاجل لمياه صالحة للشرب من طائرة SAR.
usageTranslations.pt: Mayday relé, bote eco relata dois pacotes de água de emergência rompidos; solicita lançamento prioritário de água potável por aeronave SAR.
usageTranslations.ru: Мэйдэй ретрансляция: плот Эхо сообщает о разрыве двух аварийных пакетов воды при посадке; просим приоритетный сброс питьевой воды самолётом ПСО.
usageTranslations.ja: メイデイ中継、エコー筏で搭乗中に緊急飲料水パック2個破損。SAR機による飲料水優先投下要請。
usageTranslations.it: Mayday relay, zattera echo segnala due pacchi acqua emergenza rotti durante l’imbarco; richiede lancio prioritario di acqua potabile da aereo SAR.
usageTranslations.vi: Truyền Mayday, bè echo báo hai gói nước khẩn cấp vỡ khi lên bè; yêu cầu SAR thả nước uống ưu tiên.
usageTranslations.hi: मेडे रिले, राफ्ट इको में दो इमरजेंसी वाटर पैक फट गए; SAR विमान से पीने का पानी प्राथमिक रूप से गिराने का अनुरोध।
usageTranslations.th: เมเดย์รีเลย์ แพอีโค รายงานแพ็คน้ำฉุกเฉินสองชุดแตกขณะขึ้นแพ ขอเครื่องบิน SAR ทิ้งน้ำดื่มด่วน
usageTranslations.id: Mayday relay, rakit echo melapor dua paket air darurat pecah saat boarding; minta pesawat SAR menjatuhkan air minum prioritas.

terms.definition: Battery-powered high-intensity flashing beacon attached to life-vest or raft to enhance night-time visibility for rescuers.
terms.usage: Rescue helicopter inbound reports intermittent visual on survival strobe lights; request all rafts activate strobes simultaneously for positive identification.

termTranslations.ja: サバイバルストロボライト
termTranslations.th: ไฟแฟลชยังชีพ

usageTranslations.en: Rescue helicopter inbound reports intermittent visual on survival strobe lights; request all rafts activate strobes simultaneously for positive identification.
usageTranslations.tr: Yaklaşan kurtarma helikopteri hayatta kalma flaş ışıklarını aralıklı görüyor; tüm sallara teşhis için strobları aynı anda yakmaları isteniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Hélico de secours en rapprochement signale contact visuel intermittent sur les strobes de survie ; prière à tous les radeaux d’activer les strobes simultanément pour identification positive.
usageTranslations.de: Rettungsheli meldet sporadische Sicht auf Überlebens-Stroboskoplichter; bitte alle Flöße Blitzer gleichzeitig aktivieren zur eindeutigen Identifikation.
usageTranslations.es: Helicóptero de rescate entrante informa visual intermitente de luces estroboscópicas de supervivencia; solicitar que todas las balsas activen estrobos al mismo tiempo para identificación.
usageTranslations.zh: 救援直升机进场，间歇看到生存闪光灯；请求所有筏同步开启闪光灯以便确认。
usageTranslations.ar: مروحية الإنقاذ القادمة ترى أضواء ستروب النجاة بشكل متقطع؛ يُطلب من جميع الطوافات تشغيل الأضواء معًا للتعرف الإيجابي.
usageTranslations.pt: Helicóptero de resgate em aproximação relata visuais intermitentes dos estrobos de sobrevivência; solicitar a todos os botes que ativem estrobos simultaneamente para identificação.
usageTranslations.ru: Спас-вертолёт на подходе видит стробы выживших прерывисто; просьба всем плотам включить стробоскопы одновременно для точного обнаружения.
usageTranslations.ja: 接近中の救助ヘリがサバイバルストロボを断続的に視認。全筏が同時にストロボ点灯し確認を要請。
usageTranslations.it: Elicottero soccorso in arrivo riferisce visione intermittente delle strobo di sopravvivenza; si chiede a tutte le zattere di attivare le strobo simultaneamente per identificazione positiva.
usageTranslations.vi: Trực thăng cứu hộ tới gần thấy đèn strobe sinh tồn chập chờn; yêu cầu tất cả bè bật đồng thời để nhận dạng chắc chắn.
usageTranslations.hi: आ रहे रेस्क्यू हेलिकॉप्टर को स्ट्रोब लाइट्स झलकती दिखीं; सभी राफ्ट एक साथ स्ट्रोब सक्रिय करें पहचान हेतु।
usageTranslations.th: เฮลิคอปเตอร์กู้ภัยรายงานเห็นไฟแฟลชยังชีพเป็นช่วงๆ ขอให้ทุกแพเปิดแฟลชพร้อมกันเพื่อยืนยันตำแหน่ง
usageTranslations.id: Heli SAR masuk melaporkan lampu strobo survival terlihat putus-putus; minta semua rakit nyalakan strobo bersamaan untuk identifikasi.

terms.definition: Bright fluorescent dye packet released into water to create high-contrast slick, aiding aerial visual location of survivors.
terms.usage: Aircraft five zero, survivors released sea dye marker at 12-three-zero degrees, two miles; observe bright green slick for visual pickup.

termTranslations.th: สีย้อมทะเลสำหรับส่งสัญญาณ

usageTranslations.en: Aircraft five zero, survivors released sea dye marker at 12-three-zero degrees, two miles; observe bright green slick for visual pickup.
usageTranslations.tr: Uçak beş sıfır, kazazedeler 12-30 derecede, iki mil mesafede deniz boya işareti bıraktı; parlak yeşil iz görsel tespit için gözleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Avion cinq zéro, survivants ont largué un marqueur colorant marin au 123 °, deux milles; repérez la traînée verte brillante pour prise visuelle.
usageTranslations.de: Flugzeug fünf null, Überlebende setzten See-Farbstoffmarkierung bei 123 Grad, zwei Meilen; grüne Spur zur Sichtaufnahme beobachten.
usageTranslations.es: Aeronave cinco cero, los supervivientes soltaron marcador de tinte marino en 123º, dos millas; observe la mancha verde brillante para localización visual.
usageTranslations.zh: 50号飞机，生还者在123度两海里处投放海面染色标记；请注意亮绿色水迹以目视定位。
usageTranslations.ar: طائرة خمسة صفر، أطلق الناجون علامة صبغة بحرية على 123° لمسافة ميلين؛ راقب بقعة خضراء زاهية للعثور عليهم بصريًا.
usageTranslations.pt: Aeronave cinco zero, sobreviventes lançaram marcador corante marinho a 123 graus, duas milhas; observe mancha verde para identificação visual.
usageTranslations.ru: Борт пять-ноль, выжившие сбросили морской маркер-краситель на курсе 123°, две мили; наблюдайте ярко-зелёное пятно для визуального обнаружения.
usageTranslations.ja: エアクラフト50、生存者が123度2マイル地点にシーダイマーカー投下。明るい緑の帯を目視で確認。
usageTranslations.it: Aeromobile cinque zero, i sopravvissuti hanno rilasciato marcatore di colorante marino a 123 gradi, due miglia; individuare scia verde brillante visivamente.
usageTranslations.vi: Máy bay 50, người sống sót thả thuốc nhuộm biển tại 123°, cách 2 hải lý; quan sát vệt xanh sáng để định vị.
usageTranslations.hi: एयरक्राफ्ट 5-0, जीवितों ने 123° पर 2 मील सी डाई मार्कर डाला; चमकीला हरा धब्बा देखें जाकर।
usageTranslations.th: เครื่องบินห้า-ศูนย์ ผู้รอดชีวิตปล่อยสีย้อมทะเลที่ 123 องศา ห่างสองไมล์ สังเกตคราบสีเขียวสดสำหรับมองเห็น
usageTranslations.id: Pesawat lima-nol, penyintas melepaskan penanda pewarna laut di 123°, dua mil; amati noda hijau cerah untuk penjemputan visual.

terms.definition: Hand-held maritime flare producing coloured smoke during daylight to signal distress location to aircraft or vessels.
terms.usage: Raft alpha to rescue craft: orange signal smoke deployed and drifting leeward; advise visual confirmation and approach bearing.

termTranslations.th: ควันสัญญาณ

usageTranslations.en: Raft alpha to rescue craft: orange signal smoke deployed and drifting leeward; advise visual confirmation and approach bearing.
usageTranslations.tr: Sal Alfa'dan kurtarma aracına: turuncu duman sinyali bırakıldı, rüzgar altına sürükleniyor; görsel teyit ve yaklaşma kerterizini bildiriniz.
usageTranslations.fr: Radeau alpha au canot de sauvetage : fumée orange de signalisation activée, dérivant sous le vent ; confirmez visuel et cap d’approche.
usageTranslations.de: Floß Alpha an Rettungsboot: orange Signalrauch gezündet, treibt luv-ab; bitte Sichtbestätigung und Ansteuerkurs.
usageTranslations.es: Balsa alfa a embarcación de rescate: humo naranja de señal desplegado, derivando a sotavento; confirme visual y rumbo de aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 阿尔法筏呼叫救援艇：已施放橙色信号烟，向下风漂移；请确认目视并报告接近方位。
usageTranslations.ar: قارب ألفا إلى زورق الإنقاذ: أطلق دخان إشارة برتقالي وينجرف مع الريح؛ أكد الرؤية واتجاه الاقتراب.
usageTranslations.pt: Bote alfa ao resgate: fumaça de sinalização laranja ativada derivando sotavento; confirme visual e rumo de aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Плот Альфа спасательному судну: оранжевый сигнальный дым активирован, сносит по ветру; запрос визуальное подтверждение и курс подхода.
usageTranslations.ja: 筏アルファから救助艇へ：橙色シグナルスモーク放出、風下に流れ中。視認確認と接近方位を通知願う。
usageTranslations.it: Zattera alfa alla nave soccorso: fumogeno arancione attivato, deriva sotto vento; confermare avvistamento e rotta d’avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Bè alpha gọi tàu cứu: khói tín hiệu màu cam đã thả, trôi theo gió; xác nhận nhìn thấy và báo hướng tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: राफ्ट अल्फा से रेस्क्यू क्राफ्ट: नारंगी सिग्नल स्मोक छोड़ा, पवनधारा में बह रहा; दृश्य पुष्टि व अप्रोच बेयरिंग बताएं।
usageTranslations.th: แพอัลฟาถึงเรือกู้ภัย ปล่อยควันสัญญาณสีส้ม ลอยไปตามลมแล้ว ขอรับยืนยันการมองเห็นและทิศทางเข้าหา
usageTranslations.id: Rakit alfa ke kapal penyelamat: asap sinyal oranye dilepas dan hanyut ke bawah angin; mohon konfirmasi visual dan arah pendekatan.

terms.definition: Light rope fitted with weighted end carried in life-rafts to establish first connection with rescue vessel.
terms.usage: Rescue boat approaching, prepare heaving line on raft bow and stand by to secure painter once line received aboard.

termTranslations.th: เชือกโยน

usageTranslations.en: Rescue boat approaching, prepare heaving line on raft bow and stand by to secure painter once line received aboard.
usageTranslations.tr: Kurtarma botu yaklaşıyor, sal başına atma halatını hazırlayın ve halat tekneye alınınca bağlamak için bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Bateau de sauvetage en approche, préparez la ligne de jet à l’étrave du radeau et tenez-vous prêts à fixer le painer dès réception.
usageTranslations.de: Rettungsboot nähert sich, Wurfleine am Floßbug bereitstellen und warten, um das Schleppseil zu sichern sobald Leine an Bord.
usageTranslations.es: Barco de rescate aproximándose, prepare cabo de lanzamiento en proa de la balsa y listo para asegurar el pintador al recibir la línea.
usageTranslations.zh: 救援艇靠近，筏首准备抛投绳，收线后待绑系拖缆。
usageTranslations.ar: قارب إنقاذ يقترب، جهز حبل القذف عند مقدمة الطوف واستعد لتأمين الحبل عند استلامه على المتن.
usageTranslations.pt: Barco de resgate aproximando, preparar cabo de arremesso na proa do bote e aguardar para fixar o cabo principal quando recebido.
usageTranslations.ru: Спас-катер приближается, приготовьте бросательный конец на носу плота и будьте готовы закрепить швартов после приема.
usageTranslations.ja: 救助艇接近、筏船首でヒービングライン準備。ライン受領後ペインター固定に待機。
usageTranslations.it: Barca soccorso in avvicinamento, prepara la cima da lancio a prua della zattera e attendi per fissare il cavo quando ricevuto.
usageTranslations.vi: Tàu cứu hộ tiếp cận, chuẩn bị dây ném ở mũi bè và sẵn sàng buộc dây chính khi nhận.
usageTranslations.hi: रेस्क्यू बोट पास आ रही, राफ्ट के धनुष पर हिविंग लाइन तैयार रखें; लाइन मिलने पर पेंटर सुरक्षित करें।
usageTranslations.th: เรือกู้ภัยกำลังเข้าใกล้ เตรียมเชือกโยนที่หัวแพและพร้อมผูกเชือกหลักเมื่อรับเชือกแล้ว
usageTranslations.id: Kapal penyelamat mendekat, siapkan tali lempar di haluan rakit dan siap amankan painter setelah tali diterima.

terms.definition: Knife-type tool with guarded blade carried in cockpit or cabin to sever jammed seat-belts during emergency evacuation or rescue.
terms.usage: Flight deck to cabin: seat-belt cutter required at row 22 left, belt jammed and passenger unable to evacuate; dispatch trained crew immediately.

termTranslations.ja: シートベルトカッター
termTranslations.th: ที่ตัดเข็มขัดนิรภัย

usageTranslations.en: Flight deck to cabin: seat-belt cutter required at row 22 left, belt jammed and passenger unable to evacuate; dispatch trained crew immediately.
usageTranslations.tr: Kokpit kabine: 22 sol sırada emniyet kemeri sıkıştı, yolcu tahliye edemiyor; emniyet kemeri kesici ve eğitimli ekip derhal gönderin.
usageTranslations.fr: Cockpit à cabine : coupe-ceinture requis rangée 22 gauche, ceinture bloquée et passager ne peut évacuer ; envoyez équipage formé immédiatement.
usageTranslations.de: Cockpit an Kabine: Sicherheitsgurt-Schneider nötig Reihe 22 links, Gurt klemmt, Passagier kann nicht evakuieren; geschultes Personal sofort schicken.
usageTranslations.es: Cabina de vuelo a cabina: se necesita cortacinturón en fila 22 izquierda, cinturón atascado y pasajero no puede evacuar; envíe tripulación entrenada ya.
usageTranslations.zh: 驾驶舱呼叫客舱：22左排需要安全带切割器，带扣卡死，旅客无法撤离；请立即派训练有素的乘务员。
usageTranslations.ar: من قمرة القيادة إلى المقصورة: مطلوب قاطع حزام الأمان في صف 22 يسار، الحزام عالق والراكب لا يمكنه الإخلاء؛ أرسل طاقم مدرَّب فورًا.
usageTranslations.pt: Cabine de pilotagem à cabine: cortador de cinto necessário na fileira 22 esquerda, cinto travado e passageiro não pode evacuar; enviar tripulantes treinados.
usageTranslations.ru: Кабина экипажу: в 22-м ряду слева заклинило ремень, нужен резак ремня безопасности; направьте обученный экипаж немедленно.
usageTranslations.ja: 操縦室より客室へ：22列左でベルト固着、シートベルトカッター必要。乗客退避不可。訓練乗務員至急派遣。
usageTranslations.it: Cockpit a cabina: taglia-cinture richiesto fila 22 sinistra, cintura bloccata e passeggero non può evacuare; inviare equipaggio addestrato subito.
usageTranslations.vi: Buồng lái gọi khoang: cần dao cắt dây tại hàng 22 trái, dây kẹt, hành khách không thoát được; cử tổ bay đã huấn luyện ngay.
usageTranslations.hi: कॉकपिट से केबिन: पंक्ति 22 बाएँ पर सीट-बेल्ट कटर चाहिए, बेल्ट फंसा है, यात्री निकल नहीं पा रहा; प्रशिक्षित क्रू तुरंत भेजें।
usageTranslations.th: ค็อกพิทถึงห้องโดยสาร ต้องการที่ตัดเข็มขัดที่แถว 22 ซ้าย เข็มขัดติด ผู้โดยสารอพยพไม่ได้ ส่งลูกเรือที่ผ่านการฝึกทันที
usageTranslations.id: Kokpit ke kabin: perlu pemotong sabuk di baris 22 kiri, sabuk macet penumpang tak bisa evakuasi; kirim kru terlatih segera.

terms.definition: A mandatory operational meeting or exchange held prior to flight, covering crew assignments, weather, NOTAMs, operational considerations, and emergency procedures as per regulatory requirements.
terms.usage: All crew are required to attend the pre-flight briefing for today’s flight to review safety and operational details.

termTranslations.ja: フライト前ブリーフィング
termTranslations.vi: Họp giao ban trước chuyến bay
termTranslations.th: การบรีฟก่อนเที่ยวบิน

usageTranslations.en: All crew are required to attend the pre-flight briefing for today’s flight to review safety and operational details.
usageTranslations.tr: Tüm mürettebat, güvenlik ve operasyonel detayları gözden geçirmek için bugünkü uçuşun öncesindeki brifinge katılmalıdır.
usageTranslations.fr: Tout l’équipage doit assister au briefing avant vol d’aujourd’hui pour revoir les détails de sécurité et d’opération.
usageTranslations.de: Alle Besatzungsmitglieder müssen an der Flugvorbesprechung für den heutigen Flug teilnehmen, um Sicherheits- und Betriebsdetails zu besprechen.
usageTranslations.es: Toda la tripulación debe asistir a la instrucción previa al vuelo de hoy para repasar detalles de seguridad y operativos.
usageTranslations.zh: 所有机组人员须参加今日飞行的飞行前简报，以复查安全和操作细节。
usageTranslations.ar: يجب على جميع الطاقم حضور إيجاز ما قبل الرحلة لمراجعة تفاصيل السلامة والتشغيل.
usageTranslations.pt: Toda a tripulação deve comparecer ao briefing pré-voo para revisar detalhes de segurança e operacionais.
usageTranslations.ru: Весь экипаж обязан присутствовать на предполетном инструктаже для ознакомления с деталями безопасности и операций.
usageTranslations.ja: 全乗務員は本日のフライト前ブリーフィングに出席し、安全および運航の詳細を確認する必要があります。
usageTranslations.it: Tutto l’equipaggio deve partecipare al briefing pre-volo di oggi per rivedere dettagli di sicurezza e operativi.
usageTranslations.vi: Tất cả phi hành đoàn phải tham dự họp giao ban trước chuyến bay hôm nay để rà soát chi tiết an toàn và vận hành.
usageTranslations.hi: सभी चालक दल को सुरक्षा और संचालन विवरण की समीक्षा के लिए आज की उड़ान की उड़ान पूर्व ब्रीफिंग में भाग लेना आवश्यक है।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือทุกคนต้องเข้าร่วมการบรีฟก่อนเที่ยวบินวันนี้เพื่อทบทวนรายละเอียดด้านความปลอดภัยและการปฏิบัติงาน
usageTranslations.id: Seluruh kru diwajibkan mengikuti briefing pra-penerbangan hari ini untuk meninjau rincian keselamatan dan operasional.

terms.definition: An official list of all passengers onboard an aircraft, required by aviation regulations for tracking, safety, and emergency response.
terms.usage: Please ensure the passenger manifest is complete and submitted to ATC before departure.

termTranslations.th: บัญชีรายชื่อผู้โดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: Please ensure the passenger manifest is complete and submitted to ATC before departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Lütfen yolcu manifestosunun tam olduğundan ve kalkış öncesi ATC’ye sunulduğundan emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Veuillez vous assurer que le manifeste des passagers est complet et remis à l’ATC avant le départ.
usageTranslations.de: Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass die Passagierliste vollständig ist und vor dem Abflug an die ATC übermittelt wurde.
usageTranslations.es: Por favor, asegúrese de que la lista de pasajeros esté completa y entregada a ATC antes de la salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 请确保乘客名单完整并在起飞前提交给空管。
usageTranslations.ar: يرجى التأكد من اكتمال كشف أسماء الركاب وتقديمه إلى ATC قبل المغادرة.
usageTranslations.pt: Por favor, certifique-se de que o manifesto de passageiros está completo e entregue à ATC antes da partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пассажирский манифест заполнен и передан диспетчеру до вылета.
usageTranslations.ja: 乗客名簿が完全で、出発前にATCに提出されていることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Assicurarsi che il manifesto passeggeri sia completo e consegnato all’ATC prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Vui lòng đảm bảo danh sách hành khách đã đầy đủ và nộp cho ATC trước khi khởi hành.
usageTranslations.hi: कृपया सुनिश्चित करें कि यात्री सूची पूरी है और प्रस्थान से पहले ATC को सौंप दी गई है।
usageTranslations.th: กรุณาตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าบัญชีรายชื่อผู้โดยสารครบถ้วนและส่งให้ ATC ก่อนออกเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Pastikan manifest penumpang sudah lengkap dan diserahkan ke ATC sebelum keberangkatan.

terms.definition: A meal specially requested to meet specific dietary, religious, or medical requirements for individual passengers, to be loaded as per manifest.
terms.usage: Verify that all special meal requests are loaded and assigned to the correct seats before boarding.

termTranslations.th: อาหารพิเศษ

usageTranslations.en: Verify that all special meal requests are loaded and assigned to the correct seats before boarding.
usageTranslations.tr: Tüm özel yemek taleplerinin uçağa yüklendiğinden ve doğru koltuklara atandığından emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Vérifiez que toutes les demandes de repas spéciaux sont chargées et affectées aux bons sièges avant l’embarquement.
usageTranslations.de: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Spezialmahlzeiten geladen und den richtigen Sitzen zugewiesen sind, bevor das Boarding beginnt.
usageTranslations.es: Verifique que todas las comidas especiales estén cargadas y asignadas a los asientos correctos antes de abordar.
usageTranslations.zh: 请核实所有特殊餐食已装载并分配到正确座位，在登机前完成。
usageTranslations.ar: تحقق من تحميل جميع طلبات الوجبات الخاصة وتوزيعها على المقاعد الصحيحة قبل الصعود.
usageTranslations.pt: Verifique se todas as refeições especiais foram carregadas e atribuídas aos assentos corretos antes do embarque.
usageTranslations.ru: Убедитесь, что все специальные блюда загружены и назначены правильным местам до посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: 全ての特別食が搭載され、正しい座席に割り当てられているか搭乗前に確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Verifica che tutti i pasti speciali siano caricati e assegnati ai posti corretti prima dell’imbarco.
usageTranslations.vi: Xác nhận tất cả suất ăn đặc biệt đã được xếp đúng chỗ ngồi trước khi lên máy bay.
usageTranslations.hi: सभी विशेष भोजन अनुरोध लोड और सही सीटों को सौंपे गए हैं, इसकी पुष्टि करें।
usageTranslations.th: ตรวจสอบว่าอาหารพิเศษทุกประเภทบรรจุและจัดให้กับที่นั่งที่ถูกต้องก่อนขึ้นเครื่อง
usageTranslations.id: Pastikan semua permintaan makanan khusus sudah dimuat dan ditempatkan di kursi yang benar sebelum boarding.

terms.definition: A child travelling alone without a legal guardian, requiring airline supervision and special handling procedures as per ICAO Annex 9.
terms.usage: Escort the unaccompanied minor to the gate and confirm their handover with ground staff according to airline policy.

termTranslations.vi: Trẻ em không người đi kèm
termTranslations.th: ผู้เยาว์เดินทางลำพัง

usageTranslations.en: Escort the unaccompanied minor to the gate and confirm their handover with ground staff according to airline policy.
usageTranslations.tr: Refakatsiz çocuğu kapıya kadar eşlik edin ve yer personeline teslim edildiğini doğrulayın.
usageTranslations.fr: Accompagnez le mineur non accompagné à la porte et confirmez son transfert avec le personnel au sol conformément à la politique de la compagnie.
usageTranslations.de: Begleiten Sie das unbegleitete Kind zum Gate und bestätigen Sie die Übergabe mit dem Bodenpersonal gemäß den Airline-Richtlinien.
usageTranslations.es: Acompañe al menor no acompañado hasta la puerta y confirme la entrega con el personal de tierra según la política de la aerolínea.
usageTranslations.zh: 护送无陪伴儿童至登机口，并与地面工作人员确认交接，遵循航空公司政策。
usageTranslations.ar: رافق القاصر غير المصحوب إلى البوابة وحقق من تسليمه مع موظفي الأرض وفق سياسة الشركة.
usageTranslations.pt: Acompanhe o menor desacompanhado até o portão e confirme a entrega com a equipe de solo conforme a política da companhia aérea.
usageTranslations.ru: Сопроводите несопровождаемого несовершеннолетнего к выходу и подтвердите передачу наземному персоналу согласно политике авиакомпании.
usageTranslations.ja: 同伴者なし未成年者をゲートまで案内し、地上職員との引き渡しを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Accompagnare il minore non accompagnato al gate e confermare la consegna con il personale di terra secondo la politica della compagnia.
usageTranslations.vi: Hộ tống trẻ không người đi kèm đến cửa lên máy bay và xác nhận bàn giao với nhân viên mặt đất theo chính sách hãng.
usageTranslations.hi: असंगत नाबालिग को गेट तक ले जाएं और एयरलाइन नीति के अनुसार ग्राउंड स्टाफ के साथ उसके हस्तांतरण की पुष्टि करें।
usageTranslations.th: พาผู้เยาว์เดินทางลำพังไปที่ประตูขึ้นเครื่องและยืนยันการส่งมอบกับพนักงานภาคพื้นดินตามนโยบายสายการบิน
usageTranslations.id: Antar anak tanpa pendamping ke gate dan konfirmasi serah terima dengan staf darat sesuai kebijakan maskapai.

terms.definition: Wheelchair service code for a passenger requiring assistance to and from the aircraft but able to ascend and descend steps independently.
terms.usage: Confirm the passenger requesting Wheelchair WCHR is assisted to the gate and that all requirements are met prior to boarding.

termTranslations.th: รถเข็น (WCHR)

usageTranslations.en: Confirm the passenger requesting Wheelchair WCHR is assisted to the gate and that all requirements are met prior to boarding.
usageTranslations.tr: Tekerlekli sandalye (WCHR) talep eden yolcunun kapıya kadar eşlik edildiğinden ve tüm gereksinimlerin boarding öncesi karşılandığından emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Assurez-vous que le passager demandant un fauteuil roulant (WCHR) est assisté jusqu’à la porte et que toutes les exigences sont satisfaites avant l’embarquement.
usageTranslations.de: Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Passagier, der einen Rollstuhl (WCHR) angefordert hat, bis zum Gate begleitet wird und alle Anforderungen vor dem Boarding erfüllt sind.
usageTranslations.es: Confirme que el pasajero que solicita silla de ruedas (WCHR) ha sido asistido hasta la puerta y que todos los requisitos están cumplidos antes del embarque.
usageTranslations.zh: 请确认申请轮椅（WCHR）的乘客已被协助至登机口并在登机前满足所有要求。
usageTranslations.ar: تأكد من أن الراكب الذي يطلب كرسي متحرك (WCHR) قد تم مساعدته إلى البوابة وتم تلبية جميع المتطلبات قبل الصعود.
usageTranslations.pt: Confirme que o passageiro que solicita cadeira de rodas (WCHR) foi assistido até o portão e que todos os requisitos foram atendidos antes do embarque.
usageTranslations.ru: Убедитесь, что пассажир, запрашивающий инвалидную коляску (WCHR), был доставлен к выходу и что все требования выполнены до посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: 車椅子（WCHR）を要請した乗客がゲートまで案内され、搭乗前にすべての要件が満たされていることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Assicurarsi che il passeggero che richiede la sedia a rotelle (WCHR) sia assistito fino al gate e che tutti i requisiti siano soddisfatti prima dell’imbarco.
usageTranslations.vi: Xác nhận hành khách yêu cầu xe lăn (WCHR) đã được hỗ trợ đến cửa lên máy bay và đáp ứng mọi yêu cầu trước khi lên máy bay.
usageTranslations.hi: व्हीलचेयर (WCHR) की मांग करने वाले यात्री को गेट तक सहायता प्रदान की गई है और सभी आवश्यकताएं बोर्डिंग से पहले पूरी कर ली गई हैं, इसकी पुष्टि करें।
usageTranslations.th: ยืนยันว่าผู้โดยสารที่ขอรถเข็น (WCHR) ได้รับความช่วยเหลือถึงประตูขึ้นเครื่องและปฏิบัติตามข้อกำหนดทั้งหมดก่อนขึ้นเครื่อง
usageTranslations.id: Pastikan penumpang yang meminta kursi roda (WCHR) telah didampingi ke gate dan semua persyaratan sudah dipenuhi sebelum boarding.

terms.definition: A pet permitted to travel in the aircraft cabin with the passenger, subject to airline policies and operational restrictions; denoted as PETC.
terms.usage: Confirm that the pet in-cabin is documented as PETC and meets all operational requirements for cabin carriage.

termTranslations.vi: Thú nuôi trong khoang hành khách
termTranslations.th: สัตว์เลี้ยงในห้องโดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: Confirm that the pet in-cabin is documented as PETC and meets all operational requirements for cabin carriage.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin içi evcil hayvanın (PETC) belgelendiğini ve kabin taşımacılığı için tüm operasyonel gereksinimleri karşıladığını doğrulayın.
usageTranslations.fr: Vérifiez que l’animal en cabine (PETC) est documenté et respecte toutes les exigences opérationnelles pour le transport en cabine.
usageTranslations.de: Bestätigen Sie, dass das Tier in der Kabine (PETC) dokumentiert ist und alle betrieblichen Anforderungen für den Transport im Kabinenraum erfüllt.
usageTranslations.es: Confirme que la mascota en cabina (PETC) está documentada y cumple con todos los requisitos operativos para su transporte en cabina.
usageTranslations.zh: 请确认客舱宠物（PETC）已登记并满足所有客舱运输的运营要求。
usageTranslations.ar: تأكد من توثيق الحيوان الأليف في المقصورة (PETC) وأنه يستوفي جميع المتطلبات التشغيلية للنقل في المقصورة.
usageTranslations.pt: Confirme que o animal de estimação na cabine (PETC) está documentado e atende a todos os requisitos operacionais para transporte em cabine.
usageTranslations.ru: Убедитесь, что животное в салоне (PETC) оформлено и соответствует всем операционным требованиям для перевозки в салоне.
usageTranslations.ja: 機内ペット（PETC）が記録され、客室持ち込みに必要な運用要件を満たしていることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Verifica che l’animale in cabina (PETC) sia documentato e soddisfi tutti i requisiti operativi per il trasporto in cabina.
usageTranslations.vi: Xác nhận thú nuôi trong khoang hành khách (PETC) đã được ghi nhận và đáp ứng mọi yêu cầu vận hành đối với vận chuyển trong khoang.
usageTranslations.hi: सुनिश्चित करें कि केबिन में पालतू (PETC) प्रलेखित है और केबिन परिवहन के लिए सभी संचालन आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करता है।
usageTranslations.th: ยืนยันว่าสัตว์เลี้ยงในห้องโดยสาร (PETC) ได้รับการบันทึกและปฏิบัติตามข้อกำหนดการขนส่งในห้องโดยสารทั้งหมด
usageTranslations.id: Pastikan hewan peliharaan di kabin (PETC) sudah tercatat dan memenuhi semua persyaratan operasional untuk pengangkutan di kabin.

terms.definition: The process of loading all required food, beverages, and associated service items onto an aircraft prior to departure, coordinated between ground catering and cabin crew.
terms.usage: Ground, confirm catering uplift completed and all galley trolleys secured before boarding commences.

termTranslations.th: โหลดอาหารและเครื่องดื่ม

usageTranslations.en: Ground, confirm catering uplift completed and all galley trolleys secured before boarding commences.
usageTranslations.tr: Yer hizmetleri, ikram yüklemesinin tamamlandığını ve tüm galley arabalarının sabitlendiğini boarding başlamadan önce teyit edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Sol, confirmez que le chargement du service de bord est terminé et que tous les chariots sont sécurisés avant l’embarquement.
usageTranslations.de: Boden, bestätigen Sie, dass das Catering aufgenommen und alle Bordküchenwagen vor dem Boarding gesichert sind.
usageTranslations.es: Tierra, confirme que la carga de catering ha finalizado y todos los carritos están asegurados antes de embarcar.
usageTranslations.zh: 地面，确认配餐装载完成且所有厨房推车在登机前已固定。
usageTranslations.ar: الأرض، أكد اكتمال تحميل التموين وتأمين جميع عربات المطبخ قبل بدء الصعود.
usageTranslations.pt: Solo, confirme o abastecimento de catering e o travamento de todos os trolleys antes do embarque.
usageTranslations.ru: Наземные службы, подтвердите завершение загрузки питания и фиксацию всех тележек перед посадкой.
usageTranslations.ja: グランド、搭乗開始前にケータリング積込が完了し全ギャレー用カートが固定されていることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Terra, confermare il carico catering completato e tutti i carrelli fissati prima dell’imbarco.
usageTranslations.vi: Đội mặt đất xác nhận việc nạp thực phẩm phục vụ đã hoàn tất và xe đẩy bếp được cố định trước khi lên máy bay.
usageTranslations.hi: ग्राउंड, पुष्टि करें कि कैटरिंग लोडिंग पूरी हो गई है और सभी गैली ट्रॉली बोर्डिंग शुरू होने से पहले सुरक्षित हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ภาคพื้นดิน กรุณายืนยันว่าได้โหลดอาหารและเครื่องดื่มเสร็จแล้วและเก็บรถเข็นในครัวทั้งหมดก่อนเริ่มขึ้นเครื่อง
usageTranslations.id: Petugas darat, pastikan pengangkatan katering selesai dan semua troli dapur sudah diamankan sebelum boarding.

terms.definition: The specified location or compartment onboard the aircraft dedicated to the storage and preparation of food and beverage service items, designated for cabin operations.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, verify all galley positions are stocked and secured prior to pushback.

termTranslations.th: ตำแหน่งห้องครัวบนเครื่อง

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, verify all galley positions are stocked and secured prior to pushback.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, tüm galley konumlarının pushback öncesinde stoklandığını ve sabitlendiğini doğrulayın.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, vérifiez que tous les emplacements du galley sont approvisionnés et sécurisés avant le repoussage.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, überprüfen Sie vor dem Pushback, ob alle Galley-Positionen bestückt und gesichert sind.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, verifique que todas las posiciones de galera estén abastecidas y aseguradas antes del pushback.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱乘务组，请在推机前确认所有厨房位置已备齐并固定。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، تحقق من تزويد جميع مواقع المطبخ الجوي وتأمينها قبل الدفع للخلف.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, verifiquem se todas as posições do galley estão abastecidas e seguras antes do pushback.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, проверьте, что все позиции камбуза укомплектованы и зафиксированы перед буксировкой.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員の皆様、プッシュバック前にすべてのギャレー位置が補充・固定されているか確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, verificare che tutte le posizioni della cambusa siano rifornite e fissate prima del pushback.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên xác nhận tất cả vị trí bếp đã được dự trữ và cố định trước khi đẩy lùi.
usageTranslations.hi: कैबिन क्रू, सभी गैली स्थिति की पुष्टि करें कि पुशबैक से पहले वे स्टॉक और सुरक्षित हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือโปรดตรวจสอบว่าตำแหน่งห้องครัวทุกแห่งได้จัดเตรียมและเก็บให้ปลอดภัยก่อนจะดันเครื่อง
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, pastikan semua posisi galley sudah terisi dan diamankan sebelum pushback.

terms.definition: Tamper-evident security seals affixed to galley trolleys or beverage carts to ensure contents have not been accessed between service or flight segments.
terms.usage: Before landing, cabin crew must check all trolley seals for integrity and report any discrepancies to the purser.

termTranslations.th: ซีลรถเข็น

usageTranslations.en: Before landing, cabin crew must check all trolley seals for integrity and report any discrepancies to the purser.
usageTranslations.tr: İniş öncesi, kabin ekibi tüm trolley mühürlerinin sağlamlığını kontrol etmeli ve herhangi bir uygunsuzluğu kabin amirine bildirmelidir.
usageTranslations.fr: Avant l’atterrissage, l’équipage cabine doit vérifier l’intégrité des scellés de chariot et signaler toute anomalie au chef de cabine.
usageTranslations.de: Vor der Landung muss das Kabinenpersonal alle Trolley-Siegel auf Unversehrtheit überprüfen und Abweichungen an den Purser melden.
usageTranslations.es: Antes del aterrizaje, la tripulación debe revisar la integridad de todos los precintos de carro y reportar cualquier anomalía al sobrecargo.
usageTranslations.zh: 在着陆前，乘务组需检查所有手推车封条的完整性并向乘务长报告异常。
usageTranslations.ar: قبل الهبوط، يجب على طاقم المقصورة فحص جميع أختام العربات والإبلاغ عن أي مخالفة للمشرف.
usageTranslations.pt: Antes do pouso, a tripulação deve checar todos os lacres dos carrinhos e relatar discrepâncias ao chefe de cabine.
usageTranslations.ru: Перед посадкой экипаж должен проверить все пломбы тележек и сообщить о любых несоответствиях старшему бортпроводнику.
usageTranslations.ja: 着陸前に客室乗務員は全トロリーシールの状態を確認し、問題があればチーフパーサーに報告します。
usageTranslations.it: Prima dell’atterraggio, l’equipaggio deve controllare l’integrità dei sigilli dei carrelli e segnalare eventuali anomalie al capo cabina.
usageTranslations.vi: Trước khi hạ cánh, tiếp viên phải kiểm tra niêm phong xe đẩy và báo cáo bất thường cho trưởng tiếp viên.
usageTranslations.hi: लैंडिंग से पहले, कैबिन क्रू को सभी ट्रॉली सील की अखंडता की जांच करनी चाहिए और किसी भी विसंगति की रिपोर्ट पर्सर को करनी चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: ก่อนเครื่องลงจอด ลูกเรือต้องตรวจสอบซีลรถเข็นทุกคันและรายงานความผิดปกติให้หัวหน้าพนักงานต้อนรับทราบ
usageTranslations.id: Sebelum mendarat, kru kabin harus memeriksa segel troli dan melaporkan ketidaksesuaian apa pun kepada kepala awak kabin.

terms.definition: A service cart used by cabin crew to serve drinks and light refreshments to passengers during the flight, stowed in the galley when not in use.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, ensure all beverage carts are secured and locked in the galley before taxi and landing.

termTranslations.th: รถเข็นเครื่องดื่ม

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, ensure all beverage carts are secured and locked in the galley before taxi and landing.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, tüm içecek arabalarının taksi ve iniş öncesinde galleyde kilitlendiğinden ve sabitlendiğinden emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, assurez-vous que tous les chariots de boissons sont sécurisés et verrouillés dans le galley avant le roulage et l’atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Getränkewagen vor dem Rollen und der Landung im Galley gesichert und verschlossen sind.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, asegúrese de que todos los carros de bebidas estén asegurados y cerrados en la galera antes de rodaje y aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱乘务组，请确保所有饮料推车在滑行和着陆前已在厨房内锁定和固定。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، تأكدوا من تأمين جميع عربات المشروبات وإغلاقها في المطبخ الجوي قبل التحرك والهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, garantam que todos os carrinhos de bebidas estejam travados no galley antes do táxi e pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, убедитесь, что все тележки для напитков закреплены и закрыты в камбузе до руления и посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員は全ての飲料カートがギャレー内でロック・固定されているか、タクシングや着陸前に必ず確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, assicuratevi che tutti i carrelli delle bevande siano bloccati nella cambusa prima di rullaggio e atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên xác nhận tất cả xe đẩy đồ uống đã được cố định trong bếp trước khi di chuyển và hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: कैबिन क्रू, सभी पेय पदार्थ गाड़ी को टैक्सी और लैंडिंग से पहले गैली में लॉक और सुरक्षित रखें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือโปรดตรวจสอบว่ารถเข็นเครื่องดื่มทุกคันถูกล็อคในห้องครัวก่อนเคลื่อนตัวและลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, pastikan semua kereta minuman diamankan dan dikunci di galley sebelum taxi dan mendarat.

terms.definition: Any formal communication delivered to passengers by flight or cabin crew via public address system regarding flight information, safety, or operational matters.
terms.usage: Flight crew, please make the passenger announcement regarding estimated arrival time and expected weather conditions.

termTranslations.th: ประกาศสำหรับผู้โดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: Flight crew, please make the passenger announcement regarding estimated arrival time and expected weather conditions.
usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş ekibi, tahmini varış zamanı ve beklenen hava durumu hakkında yolcu anonsunu yapınız.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage de vol, veuillez faire l’annonce passagers concernant l’heure d’arrivée estimée et les conditions météorologiques prévues.
usageTranslations.de: Flugbesatzung, bitte machen Sie die Passagierdurchsage zur voraussichtlichen Ankunftszeit und zum erwarteten Wetter.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de vuelo, realicen el anuncio para pasajeros sobre la hora estimada de llegada y las condiciones meteorológicas esperadas.
usageTranslations.zh: 机组人员，请进行有关预计到达时间和预期天气状况的乘客广播。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم الطائرة، يرجى إعلان الركاب عن الوقت المتوقع للوصول وحالة الطقس المتوقعة.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação, façam o anúncio ao passageiro sobre o horário estimado de chegada e as condições meteorológicas previstas.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж, сделайте объявление для пассажиров о расчетном времени прибытия и ожидаемых погодных условиях.
usageTranslations.ja: 乗務員は到着予定時刻と予想される天候について乗客へのアナウンスを行ってください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, fare l’annuncio ai passeggeri riguardo l’orario stimato di arrivo e le condizioni meteorologiche attese.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi hành đoàn thực hiện thông báo hành khách về thời gian đến dự kiến và điều kiện thời tiết.
usageTranslations.hi: फ्लाइट क्रू, अनुमानित आगमन समय और अपेक्षित मौसम की स्थिति के बारे में यात्री घोषणा करें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือโปรดประกาศเวลาโดยประมาณที่เครื่องจะถึงและสภาพอากาศที่คาดการณ์
usageTranslations.id: Kru penerbangan, harap lakukan pengumuman penumpang terkait perkiraan waktu kedatangan dan kondisi cuaca.

terms.definition: A mandatory demonstration by the cabin crew, conducted prior to takeoff, showing passengers the use of safety equipment and procedures as per regulatory standards.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, prepare for the safety demo and ensure all passengers can see the demonstration clearly before takeoff.

termTranslations.th: สาธิตความปลอดภัย

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, prepare for the safety demo and ensure all passengers can see the demonstration clearly before takeoff.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, emniyet demonstrasyonu için hazırlanın ve kalkış öncesi tüm yolcuların gösterimi net görebildiğinden emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, préparez-vous pour la démo de sécurité et assurez-vous que tous les passagers voient clairement la démonstration avant le décollage.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, bereiten Sie die Sicherheitsvorführung vor und stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Passagiere diese vor dem Start gut sehen können.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, prepárense para la demostración de seguridad y asegúrense de que todos los pasajeros puedan verla claramente antes del despegue.
usageTranslations.zh: 乘务组请准备安全演示，并确保所有乘客在起飞前能够清楚看到演示。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، استعدوا لعرض السلامة وتأكدوا من أن جميع الركاب يرون العرض بوضوح قبل الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, preparem-se para a demonstração de segurança e certifiquem-se de que todos os passageiros possam vê-la claramente antes da decolagem.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, подготовьтесь к демонстрации безопасности и убедитесь, что все пассажиры могут видеть показ перед взлетом.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員は安全デモの準備をし、全ての乗客が離陸前にデモを見ることができるようにしてください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio di cabina, prepararsi per la dimostrazione di sicurezza e assicurarsi che tutti i passeggeri possano vedere chiaramente la dimostrazione prima del decollo.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên chuẩn bị hướng dẫn an toàn và đảm bảo tất cả hành khách đều có thể quan sát trước khi cất cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: कैबिन क्रू, सुरक्षा प्रदर्शन के लिए तैयार हों और सुनिश्चित करें कि सभी यात्री टेकऑफ से पहले प्रदर्शन को स्पष्ट रूप से देख सकें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือโปรดเตรียมสาธิตความปลอดภัยและตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าผู้โดยสารทุกคนมองเห็นได้ชัดเจนก่อนเครื่องขึ้น
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, siapkan demo keselamatan dan pastikan semua penumpang dapat melihat demonstrasi dengan jelas sebelum lepas landas.

terms.definition: The current operational state of all aircraft doors—open, closed, armed, disarmed—communicated between cabin crew, flight crew, and ground staff before movement or takeoff.
terms.usage: Cabin, report door status to the flight deck prior to pushback and confirm all doors are closed and armed.

termTranslations.th: สถานะประตู

usageTranslations.en: Cabin, report door status to the flight deck prior to pushback and confirm all doors are closed and armed.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin, pushback öncesi kokpite kapı durumunu rapor edin ve tüm kapıların kapalı ve arm olduğundan emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Cabine, indiquez le statut des portes au poste de pilotage avant le repoussage et confirmez que toutes les portes sont fermées et armées.
usageTranslations.de: Kabine, melden Sie den Türstatus an das Cockpit vor dem Pushback und bestätigen Sie, dass alle Türen geschlossen und scharf sind.
usageTranslations.es: Cabina, informe el estado de las puertas a la cabina de mando antes del pushback y confirme que todas las puertas están cerradas y armadas.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱，请在推出前向驾驶舱报告舱门状态，并确认所有舱门均已关闭并处于待命状态。
usageTranslations.ar: الكابينة، أبلغ وضع الأبواب إلى قمرة القيادة قبل الدفع للخلف وتأكد من إغلاق جميع الأبواب وتفعيلها.
usageTranslations.pt: Cabine, informe o status das portas à cabine de comando antes do pushback e confirme que todas estão fechadas e armadas.
usageTranslations.ru: Кабина, сообщите статус дверей экипажу перед буксировкой и подтвердите, что все двери закрыты и вооружены.
usageTranslations.ja: キャビン、プッシュバック前にドアステータスをフライトデッキへ報告し、全てのドアが閉鎖・アームされていることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Cabina, riferire lo stato delle porte al ponte di comando prima del pushback e confermare che tutte le porte siano chiuse e armate.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên báo cáo trạng thái cửa cho buồng lái trước khi đẩy lùi và xác nhận tất cả cửa đã đóng và kích hoạt.
usageTranslations.hi: कैबिन, पुशबैक से पहले फ्लाइट डेक को द्वार स्थिति रिपोर्ट करें और पुष्टि करें कि सभी द्वार बंद और आर्म हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือรายงานสถานะประตูให้ห้องนักบินก่อนดันเครื่องและยืนยันว่าประตูทั้งหมดปิดและเตรียมพร้อมแล้ว
usageTranslations.id: Kabin, laporkan status pintu ke flight deck sebelum pushback dan pastikan semua pintu sudah tertutup dan diarm.

terms.definition: A condition in which an aircraft's emergency evacuation slide is mechanically engaged to deploy automatically upon door opening.
terms.usage: Left and right door slides are armed; cabin is ready for taxi.

termTranslations.th: สไลด์เตรียมพร้อม

usageTranslations.en: Left and right door slides are armed; cabin is ready for taxi.
usageTranslations.tr: Sol ve sağ kapı kaydırakları arm; kabin taksi için hazır.
usageTranslations.fr: Les toboggans des portes gauche et droite sont armés; la cabine est prête pour le roulage.
usageTranslations.de: Linke und rechte Tür-Rutschen scharf; Kabine bereit zum Rollen.
usageTranslations.es: Las rampas de las puertas izquierda y derecha están armadas; cabina lista para rodaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 左、右舱门滑梯均已备战，客舱可滑行。
usageTranslations.ar: شرائح الأبواب اليمنى واليسرى مسلحة؛ الكابينة جاهزة للتحرك.
usageTranslations.pt: Escorregadores das portas esquerda e direita armados; cabine pronta para taxi.
usageTranslations.ru: Левый и правый трапы вооружены, кабина готова к рулению.
usageTranslations.ja: 左右のドアスライドがアーム状態、キャビンはタキシー準備完了。
usageTranslations.it: Gli scivoli delle porte sinistra e destra sono armati; cabina pronta per il rullaggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Cầu trượt cửa trái và phải đã kích hoạt; khoang hành khách sẵn sàng di chuyển.
usageTranslations.hi: बाएँ और दाएँ दरवाजे की स्लाइड आर्म हैं; केबिन टैक्सी के लिए तैयार है।
usageTranslations.th: สไลด์ประตูซ้ายและขวาถูกเตรียมพร้อมแล้ว ห้องโดยสารพร้อมสำหรับแท็กซี่
usageTranslations.id: Slide pintu kiri dan kanan sudah diarm; kabin siap untuk taxi.

terms.definition: A state in which an aircraft's emergency evacuation slide is mechanically disengaged so it will not deploy if the door is opened.
terms.usage: Cabin, confirm all door slides are disarmed and doors are safe for arrival at the gate.

termTranslations.ja: スライド・ディスアーム
termTranslations.vi: Cầu trượt đã tháo kích hoạt
termTranslations.th: สไลด์ปลดเตรียมพร้อม

usageTranslations.en: Cabin, confirm all door slides are disarmed and doors are safe for arrival at the gate.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin, tüm kapı kaydıraklarının disarm olduğunu ve kapıların gate varışı için güvenli olduğunu teyit edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Cabine, confirmez que tous les toboggans des portes sont désarmés et que les portes sont sécurisées pour l’arrivée à la porte.
usageTranslations.de: Kabine, bestätigen Sie, dass alle Tür-Rutschen entschärft und die Türen für das Eintreffen am Gate sicher sind.
usageTranslations.es: Cabina, confirme que todas las rampas están desarmadas y las puertas son seguras para llegar a la puerta.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱，请确认所有舱门滑梯已解除待命，舱门可安全进站。
usageTranslations.ar: الكابينة، أكد أن جميع المنزلقات غير مسلحة وأن الأبواب آمنة للوصول إلى البوابة.
usageTranslations.pt: Cabine, confirme que todos os escorregadores estão desarmados e as portas seguras para chegada ao portão.
usageTranslations.ru: Кабина, подтвердите разрядку всех трапов и безопасность дверей для стоянки у гейта.
usageTranslations.ja: キャビン、全てのドアスライドがディスアーム状態で、ドアがゲート到着時に安全であることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Cabina, confermare che tutti gli scivoli sono disarmati e le porte sicure per l’arrivo al gate.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên xác nhận tất cả cầu trượt đã tháo kích hoạt và cửa an toàn để đến cổng.
usageTranslations.hi: कैबिन, पुष्टि करें कि सभी स्लाइड डिसआर्म हैं और द्वार गेट पर आगमन के लिए सुरक्षित हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือโปรดยืนยันว่าสไลด์ทั้งหมดปลดเตรียมพร้อมและประตูปลอดภัยสำหรับการถึงเกต
usageTranslations.id: Kabin, pastikan semua slide sudah tidak diarm dan pintu aman untuk tiba di gate.

terms.definition: Formal statement by cabin crew that all safety checks are completed, all items stowed, doors armed, and the cabin is ready for taxi, takeoff, or landing.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, report to flight deck: cabin secure for takeoff, all checks completed.

termTranslations.th: ห้องโดยสารปลอดภัย

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, report to flight deck: cabin secure for takeoff, all checks completed.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, kokpite rapor edin: kalkış için kabin emniyette, tüm kontroller tamamlandı.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, rapportez au poste de pilotage : cabine sécurisée pour le décollage, tous les contrôles effectués.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, melden Sie an das Cockpit: Kabine gesichert zum Start, alle Checks abgeschlossen.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, informe a la cabina de mando: cabina segura para el despegue, todas las revisiones completadas.
usageTranslations.zh: 乘务组，请向驾驶舱报告：客舱已安全，可起飞，所有检查已完成。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، أبلغوا قمرة القيادة: الكابينة مؤمنة للإقلاع، جميع الفحوصات مكتملة.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, informe ao cockpit: cabine segura para decolagem, todas as verificações concluídas.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, доложите на пилотскую: кабина закреплена для взлета, все проверки завершены.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員はフライトデッキに報告：キャビン・セキュア、全てのチェック完了、離陸可能。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio di cabina, riferite al ponte di comando: cabina sicura per il decollo, tutti i controlli completati.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên báo cáo buồng lái: khoang hành khách an toàn để cất cánh, đã hoàn tất mọi kiểm tra.
usageTranslations.hi: कैबिन क्रू, फ्लाइट डेक को रिपोर्ट करें: केबिन टेकऑफ के लिए सुरक्षित है, सभी जांचें पूरी हो चुकी हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือรายงานห้องนักบิน: ห้องโดยสารปลอดภัยสำหรับการขึ้นบิน ตรวจสอบเสร็จสิ้นทั้งหมด
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, laporkan ke flight deck: kabin aman untuk takeoff, semua pemeriksaan selesai.

terms.definition: The action of verifying that a safety-related task (such as arming/disarming doors) has been correctly completed by another crew member.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, arm doors and cross-check before departure.

termTranslations.th: การตรวจสอบไขว้

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, arm doors and cross-check before departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, kapıları kilitleyin ve kalkıştan önce karşı kontrol yapın.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, armez les portes et effectuez une vérification croisée avant le départ.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, Türen aktivieren und vor dem Abflug gegenprüfen.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, armen puertas y verifiquen cruzadamente antes de la salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 机舱乘务员，请在起飞前武装舱门并进行交叉检查。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، جهزوا الأبواب وقوموا بالتحقق المتقاطع قبل الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, armar portas e verificar cruzadamente antes da partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж, приведите двери в рабочее положение и выполните перекрёстную проверку перед вылетом.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員は、出発前にドアをアームしてクロスチェックしてください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio cabina, armate le porte e fate il controllo incrociato prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên, vũ trang cửa và kiểm tra chéo trước khi cất cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: केबिन क्रू, रवाना होने से पहले दरवाज़े आर्म करें और क्रॉस-जांच करें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือ โปรดเตรียมประตูและตรวจสอบไขว้ก่อนออกเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Awak kabin, lengkapi pintu dan lakukan pemeriksaan silang sebelum keberangkatan.

terms.definition: To set aircraft doors to a disarmed mode so that evacuation slides will not deploy when the door is opened.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, disarm all doors and cross-check.

termTranslations.ja: ドアをディスアームする
termTranslations.th: ปลดล็อกประตู

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, disarm all doors and cross-check.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, tüm kapıları pasif hale getirin ve karşı kontrol yapın.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, désarmez toutes les portes et effectuez une vérification croisée.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, alle Türen entschärfen und gegenprüfen.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, desarmen todas las puertas y verifiquen cruzadamente.
usageTranslations.zh: 机组人员，请解除所有舱门武装并进行交叉检查。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، فكوا تسليح جميع الأبواب وقوموا بالتحقق المتقاطع.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, desarmem todas as portas e verifiquem cruzadamente.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж, разоружите все двери и выполните перекрёстную проверку.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員はすべてのドアをディスアームしてクロスチェックしてください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio cabina, disarmate tutte le porte e fate il controllo incrociato.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên, hủy kích hoạt tất cả cửa và kiểm tra chéo.
usageTranslations.hi: केबिन क्रू, सभी दरवाज़े डिसआर्म करें और क्रॉस-जांच करें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือ ปลดล็อกประตูทั้งหมดและตรวจสอบไขว้
usageTranslations.id: Awak kabin, nonaktifkan semua pintu dan lakukan pemeriksaan silang.

terms.definition: An illuminated sign in the aircraft cabin that instructs passengers to fasten their seatbelts.
terms.usage: The captain has turned on the seatbelt sign due to turbulence ahead.

termTranslations.vi: Đèn báo thắt dây an toàn
termTranslations.th: สัญญาณเข็มขัดนิรภัย

usageTranslations.en: The captain has turned on the seatbelt sign due to turbulence ahead.
usageTranslations.tr: Kaptan, öndeki türbülans nedeniyle emniyet kemeri ikazını açtı.
usageTranslations.fr: Le commandant a allumé le signal de ceinture en raison de turbulences à venir.
usageTranslations.de: Der Kapitän hat das Sicherheitsgurtzeichen wegen bevorstehender Turbulenzen eingeschaltet.
usageTranslations.es: El capitán encendió la señal del cinturón debido a turbulencias.
usageTranslations.zh: 由于前方有乱流，机长已开启安全带指示灯。
usageTranslations.ar: قام القبطان بتشغيل إشارة حزام الأمان بسبب الاضطرابات القادمة.
usageTranslations.pt: O comandante acendeu a luz do cinto de segurança devido à turbulência à frente.
usageTranslations.ru: Капитан включил индикатор ремней из-за турбулентности впереди.
usageTranslations.ja: 機長は前方の乱気流のためシートベルトサインを点灯しました。
usageTranslations.it: Il comandante ha acceso il segnale della cintura per le turbolenze in arrivo.
usageTranslations.vi: Cơ trưởng đã bật đèn báo thắt dây do có nhiễu loạn phía trước.
usageTranslations.hi: कैप्टन ने आगे आने वाली अशांति के कारण सीटबेल्ट संकेत चालू किया है।
usageTranslations.th: กัปตันเปิดสัญญาณเข็มขัดนิรภัยเนื่องจากมีความปั่นป่วนข้างหน้า
usageTranslations.id: Kapten menyalakan lampu sabuk pengaman karena turbulensi di depan.

terms.definition: A mandatory cabin safety instruction indicating that smoking is prohibited on board the aircraft.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, please ensure that all passengers comply with the no smoking sign.

termTranslations.th: ห้ามสูบบุหรี่

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, please ensure that all passengers comply with the no smoking sign.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, lütfen tüm yolcuların sigara içilmez işaretine uyduğundan emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage de cabine, veuillez vous assurer que tous les passagers respectent le panneau interdiction de fumer.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, stellen Sie bitte sicher, dass alle Passagiere das Rauchverbotsschild befolgen.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación de cabina, por favor asegúrense de que todos los pasajeros respeten la señal de no fumar.
usageTranslations.zh: 机组人员，请确保所有乘客遵守禁止吸烟标志。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، يرجى التأكد من امتثال جميع الركاب لإشارة ممنوع التدخين.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação de cabine, por favor, assegurem-se de que todos os passageiros cumprem a sinalização de proibido fumar.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, убедитесь, что все пассажиры соблюдают знак запрета курения.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員の皆さん、すべての乗客が禁煙サインに従っていることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio di cabina, assicuratevi che tutti i passeggeri rispettino il segnale di divieto di fumo.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên, vui lòng đảm bảo tất cả hành khách tuân thủ biển cấm hút thuốc.
usageTranslations.hi: कृपया सुनिश्चित करें कि सभी यात्री धूम्रपान निषेध संकेत का पालन कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือโปรดตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าผู้โดยสารทุกคนปฏิบัตามสัญลักษณ์ห้ามสูบบุหรี่
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, harap pastikan semua penumpang mematuhi tanda dilarang merokok.

terms.definition: Any small battery-powered electronic item used by passengers, which may interfere with aircraft systems if not managed properly.
terms.usage: Passengers are reminded to turn off all portable electronic devices during take-off and landing.

termTranslations.vi: Thiết bị điện tử di động
termTranslations.th: อุปกรณ์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์แบบพกพา

usageTranslations.en: Passengers are reminded to turn off all portable electronic devices during take-off and landing.
usageTranslations.tr: Yolcuların kalkış ve iniş sırasında tüm taşınabilir elektronik cihazları kapatmaları hatırlatılır.
usageTranslations.fr: Il est rappelé aux passagers d'éteindre tous les appareils électroniques portables lors du décollage et de l'atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Passagiere werden daran erinnert, während Start und Landung alle tragbaren elektronischen Geräte auszuschalten.
usageTranslations.es: Se recuerda a los pasajeros apagar todos los dispositivos electrónicos portátiles durante el despegue y el aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 提醒乘客在起飞和降落期间关闭所有便携式电子设备。
usageTranslations.ar: يُطلب من الركاب إيقاف تشغيل جميع الأجهزة الإلكترونية المحمولة أثناء الإقلاع والهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Lembra-se aos passageiros de desligar todos os dispositivos eletrônicos portáteis durante a decolagem e o pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Пассажирам напоминается выключить все портативные электронные устройства во время взлета и посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: 離着陸時にはすべての携帯電子機器の電源を切るよう乗客に案内されます。
usageTranslations.it: Si ricorda ai passeggeri di spegnere tutti i dispositivi elettronici portatili durante decollo e atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Hành khách được nhắc nhở tắt tất cả thiết bị điện tử di động khi cất cánh và hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: यात्रियों को टेक-ऑफ और लैंडिंग के दौरान सभी पोर्टेबल इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डिवाइस बंद करने की याद दिलाई जाती है।
usageTranslations.th: แจ้งเตือนผู้โดยสารให้ปิดอุปกรณ์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์แบบพกพาทั้งหมดระหว่างการขึ้นและลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: Penumpang diingatkan untuk mematikan semua perangkat elektronik portabel saat lepas landas dan mendarat.

terms.definition: Confirmation that the aircraft's lavatory system is fully operational and available for use during flight.
terms.usage: Tower, Speedbird 123, confirm lavatory serviceable for departure clearance.

termTranslations.th: ห้องน้ำใช้งานได้

usageTranslations.en: Tower, Speedbird 123, confirm lavatory serviceable for departure clearance.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Speedbird 123, kalkış izni için tuvalet kullanılabilir olduğunu teyit edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Speedbird 123, confirmez toilettes opérationnelles pour autorisation de départ.
usageTranslations.de: Turm, Speedbird 123, bestätigen Sie Toilette funktionsfähig für Startfreigabe.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Speedbird 123, confirme lavabo operativo para autorización de despegue.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，Speedbird 123，确认洗手间可用以获得起飞许可。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، سبيدبيرد 123، تأكيد المرحاض صالح للاستخدام للحصول على تصريح الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Speedbird 123, confirme banheiro operacional para liberação de decolagem.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Speedbird 123, подтвердите, что туалет исправен для разрешения на взлёт.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、Speedbird 123、離陸許可のためにトイレ使用可能であることを確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Speedbird 123, confermi servizi igienici operativi per autorizzazione al decollo.
usageTranslations.vi: Đài kiểm soát, Speedbird 123, xác nhận nhà vệ sinh hoạt động để được cấp phép cất cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, Speedbird 123, प्रस्थान मंजूरी के लिए शौचालय उपयोगी की पुष्टि करें।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการบิน, Speedbird 123, ยืนยันห้องน้ำใช้งานได้เพื่อรับอนุญาตออกตัว。
usageTranslations.id: Menara, Speedbird 123, konfirmasi toilet dapat digunakan untuk izin lepas landas.

terms.definition: The controlled air pressure within an aircraft cabin, maintained to ensure passenger safety and comfort at altitude.
terms.usage: The cabin pressure is stable and within operational limits at cruising altitude.

termTranslations.th: ความดันในห้องโดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: The cabin pressure is stable and within operational limits at cruising altitude.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin basıncı sabittir ve seyir irtifasında operasyonel sınırlar içindedir.
usageTranslations.fr: La pression cabine est stable et dans les limites opérationnelles à l'altitude de croisière.
usageTranslations.de: Der Kabinendruck ist stabil und liegt innerhalb der Betriebsgrenzen auf Reiseflughöhe.
usageTranslations.es: La presión de cabina es estable y dentro de los límites operativos a altitud de crucero.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱压力稳定，在巡航高度时处于操作限制范围内。
usageTranslations.ar: ضغط المقصورة مستقر وضمن الحدود التشغيلية على ارتفاع الطيران.
usageTranslations.pt: A pressão da cabine está estável e dentro dos limites operacionais na altitude de cruzeiro.
usageTranslations.ru: Давление в кабине стабильно и находится в пределах эксплуатационных норм на крейсерской высоте.
usageTranslations.ja: 巡航高度で客室内の気圧は安定しており、運用限界内です。
usageTranslations.it: La pressione della cabina è stabile e nei limiti operativi a quota di crociera.
usageTranslations.vi: Áp suất khoang hành khách ổn định và trong giới hạn vận hành ở độ cao hành trình.
usageTranslations.hi: केबिन दबाव स्थिर है और क्रूज़ ऊंचाई पर परिचालन सीमा के भीतर है।
usageTranslations.th: ความดันในห้องโดยสารมีความเสถียรและอยู่ในขอบเขตการทำงานที่ระดับความสูง
usageTranslations.id: Tekanan kabin stabil dan berada dalam batas operasional pada ketinggian jelajah.

terms.definition: An animal on board not trained to assist a person with a disability, such as a pet, requiring specific handling.
terms.usage: Tower, Speedbird 123, reporting non-service animal on board for departure.

termTranslations.th: สัตว์ที่ไม่ใช่เพื่อการบริการ

usageTranslations.en: Tower, Speedbird 123, reporting non-service animal on board for departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Speedbird 123, kalkış için hizmet dışı hayvan bulunduğunu bildiriyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Speedbird 123, signale un animal non d'assistance à bord pour le départ.
usageTranslations.de: Turm, Speedbird 123, meldet ein nicht-Diensttier an Bord für den Start.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Speedbird 123, reporta animal no de servicio a bordo para despegue.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，Speedbird 123，报告机上有非服务动物以起飞。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، سبيدبيرد 123، يبلغ عن حيوان غير خدمي على متن الطائرة للإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Speedbird 123, reporta animal não de serviço a bordo para decolagem.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Speedbird 123, сообщаю о неслужебном животном на борту для вылета.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、Speedbird 123、離陸のために非介助動物が機内にいると報告します。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Speedbird 123, segnala animale non di servizio a bordo per il decollo.
usageTranslations.vi: Đài kiểm soát, Speedbird 123, báo cáo có động vật không phục vụ trên máy bay để cất cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, Speedbird 123, प्रस्थान के लिए गैर-सेवा पशु की उपस्थिति की रिपोर्टिंग।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการบิน, Speedbird 123, รายงานว่ามีสัตว์ที่ไม่ใช่เพื่อการบริการบนเครื่องเพื่อออกตัว。
usageTranslations.id: Menara, Speedbird 123, melaporkan hewan bukan pelayan di dalam pesawat untuk keberangkatan.

terms.definition: An onboard retail service offered to passengers, typically involving the sale of duty-free goods during flight.
terms.usage: The cabin crew will now commence the sky shop service, please have your payment method ready.

termTranslations.th: ร้านค้าบนเครื่องบิน

usageTranslations.en: The cabin crew will now commence the sky shop service, please have your payment method ready.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi şimdi uçak içi mağaza servisine başlayacaktır, lütfen ödeme yöntemlerinizi hazırlayın.
usageTranslations.fr: L'équipage va maintenant commencer le service de la boutique à bord, préparez votre moyen de paiement.
usageTranslations.de: Die Kabinenbesatzung beginnt jetzt mit dem Bordshop-Service, bitte halten Sie Ihr Zahlungsmittel bereit.
usageTranslations.es: La tripulación de cabina comenzará ahora el servicio de tienda a bordo, tenga su método de pago listo.
usageTranslations.zh: 机组人员将开始空中商店服务，请准备好您的付款方式。
usageTranslations.ar: سيبدأ طاقم المقصورة الآن خدمة المتجر الجوي، يرجى تجهيز وسيلة الدفع.
usageTranslations.pt: A tripulação de cabine iniciará agora o serviço de loja a bordo, prepare seu método de pagamento.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж начинает обслуживание магазина на борту, пожалуйста, подготовьте способ оплаты.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員が機内販売サービスを開始しますので、お支払い方法のご用意をお願いします。
usageTranslations.it: L'equipaggio inizierà ora il servizio del negozio a bordo, preparate il vostro metodo di pagamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên sẽ bắt đầu dịch vụ cửa hàng trên máy bay, vui lòng chuẩn bị phương thức thanh toán.
usageTranslations.hi: अब केबिन क्रू स्काई शॉप सेवा शुरू करेगा, कृपया अपना भुगतान तरीका तैयार रखें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือจะเริ่มให้บริการร้านค้าบนเครื่องบิน กรุณาเตรียมวิธีชำระเงินของคุณ
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin akan memulai layanan toko di pesawat, harap siapkan metode pembayaran Anda.

terms.definition: Row of seats adjacent to an emergency exit, where passengers have responsibilities for assisting in case of evacuation.
terms.usage: Tower, Speedbird 123, exit row passenger unable to assist in evacuation.

termTranslations.th: แถวที่นั่งทางออกฉุกเฉิน

usageTranslations.en: Tower, Speedbird 123, exit row passenger unable to assist in evacuation.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Speedbird 123, çıkış koltuk sırasındaki yolcu tahliyede yardımcı olamıyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Speedbird 123, passager en rangée de sortie incapable d'aider à l'évacuation.
usageTranslations.de: Turm, Speedbird 123, Passagier in der Notausgangsreihe kann bei Evakuierung nicht helfen.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Speedbird 123, pasajero en fila de salida no puede asistir en la evacuación.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，Speedbird 123，紧急出口座排的乘客无法协助疏散。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، سبيدبيرد 123، راكب في صف المخرج غير قادر على المساعدة في الإخلاء.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Speedbird 123, passageiro na fileira de saída incapaz de ajudar na evacuação.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Speedbird 123, пассажир в ряду у аварийного выхода не может помочь при эвакуации.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、Speedbird 123、非常口列の乗客が避難の支援ができません。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Speedbird 123, passeggero nella fila di uscita non può assistere nell'evacuazione.
usageTranslations.vi: Đài kiểm soát, Speedbird 123, hành khách ở hàng ghế lối thoát không thể hỗ trợ sơ tán.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, Speedbird 123, निकास पंक्ति का यात्री निकासी में सहायता करने में असमर्थ है।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการบิน, Speedbird 123, ผู้โดยสารในแถวทางออกฉุกเฉินไม่สามารถช่วยในการอพยพได้。
usageTranslations.id: Menara, Speedbird 123, penumpang di baris pintu keluar tidak dapat membantu evakuasi.

terms.definition: An indicator light in the aircraft cabin that signals a passenger is requesting crew assistance.
terms.usage: The passenger in seat 22C has activated the call light for assistance.

termTranslations.th: ไฟเรียก

usageTranslations.en: The passenger in seat 22C has activated the call light for assistance.
usageTranslations.tr: 22C koltuğundaki yolcu yardım için çağrı ışığını yaktı.
usageTranslations.fr: Le passager du siège 22C a activé la lumière d'appel pour demander de l'aide.
usageTranslations.de: Der Passagier auf Sitz 22C hat das Ruflicht zur Hilfe aktiviert.
usageTranslations.es: El pasajero en el asiento 22C ha activado la luz de llamada para pedir ayuda.
usageTranslations.zh: 22C座位的乘客已按下呼叫灯请求协助。
usageTranslations.ar: قام الراكب في المقعد 22C بتفعيل ضوء النداء لطلب المساعدة.
usageTranslations.pt: O passageiro do assento 22C ativou a luz de chamada para assistência.
usageTranslations.ru: Пассажир на месте 22C включил сигнальную кнопку для вызова помощи.
usageTranslations.ja: 22C席の乗客が呼び出しランプを点灯させて援助を求めました。
usageTranslations.it: Il passeggero al posto 22C ha attivato la luce di chiamata per assistenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Hành khách ghế 22C đã bật đèn gọi tiếp viên để được hỗ trợ.
usageTranslations.hi: 22C सीट पर बैठे यात्री ने सहायता के लिए कॉल लाइट चालू की है।
usageTranslations.th: ผู้โดยสารที่นั่ง 22C ได้เปิดไฟเรียกเพื่อขอความช่วยเหลือ
usageTranslations.id: Penumpang di kursi 22C telah menyalakan lampu panggilan untuk meminta bantuan.

terms.definition: Services provided to passengers during flight, such as meals and beverages, potentially affecting departure or operations.
terms.usage: Tower, Speedbird 123, requesting delay for inflight service preparation.

termTranslations.th: บริการบนเครื่องบิน

usageTranslations.en: Tower, Speedbird 123, requesting delay for inflight service preparation.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Speedbird 123, uçuş içi hizmet hazırlığı için gecikme talep ediyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Speedbird 123, demande un délai pour la préparation du service à bord.
usageTranslations.de: Turm, Speedbird 123, erbittet Verzögerung für die Vorbereitung des Borddienstes.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Speedbird 123, solicita retraso para la preparación del servicio a bordo.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，Speedbird 123，请求因飞行服务准备而延迟。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، سبيدبيرد 123، يطلب تأخيرًا لتجهيز خدمة على متن الطائرة.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Speedbird 123, solicita atraso para preparação do serviço de bordo.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Speedbird 123, запрашиваю задержку для подготовки бортового обслуживания.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、Speedbird 123、機内サービスの準備のために遅延をリクエストします。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Speedbird 123, richiede ritardo per la preparazione del servizio di bordo.
usageTranslations.vi: Đài kiểm soát, Speedbird 123, yêu cầu hoãn để chuẩn bị dịch vụ trên chuyến bay.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, Speedbird 123, उड़ान सेवा preparation के लिए विलंब का अनुरोध करता है।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการบิน, Speedbird 123, ขอเลื่อนเวลาสำหรับการเตรียมบริการบนเครื่องบิน。
usageTranslations.id: Menara, Speedbird 123, meminta penundaan untuk persiapan layanan dalam penerbangan.

terms.definition: Tax-exempt goods available for purchase on board, relevant for passenger services during flight.
terms.usage: Tower, Speedbird 123, duty-free shop open for passengers during cruise.

termTranslations.th: ปลอดภาษี

usageTranslations.en: Tower, Speedbird 123, duty-free shop open for passengers during cruise.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Speedbird 123, seyir sırasında yolcular için gümrüksüz mağaza açık.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Speedbird 123, boutique hors taxes ouverte pour les passagers en croisière.
usageTranslations.de: Turm, Speedbird 123, zollfreier Laden während des Reiseflugs für Passagiere geöffnet.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Speedbird 123, tienda libre de impuestos abierta para pasajeros durante el crucero.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，Speedbird 123，巡航期间免税店对乘客开放。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، سبيدبيرد 123، متجر معفاة من الرسوم مفتوح للركاب أثناء الطيران.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Speedbird 123, loja isenta de impostos aberta para passageiros durante o cruzeiro.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Speedbird 123, беспошлинный магазин открыт для пассажиров во время крейсерского полёта.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、Speedbird 123、クルーズ中に免税店が乗客向けにオープンしています。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Speedbird 123, negozio esente da dazi aperto per i passeggeri durante la crociera.
usageTranslations.vi: Đài kiểm soát, Speedbird 123, cửa hàng miễn thuế mở cho hành khách trong giai đoạn bay hành trình.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, Speedbird 123, क्रूज के दौरान यात्रियों के लिए कर मुक्त दुकान खुली है।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการบิน, Speedbird 123, ร้านปลอดภาษีเปิดให้ผู้โดยสารระหว่างการบินระดับคงที่。
usageTranslations.id: Menara, Speedbird 123, toko bebas bea dibuka untuk penumpang selama pelayaran.

terms.definition: A secure storage compartment above passenger seats used to stow carry-on baggage in the aircraft cabin.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, please ensure all overhead bins are properly closed before takeoff.

termTranslations.th: ช่องเก็บสัมภาระเหนือศีรษะ

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, please ensure all overhead bins are properly closed before takeoff.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, tüm baş üstü bagaj bölmelerinin kalkış öncesinde kapalı olduğundan emin olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage de cabine, veuillez vous assurer que tous les coffres à bagages supérieurs sont bien fermés avant le décollage.
