usageTranslations.en: Tower, we experienced a runway excursion during landing roll, requesting tow assistance.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, iniş sırasında pistten çıktık, çekici yardımı talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, nous avons eu une sortie de piste pendant l’atterrissage, demandons assistance de remorquage.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, wir hatten ein Pistenabkommen beim Ausrollen, benötigen Abschlepphilfe.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, tuvimos una excursión de pista durante el rodaje de aterrizaje, solicitamos asistencia de remolque.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，我们在着陆过程中发生了跑道偏离，请求牵引支援。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، خرجنا عن المدرج أثناء الهبوط، نطلب المساعدة بالسحب.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, tivemos uma saída de pista na rolagem de pouso, solicitamos reboque.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, при пробеге произошёл выход за пределы ВПП, просим буксировку.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、着陸後の滑走中に滑走路逸脱が発生、牽引支援を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Tower, abbiamo avuto una escursione fuori pista in atterraggio, richiediamo assistenza traino.
usageTranslations.vi: Tower, chúng tôi bị lệch khỏi đường băng khi hạ cánh, yêu cầu hỗ trợ kéo.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, लैंडिंग रोल के दौरान रनवे से फिसल गए, टग असिस्टेंस चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับ, เครื่องบินออกนอกทางวิ่งระหว่างแลนดิ้ง ขอความช่วยเหลือในการลาก
usageTranslations.id: Tower, kami mengalami keluar dari landasan saat pendaratan, minta bantuan penarikan.

terms.definition: Any occurrence at an aerodrome involving the incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and take-off of aircraft.
terms.usage: Tower, we observed a vehicle runway incursion near holding point Alpha Two, request verification.

termTranslations.th: การบุกรุกทางวิ่ง

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we observed a vehicle runway incursion near holding point Alpha Two, request verification.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Alfa İki bekleme noktasına yakın bir araç piste izinsiz girdi, doğrulama talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, nous avons observé une incursion d’un véhicule sur la piste près du point d’attente Alpha Deux, demandons vérification.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, haben eine Runway-Inkursion eines Fahrzeugs nahe Haltepunkt Alpha Zwei beobachtet, bitten um Bestätigung.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, observamos una intrusión de vehículo en la pista cerca del punto de espera Alfa Dos, solicitamos verificación.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，我们在阿尔法二等待点附近观察到一辆车进入跑道，请求确认。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، لاحظنا توغل مركبة في المدرج قرب نقطة الانتظار ألفا تو، نطلب التحقق.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, observamos uma intrusão de veículo na pista próximo ao ponto de espera Alpha Dois, solicitamos verificação.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, замечено проникновение автомобиля на ВПП у точки ожидания Альфа Два, просим подтвердить.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、ホールディングポイントアルファ2付近で車両の滑走路進入を確認、確認を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Tower, abbiamo osservato un veicolo sulla pista vicino al punto di attesa Alpha Due, richiediamo verifica.
usageTranslations.vi: Tower, chúng tôi thấy một phương tiện xâm nhập đường băng gần điểm chờ Alpha Hai, yêu cầu xác minh.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, हमने अल्फा टू होल्डिंग पॉइंट के पास एक वाहन को रनवे में घुसते देखा, पुष्टि चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับ, พบยานพาหนะบุกรุกทางวิ่งใกล้จุดรออัลฟ่า 2 ขอการยืนยัน
usageTranslations.id: Tower, kami melihat kendaraan melanggar landasan dekat titik tunggu Alpha Dua, mohon verifikasi.

terms.definition: A condition where an aircraft tyre bursts during taxi, take-off, or landing, possibly affecting braking or steering.
terms.usage: Ground, we suspect a blown tyre on landing, request inspection team and tow vehicle.

termTranslations.th: ยางระเบิด

usageTranslations.en: Ground, we suspect a blown tyre on landing, request inspection team and tow vehicle.
usageTranslations.tr: Yer, iniş sırasında patlamış bir teker şüphesi var, denetim ekibi ve çekici talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Sol, pneu éclaté suspecté à l’atterrissage, demandons inspection et véhicule de remorquage.
usageTranslations.de: Boden, Verdacht auf Reifenplatzer bei der Landung, bitte Inspektion und Abschleppfahrzeug.
usageTranslations.es: Tierra, sospechamos de un neumático reventado al aterrizar, solicitamos inspección y remolque.
usageTranslations.zh: 地面，我们怀疑着陆时轮胎爆裂，请求检查组和牵引车。
usageTranslations.ar: أرض، نشتبه في انفجار إطار عند الهبوط، نطلب فريق فحص ومركبة سحب.
usageTranslations.pt: Solo, suspeitamos de pneu estourado no pouso, solicitamos equipe de inspeção e reboque.
usageTranslations.ru: Наземный, подозрение на разрыв шины при посадке, просим инспекцию и тягач.
usageTranslations.ja: グラウンド、着陸時にタイヤ破裂の疑い、点検チームと牽引車を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Terra, sospettiamo pneumatico esploso in atterraggio, richiediamo ispezione e mezzo traino.
usageTranslations.vi: Ground, nghi ngờ lốp bị nổ khi hạ cánh, yêu cầu kiểm tra và xe kéo.
usageTranslations.hi: ग्राउंड, लैंडिंग पर टायर फटने का संदेह है, निरीक्षण टीम और टो वाहन चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: ภาคพื้น, สงสัยว่ายางระเบิดขณะแลนดิ้ง ขอทีมตรวจสอบและรถลาก
usageTranslations.id: Ground, kami curiga ban pecah saat mendarat, mohon tim inspeksi dan kendaraan derek.

terms.definition: A condition in which the aircraft hydraulic system exceeds its normal operating temperature limits, potentially leading to system degradation or failure.
terms.usage: Tower, we have a hydraulic overheat warning on system two, requesting immediate return to gate.

termTranslations.vi: Hệ Thống Thủy Lực Quá Nhiệt
termTranslations.th: ระบบไฮดรอลิกร้อนเกินไป

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we have a hydraulic overheat warning on system two, requesting immediate return to gate.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, sistem iki üzerinde hidrolik aşırı ısınma uyarısı aldık, hemen kapıya dönmeyi talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, surchauffe hydraulique signalée sur le système deux, demandons retour immédiat à la porte.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, Warnung vor Hydrauliküberhitzung im System Zwei, bitten um sofortige Rückkehr zum Gate.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, advertencia de sobrecalentamiento hidráulico en el sistema dos, solicitamos retorno inmediato a la puerta.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，系统二出现液压过热警告，请求立即返回登机口。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، لدينا تحذير من ارتفاع حرارة النظام الهيدروليكي الثاني، نطلب العودة الفورية إلى البوابة.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, temos alerta de superaquecimento hidráulico no sistema dois, solicitamos retorno imediato ao portão.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, перегрев гидросистемы номер два, просим немедленно вернуться к гейту.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、システム2に油圧過熱警告あり、ゲートへの即時帰還を要請。
usageTranslations.it: Tower, allarme surriscaldamento idraulico sul sistema due, richiediamo ritorno immediato al gate.
usageTranslations.vi: Tower, có cảnh báo hệ thủy lực số hai quá nhiệt, xin phép quay lại cổng ngay.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, सिस्टम दो में हाइड्रोलिक अधिक गर्मी की चेतावनी है, तत्काल गेट पर वापसी की अनुमति चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับ, ระบบสองแจ้งเตือนความร้อนสูงเกินไป, ขออนุญาตกลับประตูทันที
usageTranslations.id: Tower, ada peringatan overheat hidrolik pada sistem dua, mohon segera kembali ke gerbang.

terms.definition: A situation in which the aircraft's braking system exceeds safe operating temperatures, potentially reducing effectiveness or causing damage.
terms.usage: Tower, we are showing a brake overheat indication after landing, requesting ground assistance.

termTranslations.th: เบรกมีความร้อนสูงเกินไป

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we are showing a brake overheat indication after landing, requesting ground assistance.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, iniş sonrası fren aşırı ısınma göstergesi aldık, yer desteği talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, surchauffe des freins après atterrissage, demandons assistance au sol.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, Anzeige von Bremsenüberhitzung nach der Landung, bitten um Bodenunterstützung.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, indicación de sobrecalentamiento de frenos tras aterrizaje, solicitamos asistencia en tierra.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，着陆后出现刹车过热指示，请求地面协助。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، لدينا مؤشر سخونة زائدة في المكابح بعد الهبوط، نطلب المساعدة الأرضية.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, indicação de superaquecimento dos freios após pouso, solicitamos assistência em solo.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, индикация перегрева тормозов после посадки, просим помощь на земле.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、着陸後にブレーキ過熱の表示あり、地上支援を要請。
usageTranslations.it: Tower, indicazione di surriscaldamento dei freni dopo l'atterraggio, richiediamo assistenza a terra.
usageTranslations.vi: Tower, hệ thống báo quá nhiệt phanh sau hạ cánh, xin hỗ trợ mặt đất.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, लैंडिंग के बाद ब्रेक ओवरहीट का संकेत है, ग्राउंड सहायता चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับ, มีสัญญาณเบรกมีความร้อนสูงหลังจากแลนดิ้ง, ขอความช่วยเหลือจากภาคพื้น
usageTranslations.id: Tower, kami mendapat indikasi rem terlalu panas setelah mendarat, mohon bantuan darat.

terms.definition: A situation where the landing gear doors remain open after gear extension or retraction, indicating a potential malfunction or aerodynamic hazard.
terms.usage: Tower, we have an indication that the landing gear door remains open after gear retraction.

termTranslations.es: Puerta del Tren de Aterrizaje Abierta
termTranslations.pt: Porta do Trem de Pouso Aberta
termTranslations.ja: ランディングギアドアが開いている
termTranslations.th: ประตูล้อแลนด์ดิ้งเปิดอยู่

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we have an indication that the landing gear door remains open after gear retraction.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, iniş takımı toplandıktan sonra kapağın açık kaldığına dair bir gösterge var.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, indication que la trappe du train reste ouverte après rétraction.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, Anzeige dass Fahrwerksklappe nach Einfahren offen bleibt.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, tenemos una indicación de que la puerta del tren sigue abierta tras retraer el tren.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，起落架收起后舱门仍显示开启。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، هناك إشارة بأن باب معدات الهبوط ما زال مفتوحاً بعد السحب.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, temos indicação de que a porta do trem permanece aberta após retração.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, есть индикация, что люк шасси остался открыт после уборки.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、ギア格納後もドアが開いたままの表示です。
usageTranslations.it: Tower, abbiamo indicazione che il portello resta aperto dopo il rientro del carrello.
usageTranslations.vi: Tower, có tín hiệu cho thấy cửa hạ cánh vẫn mở sau khi thu vào.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, गियर रिट्रैक्ट करने के बाद दरवाज़ा खुला है ऐसा संकेत मिल रहा है।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับ, มีสัญญาณว่าประตูล้อแลนด์ดิ้งยังเปิดอยู่หลังจากเก็บล้อแล้ว
usageTranslations.id: Tower, kami mendapat indikasi bahwa pintu roda tetap terbuka setelah roda ditarik.

terms.definition: An emergency procedure where passengers and crew exit the aircraft rapidly using all available exits, typically initiated after landing or in a critical situation.
terms.usage: Tower, we are initiating a cabin evacuation due to smoke in the cabin after landing.

termTranslations.th: อพยพผู้โดยสารในห้องโดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we are initiating a cabin evacuation due to smoke in the cabin after landing.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, iniş sonrası kabindeki duman nedeniyle kabin tahliyesine başlıyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, évacuation de la cabine en cours en raison de fumée après l'atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, wir leiten eine Kabinenräumung wegen Rauch nach der Landung ein.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, iniciamos evacuación de cabina por humo tras el aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，由于着陆后客舱出现烟雾，我们正在进行客舱撤离。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، نبدأ بإخلاء المقصورة بسبب الدخان بعد الهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, iniciando evacuação da cabine devido a fumaça após o pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, начинаем эвакуацию из салона из-за дыма после посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、着陸後に客室内の煙のため、緊急脱出を開始します。
usageTranslations.it: Tower, stiamo iniziando l'evacuazione della cabina a causa di fumo dopo l'atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Tower, chúng tôi bắt đầu sơ tán khoang hành khách do có khói sau khi hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, लैंडिंग के बाद केबिन में धुआं होने के कारण निकासी शुरू कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับ, เรากำลังเริ่มอพยพผู้โดยสารในห้องโดยสารเนื่องจากมีควันหลังจากแลนดิ้ง
usageTranslations.id: Tower, kami mulai evakuasi kabin karena ada asap setelah mendarat.

terms.definition: The act of activating and extending the inflatable escape slide on an aircraft to facilitate emergency evacuation.
terms.usage: Tower, we have deployed the escape slide and all passengers have evacuated safely.

termTranslations.es: Despliegue De La Rampa De Emergencia
termTranslations.vi: Triển Khai Cầu Trượt Thoát Hiểm
termTranslations.th: การเปิดใช้งานสไลด์หนีภัย

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we have deployed the escape slide and all passengers have evacuated safely.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, tahliye kaydırağını açtık ve tüm yolcular güvenle tahliye edildi.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, nous avons déployé le toboggan et tous les passagers ont été évacués en sécurité.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, wir haben die Notrutsche ausgelöst und alle Passagiere wurden sicher evakuiert.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, desplegamos la rampa de emergencia y todos los pasajeros evacuaron con seguridad.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，我们已部署逃生滑梯，所有乘客已安全撤离。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، قمنا بنشر مزلق الطوارئ وتم إجلاء جميع الركاب بأمان.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, ativamos o escorregador de emergência e todos os passageiros evacuaram com segurança.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, аварийный трап развернут, все пассажиры эвакуированы.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、脱出スライドを展開し、すべての乗客が安全に避難しました。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, abbiamo aperto lo scivolo di emergenza e tutti i passeggeri sono stati evacuati in sicurezza.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp điều khiển, chúng tôi đã triển khai cầu trượt thoát hiểm và tất cả hành khách đã sơ tán an toàn.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर, हमने आपातकालीन स्लाइड तैनात कर दी है और सभी यात्री सुरक्षित रूप से निकल गए हैं।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการ เราได้เปิดใช้งานสไลด์หนีภัยและผู้โดยสารทุกคนอพยพเรียบร้อยแล้ว
usageTranslations.id: Menara, kami telah mengaktifkan seluncur darurat dan semua penumpang telah dievakuasi dengan aman.

terms.definition: The operation of over-wing emergency exits by passengers or crew during evacuation procedures, usually in the case of land or water evacuations.
terms.usage: Passengers seated at the over-wing exits must be briefed on how to operate them during evacuation.

termTranslations.fr: Utilisation De La Sortie Sur L'aile
termTranslations.es: Uso De La Salida Sobre El Ala
termTranslations.pt: Uso Da Saída Sobre A Asa
termTranslations.vi: Sử Dụng Lối Thoát Trên Cánh
termTranslations.hi: विंग के ऊपर निकास का उपयोग
termTranslations.th: การใช้ทางออกเหนือปีก
termTranslations.id: Penggunaan Pintu Keluar Di Atas Sayap

usageTranslations.en: Passengers seated at the over-wing exits must be briefed on how to operate them during evacuation.
usageTranslations.tr: Kanat üstü çıkışlarda oturan yolculara tahliye sırasında nasıl kullanılacağı anlatılmalıdır.
usageTranslations.fr: Les passagers assis près des sorties sur l'aile doivent être informés sur leur utilisation en cas d'évacuation.
usageTranslations.de: Passagiere an den Flügelausstiegen müssen über deren Bedienung im Notfall informiert werden.
usageTranslations.es: Los pasajeros en las salidas sobre el ala deben ser instruidos sobre su uso durante la evacuación.
usageTranslations.zh: 坐在机翼出口的乘客必须被告知如何在紧急情况下操作这些出口。
usageTranslations.ar: يجب إبلاغ الركاب الجالسين عند المخارج فوق الجناح بكيفية استخدامها أثناء الإخلاء.
usageTranslations.pt: Os passageiros nas saídas sobre a asa devem ser instruídos sobre como usá-las em caso de evacuação.
usageTranslations.ru: Пассажиры у крыльевых выходов должны быть проинструктированы об их использовании при эвакуации.
usageTranslations.ja: 翼上の非常口付近に座っている乗客には、避難時の操作方法を説明する必要があります。
usageTranslations.it: Ai passeggeri seduti presso le uscite sopra l’ala deve essere spiegato come usarle in caso di evacuazione.
usageTranslations.vi: Hành khách ngồi gần lối thoát trên cánh phải được hướng dẫn cách sử dụng khi sơ tán.
usageTranslations.hi: पंखों के ऊपर निकास के पास बैठे यात्रियों को निकासी के दौरान इसके उपयोग के बारे में जानकारी दी जानी चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: ผู้โดยสารที่นั่งใกล้ทางออกเหนือปีกต้องได้รับคำแนะนำในการใช้งานระหว่างการอพยพ
usageTranslations.id: Penumpang yang duduk di pintu keluar atas sayap harus diberi pengarahan tentang cara menggunakannya saat evakuasi.

terms.definition: A body position adopted by passengers and crew to minimize injury during an imminent impact or emergency landing, as per operator instructions.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, instruct passengers to assume the brace position for emergency landing.

termTranslations.th: ท่าป้องกัน

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, instruct passengers to assume the brace position for emergency landing.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, yolculara acil iniş için koruma pozisyonunu almalarını söyleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, demandez aux passagers d'adopter la position de protection pour un atterrissage d'urgence.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, weisen Sie die Passagiere an, die Schutzposition für die Notlandung einzunehmen.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación, indique a los pasajeros que adopten la posición de protección para el aterrizaje de emergencia.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱组员，请指示乘客采取紧急着陆的防冲撞姿势。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، اطلبوا من الركاب اتخاذ وضعية الحماية لهبوط الطوارئ.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação, instruam os passageiros a adotar a posição de proteção para pouso de emergência.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж, дайте указание пассажирам принять защитную позу для аварийной посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員は、緊急着陸のためにブレースポジションを取るよう乗客に指示してください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, dite ai passeggeri di assumere la posizione di sicurezza per l’atterraggio d’emergenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên, hướng dẫn hành khách vào tư thế bảo vệ khi hạ cánh khẩn cấp.
usageTranslations.hi: केबिन क्रू, यात्रियों को आपात लैंडिंग के लिए ब्रेस स्थिति लेने को कहें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือ โปรดแจ้งให้ผู้โดยสารอยู่ในท่าป้องกันเพื่อเตรียมลงจอดฉุกเฉิน
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, beri instruksi kepada penumpang untuk mengambil posisi bersiap untuk pendaratan darurat.

terms.definition: A safety verification by cabin crew to ensure passengers are seated, seat belts fastened, cabin items stowed, and emergency equipment is ready before take-off or landing.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, perform final cabin secure check and report to the flight deck.

termTranslations.fr: Contrôle De Sécurité De La Cabine
termTranslations.vi: Kiểm Tra An Toàn Khoang Hành Khách
termTranslations.th: ตรวจสอบความปลอดภัยในห้องโดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, perform final cabin secure check and report to the flight deck.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, son kabin güvenlik kontrolünü yapın ve uçuş ekibine rapor verin.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, effectuez le contrôle final de sécurité et rapportez à l’équipage de vol.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenbesatzung, führen Sie die abschließende Sicherheitskontrolle durch und melden Sie sich beim Cockpit.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación, realicen la verificación final de seguridad de cabina y repórtenlo a cabina de mando.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱组员，进行最终的客舱安全检查并报告飞行舱。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، قوموا بالتفقد النهائي للأمان وأبلغوا قمرة القيادة.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação, façam a verificação final da cabine e informem a cabine de comando.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, выполните финальную проверку безопасности и доложите в кабину экипажа.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員、最終の客室安全確認を行い、操縦室に報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, eseguite il controllo finale della cabina e riferite alla cabina di pilotaggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên, thực hiện kiểm tra an toàn khoang hành khách lần cuối và báo cáo buồng lái.
usageTranslations.hi: कु्र, अंतिम केबिन सुरक्षा जांच करें और फ्लाइट डेक को रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือ โปรดตรวจสอบความปลอดภัยในห้องโดยสารครั้งสุดท้ายและรายงานให้ห้องนักบินทราบ
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, lakukan pemeriksaan keamanan akhir dan laporkan ke kokpit.

terms.definition: A procedure practiced by cabin crew and passengers for emergency water landings, including life vest use, brace position, and evacuation steps.
terms.usage: Cabin crew, commence water ditching drill briefing for all passengers in accordance with procedure.

termTranslations.vi: Diễn Tập Hạ Cánh Trên Nước
termTranslations.th: การฝึกซ้อมลงจอดฉุกเฉินในน้ำ

usageTranslations.en: Cabin crew, commence water ditching drill briefing for all passengers in accordance with procedure.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, prosedüre uygun olarak tüm yolculara suya iniş tatbikatı brifingi verin.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage cabine, commencez le briefing de l'exercice d'amerrissage selon la procédure.
usageTranslations.de: Kabinenpersonal, beginnen Sie gemäß Vorschrift mit dem Briefing zur Notwasserungsübung.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación, inicien el simulacro de amerizaje para todos los pasajeros según el procedimiento.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱组员，请按照程序开始为所有乘客进行水上迫降演练讲解。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم المقصورة، ابدأوا بإعطاء تعليمات تمرين الهبوط المائي لجميع الركاب وفقًا للإجراءات.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação, iniciem o briefing de amaragem de acordo com o procedimento.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники, начните инструктаж по приводнению согласно процедуре.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員は、手順に従って全乗客に水上着陸訓練の説明を開始してください。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, iniziate il briefing dell'esercitazione di ammaraggio secondo la procedura.
usageTranslations.vi: Tiếp viên, bắt đầu hướng dẫn diễn tập hạ cánh trên nước cho toàn bộ hành khách theo quy trình.
usageTranslations.hi: केबिन क्रू, प्रक्रिया के अनुसार सभी यात्रियों को पानी में उतरने का अभ्यास समझाएं।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือ เริ่มการบรรยายฝึกซ้อมลงจอดในน้ำให้ผู้โดยสารทุกคนตามขั้นตอน
usageTranslations.id: Kru kabin, mulai pengarahan latihan pendaratan darurat di air untuk semua penumpang sesuai prosedur.

terms.definition: The procedure of deploying and utilizing inflatable life rafts by crew and passengers following a water landing, in accordance with emergency protocols.
terms.usage: After ditching, instruct passengers to board the life raft in an orderly manner and stay calm.

termTranslations.th: การใช้แพชูชีพ

usageTranslations.en: After ditching, instruct passengers to board the life raft in an orderly manner and stay calm.
usageTranslations.tr: Suya iniş sonrası, yolculara düzenli şekilde can salına binmelerini ve sakin kalmalarını söyleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Après l'amerrissage, demandez aux passagers d'embarquer calmement sur le radeau de sauvetage.
usageTranslations.de: Nach der Notwasserung, weisen Sie die Passagiere an, geordnet das Rettungsfloß zu besteigen und ruhig zu bleiben.
usageTranslations.es: Después del amerizaje, indique a los pasajeros que aborden la balsa salvavidas de manera ordenada y permanezcan tranquilos.
usageTranslations.zh: 水上迫降后，指示乘客有序登上救生筏并保持冷静。
usageTranslations.ar: بعد الهبوط في الماء، ارشد الركاب للصعود إلى قارب النجاة بهدوء وهدوء.
usageTranslations.pt: Após amaragem, oriente os passageiros a embarcar no bote salva-vidas de forma ordeira e manter a calma.
usageTranslations.ru: После приводнения проинструктируйте пассажиров спокойно сесть в спасательный плот.
usageTranslations.ja: 水上着陸後、乗客に落ち着いて順序よく救命いかだに乗るよう指示してください。
usageTranslations.it: Dopo l’ammaraggio, istruite i passeggeri a salire ordinatamente sulla zattera di salvataggio e mantenere la calma.
usageTranslations.vi: Sau khi hạ cánh xuống nước, hướng dẫn hành khách lên bè cứu sinh một cách trật tự và giữ bình tĩnh.
usageTranslations.hi: पानी में उतरने के बाद, यात्रियों को शांति से जीवन राफ्ट पर चढ़ने और शांत रहने के लिए कहें।
usageTranslations.th: หลังจากลงจอดในน้ำ ให้แจ้งผู้โดยสารขึ้นแพชูชีพอย่างเป็นระเบียบและใจเย็น
usageTranslations.id: Setelah mendarat di air, arahkan penumpang untuk menaiki rakit penyelamat dengan tertib dan tetap tenang.

terms.definition: An intentional or emergency landing of an aircraft on a body of water due to operational necessity or system failure.
terms.usage: Mayday, mayday, we are executing a water landing due to complete engine failure, standby for ditching procedures.

termTranslations.th: การลงจอดในน้ำ

usageTranslations.en: Mayday, mayday, we are executing a water landing due to complete engine failure, standby for ditching procedures.
usageTranslations.tr: Mayday, mayday, motor arızası nedeniyle suya iniş yapıyoruz, tahliye prosedürleri için hazır olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Mayday, mayday, nous effectuons un amerrissage suite à une panne moteur totale, restez prêts pour les procédures d’évacuation.
usageTranslations.de: Mayday, Mayday, wir führen eine Wasserlandung aufgrund eines kompletten Triebwerksausfalls durch, bereit für Notwasserung.
usageTranslations.es: Mayday, mayday, realizamos un amerizaje por fallo total de motor, preparados para procedimiento de evacuación.
usageTranslations.zh: 求救，求救，由于发动机完全失效，我们正在进行水上着陆，请准备弃机程序。
usageTranslations.ar: نداء استغاثة، نقوم بهبوط على الماء بسبب فشل كامل للمحرك، استعدوا لإجراءات الإخلاء.
usageTranslations.pt: Mayday, mayday, estamos realizando pouso na água por falha total dos motores, preparem-se para procedimentos de evacuação.
usageTranslations.ru: Мэйдэй, мэйдэй, совершаем приводнение из-за отказа всех двигателей, готовьтесь к эвакуации.
usageTranslations.ja: メーデー、メーデー、全エンジン故障のため水上着陸を行います、避難手順の準備をお願いします。
usageTranslations.it: Mayday, mayday, stiamo eseguendo un ammaraggio per guasto completo ai motori, preparatevi all’evacuazione.
usageTranslations.vi: Mayday, mayday, chúng tôi đang hạ cánh trên nước do lỗi động cơ hoàn toàn, chuẩn bị cho quy trình sơ tán.
usageTranslations.hi: मे डे, मे डे, हम इंजन विफलता के कारण पानी पर उतर रहे हैं, निकासी प्रक्रियाओं के लिए तैयार रहें।
usageTranslations.th: เมย์เดย์ เมย์เดย์ กำลังลงจอดในน้ำเนื่องจากเครื่องยนต์ล้มเหลวทั้งหมด เตรียมพร้อมสำหรับขั้นตอนการอพยพ
usageTranslations.id: Mayday, mayday, kami akan mendarat di air karena kegagalan mesin total, bersiap untuk prosedur evakuasi.

terms.definition: Turbulence causing large, abrupt changes in altitude and/or attitude, usually resulting in momentary loss of control and difficulty in maintaining aircraft control.
terms.usage: Center, we encountered severe turbulence at FL340, requesting immediate descent to a lower flight level.

termTranslations.th: อากาศปั่นป่วนอย่างรุนแรง

usageTranslations.en: Center, we encountered severe turbulence at FL340, requesting immediate descent to a lower flight level.
usageTranslations.tr: Merkez, FL340 seviyesinde şiddetli türbülansla karşılaştık, acil alçalış talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Centre, nous avons rencontré de fortes turbulences au FL340, demandons une descente immédiate.
usageTranslations.de: Center, wir haben bei FL340 starke Turbulenzen erlebt, beantragen sofortigen Sinkflug.
usageTranslations.es: Centro, encontramos turbulencia severa en FL340, solicitamos descenso inmediato.
usageTranslations.zh: 中心，我们在FL340遇到严重颠簸，请求立即下降飞行高度。
usageTranslations.ar: المركز، واجهنا اضطرابًا شديدًا على FL340، نطلب الهبوط الفوري.
usageTranslations.pt: Centro, encontramos turbulência severa no FL340, solicitamos descida imediata.
usageTranslations.ru: Центр, на FL340 сильная турбулентность, просим немедленное снижение.
usageTranslations.ja: センター、FL340で激しい乱気流に遭遇しました。すぐに高度を下げたい。
usageTranslations.it: Centro, abbiamo incontrato turbolenza grave a FL340, richiediamo discesa immediata.
usageTranslations.vi: Trung tâm, chúng tôi gặp nhiễu loạn mạnh tại FL340, yêu cầu hạ độ cao ngay.
usageTranslations.hi: सेंटर, FL340 पर भीषण वायुविक्षोभ का सामना किया है, तुरंत नीची उड़ान ऊँचाई की अनुमति दें।
usageTranslations.th: เซ็นเตอร์ พบอากาศปั่นป่วนอย่างรุนแรงที่ FL340 ขออนุญาตลดระดับทันที
usageTranslations.id: Pusat, kami mengalami turbulensi parah di FL340, minta segera turun ke level yang lebih rendah.

terms.definition: The buildup of ice on aircraft surfaces during flight due to supercooled water droplets freezing on contact, which can impair performance or control.
terms.usage: ATC, we are experiencing in-flight ice accretion and request descent below freezing level immediately.

termTranslations.th: การก่อตัวของน้ำแข็งระหว่างบิน

usageTranslations.en: ATC, we are experiencing in-flight ice accretion and request descent below freezing level immediately.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, uçuş sırasında buzlanma yaşıyoruz, donma seviyesinin altına acil alçalış talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, nous subissons une accumulation de glace en vol, demandons descente sous le niveau de congélation.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, wir erleben Eisbildung im Flug und beantragen sofortigen Sinkflug unter die Gefriergrenze.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, estamos experimentando acumulación de hielo en vuelo y solicitamos descenso por debajo del nivel de congelación.
usageTranslations.zh: 空管，我们正在飞行中结冰，请求立即下降至冰点以下。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، نحن نواجه تراكمًا للجليد أثناء الطيران ونطلب النزول تحت مستوى التجمد فورًا.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, estamos com acúmulo de gelo em voo, solicitamos descida abaixo do nível de congelamento imediatamente.
usageTranslations.ru: АТС, наблюдаем обледенение в полёте, просим снижение ниже уровня замерзания.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、飛行中の着氷を経験しており、氷点下の高度への降下を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, stiamo accumulando ghiaccio in volo, richiediamo discesa sotto il livello di congelamento immediatamente.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, chúng tôi đang bị đóng băng khi bay, yêu cầu hạ xuống dưới mức đóng băng ngay lập tức.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, हम उड़ान के दौरान बर्फ जमने का अनुभव कर रहे हैं, कृपया तुरंत जमाव स्तर से नीचे उतरने की अनुमति दें।
usageTranslations.th: ATC เราพบการก่อตัวของน้ำแข็งระหว่างบิน ขออนุญาตลดระดับต่ำกว่าระดับเยือกแข็งทันที
usageTranslations.id: ATC, kami mengalami pembentukan es saat terbang, mohon izin turun di bawah level pembekuan segera.

terms.definition: A direct or indirect electrical discharge from the atmosphere to an aircraft, potentially causing damage to avionics, surfaces, or structural systems.
terms.usage: Tower, we suspect a lightning strike occurred during climb through cumulus clouds, conducting systems check.

termTranslations.th: ฟ้าผ่า

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we suspect a lightning strike occurred during climb through cumulus clouds, conducting systems check.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, kümülüs bulutları içinde tırmanış sırasında yıldırım çarpması olduğundan şüpheleniyoruz, sistem kontrolleri yapılıyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, nous suspectons un impact de foudre durant la montée à travers des cumulus, vérification des systèmes en cours.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, wir vermuten einen Blitzeinschlag beim Steigflug durch Kumuluswolken, führen Systemprüfung durch.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, sospechamos de un impacto de rayo al ascender entre cúmulos, realizando verificación de sistemas.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，我们怀疑在穿越积云爬升过程中遭遇雷击，正在进行系统检查。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، نشتبه بحدوث ضربة برق أثناء الصعود عبر سحب الركام، نقوم بفحص الأنظمة.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, suspeitamos de raio durante subida por cúmulos, realizando checagem de sistemas.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня, подозреваем удар молнии при наборе высоты в кучевых облаках, выполняем проверку систем.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、積雲を上昇中に雷が直撃した可能性があります。システム確認中です。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, sospettiamo un fulmine durante la salita tra cumuli, stiamo verificando i sistemi.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp điều khiển, nghi ngờ bị sét đánh khi bay qua mây tích, đang kiểm tra hệ thống.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर, हम संदेह करते हैं कि क्यूम्यलस बादलों के बीच चढ़ाई के दौरान बिजली गिरी, सिस्टम की जांच की जा रही है।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการ สงสัยว่าเกิดฟ้าผ่าระหว่างไต่ระดับผ่านเมฆคิวมูลัส กำลังตรวจสอบระบบ
usageTranslations.id: Menara, kami menduga terjadi sambaran petir saat mendaki melalui awan kumulus, sedang memeriksa sistem.

terms.definition: Ice formation in the pitot tube, which can obstruct accurate airspeed measurement, potentially leading to unreliable or erroneous cockpit indications.
terms.usage: Center, we suspect pitot tube ice, airspeed readings are fluctuating rapidly, requesting deviation to warmer altitude.

termTranslations.th: น้ำแข็งเกาะท่อพิโตต์

usageTranslations.en: Center, we suspect pitot tube ice, airspeed readings are fluctuating rapidly, requesting deviation to warmer altitude.
usageTranslations.tr: Merkez, pitot tüpü buzlanmasından şüpheleniyoruz, hava hızı değerleri hızla değişiyor, daha sıcak irtifaya sapma talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Centre, nous soupçonnons du givrage du tube de Pitot, les vitesses indiquées fluctuent rapidement, demandons déviation vers une altitude plus chaude.
usageTranslations.de: Center, wir vermuten Vereisung des Pitotrohrs, Geschwindigkeitsschwankungen stark, beantragen Kursänderung zu wärmerer Höhe.
usageTranslations.es: Centro, sospechamos hielo en el tubo Pitot, las lecturas de velocidad varían rápidamente, solicitamos desvío a altitud más cálida.
usageTranslations.zh: 中心，我们怀疑皮托管结冰，空速读数波动剧烈，请求改飞至较暖高度。
usageTranslations.ar: المركز، نشتبه في تجمد أنبوب بيتو، قراءات السرعة الجوية غير مستقرة، نطلب التحويل إلى ارتفاع أكثر دفئًا.
usageTranslations.pt: Centro, suspeitamos de gelo no tubo de Pitot, leituras de velocidade estão instáveis, solicitamos desvio para altitude mais quente.
usageTranslations.ru: Центр, подозреваем обледенение трубки Пито, показания скорости нестабильны, просим отклонение на более тёплую высоту.
usageTranslations.ja: センター、ピトー管の氷結が疑われ、対気速度が大きく変動しています。暖かい高度への偏向を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Centro, sospettiamo ghiaccio nel tubo di Pitot, la velocità indicata varia rapidamente, richiediamo deviazione a quota più calda.
usageTranslations.vi: Trung tâm, nghi ngờ đóng băng ống Pitot, tốc độ bay dao động mạnh, yêu cầu chuyển sang độ cao ấm hơn.
usageTranslations.hi: सेंटर, हमें पिटोट ट्यूब में बर्फ जमने का संदेह है, एयरस्पीड रीडिंग बहुत तेजी से बदल रही है, कृपया गर्म ऊँचाई के लिए बदलाव की अनुमति दें।
usageTranslations.th: เซ็นเตอร์ สงสัยว่ามีน้ำแข็งเกาะที่ท่อพิโตต์ ความเร็วอากาศผันผวนมาก ขอเปลี่ยนระดับไปยังระดับที่อุ่นกว่า
usageTranslations.id: Pusat, kami menduga tabung Pitot membeku, pembacaan kecepatan udara tidak stabil, mohon penyimpangan ke ketinggian yang lebih hangat.

terms.definition: An obstruction in the static pressure port of an aircraft, leading to erroneous altitude, airspeed, and vertical speed indications, potentially affecting flight safety.
terms.usage: Center, we suspect static port blockage, altimeter and VSI readings are inconsistent, requesting return to departure airport.

termTranslations.th: การอุดตันของพอร์ตความดันคงที่

usageTranslations.en: Center, we suspect static port blockage, altimeter and VSI readings are inconsistent, requesting return to departure airport.
usageTranslations.tr: Merkez, statik port tıkanmasından şüpheleniyoruz, altimetre ve VSI değerleri tutarsız, kalkış meydanına dönüş talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Centre, nous soupçonnons une obstruction de la prise statique, les altimètres et l'indicateur de vitesse verticale sont incohérents, demandons retour à l'aéroport de départ.
usageTranslations.de: Center, wir vermuten eine Verstopfung der statischen Drucköffnung, Höhenmesser und VSI zeigen widersprüchliche Werte, beantragen Rückkehr zum Startflughafen.
usageTranslations.es: Centro, sospechamos bloqueo del puerto estático, lecturas del altímetro y VSI inconsistentes, solicitamos regreso al aeropuerto de salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 中心，我们怀疑静压孔堵塞，高度计和垂直速度指示器读数不一致，请求返航。
usageTranslations.ar: المركز، نشتبه في انسداد منفذ الضغط الساكن، قراءات مقياس الارتفاع ومؤشر سرعة الصعود غير متطابقة، نطلب العودة إلى مطار الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Centro, suspeitamos de bloqueio no orifício estático, leituras do altímetro e VSI inconsistentes, solicitamos retorno ao aeroporto de origem.
usageTranslations.ru: Центр, подозреваем засорение статического порта, показания высотомера и VSI не совпадают, просим возврат в аэропорт вылета.
usageTranslations.ja: センター、静圧孔の閉塞が疑われ、高度計と垂直速度計の読みが一致しません。出発空港に戻ることを希望します。
usageTranslations.it: Centro, sospettiamo un blocco del foro statico, altimetro e VSI non coincidono, richiediamo rientro all'aeroporto di partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Trung tâm, nghi ngờ tắc ống áp suất tĩnh, độ cao và tốc độ lên xuống không khớp, xin quay lại sân bay xuất phát.
usageTranslations.hi: सेंटर, हमें स्टैटिक पोर्ट रुकावट का संदेह है, अल्टीमीटर और VSI रीडिंग में असंगति है, प्रस्थान हवाई अड्डे पर लौटने का अनुरोध है।
usageTranslations.th: เซ็นเตอร์ สงสัยว่าพอร์ตความดันคงที่อุดตัน เครื่องวัดความสูงและ VSI แสดงค่าขัดแย้ง ขออนุญาตกลับไปสนามบินต้นทาง
usageTranslations.id: Pusat, kami menduga sumbatan pada port statik, pembacaan altimeter dan VSI tidak konsisten, mohon kembali ke bandara keberangkatan.

terms.definition: Flight conducted with limited or failed cockpit instruments, typically requiring reliance on backup or standby indicators for basic attitude, navigation, or altitude references.
terms.usage: Tower, we are experiencing partial panel operations due to instrument failure, maintaining control via standby attitude indicator.

termTranslations.vi: Vận Hành Với Bảng Điều Khiển Một Phần
termTranslations.th: การบินด้วยเครื่องวัดบางส่วน

usageTranslations.en: Tower, we are experiencing partial panel operations due to instrument failure, maintaining control via standby attitude indicator.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, enstrüman arızası nedeniyle kısmi panel operasyonundayız, yedek yapay ufukla kontrol sağlıyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, vol avec instruments dégradés en raison d'une panne, maintien du contrôle via horizon artificiel de secours.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, wir fliegen im Partial Panel wegen Instrumentenausfall, Kontrolle über Reserve-Lageanzeiger.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, operamos con panel parcial por fallo de instrumentos, control mantenido con indicador de actitud de reserva.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，由于仪表故障，我们正进行部分仪表操作，通过备用姿态仪维持飞行。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، نعمل بأجهزة جزئية نتيجة عطل في المعدات، نستخدم مؤشر الاحتياط للموقف.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, operamos com painel parcial devido a falha de instrumentos, mantendo controle com indicador de atitude reserva.
usageTranslations.ru: Башня, летаем с частичным отказом приборов, ориентируемся по резервному авиагоризонту.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、計器故障により部分計器飛行中、スタンバイ姿勢指示計で操縦を維持しています。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, stiamo volando con pannello parziale per guasto strumenti, controllo mantenuto tramite indicatore d'assetto di riserva.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp điều khiển, chúng tôi đang bay với bảng điều khiển một phần do lỗi thiết bị, điều khiển bằng thiết bị dự phòng.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर, उपकरण विफलता के कारण हम आंशिक पैनल मोड में हैं, नियंत्रण स्टैंडबाय इंडिकेटर से बनाए रखा है।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการ กำลังบินด้วยเครื่องวัดบางส่วนเนื่องจากอุปกรณ์ขัดข้อง ใช้เครื่องชี้ท่าทางสำรองในการควบคุม
usageTranslations.id: Menara, kami dalam mode panel sebagian karena kegagalan instrumen, mengandalkan indikator sikap cadangan.

terms.definition: A degraded flight control mode in fly-by-wire aircraft where control surfaces respond directly to pilot input without flight envelope protection.
terms.usage: ATC, be advised we have reverted to direct control law due to multiple system faults, flight control degraded.

termTranslations.ja: ダイレクトコントロールモード
termTranslations.vi: Chế Độ Điều Khiển Trực Tiếp
termTranslations.th: โหมดควบคุมโดยตรง

usageTranslations.en: ATC, be advised we have reverted to direct control law due to multiple system faults, flight control degraded.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, birden fazla sistem arızası nedeniyle doğrudan kontrol moduna geçtik, uçuş kontrolü sınırlı.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, nous sommes passés en loi de commande directe en raison de multiples pannes, contrôle de vol dégradé.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, wir fliegen im direkten Steuergesetz wegen mehrerer Systemausfälle, Flugsteuerung beeinträchtigt.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, hemos pasado a la ley de control directo por múltiples fallos del sistema, control de vuelo degradado.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，由于多个系统故障，我们已切换为直接控制律，飞控降级。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، نعمل الآن بنظام التحكم المباشر نتيجة أعطال متعددة، التحكم في الطائرة متدهور.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, estamos em lei de controle direto devido a falhas múltiplas, controle de voo degradado.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, из-за нескольких отказов перешли в режим прямого управления, управление снижено.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、複数のシステム故障によりダイレクトコントロールモードに切り替えました。飛行制御が制限されています。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, siamo passati alla legge di controllo diretta a causa di guasti multipli, controllo di volo degradato.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, chúng tôi đã chuyển sang điều khiển trực tiếp do nhiều lỗi hệ thống, khả năng điều khiển bị hạn chế.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, कई सिस्टम दोषों के कारण प्रत्यक्ष नियंत्रण विधि में स्विच किया गया है, उड़ान नियंत्रण सीमित है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC ได้สลับไปยังโหมดควบคุมโดยตรงเนื่องจากระบบขัดข้องหลายรายการ การควบคุมเที่ยวบินลดลง
usageTranslations.id: ATC, kami beralih ke mode kontrol langsung karena beberapa kerusakan sistem, kontrol penerbangan menurun.

terms.definition: A degraded mode in fly-by-wire aircraft providing limited flight envelope protections, used when normal law is lost due to system faults.
terms.usage: ATC, we are operating under alternate control law due to flight control degradation, protections partially lost.

termTranslations.ja: オルタネートコントロールモード
termTranslations.vi: Chế Độ Điều Khiển Thay Thế
termTranslations.th: โหมดควบคุมสำรอง

usageTranslations.en: ATC, we are operating under alternate control law due to flight control degradation, protections partially lost.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, uçuş kontrol sisteminin bozulması nedeniyle alternatif kontrol modundayız, bazı korumalar devre dışı.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, nous sommes en loi de commande alternée en raison d'une dégradation du système de vol, certaines protections sont perdues.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, wir fliegen im alternativen Steuergesetz wegen Flugkontrollproblemen, Schutzsysteme teilweise deaktiviert.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, estamos operando bajo ley de control alternativa por degradación de los controles de vuelo, protecciones parcialmente perdidas.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，由于飞行控制降级，我们处于备用控制律，部分保护功能丧失。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، نعمل بنظام التحكم البديل بسبب تدهور التحكم في الطيران، بعض الحمايات معطلة.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, estamos sob lei de controle alternativa devido à degradação do controle de voo, proteções parcialmente perdidas.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, переходим в альтернативный режим управления из-за деградации систем, часть защит отключена.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、飛行制御の劣化によりオルタネートコントロールモードで運航中、一部の保護機能が失われています。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, stiamo operando in modalità di controllo alternativa per degrado del sistema di volo, alcune protezioni perse.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, chúng tôi đang vận hành trong chế độ điều khiển thay thế do hệ thống điều khiển bay suy giảm, mất một số tính năng bảo vệ.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, उड़ान नियंत्रण में गिरावट के कारण वैकल्पिक नियंत्रण विधि में संचालन कर रहे हैं, कुछ सुरक्षा विशेषताएँ निष्क्रिय हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ATC กำลังใช้งานในโหมดควบคุมสำรองเนื่องจากระบบควบคุมเที่ยวบินเสื่อมถอย การป้องกันบางส่วนหายไป
usageTranslations.id: ATC, kami menggunakan mode kontrol alternatif karena degradasi sistem kontrol penerbangan, perlindungan sebagian tidak aktif.

terms.definition: A rare fallback flight control law in fly-by-wire aircraft used under severe system failures where no flight envelope protections are available and handling characteristics are degraded.
terms.usage: ATC, be advised we are in abnormal control law due to extensive system loss, manual handling required.

termTranslations.vi: Chế Độ Điều Khiển Bất Thường
termTranslations.th: โหมดควบคุมผิดปกติ

usageTranslations.en: ATC, be advised we are in abnormal control law due to extensive system loss, manual handling required.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, kapsamlı sistem kaybı nedeniyle anormal kontrol modundayız, elle kumanda gerekiyor.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, nous sommes en loi de commande anormale à cause d'une perte étendue de systèmes, pilotage manuel requis.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, wir sind im abnormen Steuergesetz aufgrund umfassender Systemausfälle, manuelle Steuerung erforderlich.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, informamos que estamos en ley de control anormal debido a pérdida extensa de sistemas, requiere manejo manual.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，因系统大范围失效，我们处于异常控制律，需要手动操纵。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، نحن في نظام التحكم غير الطبيعي نتيجة لفقدان واسع في الأنظمة، يتطلب قيادة يدوية.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, informamos que estamos em lei de controle anormal devido à perda extensiva de sistemas, controle manual necessário.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, переходим в аварийный режим управления из-за значительной потери систем, требуется ручное управление.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、広範なシステム障害により異常制御モードにあります。手動操作が必要です。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, siamo in modalità di controllo anomala per estesa perdita di sistema, necessario pilotaggio manuale.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, chúng tôi đang trong chế độ điều khiển bất thường do mất hệ thống lớn, cần điều khiển thủ công.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, व्यापक प्रणाली विफलता के कारण हम असामान्य नियंत्रण विधि में हैं, मैनुअल संचालन आवश्यक है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC เราอยู่ในโหมดควบคุมผิดปกติเนื่องจากระบบสูญเสียอย่างมาก ต้องควบคุมด้วยมือ
usageTranslations.id: ATC, kami dalam mode kontrol abnormal karena kehilangan sistem yang luas, diperlukan kendali manual.

terms.definition: A malfunction where the ram air inlet door fails to open or close properly, affecting ventilation and cooling of avionics or cabin systems.
terms.usage: ATC, we have a ram air inlet door failure, temperature regulation affected, no impact on pressurization.

termTranslations.fr: Défaillance De La Trappe D’entrée D’air Dynamique
termTranslations.es: Fallo De La Compuerta De Entrada De Aire Dinámico
termTranslations.ar: عطل في صمام مدخل الهواء الديناميكي
termTranslations.pt: Falha Na Porta De Entrada De Ar Dinâmico
termTranslations.ja: ラムエアインレットドア故障
termTranslations.hi: राम एयर इनलेट डोर की विफलता
termTranslations.th: ความล้มเหลวของประตูรับอากาศราม

usageTranslations.en: ATC, we have a ram air inlet door failure, temperature regulation affected, no impact on pressurization.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, ram hava girişi kapağı arızası yaşadık, sıcaklık kontrolü etkileniyor, basınçlandırma etkilenmedi.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, défaillance de la trappe d’entrée d’air dynamique, régulation thermique affectée, aucune incidence sur la pressurisation.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, Ramluftklappe defekt, Temperaturregelung betroffen, Druckkabine nicht beeinträchtigt.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, fallo de la compuerta de aire dinámico, regulación térmica afectada, sin impacto en la presurización.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，我们遇到冲压进气门故障，温控受影响，增压系统未受影响。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، عطل في صمام مدخل الهواء الديناميكي، تأثرت درجة الحرارة، لا تأثير على الضغط.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, falha na porta de ar dinâmico, controle de temperatura afetado, sem impacto na pressurização.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, отказ впускной заслонки, нарушен температурный режим, герметизация не пострадала.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、ラムエアインレットドアに故障があります。温度制御に影響がありますが、与圧には影響ありません。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, guasto allo sportello dell’aria dinamica, temperatura compromessa, nessun impatto sulla pressurizzazione.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, có sự cố cửa nạp gió ram, kiểm soát nhiệt độ bị ảnh hưởng, không ảnh hưởng đến áp suất.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, राम एयर इनलेट डोर में खराबी है, तापमान नियंत्रण प्रभावित है, दबाव प्रणाली पर असर नहीं पड़ा है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC ประตูรับอากาศรามขัดข้อง การควบคุมอุณหภูมิได้รับผลกระทบ แต่ไม่มีผลต่อความดัน
usageTranslations.id: ATC, ada kegagalan pada pintu masuk udara ram, pengaturan suhu terganggu, tekanan kabin tidak terpengaruh.

terms.definition: An unintended escape of high-pressure air from the aircraft bleed air system, which may affect pressurization, anti-ice, or environmental control systems.
terms.usage: ATC, we have a bleed air leak warning on the right side, monitoring temperature and cabin pressure closely.

termTranslations.th: การรั่วของอากาศ Bleed

usageTranslations.en: ATC, we have a bleed air leak warning on the right side, monitoring temperature and cabin pressure closely.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, sağ tarafta bleed havası kaçağı uyarısı aldık, sıcaklık ve kabin basıncını yakından izliyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, alerte de fuite d’air de prélèvement côté droit, surveillance étroite de la température et de la pression cabine.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, Zapfluftleckwarnung auf der rechten Seite, Temperatur und Kabinendruck werden genau überwacht.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, advertencia de fuga de aire de sangrado en el lado derecho, monitoreamos temperatura y presión de cabina.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，右侧出现引气泄漏警告，正密切监控温度和客舱压力。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، لدينا تحذير من تسرب هواء من نظام السحب على الجانب الأيمن، نراقب درجة الحرارة وضغط المقصورة عن كثب.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, alerta de vazamento de ar sangrado no lado direito, monitoramos temperatura e pressão da cabine atentamente.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, предупреждение об утечке отборного воздуха справа, контролируем температуру и давление в кабине.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、右側にブリードエア漏れ警告が出ています。温度とキャビン圧力を注視中です。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, segnalazione di perdita di aria bleed sul lato destro, monitoriamo temperatura e pressione cabina.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, có cảnh báo rò rỉ khí bleed bên phải, đang theo dõi chặt nhiệt độ và áp suất khoang.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, दाहिने ओर ब्लीड एयर रिसाव की चेतावनी है, तापमान और केबिन दबाव की निगरानी कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ATC มีคำเตือนการรั่วของอากาศ Bleed ด้านขวา กำลังเฝ้าระวังอุณหภูมิและความดันห้องโดยสารอย่างใกล้ชิด
usageTranslations.id: ATC, ada peringatan kebocoran udara bleed di sisi kanan, memantau suhu dan tekanan kabin secara ketat.

terms.definition: An automatic or commanded shutdown of an air conditioning pack due to overtemperature, overpressure, or system fault, impacting cabin environmental control.
terms.usage: ATC, we have an air conditioning pack trip on pack one, monitoring cabin pressure and temperature.

termTranslations.es: Desconexión Del Paquete De Aire Acondicionado
termTranslations.pt: Desligamento Do Sistema De Ar Condicionado
termTranslations.vi: Ngắt Gói Điều Hòa Không Khí
termTranslations.th: ระบบปรับอากาศตัดการทำงาน

usageTranslations.en: ATC, we have an air conditioning pack trip on pack one, monitoring cabin pressure and temperature.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, bir numaralı iklimlendirme paketi devreden çıktı, kabin basıncı ve sıcaklık izleniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, arrêt du pack de climatisation numéro un, nous surveillons la pression et la température cabine.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, Klimapaket eins abgeschaltet, Kabinendruck und Temperatur werden überwacht.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, desconexión del paquete de aire acondicionado uno, monitoreamos presión y temperatura de cabina.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，1号空调组件跳脱，正在监控舱压与温度。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، وحدة تكييف الهواء رقم واحد تعطلت، نراقب ضغط وحرارة المقصورة.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, desligamento do pack de ar número um, monitoramos pressão e temperatura da cabine.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, отключился кондиционерный пакет №1, контролируем давление и температуру в кабине.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、空調パック1が遮断されました。客室の圧力と温度を監視中です。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, il pacchetto di condizionamento uno si è arrestato, stiamo monitorando la pressione e temperatura cabina.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, gói điều hòa số một bị ngắt, đang theo dõi áp suất và nhiệt độ khoang hành khách.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, एयर कंडीशनिंग पैक एक बंद हो गया है, केबिन दबाव और तापमान की निगरानी कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ATC ระบบปรับอากาศแพ็ค 1 ตัดการทำงาน กำลังเฝ้าระวังความดันและอุณหภูมิห้องโดยสาร
usageTranslations.id: ATC, paket AC nomor satu terputus, kami memantau tekanan dan suhu kabin.

terms.definition: An alert triggered by smoke sensors in the aircraft lavatory indicating possible fire, requiring immediate cabin crew and cockpit response.
terms.usage: ATC, we have a lavatory smoke detection alert in the aft section, cabin crew responding immediately.

termTranslations.fr: Détection De Fumée Dans Les Toilettes
termTranslations.es: Detección De Humo En El Aseo
termTranslations.it: Rilevamento Di Fumo Nei Servizi Igienici
termTranslations.vi: Phát Hiện Khói Trong Nhà Vệ Sinh
termTranslations.th: การตรวจจับควันในห้องน้ำ

usageTranslations.en: ATC, we have a lavatory smoke detection alert in the aft section, cabin crew responding immediately.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, arka bölümde tuvalet duman tespiti uyarısı aldık, kabin ekibi derhal müdahale ediyor.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, alerte de détection de fumée dans les toilettes arrière, l’équipage cabine intervient immédiatement.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, Rauchwarnung in der hinteren Bordtoilette, Kabinenpersonal reagiert umgehend.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, alerta de detección de humo en el aseo trasero, la tripulación de cabina está respondiendo de inmediato.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，我们在后部洗手间检测到烟雾警报，客舱乘务员正在立即处理。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، لدينا إنذار كشف دخان في دورة المياه الخلفية، طاقم المقصورة يتعامل فورًا.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, alerta de fumaça no lavabo traseiro, tripulação está respondendo imediatamente.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, сработала тревога обнаружения дыма в заднем туалете, экипаж реагирует незамедлительно.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、後方の化粧室で煙探知警報が出ています。客室乗務員が直ちに対応中です。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, rilevamento fumo nei servizi igienici posteriori, equipaggio cabina sta intervenendo immediatamente.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, có cảnh báo phát hiện khói trong nhà vệ sinh phía sau, tiếp viên đang xử lý ngay lập tức.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, पीछे के हिस्से के शौचालय में धुआं अलार्म सक्रिय हुआ है, केबिन क्रू तुरंत कार्रवाई कर रहा है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC มีการแจ้งเตือนควันในห้องน้ำด้านหลัง ลูกเรือกำลังดำเนินการทันที
usageTranslations.id: ATC, ada peringatan deteksi asap di toilet belakang, kru kabin segera merespons.

terms.definition: Smoke detected in the avionics bay, indicating potential fire or overheating of electronic components, requiring immediate response and system isolation.
terms.usage: ATC, avionics bay smoke detected, initiating smoke removal checklist and requesting immediate return to base.

termTranslations.ja: アビオニクスベイの煙
termTranslations.vi: Khói Trong Khoang Thiết Bị Điện Tử Hàng Không
termTranslations.th: ควันในช่องอุปกรณ์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์

usageTranslations.en: ATC, avionics bay smoke detected, initiating smoke removal checklist and requesting immediate return to base.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, aviyonik bölmede duman tespit edildi, duman giderme kontrol listesi uygulanıyor, üsse acil dönüş talep ediliyor.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, fumée détectée dans la baie avionique, mise en œuvre de la checklist de fumée, retour immédiat demandé.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, Rauch in der Avionik-Bucht festgestellt, Rauchcheckliste eingeleitet, Rückflug zur Basis angefordert.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, se detectó humo en la bodega aviónica, iniciando lista de verificación de humo y solicitando regreso inmediato.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，检测到航空电子舱有烟，正在执行排烟检查单，请求立即返航。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، تم اكتشاف دخان في حجرة الأجهزة الإلكترونية، نبدأ قائمة إزالة الدخان ونطلب العودة الفورية.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, fumaça detectada na baía de aviônicos, iniciando checklist e solicitando retorno imediato à base.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, в отсеке авионики зафиксирован дым, выполняем чек-лист, просим немедленное возвращение.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、アビオニクスベイで煙を検知、煙除去チェックリストを開始、直ちに基地へ戻ることを要請。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, rilevato fumo nel vano avionico, attiviamo la checklist di rimozione fumo, richiesta di ritorno immediato.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, phát hiện khói trong khoang điện tử hàng không, thực hiện danh sách kiểm tra và xin quay lại căn cứ ngay.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, एवियोनिक्स बे में धुआँ पाया गया, धुआँ हटाने की सूची शुरू कर रहे हैं, तत्काल वापसी का अनुरोध है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC ตรวจพบควันในช่องอุปกรณ์อิเล็กทรอนิกส์ กำลังเริ่มรายการตรวจสอบ และขอกลับฐานทันที
usageTranslations.id: ATC, terdeteksi asap di kompartemen avionik, menjalankan checklist penghilangan asap dan meminta kembali ke pangkalan segera.

terms.definition: A condition where the aircraft’s electrical system is operating solely on battery power, typically due to the failure of all generators or external power sources.
terms.usage: ATC, be advised we are on battery-only power, all generators offline, requesting priority landing.

termTranslations.ja: バッテリーのみの電源
termTranslations.th: ใช้พลังงานจากแบตเตอรี่เท่านั้น

usageTranslations.en: ATC, be advised we are on battery-only power, all generators offline, requesting priority landing.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC, sadece batarya gücü ile çalışıyoruz, tüm jeneratörler devre dışı, öncelikli iniş talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC, nous fonctionnons uniquement sur batterie, tous les générateurs sont hors service, demandons atterrissage prioritaire.
usageTranslations.de: ATC, wir arbeiten nur mit Batteriestrom, alle Generatoren sind ausgefallen, erbitten Vorranglandung.
usageTranslations.es: ATC, operamos solo con batería, generadores fuera de servicio, solicitamos aterrizaje prioritario.
usageTranslations.zh: ATC，我们仅使用电池供电，所有发电机失效，请求优先着陆。
usageTranslations.ar: ATC، نعمل فقط على البطارية، جميع المولدات خارج الخدمة، نطلب هبوطًا أولوياً.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC, operando apenas com bateria, todos os geradores desligados, solicitamos pouso prioritário.
usageTranslations.ru: ATC, работаем только на аккумуляторе, все генераторы отключены, запрашиваем приоритетную посадку.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC、バッテリーのみで運航中、すべての発電機が停止、優先着陸を要求します。
usageTranslations.it: ATC, alimentazione solo a batteria, tutti i generatori offline, richiediamo atterraggio prioritario.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC, chúng tôi chỉ dùng pin, tất cả máy phát điện không hoạt động, yêu cầu hạ cánh ưu tiên.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC, हम केवल बैटरी पर हैं, सभी जेनरेटर बंद हैं, प्राथमिक लैंडिंग की आवश्यकता है।
usageTranslations.th: ATC เราใช้พลังงานจากแบตเตอรี่เท่านั้น เครื่องกำเนิดไฟฟ้าทั้งหมดปิด ขออนุญาตลงจอดเร่งด่วน
usageTranslations.id: ATC, kami hanya menggunakan daya baterai, semua generator mati, meminta pendaratan prioritas.

terms.definition: A condition in which there is a significant difference in the quantity of fuel between the left and right tanks, potentially affecting aircraft stability or flight performance.
terms.usage: Tower, be advised we are experiencing a fuel imbalance and taking corrective action.

termTranslations.th: เชื้อเพลิงไม่สมดุล

usageTranslations.en: Tower, be advised we are experiencing a fuel imbalance and taking corrective action.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule, yakıt dengesizliği yaşıyoruz ve düzeltici işlem yapıyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, nous avons un déséquilibre de carburant et prenons des mesures correctives.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, wir haben ein Kraftstoffungleichgewicht und ergreifen Gegenmaßnahmen.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, tenemos un desequilibrio de combustible y estamos corrigiendo.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，请注意我们遇到燃油不平衡，正在采取纠正措施。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، نعاني من اختلال توازن الوقود ونتخذ إجراء تصحيحياً.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, estamos com desequilíbrio de combustível e tomando ações corretivas.
usageTranslations.ru: Вышка, у нас дисбаланс топлива, принимаем меры.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、燃料の不均衡が発生しており、是正処置を行っています。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, stiamo riscontrando uno squilibrio di carburante e interveniamo.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp kiểm soát, chúng tôi bị mất cân bằng nhiên liệu và đang xử lý.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर, हमारे पास ईंधन असंतुलन है और हम सुधारात्मक कदम उठा रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์ ขณะนี้เกิดเชื้อเพลิงไม่สมดุลและกำลังดำเนินการแก้ไข
usageTranslations.id: Menara, kami mengalami ketidakseimbangan bahan bakar dan sedang mengambil tindakan korektif.

terms.definition: A procedure that allows fuel to be transferred from one tank to another, typically to correct a fuel imbalance or supply an engine when a tank is low.
terms.usage: Due to low fuel in the left tank, we are initiating crossfeed to the right engine.

termTranslations.th: การถ่ายเชื้อเพลิงข้ามถัง

usageTranslations.en: Due to low fuel in the left tank, we are initiating crossfeed to the right engine.
usageTranslations.tr: Sol tankta düşük yakıt nedeniyle sağ motora aktarım başlatıyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: En raison d'un faible carburant dans le réservoir gauche, nous alimentons le moteur droit.
usageTranslations.de: Wegen geringem Kraftstoff im linken Tank versorgen wir das rechte Triebwerk.
usageTranslations.es: Debido a bajo combustible en el tanque izquierdo, iniciamos transferencia al motor derecho.
usageTranslations.zh: 由于左油箱燃油不足，我们启动向右发动机的交叉供油。
usageTranslations.ar: نظرًا لانخفاض الوقود في الخزان الأيسر، نبدأ تغذية المحرك الأيمن.
usageTranslations.pt: Devido ao baixo combustível no tanque esquerdo, iniciamos alimentação ao motor direito.
usageTranslations.ru: Из-за низкого уровня топлива в левом баке начинаем подачу к правому двигателю.
usageTranslations.ja: 左タンクの燃料が少ないため、右エンジンに供給を開始します。
usageTranslations.it: A causa del basso carburante nel serbatoio sinistro, attiviamo l’alimentazione al motore destro.
usageTranslations.vi: Do nhiên liệu bên trái thấp, chúng tôi chuyển sang cấp cho động cơ bên phải.
usageTranslations.hi: बाएँ टैंक में कम ईंधन के कारण हम दाएँ इंजन में क्रॉसफीड शुरू कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เนื่องจากน้ำมันในถังซ้ายต่ำ กำลังเริ่มส่งไปยังเครื่องยนต์ขวา
usageTranslations.id: Karena bahan bakar rendah di tangki kiri, kami mulai memasok ke mesin kanan.

terms.definition: An unintentional or spontaneous rudder movement not initiated by the pilot, potentially affecting aircraft yaw stability and directional control.
terms.usage: We are reporting uncommanded rudder input, initiating manual control procedures.

termTranslations.fr: Entrée De Gouverne De Direction Non Commandée
termTranslations.es: Entrada No Ordenada Del Timón De Dirección
termTranslations.ja: 意図しないラダー入力
termTranslations.it: Movimento Involontario Del Timone Di Direzione
termTranslations.vi: Tác Động Vô Tình Đến Cánh Đuôi
termTranslations.th: การควบคุมหางเสือโดยไม่ตั้งใจ

usageTranslations.en: We are reporting uncommanded rudder input, initiating manual control procedures.
usageTranslations.tr: Kumanda dışı dümen hareketi bildiriyoruz, manuel kontrol prosedürlerini başlatıyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous signalons une entrée de gouverne de direction non commandée, en initiant les procédures manuelles.
usageTranslations.de: Wir melden unbeabsichtigte Seitenruderbewegung und beginnen mit manuellen Verfahren.
usageTranslations.es: Reportamos una entrada no ordenada del timón, iniciando control manual.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们报告非指令方向舵输入，正在启动手动控制程序。
usageTranslations.ar: نبلغ عن إدخال دفة غير مقصود، نبدأ إجراءات التحكم اليدوي.
usageTranslations.pt: Relatamos movimento não comandado do leme e iniciamos controle manual.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщаем о непроизвольном вводе руля направления, переходим на ручное управление.
usageTranslations.ja: 意図しないラダー入力を報告し、手動操作を開始します。
usageTranslations.it: Riportiamo un movimento involontario del timone e iniziamo il controllo manuale.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi báo cáo có tác động vô tình đến cánh đuôi, bắt đầu chuyển sang điều khiển tay.
usageTranslations.hi: हम अनियोजित रडर इनपुट की रिपोर्ट कर रहे हैं और मैन्युअल नियंत्रण शुरू कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เรารายงานการควบคุมหางเสือโดยไม่ตั้งใจ และเริ่มควบคุมแบบแมนนวล
usageTranslations.id: Kami melaporkan input kemudi tak diperintah dan mulai prosedur kontrol manual.

terms.definition: A condition in which the rudder deflects fully to one side due to system failure or malfunction, potentially causing severe yaw deviation.
terms.usage: We experienced rudder hardover during climb, initiating abnormal control procedures now.

termTranslations.fr: Déviation Complète De La Gouverne De Direction
termTranslations.es: Desviación Completa Del Timón De Dirección
termTranslations.it: Deviazione Completa Del Timone Di Direzione
termTranslations.th: การเบี่ยงเบนหางเสืออย่างเต็มที่

usageTranslations.en: We experienced rudder hardover during climb, initiating abnormal control procedures now.
usageTranslations.tr: Tırmanış sırasında dikey dümen tam sapması yaşadık, şimdi anormal kontrol prosedürlerini başlatıyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous avons subi une déviation complète de la gouverne pendant la montée, initiation des procédures anormales.
usageTranslations.de: Wir erlebten vollen Seitenruderausschlag im Steigflug, leiten nun Notverfahren ein.
usageTranslations.es: Experimentamos desviación total del timón durante el ascenso, iniciamos procedimientos anormales.
usageTranslations.zh: 爬升过程中方向舵完全偏转，现正启动异常控制程序。
usageTranslations.ar: تعرضنا لانحراف كامل للدفة أثناء الصعود، نبدأ إجراءات التحكم غير العادية الآن.
usageTranslations.pt: Tivemos deslocamento total do leme na subida, iniciando procedimentos anormais agora.
usageTranslations.ru: При наборе высоты произошло полное отклонение руля направления, начинаем аварийные процедуры.
usageTranslations.ja: 上昇中にラダーが完全に偏向しました、異常操作手順を開始します。
usageTranslations.it: Abbiamo avuto una deviazione completa del timone in salita, avviamo le procedure anomale ora.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi gặp lệch hoàn toàn cánh đuôi khi leo cao, bắt đầu quy trình điều khiển bất thường.
usageTranslations.hi: चढ़ाई के दौरान रडर का पूर्ण विचलन हुआ, अब असामान्य नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया शुरू कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เกิดการเบี่ยงเบนหางเสืออย่างเต็มที่ระหว่างไต่ระดับ กำลังเริ่มกระบวนการควบคุมฉุกเฉิน
usageTranslations.id: Kami mengalami pembelokan penuh kemudi saat mendaki, memulai prosedur kontrol abnormal sekarang.

terms.definition: The phase prior to engine start during which pilots perform pre‑start checklists, request clearances, and coordinate with ground services as required.
terms.usage: Ground, Lufthansa Eight Four Seven, stand five zero, pre-start checks complete, request start-up clearance.

termTranslations.th: ก่อนสตาร์ท

usageTranslations.tr: Yer, Lufthansa Sekiz Dört Yedi, beş sıfır park alanında, motor öncesi kontroller tamam, motor çalıştırma izni talep ediliyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Sol, Lufthansa Huit Quatre Sept, point cinq zéro, pré‑démarrage terminé, demande autorisation de démarrage.
usageTranslations.de: Boden, Lufthansa Acht Vier Sieben, auf Position fünf null, Vorstart-Check abgeschlossen, bitte Startfreigabe.
usageTranslations.es: Tierra, Lufthansa Ocho Cuatro Siete, puesto cincuenta, lista previa completada, solicita autorización de arranque.
usageTranslations.zh: 地面，汉莎八四七，50号位，起动前检查完毕，请求起动许可。
usageTranslations.ar: الأرض، لوفتهانزا ثمانية أربعة سبعة، موقف خمسون، فحوصات ما قبل التشغيل مكتملة، نطلب إذن التشغيل.
usageTranslations.pt: Solo, Lufthansa Oito Quatro Sete, posição cinco zero, pré-partida completa, solicita autorização para partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Граунд, Люфтганза Восемь Четыре Семь, стоянка пятьдесят, предпусковой контроль завершён, прошу разрешение на запуск.
usageTranslations.ja: グランド、ルフトハンザ エイト フォー セブン、スタンド50、始動前チェック完了、始動許可を要求。
usageTranslations.it: Rullaggio, Lufthansa Otto Quattro Sette, stand cinquanta, pre‑avviamento completo, richiede autorizzazione all’avviamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Mặt đất, Lufthansa Tám Bốn Bảy, bãi đỗ năm mươi, kiểm tra trước khởi động xong, xin phép khởi động.
usageTranslations.hi: ग्राउंड, लुफ्थांसा आठ चार सात, स्टैंड पचास, प्री-स्टार्ट चेक पूरा, स्टार्ट-अप अनुमति अनुरोध।
usageTranslations.th: กราวด์, ลุฟท์ฮันซ่า แปดสี่เจ็ด, จุดจอดห้าศูนย์, เช็คก่อนสตาร์ทเสร็จสิ้น, ขออนุญาตสตาร์ท
usageTranslations.id: Ground, Lufthansa Delapan Empat Tujuh, posisi lima nol, cek pra‑start selesai, minta izin start.

terms.definition: The action of starting aircraft engines, typically following ATC clearance. Communicated between flight crew and ground control before taxi or pushback.
terms.usage: Ground, Emirates Three Four Six, request engine start at stand four three.

termTranslations.th: สตาร์ทเครื่องยนต์

usageTranslations.tr: Yer, Emirates Üç Dört Altı, kırk üç numaralı park yerinde motor çalıştırma izni talep ediyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Sol, Emirates Trois Quatre Six, demande autorisation de démarrer moteur au point quatre trois.
usageTranslations.de: Boden, Emirates Drei Vier Sechs, bitte Triebwerksstart auf Position vier drei.
usageTranslations.es: Tierra, Emirates Tres Cuatro Seis, solicita encendido de motor en posición cuarenta y tres.
usageTranslations.zh: 地面，阿联酋三四六号，请求在43号位启动发动机。
usageTranslations.ar: الأرض، طيران الإمارات ثلاثة أربعة ستة، يطلب تشغيل المحرك عند الموقف أربعة ثلاثة.
usageTranslations.pt: Solo, Emirates Três Quatro Seis, solicita partida do motor na posição quarenta e três.
usageTranslations.ru: Граунд, Эмирейтс Три Четыре Шесть, прошу запуск двигателей на стоянке сорок три.
usageTranslations.ja: グランド、エミレーツ スリー フォー シックス、スタンド43でエンジンスタートを要求。
usageTranslations.it: Rullaggio, Emirates Tre Quattro Sei, richiesta avviamento motore allo stand quarantatré.
usageTranslations.vi: Mặt đất, Emirates Ba Bốn Sáu, xin phép khởi động động cơ tại bãi đỗ bốn ba.
usageTranslations.hi: ग्राउंड, एमिरेट्स तीन चार छह, स्टैंड चार तीन पर इंजन स्टार्ट की अनुमति अनुरोध।
usageTranslations.th: กราวด์, เอมิเรตส์ สามสี่หก, ขออนุญาตสตาร์ทเครื่องยนต์ที่จุดจอดสี่สาม
usageTranslations.id: Ground, Emirates Tiga Empat Enam, minta izin start mesin di stand empat tiga.

terms.definition: The procedure of moving an aircraft rearward from a gate or stand using a tow vehicle, under ground control instructions, before taxiing.
terms.usage: Ground, Air France Four Two Zero, stand six four, request pushback facing east.

termTranslations.th: ผลักกลับ

usageTranslations.tr: Yer, Air France Dört İki Sıfır, altmış dört numaralı park yerinde, doğuya bakacak şekilde pushback talep ediliyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Sol, Air France Quatre Deux Zéro, point six quatre, demande repoussage face à l'est.
usageTranslations.de: Boden, Air France Vier Zwei Null, Position sechs vier, Pushback in Richtung Osten erbeten.
usageTranslations.es: Tierra, Air France Cuatro Dos Cero, puesto sesenta y cuatro, solicita remolque orientado al este.
usageTranslations.zh: 地面，法航四二零，在64号位请求朝东推出。
usageTranslations.ar: الأرض، إير فرانس أربعة اثنان صفر، موقف ستة أربعة، يطلب دفع للخلف باتجاه الشرق.
usageTranslations.pt: Solo, Air France Quatro Dois Zero, posição sessenta e quatro, solicita pushback voltado para leste.
usageTranslations.ru: Граунд, Эйр Франс Четыре Два Ноль, стоянка шестьдесят четыре, прошу толкание носом на восток.
usageTranslations.ja: グランド、エールフランス フォー ツー ゼロ、スタンド64、イーストフェイシングでプッシュバックを要求。
usageTranslations.it: Rullaggio, Air France Quattro Due Zero, stand sessantaquattro, richiesta pushback verso est.
usageTranslations.vi: Mặt đất, Air France Bốn Hai Không, vị trí sáu bốn, xin phép đẩy lùi hướng đông.
usageTranslations.hi: ग्राउंड, एयर फ्रांस चार दो शून्य, स्टैंड छह चार, ईस्ट फेसिंग पुशबैक की अनुमति अनुरोध।
usageTranslations.th: กราวด์, แอร์ฟรานซ์ สี่สองศูนย์, จุดจอดหกสี่, ขอผลักกลับหันหน้าไปทางทิศตะวันออก
usageTranslations.id: Ground, Air France Empat Dua Nol, posisi enam empat, minta izin pushback menghadap timur.

terms.definition: To move an aircraft on the surface of an aerodrome under its own power, except when taking off and landing. Used in ATC instructions to direct aircraft ground movements.
terms.usage: Taxi to holding point Bravo Two via Alpha and Bravo. Hold short of Runway 27 Left.

termTranslations.th: แท็กซี่

usageTranslations.tr: Alpha ve Bravo üzerinden Bravo İki bekleme noktasına taksi yapın. 27 Sol pistinde bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Roulez au point d’attente Bravo Deux via Alpha et Bravo. Maintenez avant la piste 27 gauche.
usageTranslations.de: Rollen Sie zum Rollhalt Bravo Zwei über Alpha und Bravo. Halten Sie vor Piste 27 links.
usageTranslations.es: Rodaje al punto de espera Bravo Dos vía Alpha y Bravo. Mantenga antes de la pista 27 izquierda.
usageTranslations.zh: 经Alpha和Bravo滑行到Bravo二号等待点。停在27左跑道前。
usageTranslations.ar: توجه إلى نقطة الانتظار برافو 2 عبر ألفا وبرافو. توقف قبل المدرج 27 يسار.
usageTranslations.pt: Táxi até o ponto de espera Bravo Dois via Alpha e Bravo. Aguarde antes da pista 27 esquerda.
usageTranslations.ru: Рулите к точке ожидания Браво два через Альфа и Браво. Остановитесь перед ВПП 27 левая.
usageTranslations.ja: アルファとブラボー経由でブラボー2待機ポイントまでタキシー。ランウェイ27Lの手前で待機。
usageTranslations.it: Rullare al punto attesa Bravo Due via Alpha e Bravo. Attendere prima della pista 27 sinistra.
usageTranslations.vi: Lăn bánh tới điểm chờ Bravo Hai qua Alpha và Bravo. Giữ trước đường băng 27 trái.
usageTranslations.hi: अल्फा और ब्रावो होते हुए ब्रावो दो होल्डिंग पॉइंट तक टैक्सी करें। रनवे 27 लेफ्ट से पहले रुकें।
usageTranslations.th: แท็กซี่ไปยังจุดรอ Bravo Two ทาง Alpha และ Bravo หยุดก่อนรันเวย์ 27 ซ้าย
usageTranslations.id: Taxi ke titik tunggu Bravo Dua melalui Alpha dan Bravo. Berhenti sebelum Runway 27 kiri.

terms.definition: An ATC instruction for an aircraft to enter the runway and position itself for take-off, without commencing the take-off roll.
terms.usage: Tower, Turkish One Four, holding short runway three four right, ready for line‑up and wait.

termTranslations.th: เข้าแนววิ่งขึ้น

usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Turkish One Four, üç dört sağ pist önünde beklemede, hiza al ve bekleye hazır.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Turkish One Four, maintient avant la piste trois quatre droite, prêt à l’alignement et attente.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, Turkish One Four, hält vor Bahn drei vier rechts, bereit zum Aufrollen und Warten.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Turkish One Four, esperando antes de pista tres cuatro derecha, listo para alinearse y esperar.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，Turkish One Four，在34右跑道等待，准备对正等待。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، Turkish One Four، ينتظر عند المدرج ثلاثة أربعة يمين، جاهز للمحاذاة والانتظار.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Turkish One Four, aguardando na pista três quatro direita, pronto para alinhar e aguardar.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Turkish One Four, ожидаю перед ВПП три четыре правая, готов выруливать и ожидать.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、ターキッシュ ワン フォー、ランウェイ34Rで待機、ラインアップ・アンド・ウェイト準備完了。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Turkish One Four, attesa davanti alla pista tre quattro destra, pronto all’allineamento e attesa.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp kiểm soát, Turkish One Four, chờ trước đường băng ba bốn phải, sẵn sàng vào vị trí và chờ.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, टर्किश वन फोर, रनवे तीन चार दाएं पर होल्डिंग, लाइन-अप और वेट के लिए तैयार।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์, Turkish One Four, รอที่รันเวย์สามสี่ขวา, พร้อมเข้าแนวและรอ
usageTranslations.id: Tower, Turkish One Four, menunggu di runway tiga empat kanan, siap berjajar dan menunggu.

terms.definition: The phase of flight beginning when an aircraft starts its ground run on the runway after take-off clearance, accelerating to lift-off speed.
terms.usage: Tower, Lufthansa Three Seven, commencing take‑off roll runway two six left.

termTranslations.th: วิ่งขึ้นรันเวย์

usageTranslations.tr: Kule, Lufthansa Üç Yedi, iki altı sol pistte kalkış koşusuna başlıyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour, Lufthansa Trois Sept, commence la course de décollage piste deux six gauche.
usageTranslations.de: Tower, Lufthansa Drei Sieben, beginnt den Startlauf auf Bahn zwei sechs links.
usageTranslations.es: Torre, Lufthansa Tres Siete, iniciando carrera de despegue pista dos seis izquierda.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台，汉莎三七，在26左跑道开始起飞滑跑。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج، لوفتهانزا ثلاثة سبعة، يبدأ لفة الإقلاع على المدرج اثنان ستة يسار.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre, Lufthansa Três Sete, iniciando corrida de decolagem na pista dois seis esquerda.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер, Люфтганза Три Семь, начинаю разбег по ВПП два шесть левая.
usageTranslations.ja: タワー、ルフトハンザ スリー セブン、ランウェイ26Lでテイクオフロールを開始。
usageTranslations.it: Torre, Lufthansa Tre Sette, inizia corsa di decollo pista due sei sinistra.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp kiểm soát, Lufthansa Ba Bảy, bắt đầu chạy đà cất cánh đường băng hai sáu trái.
usageTranslations.hi: टावर, लुफ्थांसा थ्री सेवन, रनवे दो छह बाएं पर टेक-ऑफ रोल शुरू।
usageTranslations.th: ทาวเวอร์, Lufthansa สามเจ็ด, เริ่มวิ่งขึ้นที่รันเวย์สองหกซ้าย
usageTranslations.id: Tower, Lufthansa Tiga Tujuh, mulai roll take-off di runway dua enam kiri.

terms.definition: A clearly marked line on the surface of an aerodrome, usually at a runway/taxiway intersection, beyond which an aircraft or vehicle may not proceed unless cleared by ATC.
terms.usage: Hold short of Runway 22 at the hold line. Do not cross until cleared by tower.

termTranslations.th: เส้นหยุด

usageTranslations.tr: 22 pistinde bekleme çizgisinde durun. Kule izin vermeden çizgiyi geçmeyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Maintenez avant la piste 22 à la ligne d’arrêt. Ne franchissez pas sans autorisation.
usageTranslations.de: Halten Sie an der Haltelinie vor Piste 22. Nicht überqueren, bis die Tower-Freigabe erfolgt.
usageTranslations.es: Mantenga antes de la pista 22 en la línea de espera. No cruce hasta recibir autorización.
usageTranslations.zh: 在22号跑道的等待线前停住。未获塔台许可不得越线。
usageTranslations.ar: توقف عند خط الانتظار للمدرج 22. لا تتجاوزه حتى تصرح البرج.
usageTranslations.pt: Pare na linha de espera da pista 22. Não cruze sem autorização da torre.
usageTranslations.ru: Остановитесь у линии ожидания перед ВПП 22. Не пересекайте без разрешения вышки.
usageTranslations.ja: 滑走路22のホールドラインで待機してください。タワーの許可があるまで越えないでください。
usageTranslations.it: Fermarsi alla linea d’attesa della pista 22. Non oltrepassare senza autorizzazione.
usageTranslations.vi: Dừng trước đường băng 22 tại vạch dừng. Không vượt qua nếu chưa được phép của tower.
usageTranslations.hi: रनवे 22 के होल्ड लाइन पर रुकें। टावर की अनुमति तक पार न करें।
usageTranslations.th: หยุดที่เส้นหยุดรันเวย์ 22 ห้ามข้ามจนกว่าจะได้รับอนุญาตจากทาวเวอร์
usageTranslations.id: Berhenti di hold line Runway 22. Jangan melintas tanpa izin tower.

terms.definition: A defined path at an aerodrome, established for the taxiing of aircraft and intended to provide a link between one part of the aerodrome and another, including runways, aprons, and hangars.
terms.usage: Exit the runway to the right on Taxiway Echo, then follow ground instructions to the apron.

termTranslations.th: แท็กซี่เวย์

usageTranslations.tr: Echo taksi yolundan sağa dönerek pistten çıkın, ardından yer talimatlarını takip ederek aprona gidin.
usageTranslations.fr: Quittez la piste à droite sur la voie de circulation Echo, puis suivez les instructions sol vers le parking.
usageTranslations.de: Verlassen Sie die Piste nach rechts auf Rollweg Echo und folgen Sie anschließend den Anweisungen zum Vorfeld.
usageTranslations.es: Salga de la pista a la derecha por la calle de rodaje Echo y siga las instrucciones de tierra hasta la plataforma.
usageTranslations.zh: 在Echo滑行道右转离开跑道，然后按照地面指示前往停机坪。
usageTranslations.ar: اخرج من المدرج إلى اليمين عبر مسار تاكسي Echo، ثم اتبع تعليمات الأرض إلى الموقف.
usageTranslations.pt: Saia da pista à direita na pista de táxi Echo e siga as instruções do solo até o pátio.
usageTranslations.ru: Покиньте ВПП направо на РД Эхо, затем следуйте указаниям диспетчера к перрону.
usageTranslations.ja: エコータクシーウェイで右折して滑走路を退出し、その後グランドの指示に従いエプロンへ移動してください。
usageTranslations.it: Esci dalla pista a destra su raccordo Echo, poi segui le istruzioni del suolo fino all'apron.
usageTranslations.vi: Rời đường băng sang phải tại đường lăn Echo, sau đó theo hướng dẫn ground đến bãi đỗ.
