usageTranslations.ja: 航空機の技術記録に翼根ファスナー点検のサービスブリテン保留中と記載。次回点検時に実施予定。
usageTranslations.it: I registri tecnici indicano bollettino di servizio in sospeso per ispezione attacco alare; attuazione al prossimo controllo.
usageTranslations.vi: Sổ kỹ thuật máy bay ghi nhận bản tin bảo dưỡng kiểm tra mối nối gốc cánh đang chờ; thực hiện lần kiểm tra tới.
usageTranslations.hi: विमान के तकनीकी अभिलेखों में विंग रूट फास्टनर जांच हेतु सर्विस बुलेटिन लंबित; अनुपालन अगले निरीक्षण में।
usageTranslations.th: บันทึกเทคนิคแสดงประกาศซ่อมบำรุงค้างอยู่สำหรับตรวจจุดยึดรากปีก; ดำเนินการในรอบตรวจถัดไป
usageTranslations.id: Catatan teknis pesawat menunjukkan buletin layanan tertunda untuk inspeksi pengikat akar sayap; dilakukan pada pemeriksaan berikutnya.

terms.definition: Formal written declaration by licensed engineer that aircraft or component is airworthy and fit for return to operation.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Maintenance signed certified release to service after landing gear actuator replacement; aircraft returned to line.

termTranslations.ja: 整備士合格証明（サービス再開）
termTranslations.vi: Chứng nhận đưa vào khai thác
termTranslations.th: การปล่อยใช้งานที่ได้รับการรับรอง

usageTranslations.en: Maintenance signed certified release to service after landing gear actuator replacement; aircraft returned to line.
usageTranslations.tr: Bakım, iniş takımı aktüatörü değişiminden sonra sertifikalı hizmet serbest bırakmasını imzaladı; uçak servise döndü.
usageTranslations.fr: La maintenance a signé l’approbation de remise en service après remplacement de l’actionneur de train; avion remis en ligne.
usageTranslations.de: Wartung hat nach Austausch des Fahrwerksstellers die Freigabe zur Nutzung zertifiziert; Flugzeug wieder im Einsatz.
usageTranslations.es: Mantenimiento firmó certificado de habilitación tras reemplazo de actuador del tren; aeronave lista para línea.
usageTranslations.zh: 维修在起落架作动器更换后签署了合格放行证，飞机已返回航线运营。
usageTranslations.ar: وقعت الصيانة إفراجاً معتمداً للخدمة بعد استبدال مشغل العجلات؛ الطائرة عادت للخدمة.
usageTranslations.pt: Manutenção assinou liberação certificada após troca do atuador do trem; aeronave voltou à linha.
usageTranslations.ru: Техническая служба подписала сертификат после замены актуатора шасси; самолёт вернулся в эксплуатацию.
usageTranslations.ja: メンテナンスがランディングギア作動機交換後にサービス再開証明書に署名し、機体は運用復帰。
usageTranslations.it: La manutenzione ha firmato il rilascio certificato dopo la sostituzione attuatore carrello; aeromobile tornato in servizio.
usageTranslations.vi: Bảo dưỡng ký chứng nhận đưa vào khai thác sau khi thay xi lanh càng đáp; máy bay quay lại khai thác.
usageTranslations.hi: रखरखाव ने लैंडिंग गियर एक्टुएटर बदलने के बाद प्रमाणित विमोचन पर हस्ताक्षर किए; विमान सेवा में लौट आया।
usageTranslations.th: ฝ่ายซ่อมบำรุงลงนามการปล่อยใช้งานที่ได้รับการรับรองหลังเปลี่ยนตัวกระตุ้นล้อเครื่อง; เครื่องกลับมาใช้งาน
usageTranslations.id: Perawatan menandatangani rilis bersertifikat setelah penggantian aktuator roda pendarat; pesawat kembali ke line.

terms.definition: Written logbook entry by flight crew describing observed technical defect or malfunction requiring maintenance action.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Flight crew defect report submitted for intermittent altitude alert fault on sector to Paris; maintenance action required.

termTranslations.fr: Rapport de défaut de l’équipage de conduite
termTranslations.es: Informe de defecto de tripulación de vuelo
termTranslations.vi: Báo cáo sự cố tổ lái
termTranslations.th: รายงานข้อบกพร่องของลูกเรือ

usageTranslations.en: Flight crew defect report submitted for intermittent altitude alert fault on sector to Paris; maintenance action required.
usageTranslations.tr: Paris seferinde aralıklı irtifa uyarı arızası için uçuş ekibi arıza raporu düzenlendi; bakım müdahalesi gerekiyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Rapport de défaut de l’équipage remis pour alerte altitude intermittente vers Paris; intervention maintenance requise.
usageTranslations.de: Mängelbericht der Flugbesatzung wegen sporadischem Höhenwarnungsfehler nach Paris eingereicht; Wartung erforderlich.
usageTranslations.es: Informe de defecto de tripulación presentado por fallo intermitente de alerta de altitud en sector a París; requiere mantenimiento.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行机组就飞往巴黎航段的间歇高度警告故障提交了缺陷报告，需维修处理。
usageTranslations.ar: تم تقديم تقرير عطل طاقم الطيران عن خلل متقطع في تنبيه الارتفاع في رحلة باريس؛ يلزم صيانة.
usageTranslations.pt: Relatório de defeito da tripulação submetido por falha intermitente de alerta de altitude no setor para Paris; requer manutenção.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж подал отчёт о неисправности по прерывистой ошибке высотного оповещения на рейсе в Париж; требуется ТО.
usageTranslations.ja: パリ行きセクターの断続的高度警報故障で乗員不具合レポート提出、整備必要。
usageTranslations.it: Rapporto difetto equipaggio volo presentato per guasto intermittente avviso altitudine su tratta per Parigi; richiesta manutenzione.
usageTranslations.vi: Tổ lái nộp báo cáo sự cố do cảnh báo cao độ chập chờn tuyến đi Paris; cần bảo trì.
usageTranslations.hi: पेरिस सेक्टर में अंतरित ऊंचाई चेतावनी दोष के लिए फ्लाइट क्रू दोष रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत; रखरखाव आवश्यक।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือรายงานข้อบกพร่องเรื่องสัญญาณเตือนความสูงขัดข้องบางครั้งในเที่ยวบินไปปารีส; ต้องซ่อมบำรุง
usageTranslations.id: Awak pesawat melaporkan cacat pada alarm ketinggian tidak stabil untuk sektor ke Paris; perlu perawatan.

terms.definition: Further diagnostic action needed to isolate cause of technical fault or failure not resolved by initial inspection.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Maintenance notes indicate troubleshooting required for unresolved hydraulic system leak; further action planned overnight.

termTranslations.ja: トラブルシューティング必要
termTranslations.th: ต้องการแก้ไขปัญหา

usageTranslations.en: Maintenance notes indicate troubleshooting required for unresolved hydraulic leak; further action planned overnight.
usageTranslations.tr: Bakım notlarında giderilemeyen hidrolik kaçak için arıza tespiti gerektiği belirtilmiş; ek işlem gece planlandı.
usageTranslations.fr: Notes de maintenance: dépannage requis pour fuite hydraulique non résolue; action prévue la nuit.
usageTranslations.de: Wartungsnotizen: Fehlersuche erforderlich bei ungelöstem Hydraulikleck; weitere Maßnahmen nachts geplant.
usageTranslations.es: Notas de mantenimiento: se requiere diagnóstico por fuga hidráulica no resuelta; acciones adicionales programadas por la noche.
usageTranslations.zh: 维修记录指出，未解决的液压泄漏需进一步故障排查；后续处理安排夜间进行。
usageTranslations.ar: ملاحظات الصيانة تشير إلى ضرورة استكشاف الأخطاء لتسرب هيدروليكي غير محلول؛ إجراءات لاحقة ليلاً.
usageTranslations.pt: Notas de manutenção: necessário troubleshooting para vazamento hidráulico não resolvido; ação adicional planejada à noite.
usageTranslations.ru: В заметках ТО указано: требуется поиск неисправности при нерешённой утечке гидравлики; дальнейшие меры ночью.
usageTranslations.ja: 整備記録に未解決の油圧漏れについてトラブルシューティング必要と記載。夜間に対応予定。
usageTranslations.it: Note manutenzione: richiesto troubleshooting per perdita idraulica irrisolta; ulteriori azioni in notturna.
usageTranslations.vi: Ghi chú bảo dưỡng cho biết cần kiểm tra sự cố do rò rỉ thủy lực chưa khắc phục; xử lý tiếp trong đêm.
usageTranslations.hi: रखरखाव नोट में असमाधानित हाइड्रोलिक रिसाव के लिए समस्या निवारण आवश्यक; आगे की कार्रवाई रात में होगी।
usageTranslations.th: บันทึกซ่อมบำรุงระบุว่าต้องการแก้ไขปัญหาสำหรับรอยรั่วระบบไฮดรอลิกที่ยังไม่แก้; จะดำเนินการเพิ่มกลางคืน
usageTranslations.id: Catatan perawatan menunjukkan troubleshooting diperlukan untuk kebocoran hidrolik yang belum terselesaikan; tindakan lanjutan malam hari.

terms.definition: Unique identifier of a maintenance work card specifying approved procedures for inspection, repair, or modification.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: All actions must be recorded under the relevant work card reference in the maintenance log for traceability.

termTranslations.th: การอ้างอิงบัตรงาน

usageTranslations.en: All actions must be recorded under the relevant work card reference in the maintenance log for traceability.
usageTranslations.tr: Tüm işlemler, izlenebilirlik için bakım kayıtlarında ilgili iş kartı referansı altında kaydedilmelidir.
usageTranslations.fr: Toutes les actions doivent être consignées sous la référence de la fiche de travail pertinente dans le journal de maintenance.
usageTranslations.de: Alle Maßnahmen sind unter der entsprechenden Arbeitskartenreferenz im Wartungsprotokoll zu erfassen.
usageTranslations.es: Todas las acciones deben registrarse bajo la referencia de la tarjeta de trabajo correspondiente en el libro de mantenimiento para trazabilidad.
usageTranslations.zh: 所有操作须以工单参考号记录于维修日志以便追溯。
usageTranslations.ar: يجب تسجيل جميع الإجراءات تحت مرجع بطاقة العمل ذات الصلة في سجل الصيانة للتتبع.
usageTranslations.pt: Todas as ações devem ser registradas sob a referência do cartão de trabalho pertinente no registro de manutenção para rastreabilidade.
usageTranslations.ru: Все действия должны быть зафиксированы в журнале ТО по соответствующей ссылке на рабочую карту для отслеживания.
usageTranslations.ja: すべての作業は保守記録の適切な作業カード参照番号の下で記録する必要がある。
usageTranslations.it: Tutte le azioni devono essere registrate con il riferimento della scheda lavoro nel registro manutenzione per la tracciabilità.
usageTranslations.vi: Mọi thao tác phải được ghi nhận theo tham chiếu thẻ công việc phù hợp trong nhật ký bảo trì để truy xuất.
usageTranslations.hi: सभी कार्रवाइयों को अनुरूप वर्क कार्ड संदर्भ के अंतर्गत रखरखाव लॉग में दर्ज करना आवश्यक है।
usageTranslations.th: ต้องบันทึกการดำเนินการทั้งหมดภายใต้การอ้างอิงบัตรงานที่เกี่ยวข้องในบันทึกซ่อมบำรุงเพื่อความสามารถในการติดตาม
usageTranslations.id: Semua tindakan harus dicatat di bawah referensi kartu kerja terkait di log perawatan untuk pelacakan.

terms.definition: Documented evidence that all steps of an assigned maintenance task card have been performed and signed off.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Task card completed for engine oil filter change; technician signed and logbook updated prior to dispatch.

termTranslations.th: บัตรงานเสร็จสมบูรณ์

usageTranslations.en: Task card completed for engine oil filter change; technician signed and logbook updated prior to dispatch.
usageTranslations.tr: Motor yağ filtresi değişimi için görev kartı tamamlandı; teknisyen imzaladı ve sevk öncesi kayıtlar güncellendi.
usageTranslations.fr: Fiche de tâche achevée pour le changement du filtre à huile moteur; technicien signé et registre mis à jour avant expédition.
usageTranslations.de: Aufgabenkarten für Motorölfilterwechsel abgeschlossen; Techniker unterschrieben, Protokoll vor Einsatz aktualisiert.
usageTranslations.es: Tarjeta de tarea completada para cambio de filtro de aceite del motor; técnico firmó y registro actualizado antes del despacho.
usageTranslations.zh: 发动机油滤更换任务卡已完成，技师签名并在放行前更新了日志。
usageTranslations.ar: تم إكمال بطاقة المهمة لتغيير فلتر زيت المحرك؛ الفني وقع وتم تحديث السجل قبل الإرسال.
usageTranslations.pt: Cartão de tarefa concluído para troca do filtro de óleo do motor; técnico assinou e registro atualizado antes do despacho.
usageTranslations.ru: Карта задания по замене масляного фильтра двигателя выполнена; техник подписал, журнал обновлен до выпуска.
usageTranslations.ja: エンジンオイルフィルター交換のタスクカード完了、技術者署名・出発前に記録更新。
usageTranslations.it: Scheda attività completata per il cambio filtro olio motore; tecnico firmato e registro aggiornato prima del rilascio.
usageTranslations.vi: Hoàn thành thẻ nhiệm vụ thay lọc dầu động cơ; kỹ thuật viên ký, cập nhật nhật ký trước khi xuất xưởng.
usageTranslations.hi: इंजन तेल फिल्टर बदलने के लिए कार्य कार्ड पूर्ण; तकनीशियन ने हस्ताक्षर किए और डिस्पैच से पहले लॉगबुक अपडेट की।
usageTranslations.th: บัตรงานสำหรับเปลี่ยนไส้กรองน้ำมันเครื่องเสร็จสมบูรณ์; ช่างเซ็นและอัปเดตสมุดบันทึกก่อนปล่อยเครื่อง
usageTranslations.id: Kartu tugas untuk ganti filter oli mesin selesai; teknisi menandatangani dan log diperbarui sebelum dispatch.

terms.definition: Standardized reference number identifying aircraft system/component according to the ATA 100/2200 maintenance coding system.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Please record the ATA chapter reference when entering defect details in the technical log for traceability.

termTranslations.th: การอ้างอิงบท ATA

usageTranslations.en: Please record the ATA chapter reference when entering defect details in the technical log for traceability.
usageTranslations.tr: Bakım defterine arıza detaylarını girerken ATA bölüm referansını kaydediniz.
usageTranslations.fr: Merci d’indiquer la référence chapitre ATA lors de la saisie du défaut dans le registre technique pour la traçabilité.
usageTranslations.de: Bitte geben Sie bei der Erfassung von Mängeln im Wartungsprotokoll die ATA-Kapitelreferenz an.
usageTranslations.es: Por favor registre la referencia de capítulo ATA al ingresar detalles de fallas en el libro técnico para rastreo.
usageTranslations.zh: 输入缺陷详情至维修日志时请记录ATA章节编号以便追溯。
usageTranslations.ar: يرجى تسجيل مرجع فصل ATA عند إدخال تفاصيل العطل في السجل الفني للتتبع.
usageTranslations.pt: Por favor registre a referência de capítulo ATA ao inserir detalhes de defeitos no registro técnico para rastreabilidade.
usageTranslations.ru: Пожалуйста, указывайте ссылку на главу ATA при внесении данных о неисправностях в журнал ТО для отслеживания.
usageTranslations.ja: 技術記録簿に不具合詳細入力時はATAチャプター参照を記録してください。
usageTranslations.it: Si prega di registrare il riferimento capitolo ATA durante l’inserimento dei dettagli del difetto nel registro tecnico.
usageTranslations.vi: Vui lòng ghi tham chiếu chương ATA khi nhập chi tiết sự cố vào sổ bảo trì để truy xuất.
usageTranslations.hi: तकनीकी लॉग में दोष विवरण दर्ज करते समय ATA अध्याय संदर्भ दर्ज करें।
usageTranslations.th: โปรดบันทึกการอ้างอิงบท ATA เมื่อบันทึกรายละเอียดข้อบกพร่องในสมุดซ่อมเพื่อความสามารถในการติดตาม
usageTranslations.id: Silakan catat referensi bab ATA saat memasukkan detail cacat di log teknis untuk pelacakan.

terms.definition: Pre-planned replacement of a part or system component at a specified interval or due time according to maintenance schedule.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Scheduled component change for fuel pump planned at next overnight check; action coordinated with engineering.

termTranslations.vi: Thay thế linh kiện định kỳ
termTranslations.th: เปลี่ยนชิ้นส่วนตามกำหนด

usageTranslations.en: Scheduled component change for fuel pump planned at next overnight check; action coordinated with engineering.
usageTranslations.tr: Yakıt pompası için planlı parça değişimi bir sonraki gece bakımında yapılacak; mühendislik ile koordine edildi.
usageTranslations.fr: Changement de composant programmé pour la pompe à carburant prévu lors de la prochaine visite de nuit; action coordonnée avec l’ingénierie.
usageTranslations.de: Geplanter Komponententausch der Kraftstoffpumpe beim nächsten Nachtdienst; Abstimmung mit Engineering erfolgt.
usageTranslations.es: Cambio de componente programado para la bomba de combustible en el próximo chequeo nocturno; coordinado con ingeniería.
usageTranslations.zh: 燃油泵计划组件更换将在下次夜检进行，已与工程部门协调。
usageTranslations.ar: تغيير مكون مضخة الوقود المجدول سيتم في الفحص الليلي القادم؛ منسق مع الهندسة.
usageTranslations.pt: Troca programada de componente da bomba de combustível prevista para a próxima verificação noturna; coordenada com engenharia.
usageTranslations.ru: Плановая замена топливного насоса на следующем ночном ТО; согласовано с инженерной службой.
usageTranslations.ja: 燃料ポンプの定期部品交換は次回夜間点検時に実施、エンジニアリングと調整済み。
usageTranslations.it: Cambio programmato della pompa carburante previsto al prossimo controllo notturno; azione coordinata con l’ingegneria.
usageTranslations.vi: Thay thế linh kiện định kỳ cho bơm nhiên liệu lên kế hoạch ở lần kiểm tra đêm tới; phối hợp với kỹ thuật.
usageTranslations.hi: ईंधन पंप के लिए अनुसूचित घटक परिवर्तन अगली रात की जांच में किया जाएगा; कार्य इंजीनियरिंग से समन्वित।
usageTranslations.th: เปลี่ยนชิ้นส่วนปั๊มน้ำมันตามกำหนดจะดำเนินการในรอบตรวจกลางคืนครั้งถัดไป; ประสานงานกับวิศวกรรม
usageTranslations.id: Penggantian komponen terjadwal untuk pompa bahan bakar direncanakan pada pemeriksaan malam berikutnya; sudah dikoordinasikan dengan teknik.

terms.definition: Pre-planned replacement of an aircraft component at specific intervals in accordance with the maintenance schedule.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Scheduled component change for the oxygen cylinder will be carried out during the next maintenance check.

termTranslations.vi: Thay thế linh kiện định kỳ
termTranslations.th: เปลี่ยนชิ้นส่วนตามกำหนด

usageTranslations.en: Scheduled component change for the oxygen cylinder will be carried out during the next maintenance check.
usageTranslations.tr: Oksijen tüpü için planlı parça değişimi bir sonraki bakımda gerçekleştirilecektir.
usageTranslations.fr: Le changement programmé du composant bouteille d’oxygène sera effectué lors du prochain contrôle de maintenance.
usageTranslations.de: Der geplante Austausch des Sauerstoffzylinders erfolgt bei der nächsten Wartung.
usageTranslations.es: El cambio programado del cilindro de oxígeno se realizará en la próxima revisión.
usageTranslations.zh: 氧气瓶的计划更换将在下次维护时进行。
usageTranslations.ar: سيتم تنفيذ تغيير المكون المجدول لأسطوانة الأكسجين أثناء الفحص القادم.
usageTranslations.pt: A troca programada do cilindro de oxigênio será realizada na próxima manutenção.
usageTranslations.ru: Плановая замена кислородного баллона будет выполнена при следующем техобслуживании.
usageTranslations.ja: 酸素シリンダーの定期部品交換は次回の整備で実施されます。
usageTranslations.it: La sostituzione programmata della bombola di ossigeno sarà effettuata al prossimo controllo.
usageTranslations.vi: Thay thế bình oxy định kỳ sẽ được thực hiện trong kỳ bảo dưỡng tiếp theo.
usageTranslations.hi: ऑक्सीजन सिलेंडर के लिए अनुसूचित घटक परिवर्तन अगली सर्विसिंग में किया जाएगा।
usageTranslations.th: จะเปลี่ยนถังออกซิเจนตามกำหนดในรอบซ่อมบำรุงถัดไป
usageTranslations.id: Penggantian komponen terjadwal untuk silinder oksigen akan dilakukan pada pemeriksaan berikutnya.

terms.definition: Maintenance action deferred because required replacement part is not yet available in inventory or supply chain.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Repair is pending as the replacement valve is listed as parts awaiting supply in the technical log.

termTranslations.vi: Linh kiện đang chờ cung ứng
termTranslations.th: ชิ้นส่วนรอการจัดส่ง

usageTranslations.en: Repair is pending as the replacement valve is listed as parts awaiting supply in the technical log.
usageTranslations.tr: Yedek vana tedarik bekleyen parça olarak teknik kayıtlarda göründüğünden onarım beklemede.
usageTranslations.fr: La réparation est en attente car la vanne de remplacement est notée en attente d’approvisionnement dans le registre technique.
usageTranslations.de: Die Reparatur verzögert sich, da das Ersatzventil im Wartungsprotokoll als wartend auf Lieferung steht.
usageTranslations.es: La reparación está pendiente ya que la válvula de reemplazo figura como piezas en espera de suministro.
usageTranslations.zh: 由于替换阀门被记为等待供应，维修暂停。
usageTranslations.ar: الإصلاح معلق لأن صمام الاستبدال مدرج كقطع غيار في انتظار التوريد في السجل الفني.
usageTranslations.pt: O reparo está pendente pois a válvula de substituição está listada como peças aguardando fornecimento.
usageTranslations.ru: Ремонт отложен, так как заменяющий клапан отмечен как ожидающий поставки в журнале ТО.
usageTranslations.ja: 交換バルブが部品供給待ちのため修理は保留中です。
usageTranslations.it: La riparazione è in sospeso poiché la valvola di ricambio è segnalata come parti in attesa di fornitura nel registro tecnico.
usageTranslations.vi: Việc sửa chữa đang chờ do van thay thế được ghi nhận là linh kiện đang chờ cung ứng trong nhật ký kỹ thuật.
usageTranslations.hi: रखरखाव लॉग में रिप्लेसमेंट वॉल्व 'आपूर्ति हेतु प्रतीक्षित पुर्जे' के रूप में दर्ज होने के कारण मरम्मत लंबित है।
usageTranslations.th: การซ่อมอยู่ระหว่างรอเนื่องจากวาล์วเปลี่ยนใหม่ถูกบันทึกว่าเป็นชิ้นส่วนรอการจัดส่งในสมุดเทคนิค
usageTranslations.id: Perbaikan tertunda karena katup pengganti tercatat sebagai suku cadang menunggu pasokan di log teknis.

terms.definition: A maintenance log entry confirming replenishment of expendable items such as oil, hydraulic fluid, or oxygen.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Hydraulic fluid level low; consumable replenished before next departure and log updated.

termTranslations.th: เติมของสิ้นเปลืองแล้ว

usageTranslations.en: Hydraulic fluid level low; consumable replenished before next departure and log updated.
usageTranslations.tr: Hidrolik sıvı seviyesi düşük; sarf malzemesi bir sonraki kalkıştan önce tamamlandı ve kayıt güncellendi.
usageTranslations.fr: Niveau de fluide hydraulique bas; consommable réapprovisionné avant le prochain départ et journal mis à jour.
usageTranslations.de: Hydraulikflüssigkeitsstand niedrig; Verbrauchsmaterial vor dem nächsten Abflug aufgefüllt und Protokoll aktualisiert.
usageTranslations.es: Nivel de fluido hidráulico bajo; consumible reabastecido antes de la próxima salida y registro actualizado.
usageTranslations.zh: 液压油位低；已在下次起飞前补充消耗品并更新日志。
usageTranslations.ar: مستوى سائل الهيدروليك منخفض؛ تم تزويد المستهلكات قبل المغادرة التالية وتحديث السجل.
usageTranslations.pt: Nível de fluido hidráulico baixo; consumível reabastecido antes da próxima partida e registro atualizado.
usageTranslations.ru: Уровень гидравлической жидкости низкий; расходник пополнен до следующего вылета, журнал обновлён.
usageTranslations.ja: 油圧液レベル低下、出発前に消耗品を補充し記録を更新。
usageTranslations.it: Livello fluido idraulico basso; consumo rifornito prima della prossima partenza e registro aggiornato.
usageTranslations.vi: Mức dầu thủy lực thấp; tiêu hao đã bổ sung trước chuyến tiếp theo và nhật ký đã cập nhật.
usageTranslations.hi: हाइड्रोलिक तरल स्तर कम; अगली प्रस्थान से पूर्व उपभोग्य वस्तु पुनः भरी गई और लॉग अपडेट किया गया।
usageTranslations.th: ระดับของเหลวไฮดรอลิกต่ำ; เติมของสิ้นเปลืองแล้วก่อนเที่ยวบินถัดไปและอัปเดตบันทึก
usageTranslations.id: Level cairan hidrolik rendah; consumable diisi ulang sebelum keberangkatan berikutnya dan log diperbarui.

terms.definition: Maintenance inspection not aligned with normal cycle, scheduled according to special interval or condition.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Landing gear out-of-phase check required after hard landing, as per maintenance instruction.

termTranslations.th: การตรวจสอบนอกแผน

usageTranslations.en: Landing gear out-of-phase check required after hard landing, as per maintenance instruction.
usageTranslations.tr: Zorlu iniş sonrası iniş takımı için dönem dışı kontrol gereklidir, bakım talimatına göre.
usageTranslations.fr: Contrôle hors phase du train d’atterrissage requis après atterrissage brutal selon l’instruction de maintenance.
usageTranslations.de: Nach harter Landung ist laut Wartungsanweisung eine außerplanmäßige Kontrolle des Fahrwerks erforderlich.
usageTranslations.es: Se requiere inspección fuera de fase del tren de aterrizaje tras aterrizaje fuerte según las instrucciones de mantenimiento.
usageTranslations.zh: 根据维修指令，重着陆后需要进行起落架非周期检查。
usageTranslations.ar: فحص خارج الجدول لعجلات الهبوط مطلوب بعد هبوط عنيف حسب تعليمات الصيانة.
usageTranslations.pt: Inspeção fora de fase do trem de pouso necessária após pouso duro, conforme instrução de manutenção.
usageTranslations.ru: После жёсткой посадки требуется внеплановая проверка шасси согласно инструкции ТО.
usageTranslations.ja: ハードランディング後に整備指示により非周期的なギア点検が必要です。
usageTranslations.it: Dopo atterraggio duro è richiesto controllo fuori fase del carrello, secondo istruzioni di manutenzione.
usageTranslations.vi: Kiểm tra ngoài chu kỳ càng đáp cần thực hiện sau hạ cánh mạnh, theo hướng dẫn bảo dưỡng.
usageTranslations.hi: मजबूत लैंडिंग के बाद रखरखाव निर्देशानुसार लैंडिंग गियर की अनियमित जाँच आवश्यक है।
usageTranslations.th: ต้องตรวจสอบชุดล้อขาลงนอกแผนหลังลงจอดแรง ตามคำแนะนำการซ่อมบำรุง
usageTranslations.id: Pemeriksaan di luar siklus untuk roda pendarat diperlukan setelah pendaratan keras sesuai instruksi perawatan.

terms.definition: Notification that a scheduled inspection interval will be reached within a short time frame, requiring planning.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Inspection due soon: crew should review schedule and coordinate downtime with operations.

termTranslations.th: ใกล้ถึงกำหนดตรวจสอบ

usageTranslations.en: Inspection due soon: crew should review schedule and coordinate downtime with operations.
usageTranslations.tr: Yakında yapılacak kontrol: ekip programı gözden geçirmeli ve operasyon ile zamanlamayı koordine etmelidir.
usageTranslations.fr: Inspection à venir : l’équipage doit revoir le planning et coordonner avec les opérations.
usageTranslations.de: Inspektion bald fällig: Besatzung soll den Plan prüfen und die Ausfallzeit mit der Betriebsleitung abstimmen.
usageTranslations.es: Inspección próxima: la tripulación debe revisar el cronograma y coordinar el tiempo muerto con operaciones.
usageTranslations.zh: 即将到期的检查：机组应检查计划并与运行部门协调停机时间。
usageTranslations.ar: فحص مستحق قريباً: يجب على الطاقم مراجعة الجدول والتنسيق مع العمليات.
usageTranslations.pt: Inspeção a vencer em breve: tripulação deve revisar cronograma e coordenar parada com operações.
usageTranslations.ru: Скоро предстоит инспекция: экипажу следует сверить график и согласовать простой с операторами.
usageTranslations.ja: まもなく点検時期：クルーはスケジュールを確認し運航部門と調整してください。
usageTranslations.it: Ispezione in scadenza: l’equipaggio deve controllare il programma e coordinare i tempi morti con le operazioni.
usageTranslations.vi: Sắp đến hạn kiểm tra: tổ lái nên xem lại lịch và phối hợp thời gian dừng với khai thác.
usageTranslations.hi: जाँच शीघ्र ही देय: चालक दल को शेड्यूल की समीक्षा करनी चाहिए और संचालन से समन्वय करना चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: ใกล้ถึงกำหนดตรวจสอบ: ลูกเรือต้องตรวจสอบตารางและประสานงานกับฝ่ายปฏิบัติการ
usageTranslations.id: Pemeriksaan akan jatuh tempo: kru harus meninjau jadwal dan mengoordinasikan downtime dengan operasi.

terms.definition: Indicates requirement for an operational or systems test to confirm correct function of a repaired or replaced item.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: After repair, functional test needed for autopilot before aircraft release.

termTranslations.th: ต้องการทดสอบการทำงาน

usageTranslations.en: After repair, functional test needed for autopilot before aircraft release.
usageTranslations.tr: Onarımdan sonra, uçak serbest bırakılmadan önce otopilot için fonksiyon testi gereklidir.
usageTranslations.fr: Après réparation, un test fonctionnel de l’autopilote est nécessaire avant la remise en service.
usageTranslations.de: Nach der Reparatur ist ein Funktionstest des Autopiloten vor der Freigabe des Flugzeugs erforderlich.
usageTranslations.es: Tras la reparación, se requiere una prueba funcional del piloto automático antes de liberar la aeronave.
usageTranslations.zh: 维修后，在飞机放行前需进行自动驾驶仪功能测试。
usageTranslations.ar: بعد الإصلاح، اختبار وظيفي مطلوب للطيار الآلي قبل إطلاق الطائرة.
usageTranslations.pt: Após o reparo, teste funcional necessário para o piloto automático antes da liberação da aeronave.
usageTranslations.ru: После ремонта требуется функциональный тест автопилота до выпуска ВС.
usageTranslations.ja: 修理後、機体リリース前にオートパイロットの機能テスト必要。
usageTranslations.it: Dopo la riparazione, è richiesto il test funzionale dell’autopilota prima del rilascio.
usageTranslations.vi: Sau sửa chữa, cần kiểm tra chức năng autopilot trước khi xuất xưởng.
usageTranslations.hi: मरम्मत के बाद, विमान विमोचन से पूर्व ऑटोपायलट हेतु फंक्शनल टेस्ट आवश्यक।
usageTranslations.th: หลังซ่อมต้องทดสอบการทำงานของออโตไพลอตก่อนปล่อยเครื่อง
usageTranslations.id: Setelah perbaikan, tes fungsional autopilot diperlukan sebelum pesawat dilepas.

terms.definition: Ongoing process of assessing system or component health through data and trend analysis to guide maintenance decisions.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Engine parameters under condition monitoring indicate early signs of vibration, scheduled inspection advised.

termTranslations.th: การติดตามสภาพ

usageTranslations.en: Engine parameters under condition monitoring indicate early signs of vibration, scheduled inspection advised.
usageTranslations.tr: Durum izleme altındaki motor parametreleri titreşim belirtisi gösteriyor, planlı kontrol önerildi.
usageTranslations.fr: Les paramètres moteur sous surveillance de l’état indiquent des signes précoces de vibration, inspection programmée conseillée.
usageTranslations.de: Motordaten im Rahmen der Zustandsüberwachung zeigen frühe Anzeichen von Vibration, geplante Inspektion empfohlen.
usageTranslations.es: Parámetros del motor bajo monitoreo de condición indican signos tempranos de vibración, se recomienda inspección programada.
usageTranslations.zh: 状态监测下的发动机参数显示早期振动迹象，建议进行计划检查。
usageTranslations.ar: تشير معلمات المحرك الخاضعة لمراقبة الحالة إلى علامات مبكرة للاهتزاز، يُنصح بالفحص المجدول.
usageTranslations.pt: Parâmetros do motor sob monitoramento de condição indicam sinais iniciais de vibração, recomendada inspeção programada.
usageTranslations.ru: Параметры двигателя при контроле состояния указывают на ранние признаки вибрации, рекомендована плановая проверка.
usageTranslations.ja: 状態監視下のエンジンパラメータが振動の初期兆候を示すため、定期点検が推奨されます。
usageTranslations.it: I parametri del motore monitorati mostrano segni precoci di vibrazione, si consiglia ispezione programmata.
usageTranslations.vi: Các thông số động cơ trong giám sát tình trạng cho thấy dấu hiệu rung sớm, khuyến nghị kiểm tra định kỳ.
usageTranslations.hi: स्थिति निगरानी के तहत इंजन पैरामीटर कंपन के शुरुआती संकेत दर्शाते हैं, अनुसूचित निरीक्षण की सलाह।
usageTranslations.th: พารามิเตอร์เครื่องยนต์ภายใต้การติดตามสภาพแสดงสัญญาณเริ่มต้นของการสั่น แนะนำให้ตรวจสอบตามรอบ
usageTranslations.id: Parameter mesin di bawah pemantauan kondisi menunjukkan tanda getaran awal, disarankan pemeriksaan terjadwal.

terms.definition: Mandatory maintenance or modification order issued by the operator or manufacturer, applicable to an entire fleet.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Operator issued a fleet campaign directive requiring inspection of all aircraft landing gear within 30 days.

termTranslations.ja: フリートキャンペーン指令
termTranslations.vi: Chỉ thị chiến dịch đội bay
termTranslations.th: คำสั่งรณรงค์ฝูงบิน

usageTranslations.en: Operator issued a fleet campaign directive requiring inspection of all aircraft landing gear within 30 days.
usageTranslations.tr: Operatör, tüm uçakların iniş takımı 30 gün içinde kontrol edilecek şekilde filo kampanya talimatı yayımladı.
usageTranslations.fr: L’opérateur a émis une directive de campagne flotte exigeant l’inspection du train d’atterrissage de tous les avions sous 30 jours.
usageTranslations.de: Der Betreiber erließ eine Flottenkampagnenanweisung zur Überprüfung aller Fahrwerke innerhalb von 30 Tagen.
usageTranslations.es: El operador emitió una directiva de campaña de flota que exige la inspección del tren de aterrizaje de todas las aeronaves en 30 días.
usageTranslations.zh: 运营商发布机队行动指令，要求30天内检查所有飞机起落架。
usageTranslations.ar: أصدر المشغل توجيه حملة الأسطول يطلب فحص معدات الهبوط لجميع الطائرات خلال 30 يوماً.
usageTranslations.pt: Operador emitiu diretriz de campanha de frota exigindo inspeção de todos os trens de pouso em 30 dias.
usageTranslations.ru: Оператор выпустил директиву кампании для флота о проверке всех шасси в течение 30 дней.
usageTranslations.ja: 運航者は全機のランディングギアを30日以内に点検するフリートキャンペーン指令を発行した。
usageTranslations.it: L’operatore ha emesso una direttiva campagna flotta richiedendo ispezione di tutti i carrelli in 30 giorni.
usageTranslations.vi: Hãng phát hành chỉ thị chiến dịch đội bay, yêu cầu kiểm tra càng đáp mọi máy bay trong 30 ngày.
usageTranslations.hi: ऑपरेटर ने सभी विमानों के लैंडिंग गियर की 30 दिन में जांच हेतु फ्लीट अभियान निर्देश जारी किया।
usageTranslations.th: ผู้ดำเนินการออกคำสั่งรณรงค์ฝูงบินให้ตรวจชุดล้อลงจอดทุกลำภายใน 30 วัน
usageTranslations.id: Operator mengeluarkan direktif kampanye armada untuk inspeksi semua roda pendarat pesawat dalam 30 hari.

terms.definition: A temporary update to operational or maintenance procedures, issued before the next official revision, to address urgent safety, regulatory, or operational requirements. Used in documentation and flight operations until formal revision is published.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: Flight crew, please note the interim procedural revision for approach procedures published today; ensure compliance before landing at destination.

termTranslations.vi: Sửa Đổi Quy Trình Tạm Thời
termTranslations.th: การแก้ไขขั้นตอนชั่วคราว

usageTranslations.en: Flight crew, please note the interim procedural revision for approach procedures published today; ensure compliance before landing at destination.
usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş ekibi, bugün yayımlanan yaklaşma prosedürlerine ait geçici prosedür revizyonunu dikkate alınız; varışta uygulamaya özen gösteriniz.
usageTranslations.fr: Équipage, veuillez noter la révision procédurale provisoire concernant les procédures d'approche publiée aujourd'hui; assurez-vous de la conformité avant l’atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Flugbesatzung, beachten Sie die heute veröffentlichte vorläufige Verfahrensanweisung für Anflugverfahren; setzen Sie diese vor der Landung um.
usageTranslations.es: Tripulación, tomen nota de la revisión procedimental provisional para los procedimientos de aproximación publicada hoy; aseguren su cumplimiento antes del aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 机组，请注意今天发布的临时进场程序修订；在到达前确保遵守。
usageTranslations.ar: طاقم الطائرة، يرجى ملاحظة مراجعة الإجراءات المؤقتة لإجراءات الاقتراب المنشورة اليوم؛ تأكدوا من الالتزام قبل الهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Tripulação, por favor, observe a revisão processual provisória para procedimentos de aproximação publicada hoje; assegure conformidade antes do pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Экипаж, обратите внимание на временное процедурное изменение для схем захода на посадку, опубликованное сегодня; соблюдайте перед посадкой.
usageTranslations.ja: 乗務員の皆様、本日発行されたアプローチ手順の暫定手順改訂にご注意ください。目的地着陸前に遵守をお願いします。
usageTranslations.it: Equipaggio, si prega di notare la revisione procedurale provvisoria pubblicata oggi per le procedure di avvicinamento; assicurarsi la conformità prima dell’atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi hành đoàn, lưu ý sửa đổi quy trình tạm thời về quy trình tiếp cận được ban hành hôm nay; đảm bảo tuân thủ trước khi hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: क्रू, कृपया आज प्रकाशित की गई अंतरिम प्रक्रिया संशोधन के बारे में नोट करें; गंतव्य पर उतरने से पहले अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करें।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือ โปรดทราบการแก้ไขขั้นตอนชั่วคราวสำหรับขั้นตอนการเข้าใกล้ที่เผยแพร่วันนี้ โปรดปฏิบัติตามก่อนลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: Kru penerbangan, mohon perhatikan revisi prosedur sementara untuk prosedur pendekatan yang diterbitkan hari ini; pastikan kepatuhan sebelum mendarat.

terms.definition: A maintenance log entry documenting unscheduled or unexpected technical issues or discrepancies detected during aircraft operations, requiring attention beyond regular or planned maintenance.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: After landing, maintenance recorded a non-routine work entry for the right hydraulic system leak; corrective action is now required before next flight.

termTranslations.vi: Ghi Chép Công Việc Phi Thường
termTranslations.th: รายการงานนอกตาราง

usageTranslations.en: After landing, maintenance recorded a non-routine work entry for the right hydraulic system leak; corrective action is now required before next flight.
usageTranslations.tr: İnişten sonra bakım ekibi sağ hidrolik sistem kaçağı için plansız iş kaydı oluşturdu; düzeltici işlem bir sonraki uçuş öncesi gerekmektedir.
usageTranslations.fr: Après l'atterrissage, la maintenance a enregistré une entrée de travail non-routine pour une fuite du système hydraulique droit; une action corrective est requise avant le prochain vol.
usageTranslations.de: Nach der Landung wurde wegen einer Leckage im rechten Hydrauliksystem ein Eintrag für außerplanmäßige Arbeit erfasst; Korrekturmaßnahmen sind vor dem nächsten Flug erforderlich.
usageTranslations.es: Después del aterrizaje, mantenimiento registró un trabajo no rutinario por una fuga en el sistema hidráulico derecho; se requiere acción correctiva antes del próximo vuelo.
usageTranslations.zh: 着陆后，维修记录了右液压系统泄漏的非例行工作记录；需在下次飞行前采取纠正措施。
usageTranslations.ar: بعد الهبوط، سجلت الصيانة إدخال عمل غير روتيني لتسرب النظام الهيدروليكي الأيمن؛ يلزم إجراء تصحيح قبل الرحلة التالية.
usageTranslations.pt: Após o pouso, a manutenção registrou um trabalho não rotineiro para vazamento no sistema hidráulico direito; ação corretiva é necessária antes do próximo voo.
usageTranslations.ru: После посадки техническая служба внесла запись внеплановой работы из-за утечки в правой гидросистеме; требуется устранение до следующего рейса.
usageTranslations.ja: 着陸後、整備士が右油圧系の漏れについて非定型作業記録を記入しました。次の飛行前に是正処置が必要です。
usageTranslations.it: Dopo l'atterraggio, la manutenzione ha registrato un lavoro non ordinario per una perdita del sistema idraulico destro; è richiesta un'azione correttiva prima del prossimo volo.
usageTranslations.vi: Sau khi hạ cánh, bảo trì ghi nhận sự cố rò rỉ hệ thống thủy lực phải vào công việc phi thường; phải khắc phục trước chuyến bay tiếp theo.
usageTranslations.hi: लैंडिंग के बाद, रखरखाव ने दाएं हाइड्रोलिक सिस्टम में रिसाव के लिए ग़ैर-नियमित कार्य प्रविष्टि दर्ज की; अगली उड़ान से पहले सुधारात्मक कार्य आवश्यक है।
usageTranslations.th: หลังจากลงจอด ทีมบำรุงรักษาบันทึกงานนอกตารางสำหรับการรั่วของระบบไฮดรอลิกขวา ต้องดำเนินการแก้ไขก่อนเที่ยวบินถัดไป
usageTranslations.id: Setelah mendarat, perawatan mencatat entri pekerjaan non-rutin untuk kebocoran sistem hidrolik kanan; tindakan korektif diperlukan sebelum penerbangan berikutnya.

terms.definition: A discrepancy, malfunction, or abnormality reported by crew and recorded in the aircraft cabin log for maintenance attention, typically affecting passenger or crew services and requiring rectification before or after flight.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: The cabin crew reported a cabin log defect for the inoperative overhead reading light in row 12; maintenance action required prior to departure.

termTranslations.fr: Défaut Consigné au Carnet de Bord Cabine
termTranslations.es: Defecto en el Libro de Cabina
termTranslations.ar: عيب مسجل في سجل مقصورة الطائرة
termTranslations.pt: Defeito Registrado no Diário de Cabine
termTranslations.vi: Lỗi Được Ghi Vào Nhật Ký Khoang Hành Khách
termTranslations.th: ข้อบกพร่องที่บันทึกในสมุดห้องโดยสาร

usageTranslations.en: The cabin crew reported a cabin log defect for the inoperative overhead reading light in row 12; maintenance action required prior to departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabin ekibi, 12. sıradaki çalışmayan okuma lambası için kabin kayıt defteri arızası bildirdi; kalkış öncesi bakım işlemi gerekmektedir.
usageTranslations.fr: L'équipage cabine a signalé un défaut consigné au carnet de bord cabine concernant la liseuse hors service en rangée 12; une intervention de maintenance est requise avant le départ.
usageTranslations.de: Die Kabinenbesatzung meldete einen Kabinenbuch-Mangel wegen der defekten Leselampe in Reihe 12; Wartungsmaßnahmen sind vor Abflug erforderlich.
usageTranslations.es: La tripulación de cabina reportó un defecto en el libro de cabina por la luz de lectura inoperativa en la fila 12; se requiere acción de mantenimiento antes de la salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 客舱乘务员报告第12排阅读灯失灵的客舱日志故障；出发前需进行维护处理。
usageTranslations.ar: أبلغ طاقم المقصورة عن عيب مسجل في سجل المقصورة لضوء القراءة العلوي غير العامل في الصف 12؛ يلزم إجراء الصيانة قبل المغادرة.
usageTranslations.pt: A tripulação de cabine relatou defeito registrado no diário de cabine para a luz de leitura inoperante na fileira 12; manutenção necessária antes da partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Бортпроводники зафиксировали дефект в журнале кабины из-за неработающего светильника в 12-м ряду; требуется техническое обслуживание до вылета.
usageTranslations.ja: 客室乗務員は12列の読書灯不作動についてキャビンログ欠陥を報告しました。出発前に整備が必要です。
usageTranslations.it: L'equipaggio cabina ha annotato un difetto nel registro cabina per la luce di lettura non funzionante in fila 12; intervento manutentivo richiesto prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi hành đoàn đã ghi nhận lỗi vào nhật ký khoang hành khách đối với đèn đọc sách không hoạt động ở hàng 12; phải bảo trì trước khi khởi hành.
usageTranslations.hi: केबिन क्रू ने पंक्ति 12 में खराब पठन लाइट के लिए केबिन लॉग दोष दर्ज किया; प्रस्थान से पहले रखरखाव आवश्यक है।
usageTranslations.th: ลูกเรือห้องโดยสารรายงานข้อบกพร่องที่บันทึกในสมุดห้องโดยสารสำหรับไฟอ่านหนังสือที่ใช้การไม่ได้ที่แถว 12 ต้องดำเนินการบำรุงรักษาก่อนออกเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Awak kabin melaporkan cacat log kabin untuk lampu baca overhead yang tidak berfungsi di baris 12; perbaikan diperlukan sebelum keberangkatan.

terms.definition: A formal document or electronic record certifying an aircraft’s airworthiness and readiness for flight after maintenance actions or inspections, required to be completed and signed by authorized personnel before each departure.
terms.subcategory: MEL and CDL MEL and CDL
terms.usage: The technical dispatch sheet was completed and signed by maintenance, confirming all required inspections before the aircraft was cleared for departure.

termTranslations.ja: テクニカルディスパッチシート
termTranslations.vi: Phiếu Kỹ Thuật Giao Nhiệm Vụ
termTranslations.th: แผ่นงานส่งมอบทางเทคนิค

usageTranslations.en: The technical dispatch sheet was completed and signed by maintenance, confirming all required inspections before the aircraft was cleared for departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Teknik uçuşa hazırlık formu bakım ekibi tarafından doldurulup imzalandı; uçak, tüm kontroller sonrası kalkışa uygun olarak onaylandı.
usageTranslations.fr: La fiche technique de départ a été remplie et signée par la maintenance, confirmant que toutes les inspections requises ont été effectuées avant l'autorisation de départ.
usageTranslations.de: Das technische Freigabeprotokoll wurde von der Wartung ausgefüllt und unterschrieben, wodurch alle erforderlichen Kontrollen vor dem Abflug bestätigt wurden.
usageTranslations.es: La hoja técnica de despacho fue completada y firmada por mantenimiento, confirmando todas las inspecciones necesarias antes de la salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 技术放行单由维修部门填写并签字，确认所有必要的检查已完成，飞机可以放行。
usageTranslations.ar: تم إكمال ورقة الإرسال الفنية وتوقيعها من قبل الصيانة، مؤكدة اكتمال جميع الفحوصات المطلوبة قبل الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: A ficha técnica de despacho foi preenchida e assinada pela manutenção, confirmando todas as inspeções antes da liberação da aeronave.
usageTranslations.ru: Технический лист допуска был заполнен и подписан службой технического обслуживания, подтверждая проведение всех необходимых осмотров перед разрешением на вылет.
usageTranslations.ja: テクニカルディスパッチシートは整備により記入・署名され、全点検完了後に機体が出発許可されました。
usageTranslations.it: La scheda tecnica di pronto volo è stata compilata e firmata dalla manutenzione, confermando che tutte le ispezioni richieste sono state completate prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Phiếu kỹ thuật giao nhiệm vụ đã được bảo trì hoàn thành và ký xác nhận, đảm bảo mọi kiểm tra trước khi máy bay được phép khởi hành.
usageTranslations.hi: तकनीकी प्रेषण शीट रखरखाव द्वारा पूरी की गई और हस्ताक्षरित की गई; सभी निरीक्षण पूरे होने के बाद विमान को उड़ान के लिए स्वीकृति दी गई।
usageTranslations.th: แผ่นงานส่งมอบทางเทคนิคถูกกรอกและลงนามโดยฝ่ายซ่อมบำรุง ยืนยันการตรวจสอบที่จำเป็นก่อนอนุญาตให้เครื่องบินออกเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Lembar pengiriman teknis diisi dan ditandatangani oleh perawatan, memastikan semua inspeksi telah dilakukan sebelum pesawat diizinkan berangkat.

terms.definition: Routine coded weather observation for a specific aerodrome at a specific time.
terms.usage: Tower: Delta 123, request current METAR for field conditions before departure.

termTranslations.vi: Báo cáo khí tượng sân bay
termTranslations.th: รายงานสภาพอากาศสนามบิน

usageTranslations.en: Tower: Delta 123, request current METAR for field conditions before departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule: Delta 123, kalkış öncesi saha koşulları için mevcut METAR’ı talep ediyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour : Delta 123, demande le METAR actuel des conditions au sol avant le départ.
usageTranslations.de: Turm: Delta 123, bitte aktuelle METAR für die Platzverhältnisse vor dem Abflug.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: Delta 123, solicite el METAR actual de las condiciones del aeródromo antes de la salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：Delta 123，请求出发前的最新机场METAR。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: دلتا 123، طلب أحدث METAR لظروف الميدان قبل الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: Delta 123, solicite o METAR atual das condições do aeródromo antes da partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Авиадиспетчер: Delta 123, запрашивает текущий METAR о состоянии аэродрома перед вылетом.
usageTranslations.ja: 管制塔: デルタ123、出発前に滑走路状況の最新METARを要求します。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: Delta 123, richiedi il METAR attuale delle condizioni del campo prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: Delta 123, yêu cầu METAR hiện tại cho điều kiện sân bay trước khi cất cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: डेल्टा 123, प्रस्थान से पहले फील्ड कंडीशन हेतु वर्तमान METAR का अनुरोध करता है।
usageTranslations.th: หอควบคุม: Delta 123 ขอ METAR ล่าสุดของสภาพสนามบินก่อนออกเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Menara: Delta 123, mohon METAR terbaru kondisi lapangan sebelum lepas landas.

terms.definition: A concise statement of the expected meteorological conditions at an aerodrome for a specified period.
terms.usage: Pilot: Request TAF for JFK to verify if crosswinds expected during my approach.

termTranslations.ja: ターミナル飛行場気象予報
termTranslations.vi: Dự báo sân bay đầu cuối
termTranslations.th: พยากรณ์อากาศสนามบินปลายทาง

usageTranslations.en: Pilot: Request TAF for JFK to verify if crosswinds expected during my approach.
usageTranslations.tr: Pilot: Yaklaşmam sırasında yan rüzgar beklenip beklenmediğini kontrol etmek için JFK için TAF istiyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Pilote : Demandez le TAF pour JFK afin de vérifier la présence de vents transversaux lors de mon approche.
usageTranslations.de: Pilot : Bitte TAF für JFK anfordern, um zu prüfen, ob bei meinem Anflug Seitenwinde erwartet werden.
usageTranslations.es: Piloto: Solicite el TAF para JFK para verificar si se esperan vientos cruzados durante mi aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员：请求JFK的TAF，以确认进场时是否预计有横风。
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار: أطلب TAF لـ JFK للتحقق مما إذا كانت هناك رياح عكسية متوقعة أثناء اقترابي.
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto: Solicite o TAF para JFK para verificar se ventos cruzados são esperados durante minha aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот: Запрашиваю TAF для JFK, чтобы проверить, ожидаются ли боковые ветры при заходе.
usageTranslations.ja: パイロット: 接近中に横風が予想されるか確認するため、JFKのTAFを要求します。
usageTranslations.it: Pilota: Richiedo il TAF per JFK per verificare se sono previsti venti trasversali durante la mia avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công: Yêu cầu TAF cho JFK để xác minh có gió ngang dự kiến trong lúc tiếp cận hay không.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट: मेरे एप्रोच के दौरान क्रॉसविंड की संभावना की पुष्टि हेतु JFK के लिए TAF का अनुरोध करता हूँ।
usageTranslations.th: นักบิน: ขอ TAF สำหรับ JFK เพื่อตรวจสอบว่ามีลมขวางคาดว่าในระหว่างการเข้าเขตหรือไม่
usageTranslations.id: Pilot: Minta TAF untuk JFK guna memastikan apakah ada angin silang yang diharapkan selama pendekatan saya.

terms.definition: An unscheduled aerodrome weather report issued when significant meteorological changes occur between routine METARs.
terms.usage: Tower: SPECI issued for increasing wind gusts and sudden visibility drop on runway 27.

termTranslations.vi: Báo cáo đặc biệt sân bay
termTranslations.th: รายงานสนามบินพิเศษ

usageTranslations.en: Tower: SPECI issued for increasing wind gusts and sudden visibility drop on runway 27.
usageTranslations.tr: Kule: 27 numaralı pistte artan rüzgar patlamaları ve ani görüş düşüşü nedeniyle SPECI yayımlandı.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour : SPECI émis pour rafales de vent croissantes et chute soudaine de visibilité sur la piste 27.
usageTranslations.de: Turm: SPECI herausgegeben wegen zunehmender Windböen und plötzlichem Sichtabfall auf Bahn 27.
usageTranslations.es: Torre: SPECI emitido por ráfagas de viento crecientes y caída repentina de visibilidad en la pista 27.
usageTranslations.zh: 塔台：因27跑道风阵增强和能见度突然下降，发布SPECI。
usageTranslations.ar: البرج: تم إصدار SPECI بسبب زيادة هبات الرياح وانخفاض الرؤية المفاجئ على المدرج 27.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre: SPECI emitido por rajadas de vento crescentes e queda repentina de visibilidade na pista 27.
usageTranslations.ru: Диспетчер: SPECI выпущен из‑за усиливающихся порывов ветра и резкого падения видимости на ВПП 27.
usageTranslations.ja: 塔台: 27滑走路で風の突風増加と視程急低下のためSPECIを発行しました。
usageTranslations.it: Torre: emesso SPECI per raffiche di vento in aumento e improvviso calo di visibilità sulla pista 27.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp: SPECI phát hành do gió giật tăng và tầm nhìn giảm đột ngột trên đường băng 27.
usageTranslations.hi: टॉवर: रनवे 27 पर बढ़ती हवा की झटके और अचानक दृश्यता गिरावट के लिए SPECI जारी。
usageTranslations.th: หอ: ออก SPECI เนื่องจากลมกระโชกแรงขึ้นและทัศนวิสัยลดลงอย่างฉับพลันบนรันเวย์ 27
usageTranslations.id: Menara: SPECI diterbitkan karena hembusan angin meningkat dan penurunan jarak pandang tiba-tiba di landasan 27.

terms.definition: A weather advisory issued by a Meteorological Watch Office concerning significant en‑route weather hazards affecting flight safety.
terms.usage: ATC: SIGMET 12 issued for severe turbulence between FL200 and FL360 in sector NORDIC‑ACC.

termTranslations.vi: Thông tin thời tiết quan trọng
termTranslations.th: ข้อมูลอากาศสำคัญ

usageTranslations.en: ATC: SIGMET 12 issued for severe turbulence between FL200 and FL360 in sector NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC: Sektör NORDIC‑ACC'de FL200–FL360 arasında şiddetli türbülans için SIGMET 12 yayınlandı.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : SIGMET 12 émis pour turbulence sévère entre FL200 et FL360 dans le secteur NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: SIGMET 12 herausgegeben für schwere Turbulenz zwischen FL200 und FL360 im Sektor NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: SIGMET 12 emitido por turbulencia severa entre FL200 y FL360 en el sector NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.zh: 空中交通管制：发布SIGMET 12，NORDIC-ACC扇区FL200至FL360之间有剧烈颠簸。
usageTranslations.ar: رقابة المرور الجوي: تم إصدار SIGMET 12 لاضطراب جوي شديد بين FL200 وFL360 في قطاع NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: SIGMET 12 emitido por turbulência severa entre FL200 e FL360 no setor NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.ru: УВД: выпущен SIGMET 12 для сильной турбулентности между FL200 и FL360 в секторе NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.ja: ATC：NORDIC‑ACCセクターのFL200〜FL360に激しい乱気流のためSIGMET 12を発行。
usageTranslations.it: ATC: SIGMET 12 emesso per turbolenza severa tra FL200 e FL360 nel settore NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.vi: ATC: SIGMET 12 phát hành do nhiễu động nghiêm trọng giữa FL200 và FL360 trong khu vực NORDIC‑ACC.
usageTranslations.hi: ATC: सेक्टर NORDIC‑ACC में FL200 से FL360 के बीच गंभीर उथल‑पुथल के लिए SIGMET 12 जारी किया गया।
usageTranslations.th: ATC: ออก SIGMET 12 สำหรับกระแสลมปั่นป่วนรุนแรงระหว่าง FL200 ถึง FL360 ในบริเวณ NORDIC‑ACC
usageTranslations.id: ATC: SIGMET 12 dikeluarkan untuk turbulensi parah antara FL200 dan FL360 di sektor NORDIC‑ACC.

terms.definition: A SIGMET concerning volcanic ash clouds that may affect en‑route flight safety.
terms.usage: ATC: Volcanic Ash SIGMET 12 issued for ash cloud observed at FL200 over sector NORTH FIR.

termTranslations.ar: معلومات جوية مهمة عن رماد بركاني
termTranslations.vi: Thông tin khí tượng quan trọng tro núi lửa
termTranslations.th: ข้อมูลอากาศสำคัญขี้เถ้าภูเขาไฟ

usageTranslations.en: ATC: Volcanic Ash SIGMET 12 issued for ash cloud observed at FL200 over sector NORTH FIR.
usageTranslations.tr: ATC: FL200 üzerinde NORTH FIR sektöründe gözlemlenen kül bulutu için Volkanik Kül SIGMET 12 yayınlandı.
usageTranslations.fr: ATC : SIGMET cendres volcaniques 12 émis pour nuage de cendres observé à FL200 sur secteur NORTH FIR.
usageTranslations.de: ATC: Vulkanasche SIGMET 12 herausgegeben für Aschewolke auf FL200 über Sektor NORTH FIR.
usageTranslations.es: ATC: SIGMET cenizas volcánicas 12 emitido por nube de ceniza observada en FL200 sobre sector NORTH FIR.
usageTranslations.zh: 空中交通管制：发布火山灰SIGMET12，因在NORTH FIR区域FL200观察到灰云。
usageTranslations.ar: مراقبة الحركة الجوية: SIGMET رماد بركاني 12 صادر لسحابة رماد عند FL200 فوق قطاع NORTH FIR.
usageTranslations.pt: ATC: SIGMET cinzas vulcânicas 12 emitido para nuvem de cinzas observada no FL200 sobre setor NORTH FIR.
usageTranslations.ru: УВД: SIGMET вулканический пепел 12 выпущен для облака пепла на FL200 над сектором NORTH FIR.

termTranslations.ar: ضبط الارتفاع الجوي على ارتفاع المطار
termTranslations.pt: Configuração do altímetro para elevação do aeródromo
termTranslations.ja: 高度計の飛行場標高設定
termTranslations.vi: Cài đặt cao kế theo độ cao sân bay
termTranslations.hi: हवाई अड्डे की ऊँचाई के लिए आल्टीमीटर सेटिंग
termTranslations.th: การตั้งค่ามาตรวัดความสูงที่ระดับความสูงของสนามบิน

usageTranslations.en: Set QFE for the altimeter so it reads zero while parked on the runway.
usageTranslations.tr: Altimetreyi QFE'ye ayarlayın ki pistte sıfır göstersin.
usageTranslations.fr: Réglez le QFE pour que l'altimètre indique zéro au sol.
usageTranslations.de: Stellen Sie QFE ein, damit der Höhenmesser am Boden null anzeigt.
usageTranslations.es: Ajuste el QFE para que el altímetro marque cero en la pista.
usageTranslations.zh: 将高程表设置为QFE，使其在跑道上显示为零。
usageTranslations.ar: اضبط QFE حتى يظهر الارتفاع صفرًا على المدرج.
usageTranslations.pt: Ajuste o QFE para que o altímetro indique zero na pista.
usageTranslations.ru: Установите QFE, чтобы высотомер показывал ноль на ВПП.
usageTranslations.ja: 滑走路上でゼロを示すようにQFEを設定してください。
usageTranslations.it: Imposta il QFE affinché l'altimetro legga zero in pista.
usageTranslations.vi: Cài đặt QFE để cao kế hiển thị số 0 khi đỗ trên đường băng.
usageTranslations.hi: QFE सेट करें ताकि रनवे पर ज़ीरो दिखाए।
usageTranslations.th: ตั้ง QFE เพื่อให้มาตรวัดความสูงแสดงศูนย์บนรันเวย์
usageTranslations.id: Atur QFE agar altimeter menunjukkan nol di landasan pacu.

terms.definition: An altimeter setting based on the standard pressure of 1013.25 hPa or 29.92 inHg, used above the transition altitude. Known as QNE in ICAO terminology.
terms.usage: Climb to flight level two eight zero, set standard pressure on the altimeter.

termTranslations.fr: Réglage altimétrique utilisant la pression standard
termTranslations.es: Ajuste del altímetro usando presión estándar
termTranslations.zh: 高程表使用标准气压设定
termTranslations.ar: ضبط الارتفاع الجوي باستخدام الضغط القياسي
termTranslations.pt: Configuração do altímetro usando pressão padrão
termTranslations.ja: 高度計の標準気圧設定
termTranslations.vi: Cài đặt cao kế theo áp suất tiêu chuẩn
termTranslations.hi: मानक दबाव के अनुसार आल्टीमीटर सेटिंग
termTranslations.th: การตั้งค่ามาตรวัดความสูงโดยใช้ความดันมาตรฐาน

usageTranslations.en: Climb to flight level two eight zero, set standard pressure on the altimeter.
usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi iki sekiz sıfıra tırmanın, altimetreye standart basınç ayarlayın.
usageTranslations.fr: Montez au niveau de vol deux huit zéro, réglez la pression standard sur l'altimètre.
usageTranslations.de: Steigen Sie auf Flugfläche zwei acht null, stellen Sie Standarddruck am Höhenmesser ein.
usageTranslations.es: Ascienda al nivel de vuelo dos ocho cero, ajuste presión estándar en el altímetro.
usageTranslations.zh: 爬升到飞行高度280，将高度计设为标准气压。
usageTranslations.ar: اصعد إلى مستوى الطيران 280، واضبط الضغط القياسي على مقياس الارتفاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Suba para o nível de voo dois oito zero, defina a pressão padrão no altímetro.
usageTranslations.ru: Наберите эшелон два восемь ноль, установите стандартное давление на высотомере.
usageTranslations.ja: フライトレベル280まで上昇し、高度計を標準気圧に設定してください。
usageTranslations.it: Salite al livello di volo due otto zero, impostate la pressione standard sull'altimetro.
usageTranslations.vi: Tăng lên mực bay 280, đặt áp suất tiêu chuẩn trên cao kế.
usageTranslations.hi: फ्लाइट लेवल 280 तक चढ़ें, और आल्टीमीटर पर मानक दबाव सेट करें।
usageTranslations.th: ไต่ระดับไปที่ FL280 ตั้งค่าความดันมาตรฐานบนมาตรวัดความสูง
usageTranslations.id: Naik ke ketinggian penerbangan dua delapan nol, atur tekanan standar pada altimeter.

terms.definition: The altitude indicated by a barometric altimeter set to the standard pressure setting of 1013.25 hPa or 29.92 inHg. Used as a reference for aircraft performance calculations.
terms.usage: For performance calculation, refer to pressure altitude and temperature.

termTranslations.th: ความสูงจากความดัน

usageTranslations.en: For performance calculation, refer to pressure altitude and temperature.
usageTranslations.tr: Performans hesaplaması için basınç irtifası ve sıcaklığa bakın.
usageTranslations.fr: Pour le calcul de performance, référez-vous à l'altitude de pression et à la température.
usageTranslations.de: Für die Leistungsberechnung beziehen Sie sich auf Druckhöhe und Temperatur.
usageTranslations.es: Para el cálculo de rendimiento, consulte la altitud de presión y la temperatura.
usageTranslations.zh: 进行性能计算时，请参考气压高度和温度。
usageTranslations.ar: لحساب الأداء، راجع ارتفاع الضغط ودرجة الحرارة.
usageTranslations.pt: Para cálculo de desempenho, consulte a altitude de pressão e a temperatura.
usageTranslations.ru: Для расчета производительности используйте давление высоты и температуру.
usageTranslations.ja: 性能計算には、気圧高度と気温を参照してください。
usageTranslations.it: Per il calcolo delle prestazioni, fare riferimento all'altitudine di pressione e alla temperatura.
usageTranslations.vi: Để tính hiệu suất, hãy tham khảo độ cao áp suất và nhiệt độ.
usageTranslations.hi: प्रदर्शन गणना के लिए दबाव ऊँचाई और तापमान देखें।
usageTranslations.th: สำหรับการคำนวณประสิทธิภาพ ให้ดูที่ความสูงจากความดันและอุณหภูมิ
usageTranslations.id: Untuk perhitungan kinerja, lihat ketinggian tekanan dan suhu.

terms.definition: A model of the atmosphere based on standard average conditions at sea level, used for calibrating instruments and performance calculations. Defined by ICAO: 15°C, 1013.25 hPa, and lapse rate of 2°C per 1000 ft.
terms.usage: Performance charts are based on International Standard Atmosphere conditions unless otherwise noted.

termTranslations.vi: Khí quyển tiêu chuẩn quốc tế
termTranslations.th: บรรยากาศมาตรฐานสากล

usageTranslations.en: Performance charts are based on International Standard Atmosphere conditions unless otherwise noted.
usageTranslations.tr: Performans tabloları, aksi belirtilmedikçe Uluslararası Standart Atmosfer koşullarına dayanır.
usageTranslations.fr: Les tableaux de performance sont basés sur l'atmosphère standard internationale sauf indication contraire.
usageTranslations.de: Leistungstabellen basieren auf der internationalen Standardatmosphäre, sofern nicht anders angegeben.
usageTranslations.es: Las tablas de rendimiento se basan en condiciones de atmósfera estándar internacional, salvo indicación contraria.
usageTranslations.zh: 性能图表以国际标准大气条件为基础，除非另有说明。
usageTranslations.ar: يتم إعداد جداول الأداء بناءً على الغلاف الجوي القياسي الدولي ما لم يُذكر خلاف ذلك.
usageTranslations.pt: Tabelas de desempenho são baseadas na atmosfera padrão internacional, salvo indicação em contrário.
usageTranslations.ru: Таблицы производительности основаны на условиях международной стандартной атмосферы, если не указано иное.
usageTranslations.ja: 性能表は特に指定がない限り、国際標準大気条件に基づいています。
usageTranslations.it: Le tabelle delle prestazioni si basano sull'atmosfera standard internazionale, salvo diversa indicazione.
usageTranslations.vi: Biểu đồ hiệu suất dựa trên điều kiện khí quyển tiêu chuẩn quốc tế trừ khi có ghi chú khác.
usageTranslations.hi: प्रदर्शन चार्ट अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानक वायुमंडल पर आधारित होते हैं जब तक अन्यथा उल्लेख न हो।
usageTranslations.th: ตารางสมรรถนะขึ้นอยู่กับบรรยากาศมาตรฐานสากล เว้นแต่จะระบุไว้เป็นอย่างอื่น
usageTranslations.id: Bagan kinerja didasarkan pada kondisi atmosfer standar internasional kecuali dinyatakan lain.

terms.definition: The difference between the actual atmospheric temperature and the standard temperature defined by the International Standard Atmosphere at a given altitude.
terms.usage: Report ISA deviation in degrees Celsius at flight level three five zero.

termTranslations.es: Desviación de la atmósfera estándar internacional
termTranslations.ar: الانحراف عن الغلاف الجوي القياسي الدولي
termTranslations.ja: 国際標準大気からの逸脱
termTranslations.vi: Sai lệch khí quyển tiêu chuẩn quốc tế
termTranslations.th: ค่าคลาดเคลื่อนจากบรรยากาศมาตรฐานสากล

usageTranslations.en: Report ISA deviation in degrees Celsius at flight level three five zero.
usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi üç beş sıfırda ISA sapmasını santigrat derece olarak bildirin.
usageTranslations.fr: Indiquez l'écart ISA en degrés Celsius au niveau de vol trois cinq zéro.
usageTranslations.de: Melden Sie ISA-Abweichung in Grad Celsius auf Flugfläche drei fünf null.
usageTranslations.es: Informe la desviación ISA en grados Celsius al nivel de vuelo tres cinco cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 报告在飞行高度350的ISA偏差，单位摄氏度。
usageTranslations.ar: أبلغ عن انحراف ISA بدرجات مئوية عند مستوى الطيران ثلاثة خمسة صفر.
usageTranslations.pt: Reporte a diferença ISA em graus Celsius no nível de voo três cinco zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщите отклонение ISA в градусах Цельсия на эшелоне три пять ноль.
usageTranslations.ja: フライトレベル350でのISA偏差を摂氏で報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: Riporta la deviazione ISA in gradi Celsius al livello di volo tre cinque zero.
usageTranslations.vi: Báo cáo sai lệch ISA theo độ C tại mức bay ba năm không.
usageTranslations.hi: फ्लाइट लेवल तीन पांच शून्य पर ISA विचलन सेल्सियस में रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: รายงานค่าคลาดเคลื่อน ISA เป็นองศาเซลเซียสที่ระดับการบินสามห้าศูนย์
usageTranslations.id: Laporkan penyimpangan ISA dalam derajat Celsius pada flight level tiga lima nol.

terms.definition: A meteorological condition where temperature increases with altitude instead of decreasing, which can trap pollutants and affect aircraft climb performance.
terms.usage: Climb performance may be reduced due to a temperature inversion above two thousand feet.

termTranslations.th: การผกผันของอุณหภูมิ

usageTranslations.en: Climb performance may be reduced due to a temperature inversion above two thousand feet.
usageTranslations.tr: İki bin feet üzerindeki sıcaklık terselmesi nedeniyle tırmanma performansı azalabilir.
usageTranslations.fr: Les performances de montée peuvent être réduites en raison d'une inversion de température au-dessus de deux mille pieds.
usageTranslations.de: Die Steigleistung kann aufgrund einer Temperaturinversion über zweitausend Fuß reduziert sein.
usageTranslations.es: El rendimiento de ascenso puede verse reducido debido a una inversión térmica por encima de dos mil pies.
usageTranslations.zh: 由于两千英尺以上出现逆温，爬升性能可能下降。
usageTranslations.ar: قد تنخفض كفاءة التسلق بسبب انعكاس حراري فوق ألفي قدم.
usageTranslations.pt: O desempenho de subida pode ser reduzido devido a uma inversão térmica acima de dois mil pés.
usageTranslations.ru: Характеристики набора высоты могут снизиться из-за температурной инверсии выше двух тысяч футов.
usageTranslations.ja: 2000フィート以上での気温逆転により上昇性能が低下する可能性があります。
usageTranslations.it: Le prestazioni di salita possono essere ridotte a causa di un'inversione termica sopra i duemila piedi.
usageTranslations.vi: Hiệu suất leo có thể bị giảm do nghịch đảo nhiệt độ trên hai nghìn feet.
usageTranslations.hi: दो हजार फीट से ऊपर तापमान प्रतिलोमन के कारण चढ़ाई प्रदर्शन कम हो सकता है।
usageTranslations.th: สมรรถนะการไต่ระดับอาจลดลงเนื่องจากการผกผันของอุณหภูมิที่ระดับสูงกว่าสองพันฟุต
usageTranslations.id: Performa pendakian dapat menurun karena inversi suhu di atas dua ribu kaki.

terms.definition: The lowest altitude in the atmosphere at which the air temperature drops to 0°C (32°F), marking the boundary where liquid water can freeze.
terms.usage: Freezing level reported at seven thousand feet, caution for icing.

termTranslations.th: ระดับที่น้ำกลายเป็นน้ำแข็ง

usageTranslations.en: Freezing level reported at seven thousand feet, caution for icing.
usageTranslations.tr: Donma seviyesi yedi bin feette raporlandı, buzlanmaya dikkat.
usageTranslations.fr: Niveau de congélation signalé à sept mille pieds, attention au givrage.
usageTranslations.de: Gefriergrenze bei siebentausend Fuß gemeldet, Vorsicht vor Vereisung.
usageTranslations.es: Nivel de congelación reportado a siete mil pies, precaución por engelamiento.
usageTranslations.zh: 结冰高度报告为七千英尺，请注意结冰。
usageTranslations.ar: تم الإبلاغ عن مستوى التجمد على ارتفاع سبعة آلاف قدم، الحذر من تكون الجليد.
usageTranslations.pt: Nível de congelamento relatado a sete mil pés, cuidado com formação de gelo.
usageTranslations.ru: Уровень замерзания на семи тысячах футов, осторожно — возможна обледенение.
usageTranslations.ja: 氷結高度は7,000フィート、着氷に注意してください。
usageTranslations.it: Livello di congelamento segnalato a settemila piedi, attenzione alla formazione di ghiaccio.
usageTranslations.vi: Mức đóng băng được báo cáo ở bảy nghìn feet, chú ý băng giá.
usageTranslations.hi: जमाव स्तर सात हजार फीट पर रिपोर्ट किया गया, बर्फ जमने की चेतावनी।
usageTranslations.th: รายงานระดับที่น้ำกลายเป็นน้ำแข็งที่เจ็ดพันฟุต ระวังน้ำแข็งเกาะ
usageTranslations.id: Tingkat pembekuan dilaporkan pada tujuh ribu kaki, hati-hati terhadap pembentukan es.

terms.definition: The accumulation of ice on aircraft surfaces due to supercooled water droplets, which can affect aerodynamics and instrument performance.
terms.usage: Severe icing reported at flight level one eight zero by previous aircraft.

termTranslations.th: การก่อตัวของน้ำแข็ง

usageTranslations.en: Severe icing reported at flight level one eight zero by previous aircraft.
usageTranslations.tr: Önceki uçak tarafından FL180 seviyesinde şiddetli buzlanma rapor edildi.
usageTranslations.fr: Un givrage sévère a été signalé au niveau de vol 180 par l'avion précédent.
usageTranslations.de: Starke Vereisung wurde von dem vorherigen Flugzeug auf Flugfläche 180 gemeldet.
usageTranslations.es: Se reportó engelamiento severo en el nivel de vuelo 180 por la aeronave anterior.
usageTranslations.zh: 上一架飞机在180飞行高度报告严重结冰。
usageTranslations.ar: تم الإبلاغ عن تكون جليد شديد على ارتفاع الطيران 180 من قبل الطائرة السابقة.
usageTranslations.pt: Formação severa de gelo reportada no nível de voo 180 pela aeronave anterior.
usageTranslations.ru: Сильное обледенение на эшелоне 180 было отмечено предыдущим самолётом.
usageTranslations.ja: 前の航空機がフライトレベル180で著しい着氷を報告しました。
usageTranslations.it: Ghiacciamento severo segnalato al livello di volo 180 dall'aeromobile precedente.
usageTranslations.vi: Máy bay trước đó báo cáo băng giá nghiêm trọng ở mực bay 180.
usageTranslations.hi: पिछले विमान द्वारा फ़्लाइट लेवल 180 पर गंभीर बर्फ जमने की सूचना दी गई।
usageTranslations.th: เครื่องบินลำก่อนหน้ารายงานการเกิดน้ำแข็งอย่างรุนแรงที่ระดับความสูง 180
usageTranslations.id: Pesawat sebelumnya melaporkan pembentukan es parah di ketinggian penerbangan 180.

terms.definition: The formation of rough, milky, opaque ice due to rapid freezing of supercooled water droplets on aircraft surfaces.
terms.usage: Pilot reports moderate rime icing at flight level one-eight-zero.

termTranslations.th: น้ำแข็งเกล็ด

usageTranslations.en: Pilot reports moderate rime icing at flight level one-eight-zero.
usageTranslations.tr: Pilot, uçuş seviyesi bir-sekiz-sıfırda orta derecede kırağı tipi buzlanma bildiriyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Le pilote signale un givrage blanc modéré au niveau de vol cent quatre-vingts.
usageTranslations.de: Pilot meldet mäßige Raueisbildung auf Flugfläche eins-acht-null.
usageTranslations.es: El piloto informa de formación moderada de hielo blanco en el nivel de vuelo uno-ocho-cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员报告在飞行高度一八零有中度霜冰。
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار يبلغ عن تجمد خشن معتدل على مستوى الطيران 180.
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto relata formação moderada de gelo granulado no nível de voo um-oito-zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот сообщает о умеренном обледенении инеем на эшелоне полета 180.
usageTranslations.ja: パイロットはフライトレベル180で中程度のライムアイシングを報告しています。
usageTranslations.it: Il pilota riporta ghiaccio brinoso moderato al livello di volo uno-otto-zero.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công báo cáo có băng giá trắng vừa phải ở mực bay một-tám-không.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट उड़ान स्तर 180 पर मध्यम किरायुक्त बर्फ़ की सूचना देता है।
usageTranslations.th: นักบินรายงานน้ำแข็งเกล็ดในระดับการบินหนึ่งแปดศูนย์
usageTranslations.id: Pilot melaporkan pembentukan es kristal sedang di ketinggian penerbangan satu-delapan-nol.

terms.definition: The formation of smooth, transparent ice on aircraft surfaces, resulting from slow freezing of large supercooled water droplets.
terms.usage: Pilot reports moderate clear icing at flight level one-eight-zero.

termTranslations.th: น้ำแข็งใส

usageTranslations.en: Pilot reports moderate clear icing at flight level one-eight-zero.
usageTranslations.tr: Pilot, uçuş seviyesi bir-sekiz-sıfırda orta derecede berrak tip tipi buzlanma bildiriyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Le pilote signale un givrage transparent modéré au niveau de vol cent quatre-vingts.
usageTranslations.de: Pilot meldet mäßige Klareisbildung auf Flugfläche eins-acht-null.
usageTranslations.es: El piloto informa de formación moderada de hielo transparento en el nivel de vuelo uno-ocho-cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员报告在飞行高度一八零有中度清冰。
usageTranslations.ar: الطيار يبلغ عن تجمد خشن معتدل على مستوى الطيران 180.
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto relata formação moderada de gelo transparente no nível de voo um-oito-zero.
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот сообщает о умеренном обледенении инеем на эшелоне полета 180.
usageTranslations.ja: パイロットはフライトレベル180で中程度のクリアアイシングを報告しています。
usageTranslations.it: Il pilota riporta ghiaccio trasparente moderato al livello di volo uno-otto-zero.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công báo cáo có băng giá trong suốt vừa phải ở mực bay một-tám-không.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट उड़ान स्तर 180 पर मध्यम साफ़ बर्फ़ की सूचना देता है।
usageTranslations.th: นักบินรายงานน้ำแข็งใสในระดับการบินหนึ่งแปดศูนย์
usageTranslations.id: Pilot melaporkan pembentukan es jernih sedang di ketinggian penerbangan satu-delapan-nol.

terms.definition: Presence of both rime and clear ice types on aircraft surfaces.
terms.usage: Tower: Be advised, runway may have mixed icing on surface, expect longer landing roll.

termTranslations.th: น้ำแข็งผสม

usageTranslations.en: Be advised, runway may have mixed icing on surface, expect longer landing roll.
usageTranslations.tr: Bilginize, pist yüzeyinde karışık buzlanma olabilir, iniş pistinde daha uzun kayma bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: À noter, piste peut présenter givrage mixte, prévoyez une roulage plus longue.
usageTranslations.de: Hinweis: Piste kann gemischte Vereisung haben, rechnen Sie mit längerer Landestrecke.
usageTranslations.es: Tenga en cuenta, pista puede tener hielo mixto, espere rodaje más largo.
usageTranslations.zh: 请注意，跑道可能存在混合结冰，预计着陆滑行距离较长。
usageTranslations.ar: يرجى العلم، قد يكون هناك تجلد مختلط على المدرج، توقع مسافة هبوط أطول.
usageTranslations.pt: Informe-se, pista pode ter geada mista, espere rolamento mais longo.
usageTranslations.ru: Обратите внимание, на полосе может быть смешанное обледенение, ожидайте удлинённого пробега.
usageTranslations.ja: ご注意ください、滑走路上に混合氷結がある可能性があります、ランディングロールが長くなる見込みです。
usageTranslations.it: Avviso: pista potrebbe avere ghiaccio misto, prevedere rullaggio più lungo.
usageTranslations.vi: Lưu ý, đường băng có thể có băng hỗn hợp, dự kiến đường lăn lâu hơn.
usageTranslations.hi: जानकारी हेतु, रनवे पर मिश्र बर्फ जाम हो सकता है, लंबा लैंडिंग रोल अपेक्षित है।
usageTranslations.th: โปรดทราบ รันเวย์อาจมีน้ำแข็งผสม คาดการณ์ระยะลงจอดนานขึ้น
usageTranslations.id: Harap diketahui, landasan bisa memiliki pembekuan campuran, harap siap jarak landing lebih panjang.

terms.definition: Liquid droplets below freezing point that can remain liquid until striking an object.
terms.usage: Pilot: We are in supercooled large droplet conditions, requesting climb to avoid ice accumulation.

termTranslations.th: หยดใหญ่เยือกแข็ง

usageTranslations.en: We are in supercooled large droplet conditions, requesting climb to avoid ice accumulation.
usageTranslations.tr: Büyük süper soğutulmuş damlacık koşullarındayız, buz birikimini önlemek için tırmanmak istiyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous sommes en conditions de grosse goutte surfondue, demande de montée pour éviter accumulation de givre.
usageTranslations.de: Wir befinden uns in überkühlten großen Tröpfchenbedingungen, erbitten Steig flug zur Vermeidung von Vereisung.
usageTranslations.es: Estamos en condiciones de gota grande superenfriada, solicito ascenso para evitar acumulación de hielo.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们处于过冷大液滴条件，请求爬升以避免结冰。
usageTranslations.ar: نحن في ظروف قطيرة كبيرة فوق برمجة، نطلب تسلّق لتجنب تراكم الجليد.
usageTranslations.pt: Estamos em condições de gota grande superresfriada, solicitamos subida para evitar acumulação de gelo.
usageTranslations.ru: Мы в условиях сверхохлаждённых крупных капель, запрашиваем набор для избежания обледенения.
usageTranslations.ja: 過冷却大型液滴条件です。氷結防止のため上昇を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Siamo in condizioni di goccia grande soproraffreddata, richiediamo salita per evitare accumulo di ghiaccio.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi đang trong điều kiện giọt lớn siêu lạnh, yêu cầu leo cao để tránh đóng băng.
usageTranslations.hi: हम सुपरकूल्ड बड़ी बूंद स्थितियों में हैं, बर्फ जमने से बचने लिए चढ़ाई की अनुरोध कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เรากำลังอยู่ในสภาวะหยดใหญ่เยือกแข็ง ขอไต่ระดับเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยงน้ำแข็งจับตัว
usageTranslations.id: Kami berada dalam kondisi tetesan besar superdidinginkan, minta naik untuk menghindari es.

terms.definition: Removal of existing frost, ice or snow from aircraft surfaces before flight.
terms.usage: Ground: De‑icing in progress on aircraft stand two, expect five minutes to complete.

termTranslations.th: การกำจัดน้ำแข็ง

usageTranslations.en: De‑icing in progress on aircraft stand two, expect five minutes to complete.
usageTranslations.tr: Uygulama noktası iki numarada buz temizleme devam ediyor, tamamlanması yaklaşık beş dakika sürecek.
usageTranslations.fr: Décapage du givre en cours au poste deux, prévoyez cinq minutes pour terminer.
usageTranslations.de: Enteisung auf Parkplatz zwei läuft, Dauer etwa fünf Minuten.
usageTranslations.es: Deshielo en progreso en posición dos, espere cinco minutos para completar.
usageTranslations.zh: 二号停机位正在进行除冰，预计五分钟完成。
usageTranslations.ar: الاستعداد رقم اثنين جاري إزالة الجليد، متوقع خمس دقائق للإنهاء.
usageTranslations.pt: Descongelamento em andamento no finger dois, estimado cinco minutos para concluir.
usageTranslations.ru: Обезледенивание на стоянке два, ожидается пять минут.
usageTranslations.ja: スタンド2で除氷中、完了まで約5分を予定。
usageTranslations.it: Disgelo in corso al posto due, previsto cinque minuti per terminare.
usageTranslations.vi: Đang tẩy băng tại bãi đỗ hai, dự kiến năm phút hoàn tất.
usageTranslations.hi: स्टैंड दो पर डिआइसिंग जारी है, पूरा होने में लगभग पांच मिनट लगेंगे।
usageTranslations.th: กำลังทำการกำจัดน้ำแข็ง ณ จุดจอดเครื่องที่สอง คาดว่าจะเสร็จภายในห้านาที
usageTranslations.id: Penghilangan es sedang berlangsung di stand dua, diperkirakan selesai dalam lima menit.

terms.definition: Application of fluid to prevent ice formation during ground operations or flight.
terms.usage: Ground: Anti‑icing fluid applied, hold five minutes for absorption before taxi.

termTranslations.th: ป้องกันน้ำแข็ง

usageTranslations.en: Anti‑icing fluid applied, hold five minutes for absorption before taxi.
usageTranslations.tr: Buz önleme sıvısı uygulandı, emilmesi için beş dakika bekleyin sonra taksi yapın.
usageTranslations.fr: Fluide anti‑givrage appliqué, attendez cinq minutes avant roulage.
usageTranslations.de: Anti‑Vereisungsfluid aufgetragen, warten Sie fünf Minuten vor dem Rollen.
usageTranslations.es: Fluido antihielo aplicado, manténgase cinco minutos para absorción antes de rodar.
usageTranslations.zh: 防冰液已喷涂，请等待五分钟吸收后滑行。
usageTranslations.ar: تم تطبيق سائل مكافحة الجليد، انتظر خمس دقائق للامتصاص قبل السير.
usageTranslations.pt: Fluido antigeada aplicado, aguarde cinco minutos antes do taxiamento.
usageTranslations.ru: Нанесен противообледенительный состав, ожидать пять минут перед рулением.
usageTranslations.ja: 防氷液が塗布されました、吸収のため5分保持後にタクシー願います。
usageTranslations.it: Liquido antighiaccio applicato, attendete cinque minuti prima del rullaggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Chất chống băng đã được phun, giữ 5 phút trước khi lăn bánh.
usageTranslations.hi: एंटी‑आइसिंग तरल लगाया गया है, टैक्सी से पहले पांच मिनट रुकें।
usageTranslations.th: พ่นของเหลวป้องกันน้ำแข็ง รอห้านาทีก่อนเลื่อนล้อ
usageTranslations.id: Cairan anti es telah diaplikasikan, tunggu lima menit sebelum taxi.

terms.definition: Estimated time fluid will prevent ice before need for re‑application.
terms.usage: Pilot: We have exceeded hold‑over time on anti‑icing, request further treatment before departure.

termTranslations.ja: ホールドオーバー時間
termTranslations.th: เวลาคงสภาพ

usageTranslations.en: We have exceeded hold‑over time on anti‑icing, request further treatment before departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Buz önleme bekleme süresini aştık, kalkış öncesi ek uygulama talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous avons dépassé la durée d’action du liquide anti‑givrage, demandons traitement supplémentaire avant départ.
usageTranslations.de: Wir haben die Wirkungszeit des Anti‑Vereisungsfluid überschritten, bitten um Nachbehandlung vor Abflug.
usageTranslations.es: Hemos superado el tiempo de retención del anti‑hielo, solicitamos tratamiento adicional antes del despegue.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们已超出防冰保护时间，请求于起飞前进一步处理。
usageTranslations.ar: لقد تجاوزنا مدة الحماية، نطلب معاملة إضافية قبل الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Excedemos o tempo de ação do antigeada, solicito tratamento adicional antes da partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Мы превысили время защиты, просим повторное нанесение перед вылетом.
usageTranslations.ja: ホールドオーバー時間を超えました。離陸前に再処理を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Abbiamo superato il tempo di efficacia dell’antighiaccio, richiediamo trattamento aggiuntivo prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi đã vượt quá thời gian duy trì, yêu cầu phun lại trước khi cất cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: हम होल्ड‑ओवर समय से अधिक हो गए हैं, प्रस्थान से पहले अतिरिक्त उपचार का अनुरोध करते हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เราเลยเวลาคงสภาพแล้ว ขอฉีดใหม่ก่อนบิน
usageTranslations.id: Kami telah melebihi waktu tahan, mohon perlakuan ulang sebelum keberangkatan.

terms.definition: Runway with >25% surface covered by standing water ≥3 mm, slush, snow, ice.
terms.usage: Tower: Be aware runway is contaminated with standing water over one quarter length, use caution.

termTranslations.th: รันเวย์ปนเปื้อน

usageTranslations.en: Be aware runway is contaminated with standing water over one quarter length, use caution.
usageTranslations.tr: Bilginize pistin dörtte biri boyunca durgun suyla kontamine olduğunu, dikkatli olun.
usageTranslations.fr: À noter piste contaminée par eau stagnante sur plus d’un quart de sa longueur, prudence.
usageTranslations.de: Achtung, Landebahn an über einem Viertel der Länge verschmutzt durch stehendes Wasser, Vorsicht.
usageTranslations.es: Atención: pista contaminada con agua estancada en más de un cuarto de su longitud, precaución.
usageTranslations.zh: 注意：跑道四分之一以上存在积水污染，谨慎使用。
usageTranslations.ar: تنبيه: المدرج ملوث بمياه راكدة على أكثر من ربع طوله، تحلّ بحذر.
usageTranslations.pt: Aviso: pista contaminada com água parada em mais de um quarto do comprimento, cautela.
usageTranslations.ru: Внимание: ВПП загрязнена стоячей водой более чем на четверть длины, осторожно.
