usageTranslations.ja: 注意：滑走路の４分の一以上に停滞水による汚染あり、注意して使用。
usageTranslations.it: Attenzione: pista contaminata da acqua stagnante su oltre un quarto della lunghezza, cautela.
usageTranslations.vi: Lưu ý: đường băng bị ô nhiễm bởi nước đọng dài hơn một phần tư, thận trọng.
usageTranslations.hi: सूचना: रनवे की एक चौथाई से अधिक लंबाई स्थिर पानी से संक्रमित है, सावधान रहें।
usageTranslations.th: โปรดระวัง รันเวย์มีน้ำขังครอบคลุมมากกว่าหนึ่งในสี่ ใช้ความระมัดระวัง
usageTranslations.id: Harap diperhatikan landasan tercemar oleh air tergenang lebih dari seperempat panjang, berhati-hati.

terms.definition: Aerodrome-issued report of runway surface condition using RCAM and RWYCC.
terms.usage: Pilot: Request latest runway condition report including third‑section RWYCC before approach.

termTranslations.vi: báo cáo điều kiện đường băng
termTranslations.th: รายงานสภาพรันเวย์

usageTranslations.en: Request latest runway condition report including third‑section RWYCC before approach.
usageTranslations.tr: İniş öncesi üçüncü bölüm RWYCC içeren en güncel pist durumu raporunu talep ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Je demande le dernier rapport de conditions de piste incluant RWYCC par tiers avant l’approche.
usageTranslations.de: Bitte um neuesten Landebahnzustandsbericht einschließlich Drittabschnitts-RWYCC vor dem Anflug.
usageTranslations.es: Solicito el último informe de condiciones de pista incluyendo RWYCC por tercios antes del aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 进近前请求包括第三段RWYCC的最新跑道状况报告。
usageTranslations.ar: أطلب أحدث تقرير حالة المدرج بما في ذلك RWYCC للقسم الثالث قبل الهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Solicito o relatório mais recente de condições da pista, incluindo RWYCC por terço antes da aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Запрашиваю последний отчет о состоянии ВПП с RWYCC по третьям перед заходом.
usageTranslations.ja: 進入前に第三セクションのRWYCCを含む最新の滑走路状態報告を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Richiedo ultimo rapporto condizioni pista con RWYCC per terzo prima dell’avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Yêu cầu báo cáo điều kiện đường băng mới nhất bao gồm RWYCC cho mỗi phần trước khi tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: अप्रोच से पहले तृतीय अनुभाग RWYCC सहित नवीनतम रनवे स्थिति रिपोर्ट की अनुरोध।
usageTranslations.th: ขอรายงานสภาพรันเวย์ล่าสุดรวม RWYCC แบ่งสามส่วนก่อนการเข้า
usageTranslations.id: Mohon laporan kondisi landasan terbaru termasuk RWYCC tiap sepertiga sebelum pendekatan.

terms.definition: Pilot- or airport-reported assessment of runway surface stopping quality: good/medium/poor/nil.
terms.usage: Pilot: Braking action on landing reported as poor, runway slippery and deceleration limited.

termTranslations.th: ประสิทธิภาพเบรก

usageTranslations.en: Braking action on landing reported as poor, runway slippery and deceleration limited.
usageTranslations.tr: İnişte frenleme durumu zayıf bildirildi, pist kaygan ve yavaşlama sınırlı.
usageTranslations.fr: Action de freinage à l’atterrissage signalée comme faible, piste glissante et décélération limitée.
usageTranslations.de: Bremswirkung bei Landung als schlecht gemeldet, Landebahn rutschig und Verzögerung begrenzt.
usageTranslations.es: Acción de frenado en aterrizaje reportada como pobre, pista resbaladiza y desaceleración limitada.
usageTranslations.zh: 着陆制动效果报告为差，跑道滑且减速受限。
usageTranslations.ar: أبلغ عن فعالية كبح ضعيفة عند الهبوط، المدرج زلق وتباطؤ محدود.
usageTranslations.pt: Ação de frenagem no pouso relatada como pobre, pista escorregadia e desaceleração limitada.
usageTranslations.ru: Тормозное действие при посадке оценено как плохое, ВПП скользкая, торможение ограничено.
usageTranslations.ja: 着陸時の制動性能がPoorと報告されました、滑走路滑りやすく減速が制限されています。
usageTranslations.it: Azione frenante al touchdown segnalata scarsa, pista scivolosa e decelerazione limitata.
usageTranslations.vi: Hiệu quả phanh khi hạ cánh báo là kém, đường băng trơn và giảm tốc hạn chế.
usageTranslations.hi: लैंडिंग पर ब्रेक कार्रवाई कमजोर बताई गई, रनवे फिसलन और धीमा करना सीमित है।
usageTranslations.th: รายงานผลเบรกขณะลงจอดว่าแย่ รันเวย์ลื่นและการชะลอตัวจำกัด
usageTranslations.id: Aksi pengereman saat mendarat dilaporkan buruk, landasan licin dan deselerasi terbatas.

terms.definition: Special NOTAM issued when snow, ice or slush significantly affects aerodrome movement areas.
terms.usage: Pilot: Confirm receipt of Snow Notice to Airmen indicating compacted snow and braking action medium to poor.

termTranslations.th: SNOWTAM

usageTranslations.en: Confirm receipt of Snow Notice to Airmen indicating compacted snow and braking action medium to poor.
usageTranslations.tr: Kompakt kar ve frenleme durumu orta‑kötü olduğunu belirten Kar NOTAM’ını aldığımı teyit ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Confirme réception du Snow NOTAM indiquant neige compactée et freinage moyen à faible.
usageTranslations.de: Bestätige Empfang des Schnee‑NOTAMs mit kompakter Schneedecke und Bremswirkung mittel bis schlecht.
usageTranslations.es: Confirmo recepción del NOTAM de nieve indicando nieve compacta y acción de frenado de medio a pobre.
usageTranslations.zh: 确认收到积雪通告，指出路面有压实雪且制动效果中到差。
usageTranslations.ar: أؤكد استلام NOTAM الثلوج التي تشير إلى ثلج مضغوط وأداء كبح متوسط إلى ضعيف.
usageTranslations.pt: Confirmo recepção do SNOWTAM indicando neve compactada e ação de frenagem de média a pobre.
usageTranslations.ru: Подтверждаю получение SNOWTAM, указывающего на плотный снег и торможение средне‑плохое.
usageTranslations.ja: 圧雪と制動性能中～Poor を示すスノータムを受領したことを確認します。
usageTranslations.it: Confermo ricezione NOTAM neve con neve compattata e azione frenante da media a scarsa.
usageTranslations.vi: Xác nhận nhận SNOWTAM chỉ định tuyết nén và hiệu quả phanh trung bình đến kém.
usageTranslations.hi: कॉम्पैक्ट बर्फ और मध्यम से खराब ब्रेक कार्रवाई वाले स्नो टाम की प्राप्ति की पुष्टि करता हूँ।
usageTranslations.th: ยืนยันได้รับ SNOWTAM ระบุหิมะอัดและประสิทธิภาพเบรกระดับกลางถึงแย่
usageTranslations.id: Konfirmasi penerimaan SNOWTAM menunjukkan salju padat dan aksi pengereman sedang ke buruk.

terms.definition: Measurement of friction coefficient between tires and runway; indicates braking performance.
terms.usage: Pilot: Runway friction measured at 0.30 mid‑field, request confirmation this supports landing calculation.

termTranslations.th: แรงเสียดทานรันเวย์

usageTranslations.en: Runway friction measured at 0.30 mid‑field, request confirmation this supports landing calculation.
usageTranslations.tr: Orta pistte pist sürtünmesi 0.30 ölçüldü, iniş hesabını desteklediğini teyit edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Friction piste mesurée à 0,30 au milieu, demande confirmation que cela supporte le calcul d’atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Landebahnreibung mittig mit 0,30 gemessen, bitte bestätigen, dass dies Landerechnung unterstützt.
usageTranslations.es: Fricción de pista medida en 0,30 en el medio, solicito confirmación que apoya el cálculo de aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 中段跑道摩擦系数测得为0.30，请确认支持着陆计算。
usageTranslations.ar: تم قياس احتكاك المدرج في المنتصف عند 0.30، أطلب تأكيد أنه يدعم حساب الهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Fricção pista medida em 0,30 no meio, solicito confirmação se suporta cálculo de pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Трение ВПП измерено 0,30 по середине, прошу подтвердить, что это подходит для расчета посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: 滑走路摩擦係数中央部で0.30計測、着陸計算に適合するか確認願います。
usageTranslations.it: Attrito pista misurato 0,30 a metà campo, richiedo conferma supporto calcolo atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Ma sát đường băng đo giữa trường 0.30, yêu cầu xác nhận hỗ trợ tính toán hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: मध्य‑फ़ील्ड पर रनवे घर्षण 0.30 मापा गया, कृपया पुष्टि करें कि यह लैंडिंग गणना का समर्थन करता है।
usageTranslations.th: วัดแรงเสียดทานรันเวย์กลางสนามที่ 0.30 ขอคำยืนยันว่านี้รองรับการคำนวณลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: Gesekan landasan diukur 0.30 di tengah landasan, minta konfirmasi mendukung perhitungan pendaratan.

terms.definition: Distance over which runway markings or lights are visible from centreline on approach.
terms.usage: Pilot: What is current runway visual range touchdown, midfield and rollout values, please?

termTranslations.th: ระยะทัศนวิสัยรันเวย์

usageTranslations.en: What is current runway visual range touchdown, midfield and rollout values, please?
usageTranslations.tr: Mevcut iniş, orta ve çıkış RVR değerleri nelerdir, lütfen?
usageTranslations.fr: Quelles sont les valeurs actuelles de visibilité de piste au toucher, milieu et sortie, s’il vous plaît?
usageTranslations.de: Wie lauten derzeitigen RVR‑Werte für Touchdown, Mitte und Rollout bitte?
usageTranslations.es: ¿Cuáles son los valores actuales de alcance visual en pista en touchdown, medio y rollout?
usageTranslations.zh: 请告知当前跑道接地点、中段及滑出段的能见度值。
usageTranslations.ar: ما هي قيم مدى الرؤية على المدرج عند اللمس والوسط والخروج؟
usageTranslations.pt: Quais os valores atuais de RVR no touchdown, meio e rollout, por favor?
usageTranslations.ru: Каковы текущие значения RVR на касании, середине и пробеге?
usageTranslations.ja: ランウェイの着陸、中央、ロールアウト視程は現在どれくらいですか？
usageTranslations.it: Quali sono i valori RVR correnti per touchdown, metà e rollout?
usageTranslations.vi: Giá trị tầm nhìn RVR hiện tại tại điểm chạm, giữa và cuối đường là bao nhiêu?
usageTranslations.hi: कृपया वर्तमान रनवे दृश्य सीमा (RVR) टचडाउन, मध्य और रोलआउट मान क्या हैं?
usageTranslations.th: ขอทราบค่า RVR รันเวย์ขณะทัชดาวน์ กลาง และโรลเอาท์?
usageTranslations.id: Berapa nilai RVR landasan saat touchdown, tengah, dan rollout saat ini?

terms.definition: Greatest distance at which prominent objects are visible and identifiable by day.
terms.usage: Tower: Visibility is down to one point two miles, confirm if you have the runway environment in sight.

termTranslations.th: ทัศนวิสัย

usageTranslations.en: Visibility is down to one point two miles, confirm if you have the runway environment in sight.
usageTranslations.tr: Görüş mesafesi 1,2 mil olarak azaldı, pist çevresini net görüp görmediğinizi onaylayın.
usageTranslations.fr: La visibilité est réduite à 1,2 miles, confirmez si vous avez l’environnement de piste en vue.
usageTranslations.de: Die Sichtweite ist auf 1,2 Meilen gesunken, bestätigen Sie, ob Sie das Pistenumfeld sehen.
usageTranslations.es: La visibilidad ha bajado a 1,2 millas, confirme si ve el entorno de la pista.
usageTranslations.zh: 能见度降至1.2英里，请确认您是否看到跑道环境。
usageTranslations.ar: الرؤية انخفضت إلى 1.2 ميل، أكد إذا كنت ترى بيئة المدرج.
usageTranslations.pt: A visibilidade caiu para 1,2 milhas, confirme se você avista o entorno da pista.
usageTranslations.ru: Видимость упала до 1,2 мили, подтвердите, видите ли вы окружение ВПП.
usageTranslations.ja: 視程が1.2マイルに低下しています。滑走路周辺を視認しているか確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: La visibilità è scesa a 1,2 miglia, confermi se vede l’ambiente pista.
usageTranslations.vi: Tầm nhìn giảm xuống 1,2 hải lý, xác nhận bạn có thấy vùng quanh đường băng không.
usageTranslations.hi: दृश्यता 1.2 मील तक घट गई है, पुष्टि करें कि क्या आप रनवे का परिवेश देख पा रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ทัศนวิสัยลดลงเหลือ 1.2 ไมล์ ยืนยันว่าสังเกตเห็นสภาพแวดล้อมรันเวย์หรือไม่
usageTranslations.id: Jarak pandang turun menjadi 1,2 mil, konfirmasi apakah Anda melihat lingkungan landasan.

terms.definition: Greatest visibility value equaled or exceeded for at least half the horizon.
terms.usage: Pilot: What is the prevailing visibility reported at the field for our approach?

termTranslations.th: ทัศนวิสัยหลัก

usageTranslations.en: What is the prevailing visibility reported at the field for our approach?
usageTranslations.tr: Yaklaşmamız için sahadaki geçerli görüş mesafesi nedir?
usageTranslations.fr: Quelle est la visibilité dominante signalée sur le terrain pour notre approche ?
usageTranslations.de: Wie hoch ist die vorherrschende Sichtweite auf dem Flugfeld für unseren Anflug?
usageTranslations.es: ¿Cuál es la visibilidad predominante reportada en el aeropuerto para nuestra aproximación?
usageTranslations.zh: 为我们的进近报告的主要能见度是多少？
usageTranslations.ar: ما هي الرؤية السائدة المبلغ عنها في المطار لاقترابنا؟
usageTranslations.pt: Qual é a visibilidade predominante reportada no aeródromo para nossa aproximação?
usageTranslations.ru: Какая преобладающая видимость на площадке для нашего захода?
usageTranslations.ja: 進入のための空港で報告されている優勢視程はどれですか？
usageTranslations.it: Qual è la visibilità prevalente segnalata sul campo per il nostro avvicinamento?
usageTranslations.vi: Tầm nhìn chiếm ưu thế được báo cáo tại sân bay cho tiếp cận của chúng tôi là bao nhiêu?
usageTranslations.hi: हमारे अप्रोच के लिए फील्ड पर रिपोर्ट की गई प्रचलित दृश्यता कितनी है?
usageTranslations.th: ทัศนวิสัยหลักที่รายงานที่สนามสำหรับการเข้าใช้มีเท่าใด?
usageTranslations.id: Berapa jarak pandang dominan yang dilaporkan di lapangan untuk pendekatan kami?

terms.definition: Height above ground at which an unbroken or overcast cloud layer exists.
terms.usage: Tower: Ceiling is reported at eight hundred feet broken, confirm if you need visual approach.

termTranslations.th: ระดับต่ำสุดยอดเมฆ

usageTranslations.en: Ceiling is reported at eight hundred feet broken, confirm if you need visual approach.
usageTranslations.tr: Tabaka taban yüksekliği sekiz yüz feet kırık olarak bildirildi, görsel yaklaşmaya ihtiyacınız olup olmadığını onaylayın.
usageTranslations.fr: Plafond estimé à huit cents pieds par couches discontinues, confirmez si vous avez besoin d’approche visuelle.
usageTranslations.de: Untergrenze für Wolken bei 800 Fuß broken, bestätigen Sie, ob Sie visuellen Anflug benötigen.
usageTranslations.es: El techo reportado es de 800 pies con nubes broken, confirme si necesita aproximación visual.
usageTranslations.zh: 云底高度报告为800英尺broken，确认是否需要目视进近。
usageTranslations.ar: السماء الملبدة تبلغ ثمانية مئة قدم broken، أكد إذا كنتم بحاجة إلى اقتراب بصري.
usageTranslations.pt: Teto reportado a oitocentos pés broken, confirme se precisa de aproximação visual.
usageTranslations.ru: Низкая облачность примерно 800 футов broken, подтвердите, нужен ли вам визуальный заход.
usageTranslations.ja: 雲底が800フィートbrokenと報告されています。視覚進入が必要か確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Soffitto stimato a ottocento piedi broken, confermi se necessita di avvicinamento visivo.
usageTranslations.vi: Mức mây báo ở tám trăm feet broken, xác nhận nếu bạn cần tiếp cận bằng thị giác.
usageTranslations.hi: छत आठ सौ फीट broken बताया गया है, पुष्टि करें कि क्या आप दृश्य दृष्टिकोण चाहिए।
usageTranslations.th: ระดับเมฆถูกรายงานที่แปดร้อยฟุต broken โปรดยืนยันหากต้องการเข้าใช้แบบมองเห็น
usageTranslations.id: Langit rendah dilaporkan delapan ratus kaki broken, konfirmasi jika Anda membutuhkan pendekatan visual.

terms.definition: Lowest altitude of the visible cloud layer, reported as base of scattered, broken, overcast.
terms.usage: Pilot: We observe cloud base at approximately fifteen hundred feet and request descent clearance.

termTranslations.th: ฐานเมฆ

usageTranslations.en: We observe cloud base at approximately fifteen hundred feet and request descent clearance.
usageTranslations.tr: Kabaca bin beş yüz feet bulut tabanı görüyoruz ve alçalma izni talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous relevons une base des nuages à environ mille cinq cents pieds et demandons autorisation de descente.
usageTranslations.de: Wir beobachten die Wolkenuntergrenze bei etwa 1500 Fuß und beantragen Sinkflugfreigabe.
usageTranslations.es: Observamos base de nubes aproximadamente a mil quinientos pies y solicitamos autorización de descenso.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们观测到云底约1500英尺，请求下降许可。
usageTranslations.ar: نلاحظ أن قاعدة السحب عند حوالي 1500 قدم ونطلب إذن النزول.
usageTranslations.pt: Observamos base das nuvens a aproximadamente quinze centenas de pés e solicitamos autorização para descida.
usageTranslations.ru: Наблюдаем низ облаков приблизительно на 1500 футах, запрашиваем разрешение на снижение.
usageTranslations.ja: 約1500フィートの雲底を確認、降下クリアランスを要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Osserviamo base delle nubi a circa millecinquecento piedi e chiediamo autorizzazione a scendere.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi quan sát đáy mây ở khoảng một nghìn năm trăm feet và xin phép hạ xuống.
usageTranslations.hi: हम 1500 फीट के लगभग बादल आधार देख रहे हैं और अवतरण अनुमति का अनुरोध कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เราสังเกตฐานเมฆที่ประมาณหนึ่งพันห้าร้อยฟุตและขออนุญาตลดระดับ
usageTranslations.id: Kami mengamati dasar awan sekitar seribu lima ratus kaki dan meminta izin turun.

terms.definition: Towering vertical cloud with significant turbulence, precipitation, and lightning potential.
terms.usage: Pilot: We have cumulonimbus cloud ahead with severe turbulence, request deviation to avoid.

termTranslations.th: เมฆคิวมูโลนิมบัส

usageTranslations.en: We have cumulonimbus cloud ahead with severe turbulence, request deviation to avoid.
usageTranslations.tr: Önde şiddetli türbulans içeren bir gökgürültülü kümülonimbus bulut var, kaçınmak için sapma talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous avons un cumulonimbus devant avec turbulence sévère, demandons déviation pour éviter.
usageTranslations.de: Wir haben eine Gewitterwolke voraus mit starker Turbulenz, beantragen Ausweichung zum Vermeiden.
usageTranslations.es: Tenemos nube cumulonimbo adelante con turbulencia severa, solicitamos desviación para evitarla.
usageTranslations.zh: 前方有积雨云伴随强烈颠簸，请求偏航回避。
usageTranslations.ar: أمامنا سحاب رعدي مع اضطراب شديد، نطلب انحراف لتجنبه.
usageTranslations.pt: Temos nuvem cumulonimbus à frente com turbulência severa, solicitamos desvio para evitar.
usageTranslations.ru: Перед нами кумулонимбус с сильной турбулентностью, просим отклонение для обхода.
usageTranslations.ja: 前方に積乱雲があり激しい乱気流です。回避のため逸脱を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Abbiamo cumulonembo davanti con turbolenza severa, richiediamo deviazione per evitarlo.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi có mây cumulonimbus phía trước với nhiễu động nghiêm trọng, xin chuyển hướng để tránh.
usageTranslations.hi: हमारे आगे गंभीर उथल‑पुथल वाले क्यूमुुलोनिम्बस बादल हैं, बचाव हेतु विचलन का अनुरोध करते हैं।
usageTranslations.th: มีเมฆคิวมูโลนิมบัสด้านหน้าและความวุ่นวายรุนแรง ขออนุญาตเบี่ยงเบนเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยง
usageTranslations.id: Kami ada awan cumulonimbus di depan dengan turbulensi hebat, mohon belok untuk menghindarinya.

terms.definition: Large cumulus cloud with strong vertical development, indicating convective activity, but not yet cumulonimbus.
terms.usage: Pilot: I see towering cumulus cloud developing at ten o’clock, slight deviation requested to avoid updrafts.

termTranslations.th: เมฆคิวมูลัสสูง

usageTranslations.en: I see towering cumulus cloud developing at ten o’clock, slight deviation requested to avoid updrafts.
usageTranslations.tr: On birde yükselen kümülüs bulut gelişiyor, termiklerden kaçınmak için hafif sapma talep ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Je vois un cumulus bourgeonnant à dix heures, demande légère déviation pour éviter montées d’air.
usageTranslations.de: Ich sehe einen turmartigen Kumulus bei zehn Uhr, bitte leichte Ausweichung um Aufwinde zu vermeiden.
usageTranslations.es: Veo cúmulo enriquecido a las diez, solicito ligera desviación para evitar corrientes ascendentes.
usageTranslations.zh: 我在十点方向看到高积云形成，请求轻微偏航以避开上升气流。
usageTranslations.ar: أرى سحاب ركامي مرتفع عند الساعة العاشرة، أرجو انحراف طفيف لتجنب التيارات الصاعدة.
usageTranslations.pt: Vejo nuvem cúmulo torreante a dez horas, solicito ligeira desvio para evitar correntes ascendentes.
usageTranslations.ru: Вижу вышинающий cumulus в положении десять часов, прошу небольшое отклонение чтобы избежать подъемов.
usageTranslations.ja: 十時方向に積雲（高）が発達しているのが見えます。上昇気流回避のため軽微な逸脱を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Vedo cumulus imponente a dieci in punto, richiedo lieve deviazione per evitare correnti ascendenti.
usageTranslations.vi: Tôi thấy mây tích vĩ cao phát triển ở vị trí mười giờ, xin chuyển hướng nhẹ để tránh luồng nâng lên.
usageTranslations.hi: मैं दस बजे की दिशा में उभरते टावरिंग क्यूमुुलस बादल देख रहा हूँ, अपवर्तकों से बचने हेतु हल्के विचलन का अनुरोध करता हूँ।
usageTranslations.th: ฉันเห็นเมฆคิวมูลัสสูงกำลังก่อตัวที่ตำแหน่งสิบโมง ขอเบี่ยงเล็กน้อยเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยงกระแสบวก
usageTranslations.id: Saya melihat awan cumulus menjulang berkembang pada pukul sepuluh, minta sedikit aviasi untuk menghindari aliran naik.

terms.definition: Medium-level turreted cloud with rising towers indicating mid‑level instability, possible precursor to thunderstorms.
terms.usage: Pilot: We observe altocumulus castellanus cloud at 12 o’clock six miles, requesting heading change to avoid build‑up.

termTranslations.th: เมฆแอลโตคิวมูลัสคาสเทลลานัส

usageTranslations.en: We observe altocumulus castellanus cloud at 12 o’clock six miles, requesting heading change to avoid build‑up.
usageTranslations.tr: 12’de altocumulus castellanus bulutu altı mil ötede gözlemliyoruz, büyümeyi önlemek için rota değişikliği talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous observons un altocumulus castellanus à midi six miles, demandons un changement de cap pour éviter le développement.
usageTranslations.de: Wir beobachten Altocumulus Castellanus um zwölf Uhr in sechs Meilen, bitten Kursänderung zur Vermeidung von Aufbau.
usageTranslations.es: Observamos altocumulus castellanus a las doce, a seis millas, solicitamos cambio de rumbo para evitar desarrollo.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们在十二点六海里处观测到岗状高积云，请求转向以避其发展。
usageTranslations.ar: نلاحظ سحابة altocumulus castellanus عند الساعة 12 على بعد ستة أميال، نطلب تغيير مسار لتجنب النمو.
usageTranslations.pt: Observamos nuvem altocumulus castellanus às 12 horas a seis milhas, solicitamos mudança de rumo para evitar formação.
usageTranslations.ru: Наблюдаем altocumulus castellanus в положении 12 часов, шесть миль, запрашиваем изменение курса для избегания развития.
usageTranslations.ja: 12時位置6マイルに高積雲カステラヌスを確認、発達回避のため進路変更を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Osserviamo altocumulus castellanus alle dodici a sei miglia, chiediamo cambio rotta per evitare sviluppo.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi quan sát mây altocumulus castellanus ở 12 giờ cách sáu dặm, yêu cầu đổi hướng để tránh phát triển.
usageTranslations.hi: हम 12 बजे छह मील दूर alto‑cumulus castellatus बादल देख रहे हैं, विकास से बचने हेतु दिशा परिवर्तन अनुरोध करते हैं।
usageTranslations.th: เราสังเกตเห็นเมฆ altocumulus castellanus ที่ตำแหน่งสิบสองโมงหกไมล์ ขอเปลี่ยนทิศทางเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยงการก่อตัว
usageTranslations.id: Kami mengamati awan altocumulus castellanus di jam 12 sejauh enam mil, minta ubah heading untuk menghindari berkembang.

terms.definition: Convective weather event with thunder, lightning, precipitation and possible severe turbulence.
terms.usage: Tower: Avoid thunderstorm at two o’clock five miles west; heavy precipitation and lightning present.

termTranslations.th: พายุฝนฟ้าคะนอง

usageTranslations.en: Avoid thunderstorm at two o’clock five miles west; heavy precipitation and lightning present.
usageTranslations.tr: Batı yönünde iki saat beş milde bulunan gök gürültülü fırtınadan kaçının; yoğun yağış ve yıldırım var.
usageTranslations.fr: Évitez l’orage à deux heures, cinq milles à l’ouest ; fortes précipitations et éclairs présents.
usageTranslations.de: Vermeiden Sie Gewitter um zwei Uhr, fünf Meilen westlich; starker Niederschlag und Blitzaktivität.
usageTranslations.es: Evite tormenta eléctrica a las dos y cinco millas al oeste; precipitación intensa y relámpagos presentes.
usageTranslations.zh: 避开位于西偏北五英里处的雷暴；有强降水和雷电。
usageTranslations.ar: تجنب العاصفة الرعدية عند الساعة الثانية غرباً بخمس أميال؛ هطول كثيف وبرق present.
usageTranslations.pt: Evite trovoada às duas horas cinco milhas a oeste; precipitação intensa e relâmpagos presentes.
usageTranslations.ru: Обходите грозу в положении два часа, пять миль к западу; сильные осадки и молнии.
usageTranslations.ja: 西に5マイル2時位置の雷雨を避けてください。激しい降水と雷あり。
usageTranslations.it: Eviti temporale alle due in posizione ovest a cinque miglia; forte precipitazione e fulmini presenti.
usageTranslations.vi: Tránh giông bão vị trí hai giờ năm dặm về phía tây; mưa lớn và sét hiện diện.
usageTranslations.hi: पश्चिम में दो बजे पांच मील पर स्थित बिजली की तूफ़ान से बचें; भारी वर्षा और बिजली मौजूद है।
usageTranslations.th: หลีกเลี่ยงพายุฝนฟ้าคะนองที่สองนาฬิกา ห่างไปห้าไมล์ทางตะวันตก มีฝนหนักและฟ้าผ่า
usageTranslations.id: Hindari badai petir pada jam dua lima mil barat; presipitasi lebat dan petir hadir.

terms.definition: Cumulonimbus cloud obscured within other cloud layers, not visually identifiable, but with severe turbulence and precipitation.
terms.usage: Pilot: We are requesting climb due to embedded cumulonimbus cloud overcast, encountered severe turbulence during approach.

termTranslations.th: เมฆคิวมูโลนิมบัสฝังตัว

usageTranslations.en: We are requesting climb due to embedded cumulonimbus cloud overcast, encountered severe turbulence during approach.
usageTranslations.tr: Gömülü cumulonimbus bulut örtüsü nedeniyle tırmanış talep ediyoruz, iniş sırasında şiddetli türbulans yaşadık.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous demandons une montée en raison d’un cumulonimbus encastré dans la couche nuageuse, turbulence sévère rencontrée en approche.
usageTranslations.de: Wir bitten um Steigflug aufgrund eingebetteter Cumulonimbuswolke in der Überdeckung, haben beim Anflug starke Turbulenz erfahren.
usageTranslations.es: Solicitamos ascenso debido a cumulonimbo empotrado en la capa nubosa, encontramos turbulencia severa durante la aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们请求爬升，因嵌入式积雨云遮蔽，在进近过程中遭遇强烈颠簸。
usageTranslations.ar: نطلب صعودًا بسبب سحابة cumulonimbus مدفونة ضمن السحابة، واجهنا اضطرابًا شديدًا أثناء الاقتراب.
usageTranslations.pt: Solicitamos subida devido à nuvem cumulonimbus embutida na camada de nuvens, encontramos turbulência severa durante a aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Запрашиваем набор из-за встроенного кучево-грозового облака в сплошной облачность, при заходе столкнулись с сильной турбуленцией.
usageTranslations.ja: 埋没積乱雲が雲層に含まれているため、上昇を要請します。アプローチ中に激しい乱気流を経験しました。
usageTranslations.it: Richiediamo salita a causa di cumulonembo incorporato nella copertura nuvolosa, incontrata turbolenza severa in avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi yêu cầu leo lên do mây cumulonimbus nhúng trong lớp mây phủ, gặp nhiễu động nghiêm trọng trong quá trình tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: पूरी बादल परत में एम्बेडेड क्यूमुुलोनिम्बस बादल के कारण चढ़ाई का अनुरोध कर रहे हैं, अप्रोच के दौरान गंभीर उथल‑पुथल का सामना हुआ।
usageTranslations.th: ขอขึ้นบินเนื่องจากเมฆคิวมูโลนิมบัสฝังตัวในชั้นเมฆ พบความปั่นป่วนรุนแรงขณะเข้าใกล้
usageTranslations.id: Kami meminta naik karena awan cumulonimbus tertanam dalam lapisan awan, mengalami turbulensi hebat saat pendekatan.

terms.definition: A small, intense downdraft producing damaging winds near the ground, hazardous to aircraft during takeoff or landing.
terms.usage: Tower: Wind shear alert, microburst reported by preceding aircraft on short final runway 27, use caution.

termTranslations.th: ไมโครเบิร์สต์

usageTranslations.en: Wind shear alert, microburst reported by preceding aircraft on short final runway 27, use caution.
usageTranslations.tr: Rüzgar kesmesi uyarısı, pist 27 kısa finaldeki önceki uçak mikropatlama bildirdi, dikkatli olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Alerte de cisaillement, micro-rafale signalée par l’aéronef précédent en finale courte piste 27, soyez prudents.
usageTranslations.de: Windscherung-Alarm, Mikroburst gemeldet vom vorausgehenden Flugzeug im Short Final RWY 27, Vorsicht.
usageTranslations.es: Alerta de cizalladura, micro ráfaga descendente reportada por la aeronave anterior en final corta pista 27, tenga precaución.
usageTranslations.zh: 风切变警报，前机在27号跑道末段报告微下击暴流，请注意。
usageTranslations.ar: تنبيه قص الرياح، انفجار دقيق أُبلغ عنه من الطائرة السابقة في الاقتراب النهائي للمدرج 27، استخدم الحذر.
usageTranslations.pt: Alerta de tesoura de vento, microexplosão reportada pela aeronave precedente na curta final pista 27, tenha cuidado.
usageTranslations.ru: Предупреждение о сдвиге ветра, микропорыв от предыдущего борта на коротком заходе ВПП 27, соблюдайте осторожность.
usageTranslations.ja: ウィンドシア警報、滑走路27のショートファイナルで先行機がマイクロバーストを報告、注意してください。
usageTranslations.it: Allerta wind shear, microburst segnalato dall’aeromobile precedente su finale corto pista 27, usare cautela.
usageTranslations.vi: Cảnh báo gió đứt, máy bay trước đó báo cáo có gió giật vi mô ở đoạn cuối đường băng 27, thận trọng.
usageTranslations.hi: विंड शियर चेतावनी, रनवे 27 के शॉर्ट फाइनल पर पहले विमान द्वारा माइक्रोबर्स्ट की रिपोर्ट, सावधानी बरतें।
usageTranslations.th: เตือนลมเฉือน รายงานไมโครเบิร์สต์โดยอากาศยานก่อนหน้าที่ปลายทางรันเวย์ 27 โปรดใช้ความระมัดระวัง
usageTranslations.id: Peringatan wind shear, microburst dilaporkan oleh pesawat sebelumnya pada pendekatan akhir runway 27, harap waspada.

terms.definition: A sudden change in wind speed and/or direction over a short distance, hazardous during takeoff and landing.
terms.usage: Tower: Windshear alert in effect on approach runway 34, expect sudden airspeed fluctuations below 800 feet.

termTranslations.th: ลมเฉือน

usageTranslations.en: Windshear alert in effect on approach runway 34, expect sudden airspeed fluctuations below 800 feet.
usageTranslations.tr: Pist 34 yaklaşmasında rüzgar kesmesi uyarısı geçerli, 800 feet altında ani hava hızı değişiklikleri bekleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Alerte cisaillement du vent en approche piste 34, attendez-vous à des variations soudaines de vitesse en dessous de 800 pieds.
usageTranslations.de: Windscherungswarnung im Anflug auf Bahn 34 aktiv, erwarten Sie plötzliche Geschwindigkeitsänderungen unterhalb 800 Fuß.
usageTranslations.es: Alerta de cizalladura en aproximación a pista 34, espere variaciones bruscas de velocidad bajo 800 pies.
usageTranslations.zh: 34号跑道进近有风切变警报，800英尺以下可能出现空速剧变。
usageTranslations.ar: تحذير قص الرياح في الاقتراب إلى المدرج 34، توقع تغيرات مفاجئة في سرعة الطائرة تحت 800 قدم.
usageTranslations.pt: Alerta de tesoura de vento na aproximação da pista 34, espere flutuações súbitas de velocidade abaixo de 800 pés.
usageTranslations.ru: Предупреждение о сдвиге ветра на заходе на ВПП 34, ожидайте резкие изменения скорости ниже 800 футов.
usageTranslations.ja: 滑走路34進入中にウィンドシア警報発令中、800フィート以下で突発的な速度変化の恐れあり。
usageTranslations.it: Allerta wind shear in avvicinamento pista 34, attendersi variazioni improvvise di velocità sotto 800 piedi.
usageTranslations.vi: Cảnh báo gió đứt đang có hiệu lực tại tiếp cận đường băng 34, dự kiến biến động tốc độ dưới 800 feet.
usageTranslations.hi: रनवे 34 के अप्रोच पर विंड शियर चेतावनी लागू है, 800 फीट के नीचे अचानक एयरस्पीड में बदलाव की संभावना।
usageTranslations.th: แจ้งเตือนลมเฉือนขณะเข้าใกล้รันเวย์ 34 คาดว่าความเร็วลมจะเปลี่ยนแปลงฉับพลันต่ำกว่า 800 ฟุต
usageTranslations.id: Peringatan wind shear saat pendekatan ke runway 34, harapkan fluktuasi kecepatan tiba-tiba di bawah 800 kaki.

terms.definition: Wind shear occurring below 2 000 ft AGL, especially hazardous during takeoff and landing phases.
terms.usage: Tower: Low‑level wind shear detected on take‑off runway 09, expect up to 15 knots loss, use caution.

termTranslations.es: cizalladura de viento a nivel bajo
termTranslations.pt: cisalhamento de vento em baixa altitude
termTranslations.vi: gió đứt ở độ cao thấp
termTranslations.th: ลมเฉือนระดับต่ำ

usageTranslations.en: Low‑level wind shear detected on take‑off runway 09, expect up to 15 knots loss, use caution.
usageTranslations.tr: Kalkışta pist 09’da alçak seviyede rüzgar kesmesi tespit edildi, azami 15 knot kayıp bekleyin, dikkatli olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Cisaillement du vent bas niveau détecté au décollage piste 09, perte jusqu’à 15 nœuds attendue, prudence.
usageTranslations.de: Niedrigstufen‑Windscherung beim Start auf Bahn 09 erkannt, bis zu 15 Knoten Verlust erwartet, Vorsicht.
usageTranslations.es: Cizalladura de viento a nivel bajo detectada en despegue pista 09, pérdida hasta 15 nudos, precaución.
usageTranslations.zh: 起飞时09跑道检测到低空风切变，预计空速损失可达15节，请谨慎。
usageTranslations.ar: تم الكشف عن قص رياح على المستوى المنخفض عند الإقلاع من المدرج 09، توقع فقد يصل إلى 15 عقدة، تحلّ بحذر.
usageTranslations.pt: Cisalhamento de vento em baixa altitude detectado na decolagem da pista 09, perda de até 15 nós, tenha cautela.
usageTranslations.ru: Сдвиг ветра на малой высоте обнаружен при взлёте с ВПП 09, ожидается потеря до 15 узлов, осторожно.
usageTranslations.ja: RWY09離陸時に低高度ウィンドシア検出、最大15ノット減速想定、注意してください。
usageTranslations.it: Rilevata wind shear a bassa quota al decollo pista 09, perdita fino a 15 nodi, cautela.
usageTranslations.vi: Phát hiện gió đứt ở độ cao thấp khi cất cánh đường băng 09, mất đến 15 knot, thận trọng.
usageTranslations.hi: टेक‑ऑफ रनवे 09 पर निचले स्तर पर विंड शियर पता चला, 15 नॉट तक की गति हानि की संभावना, सावधान रहें।
usageTranslations.th: ตรวจพบลมเฉือนระดับต่ำขณะขึ้นบินรันเวย์09 คาดอัตราลดเร็วถึง15นอต โปรดระวัง
usageTranslations.id: Low‑level wind shear terdeteksi saat lepas landas runway 09, harapkan kehilangan hingga 15 knot, berhati-hati.

terms.definition: A sudden, brief increase in wind speed, typically varying with rapid fluctuations.
terms.usage: Tower: Wind 270 at 15 knots, gusting 25, runway 27 cleared to land.

termTranslations.th: ลมกระโชก

usageTranslations.en: Wind 270 at 15 knots, gusting 25, runway 27 cleared to land.
usageTranslations.tr: Rüzgar 270, 15 knot, ani 25 knot, pist 27 inişe açık.
usageTranslations.fr: Vent du 270 à 15 nœuds, rafales à 25, piste 27 autorisée à l’atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Wind 270 mit 15 Knoten, Böen bis 25, Bahn 27 zur Landung frei.
usageTranslations.es: Viento 270 a 15 nudos, ráfagas hasta 25, pista 27 autorizada para aterrizar.
usageTranslations.zh: 风向270，风速15节，阵风25节，27号跑道允许着陆。
usageTranslations.ar: الرياح 270 بسرعة 15 عقدة، هبات تصل 25، المدرج 27 مسموح بالهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Vento 270 a 15 nós, rajadas até 25, pista 27 autorizada para pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Ветер 270, 15 узлов, порывы до 25, ВПП 27 разрешена к посадке.
usageTranslations.ja: 風270度15ノット、突風25、滑走路27着陸許可。
usageTranslations.it: Vento 270 a 15 nodi, raffiche a 25, pista 27 autorizzata all'atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Gió 270 ở 15 knot, giật tới 25, đường băng 27 được phép hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: पवन 270, 15 नॉट्स, झोंका 25, रनवे 27 लैंडिंग के लिए स्वीकृत।
usageTranslations.th: ลม 270 ที่ 15 นอต ลมกระโชกถึง 25 รันเวย์ 27 อนุญาตลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: Angin 270 dengan kecepatan 15 knot, hembusan hingga 25, runway 27 diizinkan mendarat.

terms.definition: Sudden increase in wind speed of at least 15 knots, sustained for at least one minute.
terms.usage: Pilot: We encountered a squall on final at runway 18 with wind increase from 10 to 25 knots.

termTranslations.th: ลมกระโชกแรง

usageTranslations.en: We encountered a squall on final at runway 18 with wind increase from 10 to 25 knots.
usageTranslations.tr: Pist 18 kısa finalinde rüzgar 10'dan 25 knote yükseldi, ani fırtına ile karşılaştık.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous avons rencontré une squale en finale piste 18 avec vent passant de 10 à 25 nœuds.
usageTranslations.de: Wir haben im Endanflug auf Bahn 18 eine Böe mit Windzunahme von 10 auf 25 Knoten erlebt.
usageTranslations.es: Encontramos un squall en final pista 18 con viento de 10 a 25 nudos.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们在跑道18短距进近时遇到飑，风速从10到25节。
usageTranslations.ar: واجهنا عاصفة مفاجئة في الاقتراب النهائي من المدرج 18 مع زيادة الرياح من 10 إلى 25 عقدة.
usageTranslations.pt: Encontrámos uma ventania súbita em final pista 18 com vento de 10 para 25 nós.
usageTranslations.ru: Мы встретили шквал на коротком финале ВПП 18: ветер возрос с 10 до 25 узлов.
usageTranslations.ja: 滑走路18の最終進入中に突風が発生し、風速が10から25ノットに増加しました。
usageTranslations.it: Abbiamo incontrato una raffica intensa in finale sulla pista 18 con vento da 10 a 25 nodi.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi gặp gió giật mạnh khi đến gần đường băng 18 với gió tăng từ 10 lên 25 knot.
usageTranslations.hi: हम रनवे 18 के फाइनल पर अचानक तेज़ हवा का सामना कर रहे हैं, हवा 10 से 25 नॉट बढ़ी।
usageTranslations.th: เราเผชิญกับลมกระโชกแรงในช่วงไฟนอลรันเวย์ 18 โดยลมเพิ่มจาก 10 เป็น 25 นอต
usageTranslations.id: Kami menghadapi squall pada final runway 18 dengan angin meningkat dari 10 menjadi 25 knot.

terms.definition: A narrow, fast-flowing air current in the upper atmosphere, typically between 20 000 and 50 000 ft, affecting cruise performance.
terms.usage: Pilot: We request direct track to intercept the jet stream for fuel efficiency and time savings.

termTranslations.th: เจ็ตสตรีม

usageTranslations.en: We request direct track to intercept the jet stream for fuel efficiency and time savings.
usageTranslations.tr: Yakıt verimliliği ve zaman kazancı için jet akımını kestirme güzergahla kesişmek istiyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous demandons un cap direct pour intercepter le courant‑jet, afin d’économiser carburant et temps.
usageTranslations.de: Wir bitten um direkte Route zur Abfangung des Jetstreams für Treibstoffeinsparung und Zeitgewinn.
usageTranslations.es: Solicitamos ruta directa para interceptar la corriente en chorro y ahorrar combustible y tiempo.
usageTranslations.zh: 请求直线航迹拦截急流，以节省燃油和时间。
usageTranslations.ar: نطلب مسارًا مباشرًا لاعتراض التيار النفاث لتوفير الوقود والوقت.
usageTranslations.pt: Solicitamos rota direta para interceptar a corrente de jato para economia de combustível e tempo.
usageTranslations.ru: Просим прямой курс для перехвата струи реактивных для экономии топлива и времени.
usageTranslations.ja: 燃料効率と時間節約のためにジェット気流を直線でキャッチしたいので、ダイレクトトラックを要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Richiediamo rotta diretta per intercettare la corrente a getto per risparmio di carburante e tempo.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi yêu cầu đường bay trực tiếp để chặn dòng khí cao nhằm tiết kiệm nhiên liệu và thời gian.
usageTranslations.hi: ईंधन कुशलता और समय बचाने के लिए हम जेट स्ट्रीम को इंटरसेप्ट करने हेतु डायरेक्ट ट्रैक की अनुरोध करते हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ขอเส้นทางตรงเพื่อตัดผ่านเจ็ตสตรีมเพื่อประหยัดเชื้อเพลิงและเวลา
usageTranslations.id: Kami meminta jalur langsung untuk mencegat arus jet demi efisiensi bahan bakar dan waktu.

terms.definition: The boundary layer between troposphere and stratosphere, marked by a temperature inversion, affecting flight levels and turbulence potential.
terms.usage: Pilot: We are requesting climb through tropopause to FL430 to avoid the turbulence below.

termTranslations.th: ทรอปโพสเฟียร์สูงสุด

usageTranslations.en: We are requesting climb through tropopause to FL430 to avoid the turbulence below.
usageTranslations.tr: Altında türbulansı önlemek için tropopoz seviyesinden FL430’a tırmanış talep ediyoruz.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous demandons une montée à travers la tropopause jusqu’à FL430 pour éviter la turbulence en dessous.
usageTranslations.de: Wir bitten um Steigflug durch die Tropopause auf FL430, um die darunter liegende Turbulenz zu vermeiden.
usageTranslations.es: Solicitamos ascenso a través de la tropopausa hasta FL430 para evitar la turbulencia inferior.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们请求通过对流层顶爬升至FL430以避开下方颠簸。
usageTranslations.ar: نطلب صعودًا عبر التروبوسفير الحد الأعلى إلى FL430 لتجنب الاضطراب أدناه.
usageTranslations.pt: Solicitamos subida através da tropopausa até FL430 para evitar a turbulência abaixo.
usageTranslations.ru: Просим набор через тропопаузу до FL430 для избежания турбулентности ниже.
usageTranslations.ja: 下方の乱気流を避けるため、対流圏界面を越えてFL430まで上昇を要請します。
usageTranslations.it: Richiediamo salita attraverso la tropopausa fino a FL430 per evitare la turbolenza sottostante.
usageTranslations.vi: Chúng tôi yêu cầu leo qua đỉnh đối lưu đến FL430 để tránh nhiễu động bên dưới.
usageTranslations.hi: टर्बुलेंस से बचने के लिए हम ट्रोपोपॉज़ पार कर FL430 तक चढ़ाई का अनुरोध कर रहे हैं।
usageTranslations.th: ขอขึ้นบินผ่านทรอปโพสเฟียร์สู่ FL430 เพื่อหลีกเลี่ยงความปั่นป่วนข้างล่าง
usageTranslations.id: Kami meminta naik melalui tropopause hingga FL430 untuk menghindari turbulensi di bawah.

terms.definition: Irregular atmospheric motion caused by eddies and vertical currents, affecting aircraft stability, comfort, and sometimes control.
terms.usage: Tower: Expect moderate turbulence in the climb between FL100 and FL160 due to wind shear.

termTranslations.th: ความปั่นป่วน

usageTranslations.en: Expect moderate turbulence in the climb between FL100 and FL160 due to wind shear.
usageTranslations.tr: FL100 ile FL160 arasında tırmanışta orta şiddetli türbülans beklenmektedir; rüzgar kesmesi nedeniyle.
usageTranslations.fr: Prévoir une turbulence modérée lors de la montée entre FL100 et FL160 en raison du cisaillement du vent.
usageTranslations.de: Erwarten Sie mäßige Turbulenz beim Steigflug zwischen FL100 und FL160 aufgrund von Windscherung.
usageTranslations.es: Espere turbulencia moderada durante el ascenso entre FL100 y FL160 debido a cizalladura.
usageTranslations.zh: 由于风切变，预计FL100至FL160爬升过程中有中等湍流。
usageTranslations.ar: توقع اضطرابًا متوسطًا في الصعود بين FL100 وFL160 بسبب قص الرياح.
usageTranslations.pt: Espere turbulência moderada na subida entre FL100 e FL160 devido a cisalhamento do vento.
usageTranslations.ru: Ожидается умеренная турбулентность при наборе между FL100 и FL160 из-за сдвига ветра.
usageTranslations.ja: FL100からFL160の上昇中、風のせん断により中程度の乱気流が予想されます。
usageTranslations.it: Prevedere turbolenza moderata nella salita tra FL100 e FL160 a causa del wind shear.
usageTranslations.vi: Dự kiến nhiễu động trung bình khi leo giữa FL100 và FL160 do gió cắt.
usageTranslations.hi: FL100 और FL160 के बीच चढ़ाई के दौरान मध्यम अशांति की अपेक्षा करें, हवा के बदलाव के कारण।
usageTranslations.th: คาดว่ามีความปั่นป่วนปานกลางระหว่างไต่ระดับ FL100 ถึง FL160 เนื่องจากลมเฉือน
usageTranslations.id: Harapkan turbulensi sedang saat mendaki antara FL100 dan FL160 karena shear angin.

terms.definition: Turbulence occurring in clear skies, typically at high altitudes near the jet stream, with no visible weather phenomena.
terms.usage: Center: Report clear-air turbulence if encountered at cruising altitude.

termTranslations.th: ความปั่นป่วนในอากาศใส

usageTranslations.en: Report clear-air turbulence if encountered at cruising altitude.
usageTranslations.tr: Seyir irtifasında açık hava türbülansı yaşanırsa rapor edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Signalez toute turbulence en air clair rencontrée à l'altitude de croisière.
usageTranslations.de: Melden Sie Turbulenz bei klarer Luft in Reiseflughöhe.
usageTranslations.es: Informe de turbulencia en aire claro si se presenta a nivel de crucero.
usageTranslations.zh: 如果在巡航高度遇到晴空颠簸，请报告。
usageTranslations.ar: أبلغ عن اضطراب الهواء الصافي إن حدث على ارتفاع الطيران.
usageTranslations.pt: Informe turbulência em ar claro se ocorrer em altitude de cruzeiro.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщите о турбулентности в чистом воздухе на эшелоне.
usageTranslations.ja: 巡航高度で晴天乱気流に遭遇した場合は報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: Segnalare turbolenza in aria limpida se incontrata a quota di crociera.
usageTranslations.vi: Báo cáo nhiễu động không khí trong nếu gặp ở độ cao hành trình.
usageTranslations.hi: अगर क्रूज़ ऊंचाई पर साफ़ हवा में अशांति हो तो रिपोर्ट करें।
usageTranslations.th: รายงานความปั่นป่วนในอากาศใสหากพบที่ระดับการบิน
usageTranslations.id: Laporkan turbulensi udara jernih jika terjadi pada ketinggian jelajah.

terms.definition: Turbulence that causes changes in altitude and/or attitude but aircraft remains in control; occupants may feel strain against seat belts.
terms.usage: Pilot: Experiencing moderate turbulence at FL350, requesting lower altitude.

termTranslations.th: ความปั่นป่วนระดับปานกลาง

usageTranslations.en: Experiencing moderate turbulence at FL350, requesting lower altitude.
usageTranslations.tr: FL350'de orta şiddetli türbülans yaşıyoruz, daha düşük irtifa talep ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous rencontrons des turbulences modérées au FL350, demandons une altitude inférieure.
usageTranslations.de: Mäßige Turbulenz bei FL350, beantrage niedrigere Höhe.
usageTranslations.es: Experimentando turbulencia moderada en FL350, solicitamos menor altitud.
usageTranslations.zh: 在FL350遇到中度颠簸，请求降低高度。
usageTranslations.ar: نواجه اضطرابًا جويًا متوسطًا على ارتفاع FL350، نطلب انخفاض الارتفاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Experimentando turbulência moderada no FL350, solicitando altitude inferior.
usageTranslations.ru: Испытываем умеренную турбулентность на FL350, запрашиваем снижение.
usageTranslations.ja: FL350で中程度の乱気流に遭遇、低高度を要求します。
usageTranslations.it: Stiamo incontrando turbolenza moderata a FL350, richiediamo altitudine più bassa.
usageTranslations.vi: Gặp nhiễu động vừa phải ở FL350, yêu cầu hạ độ cao.
usageTranslations.hi: FL350 पर मध्यम अशांति अनुभव कर रहे हैं, निचली ऊंचाई की मांग।
usageTranslations.th: พบความปั่นป่วนระดับปานกลางที่ FL350 ขอความสูงต่ำกว่า
usageTranslations.id: Mengalami turbulensi sedang di FL350, meminta ketinggian lebih rendah.

terms.definition: Turbulence that causes large, abrupt changes in altitude and/or attitude. Aircraft may be momentarily out of control. Occupants are forced violently against seat belts.
terms.usage: Pilot: We are experiencing severe turbulence, requesting immediate descent to avoid.

termTranslations.th: ความปั่นป่วนรุนแรง

usageTranslations.en: We are experiencing severe turbulence, requesting immediate descent to avoid.
usageTranslations.tr: Şiddetli türbülans yaşıyoruz, kaçınmak için acil alçalma talep ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Nous subissons une turbulence sévère, demandons une descente immédiate pour l'éviter.
usageTranslations.de: Wir erleben starke Turbulenz, beantragen sofortigen Sinkflug zur Vermeidung.
usageTranslations.es: Experimentamos turbulencia severa, solicitamos descenso inmediato para evitarla.
usageTranslations.zh: 我们正经历严重颠簸，请求立即下降以避开。
usageTranslations.ar: نواجه اضطرابًا جويًا شديدًا، نطلب نزولًا فوريًا لتجنبه.
usageTranslations.pt: Estamos enfrentando turbulência severa, solicitamos descida imediata para evitar.
usageTranslations.ru: Испытываем сильную турбулентность, запрашиваем немедленное снижение для обхода.
usageTranslations.ja: 強い乱気流に遭遇、回避のため即時降下を要求。
usageTranslations.it: Stiamo sperimentando turbolenza severa, chiediamo una discesa immediata per evitarla.
usageTranslations.vi: Gặp nhiễu động nghiêm trọng, yêu cầu hạ độ cao ngay lập tức để tránh.
usageTranslations.hi: हम तीव्र अशांति का सामना कर रहे हैं, बचाव के लिए तत्काल अवरोहण की मांग।
usageTranslations.th: พบความปั่นป่วนรุนแรง ขอทำการลดระดับทันทีเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยง
usageTranslations.id: Mengalami turbulensi parah, meminta penurunan segera untuk menghindari.

terms.definition: A standing atmospheric wave created when stable air flows over a mountain or ridge, often causing turbulence and rotor clouds.
terms.usage: Pilot reports moderate turbulence due to mountain wave activity over the Sierra Nevada ridge.

termTranslations.th: คลื่นภูเขา

usageTranslations.en: Pilot reports moderate turbulence due to mountain wave activity over the Sierra Nevada ridge.
usageTranslations.tr: Pilot, Sierra Nevada sırtı üzerindeki dağ dalgası nedeniyle orta şiddette türbülans bildiriyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Le pilote signale des turbulences modérées dues à une onde orographique sur la crête de la Sierra Nevada.
usageTranslations.de: Pilot meldet mäßige Turbulenzen aufgrund von Föhnwellen über dem Sierra-Nevada-Kamm.
usageTranslations.es: El piloto informa de turbulencias moderadas debido a ondas de montaña sobre la cordillera de Sierra Nevada.
usageTranslations.zh: 飞行员报告，由于穿越内华达山脉的山岳波导致中度颠簸。
usageTranslations.ar: يبلغ الطيار عن اضطرابات معتدلة بسبب نشاط موجة جبلية فوق سلسلة سييرا نيفادا.
usageTranslations.pt: Piloto relata turbulência moderada devido à atividade de onda de montanha sobre a cordilheira da Sierra Nevada.
usageTranslations.ru: Пилот сообщает о умеренной турбулентности из-за горных волн над хребтом Сьерра-Невада.
usageTranslations.ja: パイロットはシエラネバダ山脈上空で山岳波による中程度の乱気流を報告しています。
usageTranslations.it: Il pilota segnala turbolenze moderate dovute a onde orografiche sopra la dorsale della Sierra Nevada.
usageTranslations.vi: Phi công báo cáo nhiễu động mức trung bình do hoạt động sóng núi trên dãy Sierra Nevada.
usageTranslations.hi: पायलट सिएरा नेवाडा पर्वत श्रृंखला पर पहाड़ी तरंग गतिविधि के कारण मध्यम अशांति की सूचना देता है।
usageTranslations.th: นักบินรายงานความปั่นป่วนปานกลางเนื่องจากคลื่นภูเขาเหนือสันเขาเซียร์ร่าเนวาดา
usageTranslations.id: Pilot melaporkan turbulensi sedang akibat gelombang gunung di atas pegunungan Sierra Nevada.

terms.definition: A turbulent, low-level cloud formation found downwind of mountain ranges, forming in the rotor zone beneath and near mountain waves; indicative of severe turbulence and hazardous for aviation.
terms.usage: Report severe turbulence in the vicinity of a rotor cloud west of the airfield, maintain caution on approach.

termTranslations.th: เมฆโรเตอร์

usageTranslations.en: Report severe turbulence in the vicinity of a rotor cloud west of the airfield, maintain caution on approach.
usageTranslations.tr: Pistin batısında rotor bulutu yakınında şiddetli türbülans rapor edin, yaklaşmada dikkatli olun.
usageTranslations.fr: Signalez des fortes turbulences à proximité d’un nuage de rotor à l’ouest de l’aérodrome, soyez prudent en approche.
usageTranslations.de: Melden Sie starke Turbulenzen in der Nähe einer Rotorwolke westlich des Flugplatzes, beim Anflug Vorsicht walten lassen.
usageTranslations.es: Informe de turbulencia severa cerca de una nube de rotor al oeste del aeródromo, tenga precaución en la aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 报告机场西侧涡流云附近有严重颠簸，进近时请保持警惕。
usageTranslations.ar: أبلغ عن اضطرابات شديدة قرب سحابة دوامية غرب المطار، احرص على الحذر أثناء الاقتراب.
usageTranslations.pt: Relate turbulência severa nas proximidades de uma nuvem de rotor a oeste do aeródromo, mantenha cautela na aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Доложите о сильной турбулентности в районе роторного облака к западу от аэродрома, соблюдайте осторожность при заходе.
usageTranslations.ja: 飛行場西側のローター雲付近で激しい乱気流を報告、進入時は注意してください。
usageTranslations.it: Segnalare turbolenza severa in prossimità di una nuvola di rotor a ovest dell’aeroporto, mantenere cautela in avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Báo cáo nhiễu động mạnh gần mây xoáy phía tây sân bay, giữ an toàn khi tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: हवाई क्षेत्र के पश्चिम में रोटर बादल के पास गंभीर अशांति की रिपोर्ट करें, अप्रोच पर सावधानी बरतें।
usageTranslations.th: รายงานความปั่นป่วนรุนแรงใกล้เมฆโรเตอร์ทางตะวันตกของสนามบิน โปรดระวังขณะเข้าทำการบิน
usageTranslations.id: Laporkan turbulensi parah di dekat awan rotor sebelah barat bandara, waspada saat pendekatan.

terms.definition: A smooth, lens-shaped cloud that forms at high altitudes in the crest of mountain waves; often stationary, and indicative of significant atmospheric turbulence downwind of mountain ranges.
terms.usage: Advise all aircraft of a standing lenticular cloud reported at flight level one two zero south of the field; possible turbulence expected.

termTranslations.th: เมฆเลนส์รูปนิ่ง

usageTranslations.en: Advise all aircraft of a standing lenticular cloud reported at flight level one two zero south of the field; possible turbulence expected.
usageTranslations.tr: Tüm uçaklara, meydanın güneyinde uçuş seviyesi bir iki sıfırda durgun merceksi bulut rapor edilmiştir; türbülans olasılığı bekleniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Informer tous les aéronefs d’un nuage lenticulaire stationnaire signalé au niveau de vol cent vingt au sud de l’aérodrome ; turbulence possible attendue.
usageTranslations.de: Alle Luftfahrzeuge über eine stationäre Linsenwolke auf Flugfläche eins-zwei-null südlich des Platzes informieren; mögliche Turbulenz erwartet.
usageTranslations.es: Avise a todas las aeronaves de una nube lenticular estacionaria reportada en nivel de vuelo uno dos cero al sur del campo; se espera posible turbulencia.
usageTranslations.zh: 通知所有飞机在机场南侧一二零飞行高度有定状透镜云报告，预计可能有颠簸。
usageTranslations.ar: إخطار جميع الطائرات عن وجود سحابة عدسية ثابتة على ارتفاع طيران ١٢٠ جنوب المطار؛ من المتوقع حدوث اضطرابات.
usageTranslations.pt: Avisar todas as aeronaves de nuvem lenticular estacionária reportada no nível de voo um dois zero ao sul do aeródromo; possível turbulência esperada.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщите всем воздушным судам о стоячем линзовидном облаке на эшелоне сто двадцать южнее аэродрома; ожидается возможная турбулентность.
usageTranslations.ja: 空港南側の飛行レベル120で定在性レンズ雲が報告されています。乱気流の可能性があります。
usageTranslations.it: Avvisare tutti gli aeromobili di una nuvola lenticolare stazionaria segnalata a livello di volo uno due zero a sud del campo; prevista possibile turbolenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Thông báo cho tất cả máy bay về mây thấu kính đứng yên ở độ cao bay một hai không phía nam sân bay; dự kiến có nhiễu động.
usageTranslations.hi: क्षेत्र के दक्षिण में उड़ान स्तर एक दो शून्य पर स्थिर लेन्टिक्युलर बादल की सूचना सभी विमानों को दें; संभावित अशांति की उम्मीद है।
usageTranslations.th: แจ้งเครื่องบินทุกลำว่าเกิดเมฆเลนส์รูปนิ่งที่ระดับการบินหนึ่งสองศูนย์ทางใต้ของสนาม อาจมีความปั่นป่วน
usageTranslations.id: Beritahukan semua pesawat tentang awan lentikular diam pada flight level satu dua nol di selatan lapangan; kemungkinan turbulensi diharapkan.

terms.definition: The current local atmospheric pressure value set in an aircraft’s altimeter to ensure correct indication of altitude above mean sea level, typically given in hectopascals (hPa) or inches of mercury (inHg).
terms.usage: Copenhagen Tower, request altimeter setting for landing.

termTranslations.th: การตั้งค่ามาตรวัดความสูง

usageTranslations.en: Copenhagen Tower, request altimeter setting for landing.
usageTranslations.tr: Kopenhag Kulesi, iniş için altimetre ayarını talep ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Tour de Copenhague, demande le réglage de l’altimètre pour l’atterrissage.
usageTranslations.de: Kopenhagen Tower, bitte Höheneinstellwert für Landung anfragen.
usageTranslations.es: Torre Copenhague, solicito ajuste del altímetro para aterrizaje.
usageTranslations.zh: 哥本哈根塔台，请求着陆高度表设定值。
usageTranslations.ar: برج كوبنهاغن، أطلب ضبط مقياس الارتفاع للهبوط.
usageTranslations.pt: Torre de Copenhague, solicito configuração do altímetro para pouso.
usageTranslations.ru: Копенгаген Тауэр, запрашиваю установку высотомера для посадки.
usageTranslations.ja: コペンハーゲンタワー、着陸のための高度計設定値をお願いします。
usageTranslations.it: Torre di Copenaghen, richiedo impostazione altimetro per l’atterraggio.
usageTranslations.vi: Tháp Copenhagen, yêu cầu cài đặt cao kế để hạ cánh.
usageTranslations.hi: कोपेनहेगन टॉवर, लैंडिंग के लिए एल्टीमीटर सेटिंग की अनुरोध करता हूँ।
usageTranslations.th: หอบังคับการโคเปนเฮเกน ขอการตั้งค่ามาตรวัดความสูงสำหรับการลงจอด
usageTranslations.id: Menara Kopenhagen, minta pengaturan altimeter untuk pendaratan.

terms.definition: The atmospheric pressure as measured by a barometer, used to determine altimeter settings and to ensure altitude accuracy during flight operations.
terms.usage: Advise current barometric pressure for field elevation to ensure correct altimeter setting.

termTranslations.th: ความกดอากาศ

usageTranslations.en: Advise current barometric pressure for field elevation to ensure correct altimeter setting.
usageTranslations.tr: Doğru altimetre ayarı için pist irtifasına uygun güncel barometrik basıncı bildiriniz.
usageTranslations.fr: Indiquez la pression barométrique actuelle pour l’altitude de l’aérodrome afin d’assurer un réglage correct de l’altimètre.
usageTranslations.de: Bitte aktuellen barometrischen Druck für die Platzhöhe angeben, um eine korrekte Höheneinstellung zu gewährleisten.
usageTranslations.es: Informe la presión barométrica actual para la elevación del campo y asegurar el ajuste correcto del altímetro.
usageTranslations.zh: 请提供机场标高的当前气压，以确保高度表设定正确。
usageTranslations.ar: يرجى إبلاغ الضغط الجوي الحالي لارتفاع المطار لضمان ضبط مقياس الارتفاع بشكل صحيح.
usageTranslations.pt: Informe a pressão barométrica atual para a elevação do aeródromo para garantir configuração correta do altímetro.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщите текущее барометрическое давление на высоте аэродрома для правильной установки высотомера.
usageTranslations.ja: 正しい高度計設定のために、飛行場標高での現在の気圧をお知らせください。
usageTranslations.it: Indicare la pressione barometrica attuale per l’elevazione del campo per garantire la corretta impostazione dell’altimetro.
usageTranslations.vi: Vui lòng thông báo áp suất khí quyển hiện tại ở độ cao sân bay để đảm bảo cài đặt cao kế đúng.
usageTranslations.hi: सही एल्टीमीटर सेटिंग के लिए क्षेत्र की ऊँचाई पर वर्तमान बैरोमेट्रिक प्रेशर बताएं।
usageTranslations.th: โปรดแจ้งความกดอากาศปัจจุบันสำหรับความสูงของสนามบิน เพื่อให้ตั้งค่ามาตรวัดความสูงได้ถูกต้อง
usageTranslations.id: Mohon informasikan tekanan barometrik saat ini pada elevasi bandara untuk memastikan pengaturan altimeter yang benar.

terms.definition: An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is higher than that of the surrounding region, often associated with stable weather, clear skies, and reduced turbulence.
terms.usage: Expect calm winds and good visibility due to a high pressure system over the region.

termTranslations.th: ความกดอากาศสูง

usageTranslations.en: Expect calm winds and good visibility due to a high pressure system over the region.
usageTranslations.tr: Bölge üzerinde yüksek basınç sistemi nedeniyle sakin rüzgarlar ve iyi görüş bekleniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Prévoir des vents calmes et une bonne visibilité en raison d’un système de haute pression sur la région.
usageTranslations.de: Erwarten Sie ruhige Winde und gute Sicht aufgrund eines Hochdruckgebiets über der Region.
usageTranslations.es: Espere vientos calmados y buena visibilidad debido a un sistema de alta presión en la región.
usageTranslations.zh: 由于该地区高气压系统，预计风平浪静且能见度良好。
usageTranslations.ar: توقع رياح هادئة ورؤية جيدة بسبب نظام ضغط مرتفع فوق المنطقة.
usageTranslations.pt: Espere ventos calmos e boa visibilidade devido a um sistema de alta pressão na região.
usageTranslations.ru: Ожидаются спокойные ветры и хорошая видимость из-за области высокого давления в регионе.
usageTranslations.ja: 地域上空の高気圧の影響で、穏やかな風と良好な視程が予想されます。
usageTranslations.it: Prevedere venti calmi e buona visibilità a causa di un sistema di alta pressione sulla regione.
usageTranslations.vi: Dự kiến gió nhẹ và tầm nhìn tốt do hệ thống áp suất cao trong khu vực.
usageTranslations.hi: क्षेत्र में उच्च दबाव प्रणाली के कारण शांत हवाएँ और अच्छी दृश्यता अपेक्षित है।
usageTranslations.th: คาดว่าจะมีลมสงบและทัศนวิสัยดีเนื่องจากระบบความกดอากาศสูงในพื้นที่
usageTranslations.id: Harapkan angin tenang dan jarak pandang baik karena sistem tekanan tinggi di wilayah tersebut.

terms.definition: An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is lower than that of the surrounding region, often associated with unsettled weather, precipitation, and potential turbulence.
terms.usage: Advise pilots of a developing low pressure system with potential turbulence along the approach path.

termTranslations.th: ความกดอากาศต่ำ

usageTranslations.en: Advise pilots of a developing low pressure system with potential turbulence along the approach path.
usageTranslations.tr: Yaklaşma hattında potansiyel türbülans ile birlikte gelişmekte olan bir alçak basınç sistemi konusunda pilotları bilgilendirin.
usageTranslations.fr: Informer les pilotes d’un système de basse pression en développement avec une turbulence potentielle le long de l’axe d’approche.
usageTranslations.de: Weisen Sie die Piloten auf ein sich entwickelndes Tiefdruckgebiet mit möglicher Turbulenz im Anflugbereich hin.
usageTranslations.es: Informe a los pilotos sobre un sistema de baja presión en desarrollo con posible turbulencia en la trayectoria de aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 通知飞行员进近航线上有正在发展的低气压系统和可能的颠簸。
usageTranslations.ar: إبلاغ الطيارين بنظام ضغط منخفض يتطور مع احتمال حدوث اضطراب على مسار الاقتراب.
usageTranslations.pt: Avisar os pilotos sobre um sistema de baixa pressão em desenvolvimento com possível turbulência na rota de aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщите пилотам о формирующейся зоне низкого давления с возможной турбулентностью по курсу захода.
usageTranslations.ja: 進入経路に沿って発達中の低気圧と乱気流の可能性についてパイロットに通知してください。
usageTranslations.it: Informare i piloti di un sistema di bassa pressione in sviluppo con potenziale turbolenza lungo la rotta di avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Thông báo cho phi công về hệ thống áp suất thấp đang phát triển với khả năng nhiễu động trên đường tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: अप्रोच मार्ग पर संभावित अशांति के साथ विकसित हो रहे निम्न दबाव प्रणाली की जानकारी पायलटों को दें।
usageTranslations.th: แจ้งนักบินถึงระบบความกดอากาศต่ำที่กำลังพัฒนาและอาจเกิดความปั่นป่วนบนเส้นทางเข้าทำการบิน
usageTranslations.id: Beritahukan pilot tentang sistem tekanan rendah yang berkembang dengan potensi turbulensi di jalur pendekatan.

terms.definition: A composite weather front formed during the process of cyclogenesis when a cold front overtakes a warm front, leading to complex weather patterns including precipitation and changes in wind direction.
terms.usage: An occluded front is moving over the area, expect variable wind and precipitation during approach.

termTranslations.th: แนวปะทะปิด

usageTranslations.en: An occluded front is moving over the area, expect variable wind and precipitation during approach.
usageTranslations.tr: Bölge üzerinde oklüzyon cephesi hareket ediyor, yaklaşmada değişken rüzgar ve yağış bekleniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Un front occlus se déplace sur la zone, attendez-vous à des vents variables et des précipitations lors de l’approche.
usageTranslations.de: Eine Okklusionsfront zieht über das Gebiet, rechnen Sie beim Anflug mit wechselnden Winden und Niederschlag.
usageTranslations.es: Un frente ocluido se desplaza sobre la zona, espere vientos variables y precipitaciones durante la aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 锢囚锋正在该地区移动，进近时预计风向多变且有降水。
usageTranslations.ar: جبهة مسدودة تتحرك فوق المنطقة، توقع رياح متغيرة وهطول أمطار أثناء الاقتراب.
usageTranslations.pt: Uma frente ocluída está se movendo sobre a área, espere vento variável e precipitação durante a aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: Окклюзионный фронт проходит над районом, ожидайте переменный ветер и осадки при заходе на посадку.
usageTranslations.ja: 閉塞前線が地域を通過中です。進入時は風向きの変化や降水に注意してください。
usageTranslations.it: Un fronte occluso si sta spostando sull’area, prevedere vento variabile e precipitazioni in avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Một rãnh hội tụ kín đang di chuyển qua khu vực, dự kiến có gió thay đổi và mưa khi tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: क्षेत्र में ओक्लूडेड फ्रंट आ रहा है, अप्रोच के दौरान बदलती हवाएं और वर्षा की अपेक्षा करें।
usageTranslations.th: แนวปะทะปิดกำลังเคลื่อนผ่านพื้นที่ คาดว่าจะมีลมแปรปรวนและฝนขณะเข้าทำการบิน
usageTranslations.id: Front okulusi bergerak melintasi area, harapkan angin berubah-ubah dan hujan saat pendekatan.

terms.definition: A boundary where a warm air mass advances and rises over a retreating cold air mass, usually resulting in steady precipitation and lower clouds along the front.
terms.usage: A warm front is forecast along the route; expect low clouds and continuous precipitation during cruise and approach.

termTranslations.th: แนวอากาศอุ่น

usageTranslations.en: A warm front is forecast along the route; expect low clouds and continuous precipitation during cruise and approach.
usageTranslations.tr: Rota boyunca sıcak cephe tahmin ediliyor; seyir ve yaklaşmada alçak bulutlar ve sürekli yağış bekleniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Un front chaud est prévu le long de la route ; attendez-vous à des nuages bas et à des précipitations continues en croisière et à l’approche.
usageTranslations.de: Eine Warmfront wird entlang der Route vorhergesagt; erwarten Sie tiefe Wolken und anhaltenden Niederschlag während Reiseflug und Anflug.
usageTranslations.es: Se pronostica un frente cálido a lo largo de la ruta; espere nubes bajas y precipitaciones continuas durante el crucero y la aproximación.
usageTranslations.zh: 预计航线上有暖锋，巡航和进近阶段将有低云和持续降水。
usageTranslations.ar: من المتوقع وجود جبهة دافئة على طول الطريق؛ توقع غيوم منخفضة وهطول أمطار مستمر أثناء الرحلة والاقتراب.
usageTranslations.pt: Prevê-se uma frente quente ao longo da rota; espere nuvens baixas e precipitação contínua durante o cruzeiro e a aproximação.
usageTranslations.ru: На маршруте прогнозируется тёплый фронт; ожидаются низкая облачность и продолжительные осадки во время маршрута и захода.
usageTranslations.ja: 航路上に温暖前線が予想されます。巡航および進入中は低い雲と連続した降水が予想されます。
usageTranslations.it: È previsto un fronte caldo lungo la rotta; attendersi nubi basse e precipitazioni continue durante la crociera e l’avvicinamento.
usageTranslations.vi: Dự báo có rãnh nóng trên đường bay; dự kiến mây thấp và mưa liên tục khi bay hành trình và tiếp cận.
usageTranslations.hi: रूट पर वार्म फ्रंट का पूर्वानुमान है; क्रूज और अप्रोच के दौरान नीचे बादल और लगातार वर्षा की अपेक्षा करें।
usageTranslations.th: คาดการณ์แนวอากาศอุ่นตลอดเส้นทาง คาดว่าจะมีเมฆต่ำและฝนต่อเนื่องระหว่างบินและเข้าทำการบิน
usageTranslations.id: Diperkirakan ada front hangat di sepanjang rute; harapkan awan rendah dan hujan terus-menerus selama jelajah dan pendekatan.

terms.definition: A weather front where a cold air mass advances and displaces a warmer air mass, often producing showers, thunderstorms, and abrupt changes in wind and temperature.
terms.usage: A cold front is approaching from the northwest; expect wind shift, showers, and possible thunderstorms along the route.

termTranslations.th: แนวอากาศเย็น

usageTranslations.en: A cold front is approaching from the northwest; expect wind shift, showers, and possible thunderstorms along the route.
usageTranslations.tr: Kuzeybatıdan bir soğuk cephe yaklaşıyor; rota boyunca rüzgar değişimi, sağanak ve olası fırtınalar bekleniyor.
usageTranslations.fr: Un front froid approche du nord-ouest ; attendez-vous à un changement de vent, des averses et des orages possibles le long de la route.
usageTranslations.de: Eine Kaltfront nähert sich aus Nordwesten; rechnen Sie entlang der Route mit Winddrehung, Schauern und möglichen Gewittern.
usageTranslations.es: Un frente frío se aproxima desde el noroeste; espere cambios de viento, chubascos y posibles tormentas en la ruta.
usageTranslations.zh: 一股冷锋正从西北方向逼近，预计航线上将有风向变化、阵雨和可能的雷暴。
usageTranslations.ar: جبهة باردة تقترب من الشمال الغربي؛ توقع تغيير الرياح وهطول أمطار وعواصف رعدية محتملة على طول المسار.
usageTranslations.pt: Uma frente fria se aproxima do noroeste; espere mudança de vento, chuvas e possíveis tempestades ao longo da rota.
usageTranslations.ru: Северо-запада приближается холодный фронт; ожидайте смену ветра, ливни и возможные грозы по маршруту.
usageTranslations.ja: 北西から寒冷前線が接近中です。進路上では風向きの変化、にわか雨、および雷雨の可能性があります。
usageTranslations.it: Un fronte freddo si sta avvicinando da nord-ovest; attendersi cambiamento del vento, rovesci e possibili temporali lungo la rotta.
usageTranslations.vi: Một rãnh lạnh đang tiến gần từ phía tây bắc; dự kiến có chuyển hướng gió, mưa rào và có thể có giông dọc đường bay.
usageTranslations.hi: उत्तर-पश्चिम से कोल्ड फ्रंट आ रहा है; रूट पर हवा बदलने, बारिश और संभावित तूफानों की अपेक्षा करें।
usageTranslations.th: แนวอากาศเย็นกำลังเข้ามาจากทางตะวันตกเฉียงเหนือ คาดว่าจะมีลมเปลี่ยนทิศ ฝนตก และอาจมีพายุฝนฟ้าคะนองระหว่างเส้นทาง
usageTranslations.id: Front dingin mendekat dari barat laut; harapkan perubahan angin, hujan, dan kemungkinan badai petir di sepanjang rute.

terms.definition: A weather chart depicting current meteorological features such as pressure systems, fronts, and precipitation areas at the Earth's surface; essential for flight planning and enroute weather briefing.
terms.usage: Before departure, review the latest surface analysis chart for updated positions of pressure systems and frontal boundaries.

termTranslations.vi: Bản đồ phân tích bề mặt
termTranslations.th: แผนภูมิการวิเคราะห์พื้นผิว

usageTranslations.en: Before departure, review the latest surface analysis chart for updated positions of pressure systems and frontal boundaries.
usageTranslations.tr: Kalkıştan önce, basınç sistemleri ve cephelerin güncel konumları için en son yüzey analiz haritasını inceleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Avant le départ, consultez la dernière carte d’analyse de surface pour les positions mises à jour des systèmes de pression et des frontières frontales.
usageTranslations.de: Überprüfen Sie vor dem Abflug die aktuelle Bodenanalysekarte auf die neuesten Positionen der Drucksysteme und Fronten.
usageTranslations.es: Antes de la salida, revise la carta de análisis de superficie más reciente para posiciones actualizadas de sistemas de presión y frentes.
usageTranslations.zh: 起飞前请查看最新的地面分析图，以了解压力系统和锋区的最新位置。
usageTranslations.ar: قبل الإقلاع، راجع أحدث خريطة لتحليل السطح لمعرفة مواقع أنظمة الضغط والحدود الجبهية المحدثة.
usageTranslations.pt: Antes da partida, revise a carta de análise de superfície mais recente para posições atualizadas de sistemas de pressão e frentes.
usageTranslations.ru: Перед вылетом ознакомьтесь с последней картой приземного анализа для актуальных позиций барических систем и фронтов.
usageTranslations.ja: 出発前に最新の地上解析図で気圧系や前線の位置を確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Prima della partenza, consultare la più recente carta di analisi superficiale per le posizioni aggiornate dei sistemi di pressione e dei fronti.
usageTranslations.vi: Trước khi khởi hành, hãy xem bản đồ phân tích bề mặt mới nhất để biết vị trí cập nhật của các hệ thống áp suất và rãnh thời tiết.
usageTranslations.hi: प्रस्थान से पहले, दबाव प्रणालियों और फ्रंट की अद्यतित स्थितियों के लिए नवीनतम सतही विश्लेषण चार्ट देखें।
usageTranslations.th: ก่อนออกเดินทางให้ตรวจสอบแผนภูมิการวิเคราะห์พื้นผิวล่าสุดเพื่อดูตำแหน่งของระบบความกดอากาศและแนวปะทะที่อัปเดต
usageTranslations.id: Sebelum keberangkatan, tinjau peta analisis permukaan terbaru untuk posisi sistem tekanan dan batas front yang terbaru.

terms.definition: A weather chart produced by meteorological authorities that forecasts the expected positions of pressure systems, fronts, and significant weather for a specified future time.
terms.usage: Review the prognostic chart for your route to anticipate forecasted frontal positions and areas of significant weather.

termTranslations.th: แผนภูมิพยากรณ์อากาศ

usageTranslations.en: Review the prognostic chart for your route to anticipate forecasted frontal positions and areas of significant weather.
usageTranslations.tr: Rota üzerindeki tahmini cephe konumları ve önemli hava olaylarını öngörmek için prognostik haritayı inceleyin.
usageTranslations.fr: Consultez la carte de prévision pour anticiper les positions des fronts et les zones de temps significatif sur votre route.
usageTranslations.de: Überprüfen Sie die Prognosekarte für Ihre Route, um vorhergesagte Frontlagen und bedeutende Wetterbereiche zu erkennen.
usageTranslations.es: Revise la carta de pronóstico para anticipar las posiciones de frentes y áreas de tiempo significativo en su ruta.
usageTranslations.zh: 查看航线的预报图以提前了解锋区和重要天气区域。
usageTranslations.ar: راجع خريطة التوقعات لمسارك لتوقع مواقع الجبهات ومناطق الطقس الهام.
usageTranslations.pt: Revise a carta prognóstica para sua rota a fim de antecipar posições de frentes e áreas de tempo significativo.
usageTranslations.ru: Ознакомьтесь с прогностической картой маршрута для прогнозирования положения фронтов и значимых погодных зон.
usageTranslations.ja: ルート上の予想前線や重要な気象エリアを予測するため、予報図を確認してください。
usageTranslations.it: Consultare la carta prognostica della rotta per prevedere le posizioni dei fronti e le aree di tempo significativo.
usageTranslations.vi: Xem bản đồ dự báo tuyến bay để dự đoán vị trí rãnh và vùng thời tiết quan trọng.
usageTranslations.hi: अपने मार्ग के लिए पूर्वानुमान चार्ट की समीक्षा करें ताकि पूर्वानुमानित फ्रंट और महत्वपूर्ण मौसम क्षेत्रों का अनुमान लगाया जा सके।
usageTranslations.th: ตรวจสอบแผนภูมิพยากรณ์สำหรับเส้นทางของคุณเพื่อคาดการณ์ตำแหน่งแนวปะทะและพื้นที่อากาศสำคัญที่คาดการณ์ไว้
usageTranslations.id: Tinjau peta prakiraan untuk rute Anda guna mengantisipasi posisi front yang diperkirakan dan area cuaca signifikan.

terms.definition: A meteorological chart that displays forecasted significant weather phenomena, including turbulence, icing, and cumulonimbus clouds, relevant for flight safety at specific flight levels.
terms.usage: Consult the significant weather chart for reports of turbulence and icing hazards along your assigned route.

termTranslations.ja: シグニフィカントウェザー図
termTranslations.vi: Bản đồ thời tiết quan trọng
termTranslations.th: แผนภูมิอากาศสำคัญ

usageTranslations.en: Consult the significant weather chart for reports of turbulence and icing hazards along your assigned route.
usageTranslations.tr: Atanan rotanız boyunca türbülans ve buzlanma tehlikeleri için önemli hava durumu haritasına bakın.
usageTranslations.fr: Consultez la carte de temps significatif pour les rapports de turbulences et de risques de givrage sur votre route assignée.
usageTranslations.de: Prüfen Sie die Wetterkarte für signifikante Wettererscheinungen auf Turbulenz- und Vereisungsgefahren entlang Ihrer zugewiesenen Route.
usageTranslations.es: Consulte la carta de tiempo significativo para los informes de turbulencia y riesgos de engelamiento en su ruta asignada.
usageTranslations.zh: 查阅重要天气图，了解指定航线上的颠簸和结冰风险。
usageTranslations.ar: راجع خريطة الطقس الهام للتقارير عن المطبات ومخاطر الجليد على طول المسار المخصص.
usageTranslations.pt: Consulte a carta de tempo significativo para informações sobre turbulência e perigos de gelo ao longo de sua rota atribuída.
usageTranslations.ru: Изучите карту значимой погоды для информации о турбулентности и обледенении на вашем маршруте.
usageTranslations.ja: 割り当てられた航路上の乱気流や着氷の危険については、シグニフィカントウェザー図を参照してください。
usageTranslations.it: Consultare la carta del tempo significativo per segnalazioni di turbolenza e rischi di formazione di ghiaccio lungo la rotta assegnata.
usageTranslations.vi: Tham khảo bản đồ thời tiết quan trọng để biết các báo cáo về nhiễu động và nguy cơ đóng băng trên tuyến đường được phân công.
usageTranslations.hi: निर्धारित मार्ग पर टरब्यूलेंस और बर्फबारी के खतरों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण मौसम चार्ट देखें।
usageTranslations.th: โปรดดูแผนภูมิอากาศสำคัญสำหรับรายงานเกี่ยวกับความปั่นป่วนและอันตรายจากน้ำแข็งตามเส้นทางที่ได้รับมอบหมาย
usageTranslations.id: Konsultasikan peta cuaca signifikan untuk laporan turbulensi dan bahaya es di sepanjang rute yang ditugaskan Anda.

terms.definition: A meteorological report providing forecasted wind direction, wind speed, and temperature at specific altitudes above mean sea level, used for flight planning and fuel calculations.
terms.usage: Request latest wind and temperature aloft message for flight level three four zero before departure.

termTranslations.fr: Message de Vent et Température en Altitude
termTranslations.de: Wind- und Temperaturmeldung in der Höhe
termTranslations.es: Mensaje de Viento y Temperatura en Altitud
termTranslations.ar: رسالة الرياح ودرجة الحرارة على الارتفاع
termTranslations.pt: Mensagem de Vento e Temperatura em Altitude
termTranslations.ru: Сообщение о ветре и температуре на высоте
termTranslations.ja: 上空の風と気温メッセージ
termTranslations.it: Messaggio di Vento e Temperatura in Quota
termTranslations.vi: Thông báo gió và nhiệt độ trên cao
termTranslations.hi: ऊंचाई पर हवा और तापमान संदेश
termTranslations.th: ข้อความลมและอุณหภูมิในระดับสูง
termTranslations.id: Pesan Angin dan Suhu di Ketinggian

usageTranslations.en: Request latest wind and temperature aloft message for flight level three four zero before departure.
usageTranslations.tr: Kalkıştan önce uçuş seviyesi üç dört sıfır için en güncel yüksekteki rüzgar ve sıcaklık mesajını talep ediyorum.
usageTranslations.fr: Demande le dernier message de vent et température en altitude pour le niveau de vol trois-quatre-zéro avant le départ.
usageTranslations.de: Bitte vor dem Abflug die aktuelle Wind- und Temperaturmeldung in der Höhe für Flugfläche drei-vier-null anfordern.
usageTranslations.es: Solicito el mensaje más reciente de viento y temperatura en altitud para nivel de vuelo tres cuatro cero antes de la salida.
usageTranslations.zh: 起飞前请求三四零飞行高度的最新高空风与温度信息。
usageTranslations.ar: أطلب أحدث رسالة رياح ودرجة حرارة على ارتفاع مستوى الطيران ثلاثة أربعة صفر قبل الإقلاع.
usageTranslations.pt: Solicito a mensagem mais recente de vento e temperatura em altitude para o nível de voo três quatro zero antes da partida.
usageTranslations.ru: Запрашиваю последнее сообщение о ветре и температуре на высоте эшелона три четыре ноль перед вылетом.
usageTranslations.ja: 出発前にフライトレベル340の上空の風と気温の最新メッセージをリクエストします。
usageTranslations.it: Richiedo l’ultimo messaggio di vento e temperatura in quota per livello di volo tre quattro zero prima della partenza.
usageTranslations.vi: Yêu cầu thông báo mới nhất về gió và nhiệt độ trên cao cho FL340 trước khi khởi hành.
usageTranslations.hi: प्रस्थान से पहले फ्लाइट लेवल तीन चार शून्य के लिए नवीनतम ऊंचाई पर हवा और तापमान संदेश अनुरोध करें।
usageTranslations.th: ขอข้อความลมและอุณหภูมิในระดับสูงล่าสุดสำหรับระดับการบินสามสี่ศูนย์ก่อนออกเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Mohon pesan terbaru angin dan suhu di ketinggian untuk flight level tiga empat nol sebelum keberangkatan.

terms.definition: A specific altitude or flight level at which temperature changes are forecast to be significant for flight operations, affecting aircraft performance, icing risk, or fuel management.
terms.usage: Report any observed deviation from the forecast at the significant temperature level during cruise.

termTranslations.ja: シグニフィカント気温層
termTranslations.th: ระดับอุณหภูมิสำคัญ

usageTranslations.en: Report any observed deviation from the forecast at the significant temperature level during cruise.
usageTranslations.tr: Seyir sırasında önemli sıcaklık seviyesinde tahminden sapma gözlenirse rapor edin.
usageTranslations.fr: Signalez toute déviation observée par rapport aux prévisions au niveau de température significatif en croisière.
usageTranslations.de: Melden Sie jede beobachtete Abweichung von der Vorhersage auf signifikantem Temperaturniveau während des Reiseflugs.
usageTranslations.es: Informe cualquier desviación observada del pronóstico en el nivel de temperatura significativo durante el crucero.
usageTranslations.zh: 巡航期间如在重要温度层发现与预报不符的情况请报告。
usageTranslations.ar: أبلغ عن أي انحراف ملحوظ عن التوقعات عند مستوى درجة الحرارة الهام أثناء الرحلة.
usageTranslations.pt: Informe qualquer desvio observado da previsão no nível de temperatura significativo durante o cruzeiro.
usageTranslations.ru: Сообщайте о любых замеченных отклонениях от прогноза на значимом температурном уровне во время круиза.
usageTranslations.ja: 巡航中にシグニフィカント気温層で予報と異なる場合は報告してください。
usageTranslations.it: Segnalare qualsiasi scostamento osservato dalle previsioni al livello di temperatura significativo durante la crociera.
usageTranslations.vi: Báo cáo mọi sai lệch so với dự báo ở mức nhiệt độ quan trọng trong chuyến bay hành trình.
usageTranslations.hi: क्रूज के दौरान महत्वपूर्ण तापमान स्तर पर किसी भी पूर्वानुमान विचलन की सूचना दें।
usageTranslations.th: รายงานความเบี่ยงเบนที่สังเกตได้จากการพยากรณ์ที่ระดับอุณหภูมิสำคัญระหว่างเดินทาง
usageTranslations.id: Laporkan setiap penyimpangan yang diamati dari prakiraan pada level suhu signifikan selama jelajah.

terms.definition: A graphic symbol used on meteorological charts to represent wind speed and direction at a specific location and altitude, typically shown as a shaft with barbs and pennants.
terms.usage: Interpret wind barbs on the upper-air chart to determine wind speed and direction at flight level two zero zero.

termTranslations.th: ขีดบอกทิศลม

usageTranslations.en: Interpret wind barbs on the upper-air chart to determine wind speed and direction at flight level two zero zero.
usageTranslations.tr: Uçuş seviyesi iki sıfır sıfırda rüzgar hızı ve yönünü belirlemek için üst seviye haritada rüzgar çıvgınlarını yorumlayın.
usageTranslations.fr: Interprétez les barbules de vent sur la carte d’altitude supérieure pour déterminer la vitesse et la direction du vent au niveau de vol deux zéro zéro.
usageTranslations.de: Interpretieren Sie Windfedern auf der Höhenkarte, um Windgeschwindigkeit und -richtung auf Flugfläche zwei-null-null zu bestimmen.
usageTranslations.es: Interprete las barbillas de viento en la carta de altura para determinar la velocidad y dirección del viento en el nivel de vuelo dos cero cero.
usageTranslations.zh: 在高空图上解读风羽符号，以确定飞行高度二零零的风速和风向。
usageTranslations.ar: فسر ريشة الرياح على خريطة الجو العلوي لتحديد سرعة واتجاه الرياح على مستوى الطيران اثنين صفر صفر.
